crates.name: apsis-core
crates.summary:
Shared foundation types for the ApsisRS workspace: a general purpose
error type, result aliases, physical constants, and the unit marker
trait.

This crate sits at the bottom of the dependency graph. It has no
dependency on any other ApsisRS crate, so every other crate may use it.

Three concerns live here:

- [`Error`] and [`Result`] are a general purpose error carrying a coarse
  [`ErrorKind`]. They exist so that a function whose failure has no
  interesting structure can report it without inventing a type, and so
  that the workspace has a shape to fall back on. They are deliberately
  *not* the error type of the layers: a layer with a domain specific
  failure defines its own `Error` and `ErrorKind`, whose variants name
  the concrete conditions a caller would want to match on. See
  `docs/design/errors.md` for why, and for the conventions the domain
  errors follow.
- [`constant`] holds physical and astronomical constants expressed in
  SI units.
- [`Quantity`] marks newtypes that carry a physical unit, so generic
  code can accept any quantity and still recover its unit type.
crates.summary_zh:
ApsisRS 工作区共享的基础类型：一个通用错误类型、结果别名、物理常量，以及
单位标记 trait。

本 crate 位于依赖图的底部。它不依赖任何其他 ApsisRS crate，故其余每个
crate 都可以使用它。

这里有三件事：

- [`Error`] 与 [`Result`] 是携带粗糙 [`ErrorKind`] 的通用错误。它们存在，
  是为了让失败没有有趣结构的函数无需发明一个类型即可报告它，也是为了让
  工作区有一个可退守的形状。它们有意地*不是*各层的错误类型：具有领域
  特定失败的一层会定义自己的 `Error` 与 `ErrorKind`，其变体指名调用方
  想要匹配的具体情形。原因以及各领域错误遵循的约定见
  `docs/design/errors.md`。
- [`constant`] 保存以 SI 单位表达的物理与天文常量。
- [`Quantity`] 标记携带有物理单位的 newtype，使泛型代码可以接受任何量
  并仍能恢复其单位类型。

items.name: SPEED_OF_LIGHT
items.doc:
Speed of light in vacuum, in meters per second.

Exact by definition of the metre in the SI.

items.doc_zh:
牛顿万有引力常数，单位为立方米每千克每二次方秒。

CODATA 2018 推荐值，标准不确定度为 `1.5e-11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2`。

items.doc:
One day of 24 hours, in seconds.

J2000.0 历元与 Unix 历元之间的秒数。

items.name: EARTH_MU
items.doc:
Earth gravitational parameter, in cubic kilometers per second squared.

WGS 84 value, `GM = 398 600.4418 km^3/s^2`, with an uncertainty that is
dominated by the uncertainty in the Newtonian constant of gravitation.
Orbit propagation uses kilometers, so the value is given in those units
rather than in SI.

地球引力参数，单位为立方千米每二次方秒。

WGS 84 取值 `GM = 398 600.4418 km^3/s^2`，其不确定度主要来自牛顿万有引力常数的
不确定度。轨道传播使用千米，故该值以千米给出而非 SI 单位。

items.name: EARTH_EQUATORIAL_RADIUS
items.doc:

items.doc_zh:
地球赤道半径，单位为千米。

WGS 84 半长轴，`a = 6 378.137 km`。

items.name: EARTH_FLATTENING
items.doc:
Earth flattening, dimensionless.

WGS 84 value, `f = 1 / 298.257 223 563`.

items.name: EARTH_ROTATION_RATE

items.doc_zh:
WGS 84 取值，即地球的名义平均角速度，
`omega = 7.292 115e-5 rad/s`。

items.name: EARTH_J2
items.doc:

WGS 84 value, `J2 = 1.082 626 683e-3`.

items.name: STANDARD_ATMOSPHERE

标准大气海平面气压，单位为帕斯卡。

由标准大气的定义精确确定。

items.name: ZERO_CELSIUS_IN_KELVIN

items.name: ErrorKind
items.doc:
The category of an [`Error`].

The variants are grouped by the layer that most often produces them, but
any layer may return any variant. Callers should match on the variant
that is relevant to their own recovery logic and treat the rest as
opaque.

The error type used across the workspace.

`Error` carries a machine matchable [`ErrorKind`] plus a human readable
message. An optional source records the lower level error that caused
this one.

工作区使用的错误类型。

items.name: Unit
items.signature: pub trait Unit: Copy + fmt::Debug + fmt::Display + 'static {
items.doc:
A unit of a single physical dimension.

Implementors are zero sized marker types. Two units that implement
`Unit` for the same dimension convert through
[`Quantity::to_unit`](crate::Quantity::to_unit).
items.doc_zh:
单一物理量纲的单位。

实现者是零尺寸标记类型。对同一量纲实现 `Unit` 的两个单位经
[`Quantity::to_unit`](crate::Quantity::to_unit) 换算。

items.name: Quantity
items.doc:
A value paired with a unit.

Implementors are newtypes over `f64` and a [`Unit`]. The trait gives
generic code access to the stored value and its unit without assuming
which newtype it was handed.
items.doc_zh:
与单位配对的一个数值。

实现者是包装 `f64` 与 [`Unit`] 的 newtype。该 trait 使泛型代码能访问所存的
值与其单位，而不假定所接到的是哪个 newtype。

crates.name: apsis-units
crates.summary:
Strongly typed newtypes for physical quantities.

Each quantity is a newtype over `f64` that carries its unit in the type
system, so a length cannot be passed where a duration is expected. Units
of the same dimension convert through
[`Quantity::to_unit`], and each unit also
offers direct conversions for the common cases.
crates.summary_zh:
物理量的强类型 newtype。

每个量都是 `f64` 上的 newtype，并把单位带进类型系统，因此长度无法被传到
需要时长的位置。同一量纲的单位通过 [`Quantity::to_unit`] 换算，每个单位
另外为常见情形提供直接换算。

A newtype implements both [`Unit`] and [`Quantity`], with its own type as
the associated unit. For example [`Meters`] is a [`Length`](dimension::Length)
unit and a quantity whose unit is itself.

The dimensions covered here are length, time, frequency, angle, and
thermodynamic temperature. Temperature is the only affine scale in the
set, so Celsius is handled by explicit methods on [`Kelvin`] rather than
by the linear [`Unit`] conversion factor.

一个 newtype 同时实现 [`Unit`] 与 [`Quantity`]，并以自身类型作为关联单位。
例如 [`Meters`] 既是一个 [`Length`](dimension::Length) 单位，也是单位为
自身的量。

此处覆盖的量纲为长度、时间、频率、角度与热力学温度。温度是集合中唯一的
仿射标度，因此摄氏度由 [`Kelvin`] 上的显式方法处理，而不用 [`Unit`] 的
线性换算因子。

```
use apsis_core::Quantity;
use apsis_units::{Kilometers, Meters};

let distance = Meters::new(2_500.0);
let in_kilometers: Kilometers = distance.to_unit();
assert!((in_kilometers.value() - 2.5).abs() < 1e-12);
```

crates.name: apsis-math
crates.summary:
Dependency-free linear algebra for the ApsisRS workspace.

The crate provides three types:

- [`Vec3`], a three component column vector over `f64`
- [`Quat`], a unit quaternion used for rotations
- [`Mat3`], a three by three matrix stored in column-major order

The types are plain data with no interior invariants beyond those
documented on each method, so their fields are public and a value can be
built by struct literal expression. Operations that are mathematically
undefined for some inputs, such as normalizing the zero vector, return
[`Option`] instead of panicking or producing a non-finite result.

All rotations use the right-hand rule about the given axis, and all
angles are in radians. Angles are not wrapped on input; methods that
require a canonical range document that requirement.

```
use apsis_math::Vec3;

let x = Vec3::new(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
let y = Vec3::new(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
let z = x.cross(y);
assert_eq!(z, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
```
crates.summary_zh:
ApsisRS 工作区无依赖的线性代数。

本 crate 提供三种类型：

- [`Vec3`]，基于 `f64` 的三分量列矢量
- [`Quat`]，用于转动的单位四元数
- [`Mat3`]，按列主序存储的三阶矩阵

这些类型是纯数据，除各方法上所述外没有内部不变量，故其字段是公开的，
值可由结构体字面量表达式构建。对某些输入在数学上未定义的操作（如把零
矢量归一化）返回 [`Option`]，而不 panic 或产生非有限结果。

所有转动都绕给定轴采用右手定则，所有角度都以弧度计。输入时角度不进行
环绕；要求取规范区间的方法会说明该要求。

items.name: Mat3
items.doc:
A three by three matrix stored in column-major order.

The field names follow the `m<row><column>` convention, so `m01` is the
entry in the first row and second column. The fields are listed in
column-major order, and the same order is used by [`Mat3::from_columns`]
and [`Mat3::column`].
items.doc_zh:
按列主序存储的三乘三矩阵。

字段名遵循 `m<行><列>` 约定，故 `m01` 是第一行第二列的元素。字段按列主序
列出，[`Mat3::from_columns`] 与 [`Mat3::column`] 使用同样的顺序。

items.doc: The zero matrix.
items.doc_zh: 零矩阵。

items.name: IDENTITY
items.doc: The identity matrix.

Creates a matrix from its nine entries in row-major order.

The arguments are grouped by row: `row0`, then `row1`, then `row2`.
items.doc_zh:

参数按行分组：先 `row0`，再 `row1`，最后 `row2`。

items.signature: pub const fn from_columns(c0: Vec3, c1: Vec3, c2: Vec3) -> Self {

Creates a rotation matrix from a unit quaternion.

The quaternion is assumed to have unit length. A non-unit quaternion

Returns `None` when the axis has zero or non-finite length.

items.signature: pub const fn column(self, index: usize) -> Option<Vec3> {
items.doc:
Returns column `index`.

Returns `None` when `index` is outside `0..=2`.
items.doc_zh:
返回第 `index` 列。

`index` 超出 `0..=2` 时返回 `None`。

items.name: row
items.signature: pub const fn row(self, index: usize) -> Option<Vec3> {
items.doc:
Returns row `index`.

Returns `None` when `index` is outside `0..=2`.
items.doc_zh:
返回第 `index` 行。

`index` 超出 `0..=2` 时返回 `None`。

items.name: transpose
items.doc: Returns the transpose.
items.doc_zh: 返回转置。

items.name: trace
items.doc: Returns the sum of the diagonal entries.
items.doc_zh: 返回对角元素之和。

items.name: determinant
items.doc: Returns the determinant.
items.doc_zh: 返回行列式。

items.name: is_rotation
items.signature: pub fn is_rotation(self, tolerance: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when this matrix is a rotation within `tolerance`.

A matrix is a rotation when it is orthonormal with determinant one.
The check compares `M^T M` to the identity entry by entry and then
compares the determinant to one.
items.doc_zh:
当该矩阵在 `tolerance` 内为旋转矩阵时返回 `true`。

正交且行列式为一的矩阵即旋转矩阵。该检查逐元素比较 `M^T M` 与单位
矩阵，然后把行列式与一比较。

items.name: is_finite
items.doc: Returns `true` when all nine entries are finite.
items.doc_zh: 当九个元素都有限时返回 `true`。

items.name: thread_count
items.doc:
The number of threads to use for a piece of work.

This is the machine's parallelism as reported by the standard library, at
least one. It is the number the callers use to decide whether a parallel
run is worth starting.
items.doc_zh:
某项工作应使用的线程数。

这是标准库报告的机器并行度，至少为一。调用方据此决定并行运行是否值得启动。

items.name: threads_for
items.doc:
The number of threads that should run a loop over `len` items.

A loop shorter than the thread count would leave most threads with nothing
to do while still paying to start them, so this returns one thread until
there is enough work for a second. The threshold is a per item cost of
roughly a microsecond, below which starting a thread cannot pay for
itself.
items.doc_zh:
对 `len` 个元素的循环应使用的线程数。

比线程数还短的循环会让多数线程无所事事，却仍要付出启动代价，因此在工作量
足以分给第二个线程之前本函数返回一个线程。阈值是每项约一微秒的开销，低于
此值启动线程无法收回成本。

items.name: for_each_index
items.signature: pub fn for_each_index<F>(len: usize, operation: F) where F: Fn(usize) + Sync, {
items.doc:
Runs a closure once for each index of a range, spread over several threads.

The range is split into one contiguous chunk per thread and each thread
runs the closure for the indices in its chunk. The closure may be called
from any thread, so it must be `Send` and `Sync`; anything it captures is
shared rather than copied. The call returns only after every thread has
finished, so the data the closure wrote is safe to read afterwards.

The closure is handed the index rather than the element, which keeps the
signature independent of the collection: the caller reads the input and
writes the output itself, and the two never overlap.

# Panics

If the closure panics, the panic is resumed on the calling thread after
the other threads have been joined, so a failure surfaces at the call
rather than in a detached thread.
items.doc_zh:
对一段范围内的每个下标各调用一次闭包，分摊到多个线程上执行。

该范围被切分为每线程一段连续区间，每个线程对落在自己区间内的下标调用闭包。
闭包可能在任意线程上被调用，故必须是 `Send` 与 `Sync`；它捕获的数据是被共享
而非复制的。本次调用只有在全部线程结束后才返回，因此闭包写入的数据此后可安全
读取。

闭包收到的是下标而非元素，这让签名与具体集合无关：调用方自行读取输入并
写出输出，两者不会重叠。

# Panics

若闭包发生 panic，该 panic 会在其它线程 join 之后于调用线程上重新抛出，
因此失败出现在调用处，而不是某个已分离的线程中。

items.name: map_index
items.signature: pub fn map_index<T, F>(len: usize, operation: F) -> Vec<T> where T: Send, F: Fn(usize) -> T + Sync, {
items.doc:
Collects one value for each index of a range, spread over several threads.

This is [`for_each_index`] for the common case where the result of the
work is a value rather than a write into a shared array. The output is
returned in index order regardless of which thread produced which element,
so it does not depend on the scheduling.

The closure is handed the index and returns the value for that index. As
with [`for_each_index`], it may run on any thread, so captured data must be
`Sync`.
items.doc_zh:
为一段范围内的每个下标各收集一个值，分摊到多个线程上执行。

当工作的结果是值而非写入共享数组时，本函数是 [`for_each_index`] 的对应形式。
输出按下标顺序返回，与哪个线程产生了哪个元素无关，故不依赖调度。

闭包收到下标并返回该下标对应的值。与 [`for_each_index`] 一样，它可能在任意
线程上运行，故捕获的数据必须为 `Sync`。

items.name: Quat
items.doc:
A quaternion `w + xi + yj + zk`.

Methods that rotate vectors assume the quaternion has unit length.
Multiplication and addition do not, because arbitrary quaternion
arithmetic is well defined without that assumption. Use
[`Quat::normalize`] to enforce unit length, and
[`Quat::is_normalized`] to check it.

A rotation by angle `theta` about a unit axis `u` is
`w = cos(theta / 2)`, `(x, y, z) = u * sin(theta / 2)`. Composition uses
the same convention as matrix multiplication: `(a * b)` applied to a
vector applies `b` first, then `a`.
items.doc_zh:
四元数 `w + xi + yj + zk`。

旋转向量的方法假定该四元数为单位长度。乘法与加法则不然，因为任意四元数
运算在该假定下同样有良好定义。用 [`Quat::normalize`] 归一到单位长度，用
[`Quat::is_normalized`] 检查。

绕单位轴 `u` 旋转 `theta` 的四元数为
`w = cos(theta / 2)`、`(x, y, z) = u * sin(theta / 2)`。复合采用与矩阵
乘法相同的约定：`(a * b)` 作用于向量时先作用 `b`，再作用 `a`。

items.name: IDENTITY
items.doc: The identity rotation.
items.doc_zh: 恒等旋转。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(w: f64, x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a quaternion from its four components.
items.doc_zh: 由四个分量创建四元数。

items.name: from_mat3
items.doc:
Creates a quaternion from the rotation matrix `m`.

The algorithm picks the largest diagonal entry to divide by, which
keeps the square root well conditioned for every input rotation.
Returns `None` when `m` is not a rotation matrix, that is when it is
not orthonormal with determinant one within a tolerance of `1e-9`.
items.doc_zh:
由旋转矩阵 `m` 创建四元数。

算法选取对角线上最大的元素作除数，从而对任何输入旋转都保持开方的良态。
当 `m` 不是旋转矩阵时返回 `None`，即在 `1e-9` 的容差内不正交或行列式
不为一。

items.name: vector
items.doc: Returns the vector part `(x, y, z)`.
items.doc_zh: 返回向量部分 `(x, y, z)`。

items.name: norm_squared
items.doc: Returns the squared length of this quaternion.
items.doc_zh: 返回该四元数的长度平方。

items.name: norm
items.doc: Returns the length of this quaternion.
items.doc_zh: 返回该四元数的长度。

items.name: normalize
items.doc:
Returns this quaternion scaled to unit length.

Returns `None` when the length is zero or not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回该四元数缩放到单位长度后的结果。

长度为零或非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: conjugate
items.doc:
Returns the conjugate `w - xi - yj - zk`.

For a unit quaternion this is the inverse rotation.
items.doc_zh:
返回共轭 `w - xi - yj - zk`。

对单位四元数，它即逆旋转。

items.name: inverse
items.doc:
Returns the inverse rotation.

Returns `None` when the length is zero or not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回逆旋转。

长度为零或非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: dot
items.signature: pub fn dot(self, rhs: Self) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the dot product of `self` and `rhs`, treating both as four
component vectors.
items.doc_zh: 把两者都视为四分量向量，返回 `self` 与 `rhs` 的点积。

items.name: rotate
items.signature: pub fn rotate(self, v: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
items.doc:
Rotates `v` by this rotation.

Assumes this quaternion has unit length. The rotation is computed as
`v + 2 * cross(vector, cross(vector, v) + w * v)`, which avoids
forming the quaternion product matrix twice.
items.doc_zh:
用该旋转对 `v` 施以旋转。

假定该四元数为单位长度。旋转按
`v + 2 * cross(vector, cross(vector, v) + w * v)` 计算，避免两次构造
四元数乘积矩阵。

items.name: angle
items.doc:
Returns the rotation angle in radians, in `[0, pi]`.

Assumes this quaternion has unit length.
items.doc_zh:
返回旋转角，单位为弧度，位于 `[0, pi]`。

假定该四元数为单位长度。

items.name: axis
items.doc:
Returns the rotation axis as a unit vector.

Returns `None` for the identity rotation, where no axis is defined.
Assumes this quaternion has unit length.
items.doc_zh:
返回旋转轴的单位向量。

对恒等旋转返回 `None`，因为此时旋转轴未定义。假定该四元数为单位长度。

items.name: lerp
items.signature: pub fn lerp(self, rhs: Self, t: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns the linear interpolation from `self` to `rhs`.

This is a chord interpolation, so the result is not a unit
quaternion and the angular speed is not constant. Use
[`Quat::slerp`] when the intermediate rotations must be uniform.
items.doc_zh:
返回从 `self` 到 `rhs` 的线性插值。

这是弦插值，故结果不是单位四元数，角速度也不恒定。当中间旋转必须均匀时
请用 [`Quat::slerp`]。

items.name: slerp
items.signature: pub fn slerp(self, rhs: Self, t: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns the spherical linear interpolation from `self` to `rhs`.

The shortest of the two arcs is taken, so the result follows the
path a rotation would take if the angle were kept minimal. Falls
back to [`Quat::lerp`] when the inputs are nearly parallel, where
the sine in the denominator would otherwise lose precision.
items.doc_zh:
返回从 `self` 到 `rhs` 的球面线性插值。

取两段圆弧中较短者，故结果沿角度最小的旋转路径。当输入近乎平行时退回
[`Quat::lerp`]，此时分母中的正弦会损失精度。

items.name: is_normalized
items.doc: Returns `true` when the length is one within a tolerance of `1e-9`.
items.doc_zh: 当长度在 `1e-9` 容差内为一时返回 `true`。

items.name: quarter_turn_x
items.doc: Returns a rotation of a quarter turn about the first axis.
items.doc_zh: 返回绕第一轴旋转四分之一周的四元数。

items.name: half_turn_z
items.doc: Returns a rotation of a half turn about the third axis.
items.doc_zh: 返回绕第三轴旋转半周的四元数。

items.name: Vec3
items.doc:
A three component column vector.

The components are named `x`, `y`, and `z`. No meaning is attached to
them here; the reference frame is defined by the crate that uses the
vector.
items.doc_zh:
三分量列向量。

分量名为 `x`、`y`、`z`。此处不赋予它们任何含义；参考系由使用该向量的
crate 定义。

items.name: ZERO
items.doc: The zero vector.
items.doc_zh: 零向量。

items.name: X
items.doc: The unit vector along the first axis.
items.doc_zh: 沿第一轴的单位向量。

items.name: Y
items.doc: The unit vector along the second axis.
items.doc_zh: 沿第二轴的单位向量。

items.name: Z
items.doc: The unit vector along the third axis.
items.doc_zh: 沿第三轴的单位向量。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a vector from its three components.
items.doc_zh: 由三个分量创建向量。

items.name: splat
items.signature: pub const fn splat(value: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a vector whose three components all equal `value`.
items.doc_zh: 创建三个分量都等于 `value` 的向量。

items.name: x
items.doc: Returns the first component.
items.doc_zh: 返回第一分量。

items.name: y
items.doc: Returns the second component.
items.doc_zh: 返回第二分量。

items.name: z
items.doc: Returns the third component.
items.doc_zh: 返回第三分量。

items.name: get
items.signature: pub const fn get(self, index: usize) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the component selected by `index`, where `0`, `1`, and `2`
select `x`, `y`, and `z` respectively.

Returns `None` for an index outside `0..=2`.
items.doc_zh:
返回由 `index` 选定的分量，其中 `0`、`1`、`2` 分别对应 `x`、`y`、`z`。

`index` 超出 `0..=2` 时返回 `None`。

items.name: cross
items.signature: pub fn cross(self, rhs: Self) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns the cross product `self x rhs`.

The result is perpendicular to both inputs and follows the
right-hand rule, so `Vec3::X.cross(Vec3::Y)` equals `Vec3::Z`.
items.doc_zh:
返回叉积 `self x rhs`。

结果同时垂直于两个输入并遵循右手定则，因此 `Vec3::X.cross(Vec3::Y)`
等于 `Vec3::Z`。

items.name: distance
items.signature: pub fn distance(self, rhs: Self) -> f64 {
items.doc: Returns the Euclidean distance between `self` and `rhs`.
items.doc_zh: 返回 `self` 与 `rhs` 之间的欧几里得距离。

items.name: distance_squared
items.signature: pub fn distance_squared(self, rhs: Self) -> f64 {
items.doc: Returns the squared Euclidean distance between `self` and `rhs`.
items.doc_zh: 返回 `self` 与 `rhs` 之间的欧几里得距离平方。

items.name: angle_between
items.signature: pub fn angle_between(self, rhs: Self) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the angle between `self` and `rhs`, in radians.

The result lies in `[0, pi]`. Returns `None` when either vector has

items.doc_zh:
结果位于 `[0, pi]`。当任一向量长度为零或非有限，或任一向量含非有限
分量时返回 `None`。

返回 `self` 与 `rhs` 之间的夹角，单位为弧度。

crates.name: apsis-macros
crates.summary:
Macros that support the ApsisRS workspace.

This crate currently defines no macros. It exists so that the workspace
has a single place for macro definitions if a need arises, and so that
adding one later does not require a new crate.

The decision to leave it empty follows from what the workspace actually
needs. Rust's built in `macro_rules!` can already do everything the
foundation layer requires:

- Substituting a type and a literal to build a quantity, as
  `quantity!(Meters, 1.5)`.
- Dispatching on a trailing token to accept a unit suffix, as
  `to_meters!(2.5 km)`.

Both forms are demonstrated by the tests in `tests/probe.rs`. They can be
written directly in the crate that uses them, so no shared macro crate is
needed.

Two limits are worth recording, because they explain why a macro based
unit system is not provided:

- A `macro_rules!` macro cannot be generic over a unit suffix that is not
  an identifier. `1.5 m` and `1.5 km` are accepted by separate rules, so
  the macro must enumerate every suffix it supports. The unit newtypes in
  `apsis-units` already give compile time unit safety without that list,
  so the macro would add surface area without adding checking.
- A declarative macro cannot inspect the value of its arguments, so it
  cannot fold a unit conversion at compile time beyond what constant
  evaluation already does. A literal such as `2.5 * 1000.0` is folded by
  the compiler anyway.

If the workspace later needs macros that generate items, such as deriving
a set of conversions from one definition, that is the point at which this
crate should gain its first macro.
crates.summary_zh:
支持 ApsisRS 工作区的宏。

本 crate 当前不定义任何宏。它的存在是为了让工作区在需要时有存放宏定义的
单一位置，也是为了日后再加一个宏时无需新建 crate。

让它保持为空的决定源于工作区实际所需。Rust 内建的 `macro_rules!` 已能完成
基础层所需的一切：

- 替换一个类型与一个字面量以构建量，如 `quantity!(Meters, 1.5)`。
- 依据尾随记号分派以接受单位后缀，如 `to_meters!(2.5 km)`。

两种形式都由 `tests/probe.rs` 中的测试演示。它们可以直接写在用到它们的
crate 中，故无需共享的宏 crate。

有两点限制值得记下，因为它们解释了为何不提供基于宏的单位系统：

- `macro_rules!` 宏不能对不是标识符的单位后缀泛型化。`1.5 m` 与
  `1.5 km` 由不同的规则接受，故该宏必须枚举它所支持的每个后缀。
  `apsis-units` 中的单位 newtype 已在没有该列表的情况下给出编译期单位
  安全，故该宏只会增加表面积而不增加检查。
- 声明式宏无法检视其参数的值，故它无法在常量求值已做的之外于编译期折叠
  单位换算。诸如 `2.5 * 1000.0` 这样的字面量反正会被编译器折叠。

若工作区日后需要生成项（例如从一个定义派生一组换算）的宏，那便是本
crate 应获得其第一个宏之时。

crates.name: apsis-time
crates.summary:
Time scales, epochs, and calendar conversions.

This crate provides the time model used by the rest of the workspace.
An [`Epoch`] is an instant stored as a Modified Julian Date on the
International Atomic Time scale, and [`TimeScale`] names the scale a
number is expressed in.

Storing a single uniform scale makes the arithmetic exact: the
difference between two epochs is the elapsed SI time between them,
independent of the scales they were created in. UTC is not uniform,
because leap seconds are inserted to keep it near the rotation of the
Earth, so UTC conversions are routed through the table in `apsis-leap`.

```
use apsis_time::{Calendar, Epoch, TimeScale};

// Build an instant from a UTC calendar date and read it back.
let calendar = Calendar::from_ymd(2024, 6, 15);
let epoch = Epoch::from_calendar(calendar, TimeScale::Utc).expect("covered by the leap table");
let back = epoch.calendar(TimeScale::Utc).expect("covered by the leap table");
assert_eq!(back.year, 2024);
assert_eq!(back.month, 6);
assert_eq!(back.day, 15);
```

Sources:

- Julian date and Modified Julian date conventions: IAU, as described in
  the *Explanatory Supplement to the Astronomical Almanac*.
- Terrestrial Time offset from TAI: IAU 2000 Resolution B1.9.
- Leap seconds: IERS Bulletin C, embedded by `apsis-leap`.
- Calendar algorithms: Howard Hinnant, *chrono-Compatible Low-Level Date
  Algorithms*, 2015.
crates.summary_zh:
时标、历元与日历换算。

本 crate 提供工作区其余部分所用的时间模型。[`Epoch`] 是以国际原子时时标
上的约化儒略日存储的瞬时，[`TimeScale`] 指名某数所表达的时标。

存储单一的均匀时标使算术精确：两个历元之差即它们之间流逝的 SI 时间，
与它们创建时所处的时标无关。UTC 不均匀，因为插入闰秒以使其接近地球的
转动，故 UTC 换算经由 `apsis-leap` 中的表格。

出处：

- 儒略日与约化儒略日约定：IAU，如 *Explanatory Supplement to the
  Astronomical Almanac* 所述。
- 地球时相对 TAI 的偏移：IAU 2000 Resolution B1.9。
- 闰秒：IERS Bulletin C，由 `apsis-leap` 内嵌。
- 日历算法：Howard Hinnant，*chrono-Compatible Low-Level Date
  Algorithms*，2015。

items.name: SECONDS_PER_DAY
items.doc: The number of seconds in a day, not counting leap seconds.
items.doc_zh: 一天中的秒数，不计闰秒。

items.name: Calendar
items.doc:
A calendar date and time of day.

Fields are the proleptic Gregorian calendar fields. `second` is a
floating point number in the range `[0, 60)`.

The second may not reach 60. A leap second is written as second 60 in
UTC, but that label does not have a unique position on a continuous time
scale: it occupies the same interval that the following midnight would
otherwise occupy. This crate therefore treats leap seconds only where
they are unambiguous, in the `TAI - UTC` offset lookup, and not as
calendar instants.
items.doc_zh:
日历日期与日内时刻。

各字段为前推格里历的字段。`second` 是位于 `[0, 60)` 的浮点数。

秒数不会达到 60。闰秒在 UTC 中写作第 60 秒，但该标记在连续时间标度上并没有
唯一位置：它占据的区间正是随后午夜本应占据的区间。因此本 crate 只在无歧义的
位置处理闰秒，即 `TAI - UTC` 偏移查表中，而不把它当作日历瞬时。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32, hour: u32, minute: u32, second: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a calendar date from its fields.
items.doc_zh: 由各字段创建日历日期。

items.name: from_ymd
items.signature: pub const fn from_ymd(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a calendar date at the start of the given day.
items.doc_zh: 在给定日期的起点创建日历日期。

items.name: seconds_of_day
items.doc: Returns the seconds elapsed since the start of the day.
items.doc_zh: 返回自该日起点已过去的秒数。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the fields form a date that exists in the
proleptic Gregorian calendar.
items.doc_zh: 当各字段构成前推格里历中存在的日期时返回 `true`。

items.name: is_leap_year
items.signature: pub const fn is_leap_year(year: i32) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when `year` is a leap year in the proleptic Gregorian
calendar.
items.doc_zh: 当 `year` 是前推格里历中的闰年时返回 `true`。

items.name: days_in_month
items.signature: pub const fn days_in_month(year: i32, month: u32) -> u32 {
items.doc:
Returns the number of days in the given month of the given year.

Returns zero when `month` is outside `1..=12`.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定年给定月的天数。

`month` 超出 `1..=12` 时返回零。

items.name: mjd_from_ymd
items.signature: pub const fn mjd_from_ymd(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Converts a calendar date, ignoring the time of day, to a Modified Julian
Date.

The result is the MJD of the start of the given day, so it is an
integer. The time of day is ignored; use [`Calendar::seconds_of_day`] to
account for it.
items.doc_zh:
把日历日期（忽略日内时刻）转换为修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

结果是该日起点的 MJD，故为整数。日内时刻被忽略；若需计入，请用
[`Calendar::seconds_of_day`]。

items.name: ymd_from_mjd
items.signature: pub fn ymd_from_mjd(mjd: f64) -> (i32, u32, u32) {
items.doc:
Converts a Modified Julian Date to a calendar date.

The fractional part is ignored, so the result is the calendar day
containing the instant.
items.doc_zh:
把修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）转换为日历日期。

小数部分被忽略，故结果是包含该瞬时的日历日。

items.name: seconds_of_day_from_mjd
items.doc:
Keeps only the fractional part of an MJD as seconds since midnight.

The result lies in `[0, 86400)` for any finite input.
items.doc_zh:
只保留 MJD 的小数部分，表示为自午夜起的秒数。

对任何有限输入，结果都位于 `[0, 86400)`。

items.name: Epoch
items.doc:
An instant on the TAI time scale, stored as a Modified Julian Date.

The field is private so that the stored scale is guaranteed. Use
[`Epoch::from_mjd`] or the named constructors to build one.
items.doc_zh:
TAI 时间尺度上的一个瞬时，以修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）存储。

字段私有以保证所存标度确定。用 [`Epoch::from_mjd`] 或具名构造函数创建。

items.name: J2000
items.signature: pub const J2000: Self = Self::from_tai_mjd_const(51_544.5 - TT_MINUS_TAI / SECONDS_PER_DAY);
items.doc:
The instant 2000-01-01T12:00:00 TT, which defines the J2000.0 epoch.

The value is `2451545.0` on the TT scale, offset back to TAI.
items.doc_zh:
瞬时 2000-01-01T12:00:00 TT，定义了 J2000.0 历元。

该值在 TT 标度上为 `2451545.0`，并回退到 TAI。

items.name: from_tai_mjd
items.signature: pub const fn from_tai_mjd(tai_mjd: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an epoch from a Modified Julian Date on the TAI scale.
items.doc_zh: 由 TAI 标度上的修正儒略日创建历元。

items.name: from_mjd
items.signature: pub fn from_mjd(mjd: f64, scale: TimeScale) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Creates an epoch from a Modified Julian Date on the given scale.

Returns `None` when the instant cannot be expressed on the requested
scale. This happens for UTC before 1972, where the leap second table
used to convert from UTC does not apply.
items.doc_zh:
由给定标度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）创建历元。

当该瞬时无法在所请求的标度上表达时返回 `None`。这发生在 1972 年之前的
UTC，因为用于从 UTC 换算的闰秒表不适用。

items.name: from_calendar
items.signature: pub fn from_calendar(calendar: Calendar, scale: TimeScale) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Creates an epoch from a calendar date, interpreting it on the given
scale.

Returns `None` when the fields do not form a valid date, or when the
instant cannot be expressed on the requested scale.
items.doc_zh:
由日历日期创建历元，并按给定标度解释该日期。

当各字段不构成有效日期，或该瞬时无法在所请求的标度上表达时返回 `None`。

items.name: tai_mjd
items.doc: Returns the instant as a Modified Julian Date on the TAI scale.
items.doc_zh: 返回该瞬时在 TAI 标度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

items.name: mjd
items.signature: pub fn mjd(self, scale: TimeScale) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the instant as a Modified Julian Date on the given scale.

Returns `None` when the instant precedes 1972 and the UTC scale is
requested, because the leap second table does not cover that range.
items.doc_zh:
返回该瞬时在给定标度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

当该瞬时早于 1972 年且请求 UTC 标度时返回 `None`，因为闰秒表不覆盖该
区间。

items.name: calendar
items.signature: pub fn calendar(self, scale: TimeScale) -> Option<Calendar> {
items.doc:
Returns the instant as a calendar date on the given scale.

Returns `None` when the scale conversion is not available for this
instant; see [`Epoch::mjd`].
items.doc_zh:
返回该瞬时在给定标度上的日历日期。

当该瞬时不可进行标度换算时返回 `None`；参见 [`Epoch::mjd`]。

items.name: seconds_until
items.signature: pub fn seconds_until(self, other: Self) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the signed number of seconds from `self` to `other`.

The result is positive when `other` is later. Because both epochs
are stored on the uniform TAI scale, the difference is exact and
does not depend on the scales used to create either epoch.
items.doc_zh:
返回从 `self` 到 `other` 的带符号秒数。

当 `other` 更晚时结果为正。由于两个历元都存于均匀的 TAI 标度，差值
精确，且与创建二者时所用的标度无关。

items.name: add_seconds
items.signature: pub fn add_seconds(self, seconds: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns an epoch shifted by `seconds`.

The shift is measured in SI seconds on the uniform TAI scale, so it
advances the instant by exactly that much elapsed time. This is the
only shift offered: a shift measured on the UTC clock would differ
when the interval spans an inserted leap second, and the UTC clock
does not have a single well defined numeric value across such an
instant. Callers that need calendar arithmetic on the UTC scale
should convert to a [`Calendar`], adjust it, and convert back.
items.doc_zh:
返回平移 `seconds` 后的历元。

平移量以均匀 TAI 标度上的 SI 秒计，故瞬时恰好前进相同的流逝时间。这是
唯一提供的平移方式：若按 UTC 时钟平移，当区间跨越插入的闰秒时结果会
不同，而 UTC 时钟在该瞬时前后没有单一良定义的数值。需要按 UTC 标度做
日历运算的调用方，应先转为 [`Calendar`]、调整后再转回。

items.name: is_finite
items.doc: Returns `true` when the stored Modified Julian Date is finite.
items.doc_zh: 当所存修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）有限时返回 `true`。

items.name: JULIAN_DATE_OFFSET
items.doc:
The number of days between the start of the Julian Date scale and the
start of the Modified Julian Date scale.
items.doc_zh: 儒略日标度起点与修正儒略日标度起点之间的天数。

items.name: mjd_from_julian_date
items.signature: pub const fn mjd_from_julian_date(julian_date: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc: Converts a Julian Date to a Modified Julian Date.
items.doc_zh: 把儒略日（Julian Date）转换为修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

items.name: julian_date_from_mjd
items.signature: pub const fn julian_date_from_mjd(mjd: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc: Converts a Modified Julian Date to a Julian Date.
items.doc_zh: 把修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）转换为儒略日（Julian Date）。

items.name: TT_MINUS_TAI
items.doc:
Terrestrial Time minus International Atomic Time, in seconds.

Exact by the definition of Terrestrial Time.
items.doc_zh:
地球时（TT）减国际原子时（TAI），单位为秒。

由地球时的定义精确确定。

items.name: TAI_MINUS_GPS
items.doc:
International Atomic Time minus GPS time, in seconds.

Exact by the definition of GPS time.
items.doc_zh:
国际原子时（TAI）减 GPS 时，单位为秒。

由 GPS 时的定义精确确定。

items.name: TimeScale
items.doc:
A time scale.

The scale determines how a numeric instant is interpreted. It does not
change the instant itself; converting an [`Epoch`](crate::Epoch) between
scales only changes the number used to display it.
items.doc_zh:
时间尺度。

标度决定一个数值瞬时如何被解释，但并不改变瞬时本身；把
[`Epoch`](crate::Epoch) 在标度之间换算，只改变用于显示它的数值。

items.name: is_uniform
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the scale runs at a uniform rate.

UTC is the only scale here that is not uniform, because leap seconds
make some of its minutes 61 seconds long.
items.doc_zh:
当该标度以均匀速率运行时返回 `true`。

此处只有 UTC 不是均匀的，因为闰秒使其部分分钟长达 61 秒。

items.name: name
items.doc: Returns the short name of the scale, such as `TAI` or `UTC`.
items.doc_zh: 返回该标度的简称，例如 `TAI` 或 `UTC`。

crates.name: apsis-leap
crates.summary:
Embedded leap second table for the UTC time scale.

Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) is kept within 0.9 s of UT1 by
inserting or removing leap seconds. Because UTC is not a uniform time
scale, converting between UTC and the uniform scales TAI, TT, and GPS
requires the offset `TAI - UTC` in force at the instant of interest.

This crate embeds that offset as a compile time table and answers
queries against it. Dates are handled as Modified Julian Date (MJD),
which is the Julian Date minus 2 400 000.5. An MJD is a count of days
since 1858-11-17T00:00:00, so it carries no time scale of its own; the
caller states the scale by choosing which function to call.

The table begins at 1972-01-01, when UTC adopted the current integer
second offset scheme. Offsets before that date were fractional and
followed a different rule, so queries earlier than the first entry
return `None` rather than a misleading value.

Source: IERS Bulletin C, which announces leap seconds after
confirmation by the International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems
Service. The most recent entry in this table is the leap second of
2017-01-01; no leap second has been announced since.

```
use apsis_leap::{tai_minus_utc_at_mjd, LEAP_SECONDS};

// The last entry in the embedded table fixes the current offset.
let last = LEAP_SECONDS.last().expect("table is not empty");
assert_eq!(last.tai_minus_utc, 37.0);
assert_eq!(tai_minus_utc_at_mjd(60_000.0), Some(37.0));
```
crates.summary_zh:
为 UTC 时标内嵌的闰秒表。

协调世界时（UTC）通过插入或删除闰秒保持在 UT1 的 0.9 秒以内。因为 UTC
不是均匀时标，在 UTC 与均匀时标 TAI、TT、GPS 之间换算需要所关注瞬时
生效的偏移 `TAI - UTC`。

本 crate 把该偏移内嵌为编译期表格，并对其作答查询。日期按约化儒略日
（MJD）处理，它是儒略日减去 2 400 000.5。MJD 是自 1858-11-17T00:00:00
起的天数，故它自身不携带时标；调用方通过选择调用哪个函数来指明时标。

该表始于 1972-01-01，那是 UTC 采用当前整数秒偏移方案的时刻。该日之前的
偏移是小数并遵循不同规则，故早于首项的查询返回 `None` 而非误导性的值。

出处：IERS Bulletin C，它在国际地球自转与参考系服务确认之后宣布闰秒。
本表最近的一项是 2017-01-01 的闰秒；此后未再宣布闰秒。

items.name: LeapSecond
items.doc:
One leap second announcement.

The entry records the date on which a new value of `TAI - UTC` took
effect. It does not record the size of the inserted second, because in
every announcement to date the inserted second was exactly one second
and the new offset is one greater than the previous one.
items.doc_zh:
一条闰秒公告。

该条目记录 `TAI - UTC` 新值生效的日期。它不记录所插入闰秒的长度，因为迄今
每一次公告插入的闰秒都恰为一秒，且新偏移比前一个大一。

items.name: effective_mjd
items.doc:
Returns the Modified Julian Date of the effective instant.

Leap seconds take effect at 00:00:00 UTC, so the effective instant
is the start of the given calendar day.
items.doc_zh:
返回生效瞬时的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

闰秒在 00:00:00 UTC 生效，故生效瞬时即该日历日的起点。

items.name: LEAP_SECONDS
items.doc:
The leap second table, ordered by effective date.

Source: IERS Bulletin C. The first entry is 1972-01-01, when the
current scheme began with an initial offset of 10 s inherited from
earlier adjustments.
items.doc_zh:
闰秒表，按生效日期排序。

出处：IERS Bulletin C。首条为 1972-01-01，即现行方案开始之时，其初始偏移
10 s 承自更早的调整。

items.name: TABLE_COVERS_FROM_MJD
items.signature: pub const TABLE_COVERS_FROM_MJD: f64 = mjd_from_ymd( LEAP_SECONDS[0].year, LEAP_SECONDS[0].month, LEAP_SECONDS[0].day, );
items.doc:
The Modified Julian Date of the first table entry, 1972-01-01.

Queries earlier than this instant are rejected because UTC did not yet
use integer second offsets.
items.doc_zh:
表中首条的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date），1972-01-01。

早于该瞬时的查询会被拒绝，因为那时的 UTC 尚未采用整数秒偏移。

items.name: TAI_MINUS_UTC_AFTER_LAST_ENTRY
items.doc:
The value of `TAI - UTC` on and after the last table entry.

This is the offset that remains in force until a new leap second is
announced.
items.doc_zh:
自表中末条起生效的 `TAI - UTC` 值。

在新的闰秒公布之前，该偏移持续有效。

items.name: mjd_from_ymd
items.signature: pub const fn mjd_from_ymd(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Converts a proleptic Gregorian calendar date to a Modified Julian Date.

The result is the MJD of 00:00:00 on the given day. The algorithm is the
Fliegel-Van Flandern integer conversion, which is exact for every date
the Gregorian calendar is defined on and does not need a lookup table.

The computation is done in `i64` and converted once at the end, so the
result is exact for the range of dates in which a leap second can
plausibly occur.
items.doc_zh:
把前推格里历日期转换为修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

结果是给定日期 00:00:00 的 MJD。算法采用 Fliegel-Van Flandern 整数换算，
对格里历定义范围内的每个日期都精确，且无需查表。

计算在 `i64` 中进行并仅在末尾换算一次，故在闰秒可能发生的日期范围内结果
精确。

items.name: MJD_AT_UNIX_EPOCH
items.doc:
The Modified Julian Date of the Unix epoch, 1970-01-01T00:00:00.

MJD carries no time scale of its own, so this constant is the same
number whether the instant is read in UTC, TAI, or any other scale.
items.doc_zh:
Unix 历元的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date），1970-01-01T00:00:00。

MJD 本身不携带时间标度，故无论该瞬时按 UTC、TAI 还是其他标度读取，此常量
都是同一个数。

items.name: tai_minus_utc_at_mjd
items.doc:
Returns the value of `TAI - UTC` in seconds at the given UTC Modified
Julian Date.

The offset is a step function: it changes at 00:00:00 UTC on the
effective date of each leap second and is constant in between. A query
exactly on an effective date returns the new value.

Returns `None` when the instant precedes 1972-01-01, before which UTC
used fractional offsets and this table does not apply.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定 UTC 修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）处 `TAI - UTC` 的秒值。

该偏移是阶跃函数：它在每个闰秒生效日的 00:00:00 UTC 改变，其间保持不变。
恰在生效日上的查询返回新值。

当该瞬时早于 1972-01-01 时返回 `None`，因为那之前 UTC 采用小数偏移，本表
不适用。

items.name: tai_mjd_from_utc_mjd
items.doc:
Converts a UTC Modified Julian Date to the corresponding TAI Modified
Julian Date.

The conversion adds the offset in force at that instant. Because the
offset is a step function evaluated on the UTC side, the conversion is
defined for every UTC instant; the inverse conversion is not, because a
leap second makes some TAI instants correspond to no UTC instant.

Returns `None` when the instant precedes 1972-01-01.
items.doc_zh:
把 UTC 修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）转换为对应的 TAI 修正儒略日。

换算加上该瞬时生效的偏移。由于偏移是在 UTC 侧求值的阶跃函数，正向换算对每个
UTC 瞬时都有定义；反向换算则不然，因为闰秒使某些 TAI 瞬时不对应任何 UTC
瞬时。

当该瞬时早于 1972-01-01 时返回 `None`。

items.name: utc_mjd_from_tai_mjd
items.doc:
Converts a TAI Modified Julian Date to the corresponding UTC Modified
Julian Date.

Each candidate offset from the table is tried in turn. A candidate is
accepted when the offset in force at the resulting UTC instant is the
same offset that produced it. At most one offset can satisfy that
condition for a given input, so the search is unambiguous.

Returns `None` in two cases. The first is an instant before the start of
the table, where UTC carried fractional offsets that this table does not
describe. The second is an instant that falls strictly inside an
inserted leap second. Such an instant has no UTC representation, because
the UTC clock labels that interval `23:59:60`, a value that does not
exist on the continuous Modified Julian Date scale.
items.doc_zh:
把 TAI 修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）转换为对应的 UTC 修正儒略日。

表中每个候选偏移依次尝试；当所得 UTC 瞬时处生效的偏移与产生它的偏移相同时，
该候选被接受。对给定输入至多有一个偏移满足该条件，故搜索无歧义。

两种情形返回 `None`。其一是早于表中起点的瞬时，那里的 UTC 采用小数偏移，本表
未予描述。其二是严格落在所插入闰秒内部的瞬时，此类瞬时没有 UTC 表示，因为
UTC 时钟把该区间标记为 `23:59:60`，而该值在连续的修正儒略日标度上并不存在。

items.name: calendar_mjd
items.signature: pub const fn calendar_mjd(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Converts a proleptic Gregorian calendar date at 00:00:00 to a Modified
Julian Date.

This is a convenience re-export of the calendar conversion used to place
the leap second table entries. It is provided so that callers do not
have to reproduce the conversion, and because the calibration scripts in
`validation/` need the same function on both sides of a comparison.
items.doc_zh:
把前推格里历日期在 00:00:00 的瞬时转换为修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

这是用于定位闰秒表条目的日历换算之便捷再导出。提供它是为了免去调用方重复
实现该换算，也因为 `validation/` 中的标定脚本在比较的两侧都需要同一函数。

crates.name: apsis-coord
crates.summary_zh:
坐标系及它们之间的变换。

本 crate 定义在类型中携带其参考系的各类位置，故在某坐标系中表达的位置
无法传递到期望另一坐标系之处。这两个坐标系是地心惯性（ECI）系与地心
地固（ECEF）系。

提供三种位置表示：

- [`Eci`]，以米计的惯性直角坐标位置
- [`Ecef`]，以米计的地固直角坐标位置
- [`Geodetic`]，WGS 84 椭球之上的纬度、经度与高度

[`Eci`] 与 [`Ecef`] 之间的变换是由地球自转角定义的转动，由
`apsis-frames` 计算。[`Ecef`] 与 [`Geodetic`] 之间的变换使用来自
`apsis-geodesy` 的 WGS 84 椭球。

出处：

- 地球自转角：*IERS Conventions（2010）*，式 8.32，由 `apsis-frames`
  实现。
- 大地坐标换算与 WGS 84 椭球：NIMA TR8350.2，第三版，2000，由
  `apsis-geodesy` 实现。

items.name: Eci
items.doc:
A Cartesian position in the Earth-centered inertial frame.

The frame is aligned with the mean equator and equinox of J2000.0 and is
treated as inertial, so it does not rotate with the Earth. Coordinates
are in meters.
items.doc_zh:
地心惯性系中的笛卡尔位置。

该系与 J2000.0 的平赤道平春分点对齐，并视为惯性系，故不随地球自转。
坐标单位为米。

items.name: Ecef
items.doc:
A Cartesian position in the Earth-centered Earth-fixed frame.

The frame rotates with the Earth, so a point fixed to the ground has
constant coordinates in it. Coordinates are in meters.
items.doc_zh:
地心地固系中的笛卡尔位置。

该系随地球自转，故地面上固定的点在其中坐标恒定。坐标单位为米。

items.name: Geodetic
items.doc:
A position in the Earth-fixed frame given as latitude, longitude, and
height above the WGS 84 ellipsoid.

Latitude and longitude are in radians and height is in meters. Latitude
is geodetic, measured between the ellipsoid normal and the equatorial
plane.
items.doc_zh:
以纬度、经度与 WGS 84 椭球高给出的地固系位置。

纬度与经度用弧度，高用米。纬度为大地纬度，在椭球法线与赤道面之间量取。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(vector: Vec3) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an inertial position from a vector in meters.
items.doc_zh: 由米为单位的向量创建惯性位置。

items.name: vector
items.doc: Returns the position in meters.
items.doc_zh: 返回以米为单位的位置。

items.name: to_ecef
items.signature: pub fn to_ecef(self, angle: EarthRotationAngle) -> Ecef {
items.doc:
Converts this inertial position to the Earth-fixed frame at the given
Earth Rotation Angle.
items.doc_zh: 按给定的地球自转角把该惯性位置转换到地固系。

items.name: to_eci

crates.name: apsis-geodesy
crates.summary:
Reference ellipsoids and geodetic computations.

A geodetic position is written as latitude, longitude, and height above
an ellipsoid. Latitude here is always geodetic, the angle between the
ellipsoid normal and the equatorial plane, not geocentric. The two
differ by up to about 0.19 degrees at mid latitudes, so the distinction
matters for pointing and ranging.

[`WGS84`] is the ellipsoid used by GPS and by almost all satellite work.
Its defining parameters are the semi-major axis and the inverse
flattening; every other quantity is derived from those two, so the
derived values agree with the ones published in the standard to the
precision of the defining parameters.

Source: National Imagery and Mapping Agency, *Department of Defense World
Geodetic System 1984*, Technical Report TR8350.2, third edition, 2000.

```
use apsis_geodesy::{Geodetic, WGS84};

// The equator has zero height and a radius equal to the semi-major axis.
let point = Geodetic::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
let cartesian = point.to_cartesian(WGS84);
assert!((cartesian.norm() - WGS84.semi_major_axis()).abs() < 1e-9);
```
crates.summary_zh:
参考椭球与大地计算。

大地位置写为某椭球之上的纬度、经度与高度。此处的纬度总是大地纬度，即
椭球法线与赤道面之间的角，而非地心纬度。在中纬度处二者相差至多约 0.19
度，故该区别对指向与测距是要紧的。

[`WGS84`] 是 GPS 以及几乎所有卫星工作所用的椭球。其定义参数是半长轴与
扁率倒数；其余每个量都由这两个导出，故各导出值与标准中发布的值在定义
参数的精度内一致。

出处：National Imagery and Mapping Agency，*Department of Defense World
Geodetic System 1984*，技术报告 TR8350.2，第三版，2000。

items.name: Ellipsoid
items.doc:
A biaxial reference ellipsoid: an ellipse of revolution about its minor
axis.

The shape is fixed by two numbers. This crate stores the semi-major axis
and the inverse flattening, which are the two defining parameters of the
WGS 84 ellipsoid in the standard. Every other quantity is derived, so
there is no risk of the parameters disagreeing with each other.

Lengths are in meters and angles are in radians.
items.doc_zh:
双轴参考椭球：绕短轴旋转所得的椭圆。

形状由两个数确定。本 crate 存储半长轴与逆扁率，它们是标准中 WGS 84 椭球的
两个定义参数。其余量都由二者导出，故各参数之间不会失配。

长度单位为米，角度单位为弧度。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(semi_major_axis: f64, inverse_flattening: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates an ellipsoid from its semi-major axis and inverse
flattening.

Lengths are in meters. The inverse flattening must be positive and
finite; a value of infinity describes a sphere.
items.doc_zh:
由半长轴与逆扁率创建椭球。

长度单位为米。逆扁率必须为正且有限；取无穷大则描述一个球。

items.doc: Returns the semi-major axis, in meters.

对球其值为零。

items.name: semi_minor_axis
items.doc: Returns the semi-minor axis, in meters.
items.doc_zh: 返回半短轴，单位为米。

items.name: eccentricity_squared
items.doc:
Returns the first eccentricity squared, a dimensionless number in
`[0, 1)`.

It is `2f - f^2` for flattening `f`.
items.doc_zh:
返回第一偏心率平方，为位于 `[0, 1)` 的无量纲数。

对扁率 `f`，它等于 `2f - f^2`。

items.name: eccentricity
items.doc: Returns the first eccentricity, a dimensionless number in `[0, 1)`.
items.doc_zh: 返回第一偏心率，为位于 `[0, 1)` 的无量纲数。

items.name: second_eccentricity_squared
items.doc:
Returns the second eccentricity squared, a dimensionless number.

It is `e^2 / (1 - e^2)`, which appears in the closed form for
converting a geodetic position to Cartesian coordinates.
items.doc_zh:
返回第二偏心率平方，为无量纲数。

它等于 `e^2 / (1 - e^2)`，出现在把大地位置转换为笛卡尔坐标的闭式解中。

items.name: polar_radius_of_curvature
items.doc:
Returns the polar radius of curvature, in meters.

This is the radius of curvature in the meridian at the pole, equal
to `a / sqrt(1 - e^2)`.
items.doc_zh:
返回极半径曲率，单位为米。

它是极点处子午线上的曲率半径，等于 `a / sqrt(1 - e^2)`。

along the ellipsoid normal, and it grows from the semi-major axis at

The latitude is in radians.

返回给定大地纬度处卯酉圈上的曲率半径，单位为米。

它是沿椭球法线从表面量到极轴的距离，由赤道处的半长轴增长到极点的
[`Ellipsoid::polar_radius_of_curvature`]。

items.name: WGS84
items.doc:
The WGS 84 reference ellipsoid.

The two defining parameters are the semi-major axis `a = 6 378 137 m` and
the inverse flattening `1 / f = 298.257 223 563`.

Source: NIMA TR8350.2, third edition, 2000.
items.doc_zh:
WGS 84 参考椭球。

两个定义参数为半长轴 `a = 6 378 137 m` 与逆扁率 `1 / f = 298.257 223 563`。

出处：NIMA TR8350.2 第三版，2000。

items.name: WGS84_GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER
items.doc:
The Earth gravitational parameter for WGS 84, in cubic meters per second

This is held here rather than in `apsis-core` so that a caller working

该值置于此处而非 `apsis-core`，以便处理椭球的调用方使用与之匹配的重力场。

items.name: Geodetic
items.doc:
A geodetic position: latitude, longitude, and height above an ellipsoid.

Latitude and longitude are in radians and height is in meters. Latitude
is geodetic, measured between the ellipsoid normal and the equatorial
plane, and lies in `[-pi/2, pi/2]`. Longitude is measured east from the
prime meridian. Height is the distance along the ellipsoid normal, taken
as positive outside the ellipsoid.
items.doc_zh:
大地位置：纬度、经度与椭球高。

纬度与经度用弧度，高用米。纬度为大地纬度，在椭球法线与赤道面之间量取，位于
`[-pi/2, pi/2]`。经度自本初子午线向东量取。高是沿椭球法线的距离，椭球
之外取正。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(latitude: f64, longitude: f64, height: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a geodetic position from latitude, longitude, and height.

items.name: to_cartesian
items.signature: pub fn to_cartesian(self, ellipsoid: Ellipsoid) -> Vec3 {
items.doc:
Converts this geodetic position to Earth-fixed Cartesian coordinates
on the given ellipsoid.

The frame has its third axis along the ellipsoid's minor axis through
the north pole, its first axis through the intersection of the
equator and the prime meridian, and its second axis completing a
right-handed set. The result is in meters.

The closed form is

```text
N = a / sqrt(1 - e^2 sin^2(lat))
x = (N + h) cos(lat) cos(lon)
y = (N + h) cos(lat) sin(lon)
z = (N (1 - e^2) + h) sin(lat)
```

where `N` is the prime vertical radius of curvature. This form is
exact everywhere, including at the poles, where the cosine factors
vanish.
items.doc_zh:
把该大地位置转换为给定椭球上的地固笛卡尔坐标。

该系的第三轴沿椭球短轴指向北极，第一轴过赤道与本初子午线之交，第二轴构成
右手系。结果单位为米。

闭式解为

```text
N = a / sqrt(1 - e^2 sin^2(lat))
x = (N + h) cos(lat) cos(lon)
y = (N + h) cos(lat) sin(lon)
z = (N (1 - e^2) + h) sin(lat)
```

其中 `N` 为卯酉圈曲率半径。该形式处处精确，包括余弦因子为零的极点。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every field is finite and the latitude and
longitude are inside their ranges.
items.doc_zh: 当各字段都有限，且纬度与经度位于其范围内时返回 `true`。

items.name: cartesian_from_geodetic
items.signature: pub fn cartesian_from_geodetic(geodetic: Geodetic, ellipsoid: Ellipsoid) -> Vec3 {
items.doc:
Converts a geodetic position to Earth-fixed Cartesian coordinates.

See [`Geodetic::to_cartesian`] for the frame definition and the closed
form.
items.doc_zh:
把大地位置转换为地固笛卡尔坐标。

坐标系定义与闭式解见 [`Geodetic::to_cartesian`]。

items.name: geodetic_from_cartesian
items.signature: pub fn geodetic_from_cartesian(cartesian: Vec3, ellipsoid: Ellipsoid) -> Option<Geodetic> {
items.doc:
Converts Earth-fixed Cartesian coordinates to a geodetic position.

The latitude and height are recovered by Bowring's method, which solves
the meridian equation in closed form and then refines the result with a
few fixed point steps. The iteration converges to well below a
micrometer for positions from below the ellipsoid out to geostationary
radius.

Returns `None` when the position is not finite, or when it lies on the
polar axis so that no longitude is defined.
items.doc_zh:
把地固笛卡尔坐标转换为大地位置。

纬度与高由 Bowring 方法求得：先以闭式解解出子午线方程，再用若干不动点迭代
精化。对从椭球下方到地球同步半径范围内的位置，该迭代收敛到远优于一微米。

当位置非有限，或落在极轴上以致经度未定义时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-frames
crates.summary:
Reference frame definitions and the rotation between the inertial and
Earth-fixed frames.

A reference frame fixes the orientation and origin that a vector is
expressed relative to. This crate names the two frames used for
near-Earth work and computes the rotation between them. Concrete
position types that carry a frame are defined in `apsis-coord`; this
crate works with the rotation matrix and the angle that defines it.

The inertial frame is the Earth-centered inertial (ECI) frame aligned
with the mean equator and equinox of J2000.0. Its axes are fixed in
inertial space, so an orbit propagated in it is not affected by the
rotation of the Earth.

The rotating frame is the Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) frame. Its
third axis is the Earth's rotation axis and its first axis follows the
prime meridian, so a point fixed to the ground has constant coordinates
in it.

The two are related by a rotation of [`EarthRotationAngle`] about the
common third axis. This crate models the Earth's rotation with the Earth
Rotation Angle, which is a function of UT1 only. It does not apply
precession or nutation, because an angle accurate to a few hundredths of
a degree is sufficient for pointing and coverage work and the full model
needs the orientation of the celestial pole, which is a separate
computation.

Source: the Earth Rotation Angle expression is from the International
Astronomical Union, as given in the *IERS Conventions (2010)*, equation
8.32.

```
use apsis_frames::{EarthRotationAngle, rotation_eci_to_ecef};

// The angle advances by roughly 360.9856 degrees per day.
let first = EarthRotationAngle::from_ut1_days(0.0);
let second = EarthRotationAngle::from_ut1_days(1.0);
let advance = (second.radians() - first.radians()).to_degrees();
assert!((advance - 360.985_612_288_088).abs() < 1e-6);

// The rotation is ready to apply to a vector.
let _ = rotation_eci_to_ecef(first);
```
crates.summary_zh:
参考系定义，以及惯性系与地固系之间的转动。

参考系固定了矢量所相对表达的取向与原点。本 crate 为近地工作所用的两个
坐标系命名，并计算它们之间的转动。携带坐标系的具位置类型定义在
`apsis-coord` 中；本 crate 处理转动矩阵以及定义它的角。

惯性系是与 J2000.0 平赤道与平春分点对齐的地心惯性（ECI）系。其各轴在
惯性空间中固定，故在其中传播的轨道不受地球转动影响。

转动坐标系是地心地固（ECEF）系。其第三轴是地球自转轴，第一轴随本初
子午线，故固定于地面的点在其中具有恒定坐标。

二者由绕公共第三轴转动 [`EarthRotationAngle`] 相联系。本 crate 用地球
自转角为地球自转建模，它仅是 UT1 的函数。它不施加岁差或章动，因为精确
到百分之几度的角对指向与覆盖工作已足够，而完整模型需要天极的取向，那是
另一项单独的计算。

出处：地球自转角表达式来自国际天文学联合会，如 *IERS Conventions
（2010）* 式 8.32 所给出。

items.name: ERA_J2000_TURNS
items.doc:
The Earth Rotation Angle at the J2000.0 epoch, in turns.

The epoch value is zero by the definition of the angle: the International
Astronomical Union defines the Earth Rotation Angle to be zero at
2000-01-01T12:00:00 UT1.
items.doc_zh:
J2000.0 历元处的地球自转角，以周计。

按该角的定义，历元值就是零：国际天文学联合会把 2000-01-01T12:00:00 UT1
处的地球自转角定义为零。

items.name: ERA_RATE_TURNS_PER_DAY
items.doc:
The rate of change of the Earth Rotation Angle, in turns per day of UT1.

This is `1.002 737 811 911 354 6`, which is `360.985 612 288 088`
degrees per day. It exceeds one turn per day because the Earth turns once
in a sidereal day, which is shorter than a solar day.

Source: IERS Conventions (2010), equation 8.32.
items.doc_zh:
地球自转角的变化率，以每 UT1 日的周数计。

该值为 `1.002 737 811 911 354 6`，即每天 `360.985 612 288 088` 度。它
超过每天一周，因为地球在一个恒星日内转一周，而恒星日短于太阳日。

出处：IERS Conventions（2010），式 8.32。

items.name: ut1_days_from_j2000
items.doc:
The number of days from the J2000.0 epoch to the given Julian Date on the
UT1 scale.

The J2000.0 epoch is Julian Date 2451545.0, which is noon on
2000-01-01.
items.doc_zh:
从 J2000.0 历元到给定 UT1 时标儒略日的天数。

J2000.0 历元是儒略日 2451545.0，即 2000-01-01 的正午。

items.name: EarthRotationAngle
items.doc:
The Earth Rotation Angle at a given instant.

The angle is the rotation from the celestial intermediate origin to the
terrestrial intermediate origin, measured about the celestial
intermediate pole. It replaces Greenwich Mean Sidereal Time in modern
practice and, unlike sidereal time, is a linear function of UT1.

The value is held in turns. A turn is one full revolution, so the angle
is periodic with a period of one. The value returned is not reduced to
any interval, so differences between two angles are meaningful even when
the interval is longer than a day.
items.doc_zh:
某瞬时的地球自转角。

该角是从天球中间原点到地球中间原点的转动，绕天球中间极量取。它在现代
实践中取代格林尼治平恒星时，且与恒星时不同，它是 UT1 的线性函数。

该值以周保存。一周即一整圈，故该角以 1 为周期。所返回的值不归约到任何
区间，故即便区间长于一日，两角之差仍有意义。

items.name: from_turns
items.signature: pub const fn from_turns(turns: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an angle from a value in turns.
items.doc_zh: 由以周表示的值创建角。

items.name: from_radians
items.doc: Creates an angle from a value in radians.
items.doc_zh: 由以弧度表示的值创建角。

items.name: from_ut1_julian_date
items.doc: Returns the angle for a Julian Date on the UT1 scale.
items.doc_zh: 返回 UT1 时标上某儒略日对应的角。

items.name: from_ut1_days
items.doc:
Returns the angle for a number of days of UT1 since the J2000.0
epoch.

The expression is linear: `theta = 0.779 057 273 2640 + 1.002 737
909 350 795 * d`, where `d` is the interval in days. The constant
term of `0.779 057` turns is the angle at the epoch itself, which is
about 280.46 degrees.

Source: IERS Conventions (2010), equation 8.32.
items.doc_zh:
返回自 J2000.0 历元起的若干 UT1 天对应的角。

该式为线性：`theta = 0.779 057 273 2640 + 1.002 737 909 350 795 * d`，
其中 `d` 是以天计的间隔。`0.779 057` 周的常数项是历元本身的角，
约为 280.46 度。

出处：IERS Conventions（2010），式 8.32。

items.name: turns
items.doc:
Returns the angle in turns.

The value is not reduced to `[0, 1)`.
items.doc_zh:
返回以周表示的角。

该值不归约到 `[0, 1)`。

items.name: turns_positive
items.doc: Returns the angle in turns, reduced to `[0, 1)`.
items.doc_zh: 返回以周表示的角，归约到 `[0, 1)`。

items.name: radians
items.doc:
Returns the angle in radians.

The value is not reduced to `[0, 2 pi)`.
items.doc_zh:
返回以弧度表示的角。

该值不归约到 `[0, 2 pi)`。

items.name: radians_positive
items.doc: Returns the angle in radians, reduced to `[0, 2 pi)`.
items.doc_zh: 返回以弧度表示的角，归约到 `[0, 2 pi)`。

items.name: rotation_eci_to_ecef
items.doc:
Returns the rotation that maps a vector in the inertial frame to the
Earth-fixed frame.

The rotation is a clockwise turn about the third axis by the Earth
Rotation Angle. Applying it to an inertial vector yields the Earth-fixed
vector, so a vector that is fixed in inertial space acquires a negative
rotation as the Earth turns beneath it.
items.doc_zh:
返回把惯性系中的矢量映射到地固系的转动。

该转动是绕第三轴按地球自转角作顺时针转。把它施加于惯性矢量即得地固
矢量，故在惯性空间固定的矢量会随地球在其下方转动而获得一个负的
转动。

items.name: rotation_ecef_to_eci
items.doc:
Returns the rotation that maps a vector in the Earth-fixed frame to the
inertial frame.

This is the transpose of [`rotation_eci_to_ecef`], which for a rotation
matrix is also its inverse.
items.doc_zh:
返回把地固系中的矢量映射到惯性系的转动。

它是 [`rotation_eci_to_ecef`] 的转置，对旋转矩阵而言也是其逆。

items.name: mean_anomaly_moon
items.doc:
Returns the mean anomaly of the Moon, in radians.

This is the Delaunay argument `l`, from the IERS 2003 expressions.
items.doc_zh:
返回月球的平近点角，单位为弧度。

这是 Delaunay 参数 `l`，取自 IERS 2003 表达式。

items.name: mean_anomaly_sun
items.doc:
Returns the mean anomaly of the Sun, in radians.

This is the Delaunay argument `l'`. The reference evaluates it inline
rather than through the general function, and the two differ slightly.
items.doc_zh:
返回太阳的平近点角，单位为弧度。

这是 Delaunay 参数 `l'`。参考实现是内联求值而非经通用函数，二者略有
差异。

items.name: mean_anomaly_sun_iers2003
items.doc:
Returns the mean anomaly of the Sun from the IERS 2003 expressions.

This differs from [`mean_anomaly_sun`] in the last digits of the constant
and linear terms. The nutation series uses the inline form; the
complementary terms of the equation of the equinoxes use this one.

Source: as implemented by `eraFalp03`.
items.doc_zh:
返回取自 IERS 2003 表达式的太阳平近点角。

它与 [`mean_anomaly_sun`] 在常数项与线性项的最后几位上不同。章动级数
用内联形式；分点方程式的补充项用这一个。

出处：按 `eraFalp03` 所实现。

items.name: mean_elongation_moon_sun_iers2003
items.doc:
Returns the mean elongation of the Moon from the Sun from the IERS 2003
expressions.

This differs from [`mean_elongation_moon_sun`] in the last digits of the
constant term. The nutation series uses the inline form; the
complementary terms of the equation of the equinoxes use this one.

Source: as implemented by `eraFad03`.
items.doc_zh:
返回取自 IERS 2003 表达式的月球相对太阳的平距角。

它与 [`mean_elongation_moon_sun`] 在常数项的最后几位上不同。章动级数
用内联形式；分点方程式的补充项用这一个。

出处：按 `eraFad03` 所实现。

items.name: mean_latitude_moon
items.doc:
Returns the mean argument of latitude of the Moon, in radians.

This is the Delaunay argument `F`, the mean longitude of the Moon minus
the mean longitude of its ascending node.
items.doc_zh:
返回月球的平纬度参数，单位为弧度。

这是 Delaunay 参数 `F`，即月球平黄经减去其升交点平黄经。

items.name: mean_elongation_moon_sun
items.doc:
Returns the mean elongation of the Moon from the Sun, in radians.

This is the Delaunay argument `D`. The reference evaluates it inline.
items.doc_zh:
返回月球相对太阳的平距角，单位为弧度。

这是 Delaunay 参数 `D`。参考实现是内联求值。

items.name: mean_longitude_node
items.doc:
Returns the mean longitude of the Moon's ascending node, in radians.

This is the Delaunay argument `Om`.
items.doc_zh:
返回月球升交点的平黄经，单位为弧度。

这是 Delaunay 参数 `Om`。

items.name: mean_longitude_mercury
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of Mercury, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回水星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_venus
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of Venus, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回金星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_earth
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of the Earth, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回地球的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_mars
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of Mars, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回火星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_jupiter
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of Jupiter, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回木星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_saturn
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of Saturn, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回土星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_uranus
items.doc: Returns the mean longitude of Uranus, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回天王星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

items.name: mean_longitude_neptune
items.doc:
Returns the mean longitude of Neptune, in radians.

The reference evaluates this inline, from the MHB2000 model rather than
from the IERS 2003 expressions used for the other planets.
items.doc_zh:
返回海王星的平黄经，单位为弧度。

参考实现是内联求值，取自 MHB2000 模型，而非用于其余行星的 IERS 2003
表达式。

items.name: general_precession
items.doc: Returns the general accumulated precession in longitude, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回黄经上的一般累积岁差，单位为弧度。

items.name: DelaunayArguments
items.doc: The five Delaunay arguments, in the order the luni-solar series uses.
items.doc_zh: 五个 Delaunay 参数，按日月级数所用的次序排列。

items.name: at
items.doc: Returns the five arguments for a time in Julian centuries.
items.doc_zh: 返回某儒略世纪时刻的这五个参数。

items.name: as_array
items.doc: Returns the arguments as an array in series order.
items.doc_zh: 按级数次序把各参数作为数组返回。

items.name: PlanetaryArguments
items.doc:
The thirteen arguments of the planetary series, in series order.

The order is `l`, `F`, `D`, `Om`, Mercury through Uranus, Neptune, and the
general accumulated precession. Note that `l'` does not appear; the
planetary series uses the Moon's mean anomaly, not the Sun's.
items.doc_zh:
行星级数的十三个参数，按级数次序排列。

次序为 `l`、`F`、`D`、`Om`、水星到天王星、海王星，以及一般累积岁差。
注意 `l'` 不出现；行星级数用的是月球的平近点角，而非太阳的。

items.name: as_array
items.doc: Returns the arguments as an array in series order.
items.doc_zh: 按级数次序把各参数作为数组返回。

items.name: SeriesTerm
items.doc:
One term of the luni-solar nutation series.

The five multipliers are applied to the Delaunay arguments in the order
`l`, `l'`, `F`, `D`, `Om`. The six coefficients are the longitude sine,
its time derivative, the longitude cosine, the obliquity cosine, its time
derivative, and the obliquity sine, in units of 0.1 microarcsecond.
items.doc_zh:
日月章动级数的一项。

五个乘数按 `l`、`l'`、`F`、`D`、`Om` 的次序施加于 Delaunay 参数。六个
系数依次是黄经正弦、其时间导数、黄经余弦、黄赤交角余弦、其时间导数，
以及黄赤交角正弦，单位为 0.1 微角秒。

items.name: ComplementaryTerm
items.doc:
One term of the complementary terms of the equation of the equinoxes.

The eight multipliers apply to the arguments `l`, `l'`, `F`, `D`, `Om`,
the mean longitude of Venus, the mean longitude of the Earth, and the
general accumulated precession. The two coefficients are the sine and
cosine amplitudes, in arcseconds.
items.doc_zh:
分点方程式补充项的一项。

八个乘数施加于参数 `l`、`l'`、`F`、`D`、`Om`、金星的平黄经、地球的平
黄经，以及一般累积岁差。两个系数是正弦与余弦幅度，单位为角秒。

items.name: PlanetaryTerm
items.doc:
One term of the planetary nutation series.

The thirteen multipliers are applied to the planetary arguments in the
order `l`, `F`, `D`, `Om`, Mercury through Uranus, Neptune, and the
general accumulated precession. The four coefficients are the longitude
sine, the longitude cosine, the obliquity sine, and the obliquity cosine,
in units of 0.1 microarcsecond.
items.doc_zh:
行星章动级数的一项。

十三个乘数按 `l`、`F`、`D`、`Om`、水星到天王星、海王星，以及一般累积
岁差的次序施加于行星参数。四个系数依次是黄经正弦、黄经余弦、黄赤交角
正弦与黄赤交角余弦，单位为 0.1 微角秒。

items.name: Nutation
items.doc: The nutation in longitude and obliquity, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 黄经与黄赤交角方向的章动，单位为弧度。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(longitude: f64, obliquity: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a nutation from its two angles.
items.doc_zh: 由其两个角创建章动。

items.name: longitude_arcseconds
items.doc: Returns the nutation in longitude, in arcseconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回黄经方向的章动，单位为角秒。

items.name: obliquity_arcseconds
items.doc: Returns the nutation in obliquity, in arcseconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回黄赤交角方向的章动，单位为角秒。

items.name: plus
items.signature: pub const fn plus(self, other: Self) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns the sum of two nutations.
items.doc_zh: 返回两个章动之和。

items.name: nutation_2000a
items.doc:
Returns the nutation in longitude and obliquity for a time.

The time is in Julian centuries from J2000.0 on the Terrestrial Time
scale. This is the IAU 2000A model, which includes the planetary terms.

Source: IAU 2000A, as implemented by `eraNut00a`.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的黄经与黄赤交角方向的章动。

时间以 J2000.0 起的儒略世纪计，位于地球时（TT）标度。这是 IAU 2000A
模型，含行星项。

出处：IAU 2000A，按 `eraNut00a` 所实现。

items.name: nutation_2000a_with_2006_adjustment
items.doc:
Returns the nutation with the IAU 2006 precession adjustments applied.

The IAU 2000A model was built on the IAU 1976 precession, and the IAU
2006 precession changed the precession rates. The adjustment brings the
nutation into consistency with the newer precession, which is the
combination used for the modern celestial-to-terrestrial transformation.

Source: IAU 2006, as implemented by `eraNut06a`, which applies the
expressions of Wallace and Capitaine (2006), equations 5.
items.doc_zh:
返回施加 IAU 2006 岁差调整后的章动。

IAU 2000A 模型建立在 IAU 1976 岁差之上，而 IAU 2006 岁差改变了岁差
速率。该调整使章动与较新的岁差一致，这一组合正是现代天球到地球转换
所用的。

出处：IAU 2006，按 `eraNut06a` 所实现，它施加 Wallace 与
Capitaine（2006）式 5 的表达式。

items.name: FRAME_BIAS_RIGHT_ASCENSION
items.doc:
The frame bias in right ascension, in radians.

The offset between the origin of the International Celestial Reference
System and the dynamical equinox of J2000.0. The value is
minus 0.0146 arcseconds.
items.doc_zh:
赤经方向的坐标架偏差，单位为弧度。

国际天球参考系原点与 J2000.0 动力学春分点之间的偏移。该值为负
0.0146 角秒。

items.name: FRAME_BIAS_DECLINATION
items.doc:
The frame bias in declination, in radians.

The offset between the pole of the International Celestial Reference
System and the mean pole of J2000.0. The value is minus 0.0068192
arcseconds.
items.doc_zh:
赤纬方向的坐标架偏差，单位为弧度。

国际天球参考系极与 J2000.0 平极之间的偏移。该值为负 0.0068192
角秒。

items.name: FRAME_BIAS_LONGITUDE
items.doc:
The frame bias in longitude, in radians.

The offset between the two origins measured along the equator. The value
is minus 0.041775 arcseconds.
items.doc_zh:
黄经方向的坐标架偏差，单位为弧度。

沿赤道量得的两个原点之间的偏移。该值为负 0.041775 角秒。

items.name: PrecessionAngles
items.doc:
The four angles that describe the precession from J2000.0 to a date.

They are applied in the order the reference uses: a rotation by
`gamma_bar` about the third axis, then by `phi_bar` about the first, then
by minus `psi_bar` about the third, then by minus `epsilon_a` about the
first.
items.doc_zh:
描述从 J2000.0 到某日岁差的四个角。

它们按参考实现所用的次序施加：绕第三轴转 `gamma_bar`，再绕第一轴转
`phi_bar`，再绕第三轴转负的 `psi_bar`，再绕第一轴转负的
`epsilon_a`。

items.name: mean_obliquity
items.doc:
Returns the mean obliquity of the ecliptic, in radians.

The polynomial is the IAU 2006 expression, evaluated for a time in Julian
centuries from J2000.0 on the Terrestrial Time scale. The constant term
is 84381.406 arcseconds, which is the obliquity at J2000.0.

Source: the IAU 2006 precession, as implemented by `eraObl06`.
items.doc_zh:
返回黄道的平黄赤交角，单位为弧度。

该多项式是 IAU 2006 表达式，按地球时标、自 J2000.0 起的儒略世纪求值。
常数项为 84381.406 角秒，即 J2000.0 处的黄赤交角。

出处：IAU 2006 岁差，按 `eraObl06` 所实现。

items.name: precession_angles
items.doc:
Returns the four precession angles for a time.

The time is in Julian centuries from J2000.0 on the Terrestrial Time
scale.

Source: the P03 precession, as implemented by `eraPfw06`.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的四个岁差角。

时间以 J2000.0 起的儒略世纪计，位于地球时（TT）标度。

出处：P03 岁差，按 `eraPfw06` 所实现。

items.name: frame_bias_matrix
items.doc:
Returns the frame bias rotation matrix.

The bias is a constant rotation from the International Celestial
Reference System to the dynamical mean equator and equinox of J2000.0.
Its three angles are far below a tenth of an arcsecond, but omitting it
would leave a systematic error that is larger than the precision of the
nutation series.

Source: as implemented by `eraBi00`, which gives the bias as three small
rotations rather than as a matrix.
items.doc_zh:
返回坐标架偏差旋转矩阵。

该偏差是从国际天球参考系到 J2000.0 动力学平赤道与平春分点的常值
转动。其三个角远小于十分之一角秒，但略去它会留下大于章动级数精度
的系统误差。

出处：按 `eraBi00` 所实现，它把偏差给出为三个小转动而非一个矩阵。

items.name: bias_precession_matrix
items.doc:
Returns the rotation from the celestial reference frame to the mean
equator and equinox of date.

This is the bias-precession matrix. Nutation is applied on top of it to
reach the true equator and equinox of date.

The time is in Julian centuries from J2000.0 on the Terrestrial Time
scale.

Source: as implemented by `eraPmat06`.
items.doc_zh:
返回从天球参考系到该日平赤道与平春分点的转动。

这是偏差-岁差矩阵。章动施加于其上，以到达该日的真赤道与真春分点。

时间以 J2000.0 起的儒略世纪计，位于地球时（TT）标度。

出处：按 `eraPmat06` 所实现。

items.name: frame_to_mean_of_date
items.doc:
Returns the rotation from the celestial reference frame to the mean
equator and equinox of date, given precomputed precession angles.

Source: as implemented by `eraFw2m`, which applies the four elementary
rotations in sequence. The reference helper composes each new rotation
on the left of the accumulator, so the product here is written with the
last rotation applied first, in the same order.
items.doc_zh:
在给定预先算出的岁差角时，返回从天球参考系到该日平赤道与平春分点的
转动。

出处：按 `eraFw2m` 所实现，它依次施加四个基本转动。参考辅助函数把
每个新转动合成到累加器的左侧，故此处的乘积按最后施加的转动写在最前，
次序一致。

items.name: rotation_z
items.doc:
Returns a rotation of `angle` about the third axis, in radians.

The sign convention matches the other axis rotations in this module.
items.doc_zh:
返回绕第三轴转 `angle` 的旋转，单位为弧度。

符号约定与本模块中其余各轴转动一致。

items.name: greenwich_mean_sidereal_time_1982
items.signature: pub fn greenwich_mean_sidereal_time_1982(day: f64, fraction: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns Greenwich mean sidereal time from the 1982 expression, in
radians.

The expression is a polynomial in the number of Julian centuries from
J2000.0 plus the fraction of the day in seconds of time. It is the
sidereal time the SGP4 theory was fitted against, which is why it is used
here rather than the modern expression: the element sets are consistent
with it.

The Julian date is taken in two parts, a whole number of days and a
fraction, because a single `f64` near 2 461 000 has a resolution of about
40 microseconds and the sidereal time is wanted to better than that. The
caller that has only one value may pass the whole part and the fraction
separately, or pass a value twice: `(jd, 0.0)`, `(2400000.5, mjd)`, and
`(jd - 0.5, 0.5)` are all accepted, but the split with the smaller whole
part preserves more of the fraction.

Source: as implemented by `eraGmst82`.
items.doc_zh:
返回 1982 表达式给出的格林尼治平恒星时，单位为弧度。

该表达式是自 J2000.0 起儒略世纪数加上当日以时间秒计的零头所构成的多项
式。它是 SGP4 理论所拟合的恒星时，故此处用它而非现代表达式：根数集与
它一致。

儒略日按两部分取，一为整数天数、一为零头，因为接近 2 461 000 的单个
`f64` 分辨率约为 40 微秒，而所要求的恒星时优于该值。只有一个值的调用
方可以分别传入整数部分与零头，或把同一个值传两次：`(jd, 0.0)`、
`(2400000.5, mjd)` 与 `(jd - 0.5, 0.5)` 都可接受，但整数部分更小的
拆分能保留更多零头。

items.name: teme_to_terrestrial_matrix
items.signature: pub fn teme_to_terrestrial_matrix( ut1_day: f64, ut1_fraction: f64, polar_motion: PolarMotion, ) -> Mat3 {
items.doc:
Returns the rotation from the True Equator Mean Equinox frame to the
Earth-fixed frame.

The argument is the UT1 Julian date, because the rotation is the Earth's
rotation, and the polar motion is supplied by the caller because it is
measured rather than modelled.

This is the transformation to apply to the position and velocity that
`apsis-sgp4` produces.
items.doc_zh:
返回从真赤道平春分点坐标系到地固系的转动。

参数是 UT1 儒略日，因为该转动即地球自转；极移由调用方提供，因为它是
实测而非建模的。

这是施加于 `apsis-sgp4` 所产生的位置与速度的变换。

items.name: bias_precession_nutation_matrix
items.doc:
Returns the bias-precession-nutation matrix for a time.

The matrix carries a vector from the celestial reference frame to the
true equator and equinox of date. It is built from the four precession
angles with the nutation added to the last two, which is the form the
reference uses.

Source: as implemented by `eraPnm06a` and `eraFw2m`.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的偏差-岁差-章动矩阵。

该矩阵把矢量从天球参考系带到该日的真赤道与真春分点。它由四个岁差角
构成，其中最后两个角加上章动，这正是参考实现所用的形式。

出处：按 `eraPnm06a` 与 `eraFw2m` 所实现。

items.name: equation_of_the_equinoxes_complementary_terms
items.doc:
Returns the complementary terms of the equation of the equinoxes.

The equation of the equinoxes has, besides the projection of the nutation
in longitude onto the true equator, a set of small periodic terms from
the same theory. They reach about twice the constant term of the
osculating nutation, which is a millisecond of time, so they matter for a
sidereal time that is quoted to that precision.

Source: the MHB2000 complementary terms, as implemented by `eraEect00`.
items.doc_zh:
返回分点方程式的补充项。

分点方程式除黄经章动在真赤道上的投影外，还有来自同一理论的一组小
周期项。它们达到密切章动常数项的两倍左右，即一毫秒的时间，故对以该
精度给出的恒星时是重要的。

出处：MHB2000 补充项，按 `eraEect00` 所实现。

items.name: equation_of_the_equinoxes
items.doc:
Returns the equation of the equinoxes for a time.

The equation of the equinoxes is the difference between the true and mean
equinoxes measured along the true equator. It is the quantity a sidereal
time must be corrected by to become the hour angle of the true equinox.

The value is the projection of the nutation in longitude onto the true
equator, `dpsi cos(eps)`, plus the complementary terms of the theory.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的分点方程式。

分点方程式是沿真赤道量得的真春分点与平春分点之差。它是恒星时须用以
改正才能成为真春分点时角的量。

该值是黄经章动在真赤道上的投影 `dpsi cos(eps)`，加上该理论的补充项。

items.name: PolarMotion
items.doc:
The polar motion of the Earth, as two angles and the rotation.

The polar motion is the motion of the rotation pole within the Earth. It
is measured daily and published by the International Earth Rotation and
Reference Systems Service, so it cannot be computed from a model and is
supplied by the caller.
items.doc_zh:
地球的极移，以两个角与转动表示。

极移是自转极在地球内部的运动。它由国际地球自转与参考系服务每日测量
并发布，故无法由模型算出，而由调用方提供。

items.name: NONE
items.doc:
The zero polar motion, which is the approximation used when the
published values are not available.

The error from omitting the polar motion is under a tenth of an
arcsecond, well below the nutation but above the precision of a
modern transformation.
items.doc_zh:
零极移，即无法获得已发布值时所采用的近似。

略去极移的误差不到十分之一角秒，远低于章动，但高于现代转换的
精度。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(x: f64, y: f64, s: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a polar motion from its three angles.
items.doc_zh: 由其三个角创建极移。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the angles are usable.
items.doc_zh: 当各角可用时返回 `true`。

items.name: matrix
items.doc:
Returns the rotation matrix of the polar motion.

The rotation is a turn about the third axis by the locator, then
about the second by minus the `x` displacement, then about the first
by minus the `y` displacement. The signs are the ones the reference
uses, which carry the terrestrial frame into alignment with the
celestial pole.

Source: as implemented by `eraPom00`, which applies the rotations in
sequence by composing each on the left of the accumulator.
items.doc_zh:
返回极移的旋转矩阵。

该转动是绕第三轴转定位角，再绕第二轴转负的 `x` 位移，再绕第一轴
转负的 `y` 位移。符号是参考实现所用者，它们把地球坐标系带到与
天极对齐。

出处：按 `eraPom00` 所实现，它依次施加各转动，每次都把新转动合成
到累加器的左侧。

items.name: intermediate_to_terrestrial_matrix
items.signature: pub fn intermediate_to_terrestrial_matrix(ut1_julian_date: f64, tt_julian_date: f64) -> Mat3 {
items.doc:
Returns the intermediate-to-terrestrial matrix for a time.

The intermediate frame is the true equator and equinox of date, and the
terrestrial frame is the Earth-fixed frame at the same date. This uses
the equinox-based approach, in which the rotation from one to the other
is Greenwich apparent sidereal time.

The time arguments are the UT1 and TT Julian dates.

Source: the composition is the one `eraC2t06a` produces for the equinox
based chain, with the polar motion applied separately by the caller of
the full transformation.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的中间坐标系到地球坐标系的矩阵。

中间坐标系是该日的真赤道与真春分点，地球坐标系是同一日的地固系。这里
用基于春分点的方法，其中从一个到另一个的转动是格林尼治视恒星时。

时间参数为 UT1 与 TT 儒略日。

出处：该合成即 `eraC2t06a` 对基于春分点的链条所产生者，极移由完整
变换的调用方单独施加。

items.name: greenwich_apparent_sidereal_time
items.signature: pub fn greenwich_apparent_sidereal_time(ut1_julian_date: f64, tt_julian_date: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns Greenwich apparent sidereal time for a UT1 and a TT Julian date.

This is the mean sidereal time plus the equation of the equinoxes, so it
is the hour angle of the true equinox.

Source: as implemented by `eraGst06a`.
items.doc_zh:
返回某 UT1 与 TT 儒略日的格林尼治视恒星时。

它是平恒星时加分点方程式，故即真春分点的时角。

出处：按 `eraGst06a` 所实现。

items.name: greenwich_mean_sidereal_time
items.signature: pub fn greenwich_mean_sidereal_time(ut1_julian_date: f64, tt_julian_date: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns Greenwich mean sidereal time for a UT1 and a TT Julian date.

The relation is the Earth rotation angle plus the accumulated precession
in right ascension, which is the quantity that relates the equinox to the
non-rotating origin.

Source: as implemented by `eraGmst06`.
items.doc_zh:
返回某 UT1 与 TT 儒略日的格林尼治平恒星时。

关系为地球自转角加上赤经上的累积岁差，后者是联系春分点与非旋转原点
的量。

出处：按 `eraGmst06` 所实现。

items.name: earth_rotation_angle
items.doc:
Returns the Earth rotation angle for a UT1 Julian date.

This is the linear expression of the International Astronomical Union,
which is exact to the precision the angle is known.

Source: IERS Conventions (2010), equation 8.32.
items.doc_zh:
返回某 UT1 儒略日的地球自转角。

这是国际天文学联合会的线性表达式，它在该角已知的精度内是精确的。

出处：IERS Conventions（2010），式 8.32。

items.name: celestial_to_terrestrial_matrix
items.signature: pub fn celestial_to_terrestrial_matrix( ut1_julian_date: f64, tt_julian_date: f64, polar_motion: PolarMotion, ) -> Mat3 {
items.doc:
Returns the celestial-to-terrestrial matrix for a time.

This composes the whole chain: the frame bias, the precession, the
nutation, the Earth rotation, and the polar motion.

The time arguments are the UT1 and TT Julian dates, and the polar motion
is supplied by the caller because it is measured rather than modelled.

Source: the composition is the one `eraC2t06a` produces.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的天球到地球坐标系矩阵。

它合成整条链：坐标架偏差、岁差、章动、地球自转与极移。

时间参数为 UT1 与 TT 儒略日，极移由调用方提供，因为它是实测而非建模
的。

出处：该合成即 `eraC2t06a` 所产生者。

crates.name: apsis-tle
crates.summary:
Parsing of two-line element sets.

A two-line element set (TLE) describes a satellite orbit in the form
used by the North American Aerospace Defense Command and distributed by
Space-Track. The name of the satellite is carried on an optional first
line, and the two following lines carry the orbital data.

The format is fixed width. Every field occupies a fixed range of columns
and the checksum of each line is the sum of its digits modulo ten, where
a minus sign counts as one. This crate parses a TLE into structured
fields and verifies the line checksums and the matching element set
number. It does not interpret the fields; the mean elements and their
units are the concern of `apsis-sgp4`.

Column positions are one based, matching the documentation of the format.
Two conventions from the format are worth stating explicitly, because
they are easy to misread:

- An exponent field is written as a signed single digit followed by the
  magnitude. For example ` 12345-3` means `0.12345e-3`, not `12345e-3`.
- An assumed decimal point is written without a decimal point. For
  example the eccentricity field `0006703` means `0.0006703`.

Source: the field layout follows the format description published by
CelesTrak, *FAQs: Two-Line Element Set Format*, which documents the
columns defined by the original NORAD specification. The checksum rule
is the one stated there and used by Space-Track.

```
use apsis_tle::TwoLineElement;

let text = concat!(
    "1 25544U 98067A   08264.51782528 -.00002182  00000-0 -11606-4 0  2927\r\n",
    "2 25544  51.6416 247.4627 0006703 130.5360 325.0288 15.72125391563537\r\n",
);
let element = TwoLineElement::parse(text).expect("sample is well formed");
assert_eq!(element.satellite_number, 25544);
assert!((element.eccentricity - 0.0006703).abs() < 1e-12);
```
crates.summary_zh:
两行根数集的解析。

两行根数集（TLE）以北美防空司令部所用、由 Space-Track 分发的形式描述
卫星轨道。卫星名称携带在可选的第一行，其后两行携带轨道数据。

该格式是定宽的。每个字段占据固定的列范围，每行的校验和是其各位数字之和
模十，其中负号计为一。本 crate 把 TLE 解析为结构化字段，并校验各行校验和
与相匹配的根数集编号。它不解释各字段；平根数及其单位是 `apsis-sgp4` 的
事。

列位置以 1 为基，与该格式的文档一致。该格式有两条约定值得明确写出，因为
它们容易误读：

- 指数字段写为一个带符号的单数字后接幅度。例如 ` 12345-3` 意为
  `0.12345e-3`，而非 `12345e-3`。
- 隐含小数点不写小数点。例如偏心率字段 `0006703` 意为 `0.0006703`。

出处：字段布局遵循 CelesTrak 发布的格式说明，*FAQs: Two-Line Element Set
Format*，它记录了原 NORAD 规范所定义的各列。校验和规则即其中所述、
Space-Track 所用者。

items.name: line_checksum
items.doc:
Returns the checksum of the first 68 columns of a line.

The input may include the trailing checksum digit, which is ignored
because only the first 68 columns contribute to the sum. A line shorter
than 68 characters contributes only the columns it has.

A minus sign contributes one, a decimal digit contributes its value, and
every other character contributes nothing.
items.doc_zh:
返回某行前 68 列的校验和。

输入可以包含末尾的校验和数字，该位被忽略，因为只有前 68 列参与求和。短于
68 字符的行只贡献其实际具有的列。

负号贡献 1，十进制数字贡献其数值，其余字符不贡献。

items.name: verify_line_checksum
items.signature: pub fn verify_line_checksum(line: &str, line_number: usize) -> Result<()> {
