items.doc:
Verifies that the last character of a line is its checksum.

The line must be at least 69 characters long, because the checksum
occupies column 69. The expected value is compared against
[`line_checksum`] of the same line.

`line_number` is the one based number used in any error that is
returned, so that a caller parsing a multi-line input can report which
line failed.
items.doc_zh:
校验某行末位字符是否为其校验和。

该行至少须有 69 个字符，因为校验和位于第 69 列。期望值与同一行的
[`line_checksum`] 比较。

`line_number` 是返回错误时使用的从一开始的行号，使解析多行输入的调用方
能指出是哪一行失败。

items.name: Classification
items.doc: The security classification of an element set.
items.doc_zh: 根数集的安全密级。

items.name: as_char
items.doc: Returns the character used in the element set.
items.doc_zh: 返回根数集中所用的字符。

items.name: TwoLineElement
items.doc:
A parsed two-line element set.

The fields are the mean elements and identification data exactly as
written in the element set. Units are the ones the format uses, named in
each field's documentation. Converting them to a state vector is the
concern of `apsis-sgp4`.
items.doc_zh:
已解析的两线根数集。

各字段即根数集中原样写下的平均根数与标识信息。单位沿用格式所用者，在各字段
文档中注明。把它们转换为状态矢量是 `apsis-sgp4` 的职责。

items.name: expand_two_digit_year
items.signature: pub const fn expand_two_digit_year(two_digit: u32) -> i32 {
items.doc:
Expands a two digit year using the convention that `57` through `99` are
in the twentieth century and `00` through `56` are in the twenty-first.

The boundary sits before the start of the satellite catalogue, so no
catalogue entry is placed a century away from its true date.
items.doc_zh:
按如下约定展开两位数年份：`57` 至 `99` 属二十世纪，`00` 至 `56` 属
二十一世纪。

该分界位于卫星编目开始之前，故不会有编目条目被放到距真实日期一个世纪之处。

items.name: parse
items.doc:
Parses a two-line element set from one, two, or three lines.

Line endings may be `\n`, `\r\n`, or a mix; blank lines and lines
that are entirely whitespace are ignored. A leading line that does
not begin with `1 ` is taken as the satellite name, which is how the
optional three line form is written.

Each line is checked for the expected line number in column one, for
its length, and for its checksum. The element set number of the two
lines must agree.

Returns an error describing the first failure and the line on which
it occurred.
items.doc_zh:
从一行、两行或三行文本解析两线根数集。

行结束符可以是 `\n`、`\r\n` 或二者混用；空行与全为空白字符的行会被
忽略。不以 `1 ` 开头的首行被取作卫星名称，这正是可选三行形式的写法。

每一行都检查第一列的行号、长度与校验和。两行的根数集编号必须一致。

返回描述首个失败及其所在行的错误。

items.name: ElementErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a parse failure.
items.doc_zh: 解析失败的类别。

items.name: ElementError
items.doc:
A failure while parsing a two-line element set.

The error records which line failed and, where applicable, which columns
were being read, so that a caller can point at the offending text. Line
numbers are one based and column ranges are the one based inclusive
range from the format definition.
items.doc_zh:
解析两线根数集时的失败。

该错误记录哪一行失败，并在适用时记录当时正在读取的列，使调用方能指出有问题的
文本。行号从一开始，列区间为格式定义中从一开始的含两端区间。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(kind: ElementErrorKind, line: usize, columns: Option<(usize, usize)>) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates an error with the given kind, line number, and columns.

The line number is one based. The column range is the one based
inclusive range that was being read, if the failure is tied to a
field.
items.doc_zh:
用给定类别、行号与列区间创建错误。

行号从一开始。列区间为当时正在读取的从一开始的含两端区间，当失败与某个
字段相关时给出。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the offending text.
items.doc_zh: 附加对有问题的文本的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: line
items.doc: Returns the one based number of the line that failed.
items.doc_zh: 返回失败行的从一而行号。

items.name: columns
items.doc: Returns the one based inclusive column range that failed, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回失败的从一开始的含两端列区间，若有。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: Result
items.doc: A [`Result`](core::result::Result) whose error type is [`ElementError`].
items.doc_zh: 错误类型为 [`ElementError`] 的 [`Result`](core::result::Result)。

crates.name: apsis-sgp4
crates.summary_zh:
SGP4 与 SDP4 解析轨道传播器。

该传播器接收两行根数集的平轨道根数，返回卫星在所请求瞬时的位置与速度。
它是各根数集所拟合的模型，故是使用它们的正确方式；给同一个根数集一个
通用数值积分器会偏离已发布的位置。

有两条分支，传播器按轨道周期在二者之间选择。周期低于 225 分钟的卫星用
SGP4 传播，它建模地球扁率的长期效应与一个阻力项。周期不低于该值的卫星
用 SDP4 传播，它加入在该高度占主导的共振与日月摄动。

输入与输出：

- 根数是来自 [`apsis_tle::TwoLineElement`] 的平根数。根数集中的角度以度
  计，平运动以每天圈数计；本 crate 内部换算为弧度与每分钟弧度。
- 输出表达在真赤道平春分点（TEME）坐标系中，位置以千米计、速度以千米
  每秒计。TEME 是该模型所定义的坐标系；把它换算到地固系需要地球自转与
  分点方程式，不属于本 crate。
- 时间自根数集历元起以分钟计。

出处：该算法遵循 Vallado 等，*Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3*，
AIAA 2006-6753，2006，以及随该论文分发的修订实现。

items.name: propagate_minutes_at
items.doc:
Propagates a satellite at a list of minutes from its epoch, in order.

The sequential form, provided for comparison and for small lists where
starting a thread would cost more than the work.
items.doc_zh:
按顺序在历元后若干分钟列表处传播该卫星。

顺序形式，供比较以及线程开销高于工作时的小列表使用。

items.name: propagate_minutes_at_parallel
items.doc:
Propagates a satellite at a list of minutes from its epoch, across several
threads.

The result matches [`propagate_minutes_at`] element for element and in the
same order. A minute at which the model reports a decay yields `None`, as
it does in the sequential form; the threads do not stop at the first such
minute, because a caller usually wants the whole track and will decide for
itself what a decay means.

Propagation is deterministic and depends only on the minutes, so the
result does not depend on how the work was split.

The gain depends on how much work the list holds, because starting the
threads costs a fixed amount that a short list cannot repay. A day at a
one minute step is fourteen hundred states and gains little; a month is
forty three thousand and gains several fold. A caller with many short
tracks is better served by the per satellite form below, which takes the
whole list in one call.
items.doc_zh:
跨多个线程在历元后若干分钟列表处传播该卫星。

结果与 [`propagate_minutes_at`] 逐元素相同且顺序一致。模型报告衰减的
分钟给出 `None`，与顺序形式相同；线程不会在首个这样的分钟处停下，因为
调用方通常需要整条轨迹，自行判断衰减的含义。

传播是确定性的且只依赖分钟，故结果与工作如何划分无关。

收益取决于列表所含的工作量，因为启动线程有固定开销，短列表无法收回。一
天按一分钟步长是一千四百个状态，收益很小；一个月是四万三千个，可获数倍
提升。拥有许多短轨迹的调用方更适合用下方的按卫星形式，它一次调用处理
整个列表。

items.name: propagate_at
items.signature: pub fn propagate_at(satellites: &[Satellite], tai_mjd: f64) -> Vec<Option<State>> {
items.doc:
Propagates several satellites at one instant, in order.

The per satellite work is independent, so a shell's state at a single
instant is a natural batch. The satellites are read only, so they are
shared across the threads by reference.
items.doc_zh:
按顺序在同一瞬时传播多颗卫星。

各卫星的工作彼此独立，故整壳在同一瞬时的状态是天然的批处理单元。卫星
只读，因此在各线程间按引用共享。

items.name: propagate_at_parallel
items.signature: pub fn propagate_at_parallel(satellites: &[Satellite], tai_mjd: f64) -> Vec<Option<State>> {
items.doc:
Propagates several satellites at one instant, across several threads.

The result matches [`propagate_at`] element for element and in the same
order.

This is the form a coverage run wants: it holds the whole shell in one
call, so the threads start once for every satellite rather than once per
satellite, and even a shell of a few hundred gains.
items.doc_zh:
跨多个线程在同一瞬时传播多颗卫星。

结果与 [`propagate_at`] 逐元素相同且顺序一致。

覆盖计算需要的形式：它一次调用持有整壳，故线程为所有卫星启动一次而非
每颗一次，即便几百颗的壳也能获益。

items.name: PropagationErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a propagation failure.
items.doc_zh: 传播失败的类别。

items.name: PropagationError
items.doc: A failure while initialising or propagating a satellite.
items.doc_zh: 初始化或传播卫星时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the value that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: Elements
items.doc:
The elements of a satellite in the units the propagator uses.

Angles are in radians and mean motion is in radians per minute. Helpers
convert a [`TwoLineElement`] into this form.
items.doc_zh:
卫星根数在传播器所用单位下的形式。

角度用弧度，平运动用弧度每分钟。辅助函数把 [`TwoLineElement`] 转为该形式。

items.name: from_tle
items.doc:
Converts a parsed element set into the units the propagator uses.

The epoch is taken as the UTC Modified Julian Date exactly as written
in the element set. The element set epoch is a UTC calendar instant,
but the propagator treats it as a uniform time origin, which is the
convention the theory was fitted under. Converting it to a uniform
scale first would shift the epoch by the leap second offset, about
33 seconds, and that shift propagates into the solar and lunar series
of the deep space branch.
items.doc_zh:
把已解析的根数集转换为传播器所用单位。

历元直接取根数集中原样写下的 UTC 修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。
根数集历元是 UTC 日历瞬时，但传播器把它当作均匀时间原点，这正是理论
拟合所依据的约定。若先换算到均匀标度，历元会偏移一个闰秒量（约 33
秒），而该偏移会传播进深空分支的日月级数。

items.name: unkozai_mean_motion
items.signature: pub fn unkozai_mean_motion( mean_motion: f64, eccentricity: f64, inclination: f64, model: GravityModel, ) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Applies the Kozai to Brouwer mean motion correction.

The mean motion in an element set is a Kozai mean motion, which the
theory must convert to a Brouwer mean motion before use. Writing `no` for
the element set value and `xke` for the Kepler constant, the reference
implementation evaluates

```text
ak   = (xke / no)^(2/3)
d1   = 0.75 j2 (3 cos^2 i - 1) / (sqrt(1 - e^2) (1 - e^2))
del  = d1 / ak^2
adel = ak (1 - del^2 - del (1/3 + 134 del^2 / 81))
del  = d1 / adel^2
n0   = no / (1 + del)
```

The second evaluation of `del` uses `adel` rather than `ak`, which is
what makes the correction consistent with the semi-major axis implied by
the corrected mean motion.

Source: Vallado et al., *Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3*, AIAA
2006-6753, 2006.
items.doc_zh:
施加从 Kozai 平运动到 Brouwer 平运动的修正。

根数集中的平运动是 Kozai 平运动，理论须先把它换算为 Brouwer 平运动方能
使用。以 `no` 表示根数集给出的值、`xke` 表示开普勒常数，参考实现按下式
求值：

```text
ak   = (xke / no)^(2/3)
d1   = 0.75 j2 (3 cos^2 i - 1) / (sqrt(1 - e^2) (1 - e^2))
del  = d1 / ak^2
adel = ak (1 - del^2 - del (1/3 + 134 del^2 / 81))
del  = d1 / adel^2
n0   = no / (1 + del)
```

第二次求 `del` 用的是 `adel` 而非 `ak`，这正是该修正与修正后平运动所隐含
的半长轴相一致的原因。

出处：Vallado 等，*Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3*，AIAA 2006-6753，2006。

items.name: validate
items.doc:
Validates the mean elements before initialisation.

Returns an error when the orbit cannot be propagated, for example when
the eccentricity does not describe a closed orbit or the mean motion is
not positive.
items.doc_zh:
在初始化前校验平均根数。

当轨道不可传播时返回错误，例如偏心率不描述闭合轨道，或平运动不为正。

items.name: is_deep_space
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the elements describe a deep space orbit.

The test is on the orbital period, which follows from the mean motion.
items.doc_zh:
当这些根数描述一条深空轨道时返回 `true`。

判据是轨道周期，它由平运动推出。

items.name: GravityModel
items.doc: A gravity model: the Earth constants used by the propagator.
items.doc_zh: 重力模型：传播器所用的地球常数。

items.name: WGS72
items.doc:
The WGS 72 gravity model.

This is the model the SGP4 theory was fitted to and the one that
matches the standard element sets.
items.doc_zh:
WGS 72 重力模型。

这是 SGP4 理论拟合所依据、且与标准根数集相符的模型。

items.name: WGS84
items.doc:
The WGS 84 gravity model.

Use this only with element sets fitted against WGS 84.
items.doc_zh:
WGS 84 重力模型。

仅对按 WGS 84 拟合的根数集使用。

items.name: reciprocal_sqrt_mu
items.doc:
Returns the reciprocal of the square root of the gravitational
parameter, in seconds per kilometer to the three halves.
items.doc_zh: 返回引力参数平方根的倒数，单位为秒每千米的三分之二次方。

items.name: sqrt_mu
items.doc:
Returns the square root of the gravitational parameter, in kilometers
to the three halves per second.
items.doc_zh: 返回引力参数的平方根，单位为千米的三分之二次方每秒。

items.name: xke
items.doc:
Returns `xke`, the Kepler constant, in units of `er^1.5 / min`.

The propagator works in minutes and Earth radii, so the gravitational
parameter is converted by

```text
xke = 60 / sqrt(radius^3 / mu)
```

which is the angular rate, in radians per minute, of a circular orbit
of radius one Earth radius.
items.doc_zh:
返回 `xke`（开普勒常数），单位为 `er^1.5 / min`。

传播器以分钟与地球半径为单位，故引力参数按下式换算：

```text
xke = 60 / sqrt(radius^3 / mu)
```

它是一个地球半径圆轨道的角速率，单位为弧度每分钟。

items.name: tumin
items.doc:
Returns the reciprocal of `xke`, in minutes.

This is the time unit of the model: the period of the reference
circular orbit divided by two pi.
items.doc_zh:
返回 `xke` 的倒数，单位为分钟。

它是模型的时间单位：参考圆轨道的周期除以二 pi。

items.name: j3_over_j2
items.doc: Returns `j3 / j2`, which appears as a single ratio in the theory.
items.doc_zh: 返回 `j3 / j2`，理论中以单一比值形式出现。

items.name: x2o3
items.doc:
Returns `2 / 3`, the exponent the model uses in the mean motion and
drag corrections.

It appears as a power rather than a factor, in terms such as
`(xke / mean_motion)^(2/3)`, so it is a constant and does not depend
on this model.
items.doc_zh:
返回 `2 / 3`，即模型在平运动与阻力修正中使用的指数。

它以幂而非因子出现，例如 `(xke / mean_motion)^(2/3)`，故为常数，与
本模型无关。

items.name: Satellite
items.doc:
A satellite prepared for propagation.

Construct one with [`Satellite::from_element`], then call
[`Satellite::propagate_minutes`] or [`Satellite::propagate_at`] for each
instant of interest. The initialisation work, including the mean motion
correction and every coefficient that depends only on the elements, is
done once at construction.
items.doc_zh:
为传播而准备好的卫星。

用 [`Satellite::from_element`] 构造一个，然后对每个关心的瞬时调用
[`Satellite::propagate_minutes`] 或 [`Satellite::propagate_at`]。初始化工作
——包括平运动修正以及所有只依赖根数的系数——在构造时完成一次。

items.name: from_element
items.signature: pub fn from_element(element: &TwoLineElement, model: GravityModel) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Initialises a satellite from a parsed element set.

Returns `None` when the mean elements do not describe an orbit the
model can propagate, for example when the eccentricity is at least
one. A caller that needs the reason should use
[`Satellite::try_from_element`].
items.doc_zh:
由已解析的根数集初始化卫星。

当平均根数不描述模型可传播的轨道时返回 `None`，例如偏心率不小于一
的情形。需要知道原因的调用方应使用 [`Satellite::try_from_element`]。

items.name: try_from_element
items.signature: pub fn try_from_element( element: &TwoLineElement, model: GravityModel, ) -> Result<Self, PropagationError> {
items.doc:
Initialises a satellite from a parsed element set.

Returns an error describing which element is not propagatable when
the elements are rejected.
items.doc_zh:
由已解析的根数集初始化卫星。

当根数被拒绝时，返回一个说明哪个根数不可传播的错误。

items.name: try_from_elements
items.signature: pub fn try_from_elements( elements: &Elements, model: GravityModel, ) -> Result<Self, PropagationError> {
items.doc: Initialises a satellite from mean elements already in model units.
items.doc_zh: 由已按模型单位表示的平均根数初始化卫星。

items.name: epoch_mjd
items.doc:
Returns the epoch of the elements as a Modified Julian Date on the
TAI scale.
items.doc_zh: 返回根数历元，为 TAI 标度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

items.name: is_deep_space
items.doc: Returns `true` when the deep space branch applies.
items.doc_zh: 当深空分支适用时返回 `true`。

items.name: minutes_since_epoch
items.signature: pub fn minutes_since_epoch(&self, tai_mjd: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the number of minutes from the element set epoch to the
given instant.

The instant is given as a Modified Julian Date on the TAI scale, the
same scale as [`Satellite::epoch_mjd`].
items.doc_zh:
返回自根数集历元到给定瞬时的分钟数。

该瞬时以 TAI 标度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）给出，与
[`Satellite::epoch_mjd`] 同一标度。

items.name: propagate_at
items.signature: pub fn propagate_at(&self, tai_mjd: f64) -> Result<State, PropagationError> {
items.doc:
Returns the state of the satellite at a given instant.

The instant is a Modified Julian Date on the TAI scale.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星在某瞬时的状态。

该瞬时是 TAI 时标上的约化儒略日。

items.name: propagate_minutes
items.signature: pub fn propagate_minutes(&self, minutes: f64) -> Result<State, PropagationError> {
items.doc:
Returns the state of the satellite at a number of minutes from the
element set epoch.

Negative values propagate backwards. The result is in the True
Equator Mean Equinox frame, with position in kilometers and velocity
in kilometers per second.

Returns [`PropagationErrorKind::Decayed`](crate::PropagationErrorKind::Decayed)
when the propagated radius falls below one Earth radius, which the
model treats as the satellite having re-entered.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星距根数集历元若干分钟处的状态。

负值向后传播。结果在真赤道平春分点坐标系中，位置以千米计、速度以千米
每秒计。

当传播所得半径低于一个地球半径时返回
[`PropagationErrorKind::Decayed`](crate::PropagationErrorKind::Decayed)，
模型将其视为卫星已经再入。

items.name: xke
items.doc:
Returns the Kepler constant of the model, in radians per minute per
Earth radius to the three halves.
items.doc_zh: 返回模型的开普勒常数，单位为弧度每分每地球半径的三分之二次方。

items.name: State
items.doc:
The position and velocity of a satellite in the True Equator Mean Equinox
frame.

Position is in kilometers and velocity is in kilometers per second. The
frame is the one the model defines, with its first axis toward the mean
equinox, its third axis along the true equator pole, and the second
completing a right-handed set.
items.doc_zh:
真赤道平春分点系中卫星的位置与速度。

位置单位为千米，速度单位为千米每秒。该系是模型所定义者：第一轴指向平春分点，
第三轴沿真赤道极，第二轴构成右手系。

items.name: altitude_radius
items.doc: Returns the distance from the center of the Earth, in kilometers.
items.doc_zh: 返回到地心的距离，单位为千米。

items.name: speed
items.doc:
Returns the speed relative to the Earth's center, in kilometers per
second.
items.doc_zh: 返回相对地心的速率，单位为千米每秒。

crates.name: apsis-kepler
crates.summary:
Keplerian orbital elements and two-body propagation.

A Keplerian element set describes an orbit as an ellipse, a parabola, or
a hyperbola with a fixed orientation in space. From the six elements and
the gravitational parameter, this crate computes the position and
velocity at any time under the two-body assumption, and converts in the
other direction.

The two-body model includes only the point mass gravity of the central
body. It omits the oblateness of the Earth, drag, and third body
perturbations, so it drifts from reality over time. It is the right model
for analysing an orbit whose elements are already known, for example to
find the radius at a true anomaly, and the wrong model for propagating a
two-line element set, which is the job of `apsis-sgp4`.

Angles are in radians. Lengths are kilometers and the gravitational
parameter is in cubic kilometers per second squared, matching the rest of
the orbit layer.

```
use apsis_kepler::{GravityParameter, KeplerianElements};

// A circular orbit at the Earth's equatorial radius has the speed
// sqrt(mu / r), about 7.9 km/s.
let elements = KeplerianElements {
    semi_major_axis: 6_378.137,
    eccentricity: 0.0,
    inclination: 0.0,
    right_ascension: 0.0,
    argument_of_perigee: 0.0,
    true_anomaly: 0.0,
};
let state = elements.to_state(GravityParameter::WGS84).expect("valid elements");
assert!((state.velocity.norm() - 7.909).abs() < 0.01);
```
crates.summary_zh:
开普勒轨道根数与二体传播。

开普勒根数集把轨道描述为空间中具有固定取向的椭圆、抛物线或双曲线。由
六个根数与引力参数，本 crate 在二体假定下计算任意时刻的位置与速度，并
作反方向换算。

二体模型只包含中心天体的质点引力。它略去地球扁率、阻力与第三体摄动，故
随时间偏离现实。对分析已知根数的轨道（例如求真近点角处的半径），它是恰当
的模型；对传播两行根数集，它是错误的模型，后者是 `apsis-sgp4` 的事。

角度以弧度计。长度以千米计，引力参数以立方千米每平方秒计，与 orbit 层
其余部分一致。

items.name: wrap_to_pi
items.doc: Reduces an angle into `[-pi, pi)`.
items.doc_zh: 把角度归约到 `[-pi, pi)`。

items.name: true_from_eccentric
items.signature: pub fn true_from_eccentric(eccentric_anomaly: f64, eccentricity: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the true anomaly for an eccentric anomaly and eccentricity.

The relation follows from the geometry of the auxiliary circle:

```text
tan(nu / 2) = sqrt((1 + e) / (1 - e)) tan(E / 2)
```

The half angle form is used rather than the direct cosine relation so
that the result is correct in all four quadrants without a quadrant
check.
items.doc_zh:
由偏近点角与偏心率返回真近点角。

该关系来自辅助圆的几何性质：

```text
tan(nu / 2) = sqrt((1 + e) / (1 - e)) tan(E / 2)
```

采用半角形式而非直接的余弦关系，使结果在四个象限中都正确，无需判别象限。

items.name: eccentric_from_true
items.signature: pub fn eccentric_from_true(true_anomaly: f64, eccentricity: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the eccentric anomaly for a true anomaly and eccentricity.

This is the inverse of [`true_from_eccentric`].
items.doc_zh:
由真近点角与偏心率返回偏近点角。

这是 [`true_from_eccentric`] 的逆运算。

items.name: eccentric_from_mean
items.signature: pub fn eccentric_from_mean(mean_anomaly: f64, eccentricity: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the eccentric anomaly for a mean anomaly and eccentricity.

This solves Kepler's equation

```text
M = E - e sin E
```

by Newton's method. The starting guess is the mean anomaly plus a term
proportional to the eccentricity, which keeps the iteration stable for
eccentricities approaching one. The iteration always terminates, and the
result is the value reached after at most a fixed number of steps.
items.doc_zh:
由平近点角与偏心率返回偏近点角。

用 Newton 法求解开普勒方程

```text
M = E - e sin E
```

初值取平近点角加上一个正比于偏心率的项，使迭代在偏心率趋近一时保持稳定。
迭代总会终止，结果是至多固定步数后达到的值。

items.name: mean_from_eccentric
items.signature: pub fn mean_from_eccentric(eccentric_anomaly: f64, eccentricity: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the mean anomaly for an eccentric anomaly and eccentricity.

This is Kepler's equation evaluated directly, `M = E - e sin E`.
items.doc_zh:
由偏近点角与偏心率返回平近点角。

这是直接求值的开普勒方程，`M = E - e sin E`。

items.name: mean_from_true
items.signature: pub fn mean_from_true(true_anomaly: f64, eccentricity: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the mean anomaly for a true anomaly and eccentricity.

The true anomaly is first converted to the eccentric anomaly, and the
mean anomaly then follows from Kepler's equation. Going through the
eccentric anomaly avoids the separate closed form for the swept area and
keeps a single expression responsible for the relation.
items.doc_zh:
由真近点角与偏心率返回平近点角。

先把真近点角转为偏近点角，再由开普勒方程得平近点角。绕经偏近点角避免了
另立扫过面积的闭式解，使该关系只由一个表达式负责。

items.name: true_from_mean
items.signature: pub fn true_from_mean(mean_anomaly: f64, eccentricity: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc: Returns the true anomaly for a mean anomaly and eccentricity.
items.doc_zh: 由平近点角与偏心率返回真近点角。

items.name: KeplerianElements
items.doc:
The six Keplerian elements of an orbit.

The shape and size are given by the semi-major axis and the eccentricity,
the orientation by the inclination, the right ascension of the ascending
node, and the argument of perigee, and the position along the orbit by
the true anomaly.

Angles are in radians and the semi-major axis is in kilometers. The orbit
is elliptical, so the eccentricity must be below one.
items.doc_zh:
轨道的六个开普勒根数。

形状与大小由半长轴与偏心率给出，定向由倾角、升交点赤经与近地点幅角给出，
轨道上的位置由真近点角给出。

角度单位为弧度，半长轴单位为千米。轨道为椭圆，故偏心率必须小于一。

items.name: State
items.doc:
The position and velocity of a satellite in the inertial frame the
elements are referred to.

Position is in kilometers and velocity is in kilometers per second. The
frame has its first axis toward the reference direction, its third axis
along the orbit normal, and its second completing a right-handed set.
items.doc_zh:
卫星在根数所参照惯性系中的位置与速度。

位置单位为千米，速度单位为千米每秒。该系第一轴指向参考方向，第三轴沿轨道法线，
第二轴构成右手系。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the elements describe an elliptical orbit.
items.doc_zh: 当这些根数描述一条椭圆轨道时返回 `true`。

items.name: semi_latus_rectum
items.doc:
Returns the semi-latus rectum, in kilometers.

This is `a (1 - e^2)`, the distance from the focus to the orbit
measured perpendicular to the major axis.
items.doc_zh:
返回半通径，单位为千米。

它等于 `a (1 - e^2)`，即从焦点沿垂直于长轴方向量到轨道的距离。

items.name: semi_minor_axis
items.doc: Returns the semi-minor axis, in kilometers.
items.doc_zh: 返回半短轴，单位为千米。

items.name: perigee_radius
items.doc:
Returns the perigee radius, in kilometers.

This is the closest approach to the focus, `a (1 - e)`.
items.doc_zh:
返回近地点半径，单位为千米。

它是到焦点的最近距离 `a (1 - e)`。

items.name: apogee_radius
items.doc:
Returns the apogee radius, in kilometers.

This is the farthest point from the focus, `a (1 + e)`.
items.doc_zh:
返回远地点半径，单位为千米。

它是离焦点最远的点 `a (1 + e)`。

items.name: period
items.signature: pub fn period(self, parameter: GravityParameter) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the orbital period, in seconds.

This is Kepler's third law, `T = 2 pi sqrt(a^3 / mu)`.
items.doc_zh:
返回轨道周期，单位为秒。

这是开普勒第三定律，`T = 2 pi sqrt(a^3 / mu)`。

items.name: eccentric_anomaly
items.doc: Returns the eccentric anomaly corresponding to the true anomaly.
items.doc_zh: 返回与真近点角对应的偏近点角。

items.name: mean_anomaly
items.doc: Returns the mean anomaly corresponding to the true anomaly.
items.doc_zh: 返回与真近点角对应的平近点角。

items.name: to_state
items.signature: pub fn to_state(self, parameter: GravityParameter) -> Option<State> {
items.doc:
Converts these elements to a position and velocity.

Returns `None` when the elements are not a valid elliptical orbit.

The conversion places the satellite in the perifocal frame, where the
first axis points to perigee and the third along the orbit normal,

```text
r = p / (1 + e cos nu)
x = r cos nu,  y = r sin nu,  z = 0
vx = -sqrt(mu / p) sin nu
vy =  sqrt(mu / p) (e + cos nu)
```

and then rotates by the argument of perigee, the inclination, and the
right ascension of the ascending node.
items.doc_zh:
把这些根数转换为位置与速度。

当根数不是有效椭圆轨道时返回 `None`。

换算先在近点坐标系中定位卫星，该系第一轴指向近地点、第三轴沿轨道法线，

```text
r = p / (1 + e cos nu)
x = r cos nu,  y = r sin nu,  z = 0
vx = -sqrt(mu / p) sin nu
vy =  sqrt(mu / p) (e + cos nu)
```

再依次按近地点幅角、倾角与升交点赤经旋转。

items.name: from_state
items.signature: pub fn from_state(state: &State, parameter: GravityParameter) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Returns the elements for a position and velocity.

Returns `None` when the state is not finite, when the radius is zero,
or when the orbit is not elliptical. This conversion assumes the
orbit is bound, so a parabolic or hyperbolic state is rejected rather
than returned with an eccentricity at or above one.
items.doc_zh:
由位置与速度返回对应的根数。

当状态非有限、半径为零或轨道非椭圆时返回 `None`。该换算假定轨道受束缚，
因此抛物线或双曲线状态被拒绝，而不是返回偏心率大于等于一的结果。

items.name: with_true_anomaly
items.signature: pub fn with_true_anomaly(self, true_anomaly: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of these elements with a different true anomaly.
items.doc_zh: 返回真近点角不同的这些根数的副本。

items.name: with_mean_anomaly
items.signature: pub fn with_mean_anomaly(self, mean_anomaly: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns a copy of these elements at a mean anomaly.

The true anomaly is recovered from the mean anomaly through Kepler's
equation.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定平近点角处这些根数的副本。

真近点角由平近点角经开普勒方程求得。

items.name: to_mean_anomaly
items.doc:
Returns the mean anomaly, which is the linear measure of time along
the orbit.

This is the same value as [`KeplerianElements::mean_anomaly`], named
for symmetry with [`KeplerianElements::with_mean_anomaly`].
items.doc_zh:
返回平近点角，即沿轨道的时间线性度量。

其值与 [`KeplerianElements::mean_anomaly`] 相同，此处命名是为了与
[`KeplerianElements::with_mean_anomaly`] 对称。

items.name: perifocal_to_inertial
items.signature: pub fn perifocal_to_inertial( argument_of_perigee: f64, inclination: f64, right_ascension: f64, ) -> apsis_math::Mat3 {
items.doc:
Returns the rotation from the perifocal frame to the inertial frame.

The rotation is a product of three elementary rotations: by the argument
of perigee about the third axis, then the inclination about the first,
then the right ascension about the third.
items.doc_zh:
返回从近点坐标系到惯性系的旋转。

该旋转是三个基本旋转之积：先绕第三轴转近地点幅角，再绕第一轴转倾角，最后
绕第三轴转赤经。

items.name: GravityParameter
items.doc:
The gravitational parameter of the central body, in cubic kilometers per
second squared.

Two values are offered because the workspace supports both gravity
models, and the correct choice is the one that matches the source of the
orbital elements. For elements derived from a two-line element set, the
WGS 72 value is the one the SGP4 theory was fitted to.
items.doc_zh:
中心天体的引力参数，单位为立方千米每二次方秒。

提供两个值是因为工作区支持两种重力模型，正确选择取决于轨道根数的来源。对
由两线根数集导出的根数，应取 WGS 72 值，即 SGP4 理论拟合所用的那一个。

items.name: WGS72
items.doc: The WGS 72 gravitational parameter, `398 600.8 km^3/s^2`.

items.name: WGS84
items.doc: The WGS 84 gravitational parameter, `398 600.5 km^3/s^2`.

items.name: value
items.doc: Returns the value in cubic kilometers per second squared.
items.doc_zh: 返回该值，单位为立方千米每二次方秒。

items.name: sqrt
items.doc:
Returns the square root of the parameter, in kilometers to the three
halves per second.
items.doc_zh: 返回该参数的平方根，单位为千米的三分之二次方每秒。

crates.name: apsis-ephemeris
crates.summary_zh:
星历采样与插值。

传播器给出卫星在任意瞬时的状态，但当结果只用于绘制轨迹或搜索穿越时，调用
它数百万次是浪费的。本 crate 在一组时刻网格上记录状态（称为样本），并用
插值回答其间的查询。

两半是有意独立的：

- [`Ephemeris`] 是时刻与状态的表。它对状态来自何处一无所知，故由 SGP4
  传播、由二体理论计算，或从文件读取的表都以相同方式工作。
- [`Sampler`] 通过调用一个由时刻产生状态的函数来填充表。在本工作区中该
  函数通常是 `apsis_sgp4::Satellite::propagate_at`，但采样器只需要一个
  闭包，故测试可用解析函数。

插值是 Hermite 三次插值，它同时使用区间两端的位与速度。使用速度正是它
准确的原因：只过两个位置的三次式没有卫星移动多快的信息，而 Hermite 重构
匹配两端的斜率，故在相同采样间距下能好得多地复现光滑轨道。在圆轨道上误差
是步长的四阶量，故步长减半使误差约减为十六分之一。

时间以距调用方所选原点的秒数计，与 orbit 层其余部分一致。位置以千米计，
速度以千米每秒计。

items.name: Sample
items.doc:
One sampled state.

A sample is a position and velocity at a time, which is the form every
propagator in the workspace produces and the form the interpolation
needs.
items.doc_zh:
一个采样状态。

样本是某时刻的位置与速度，这既是工作区中每个传播器产出的形式，也是插值所需
的形式。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(seconds: f64, position: Vec3, velocity: Vec3) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a sample.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个样本。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the time, position, and velocity are finite.
items.doc_zh: 当时间、位置与速度都有限时返回 `true`。

items.name: radius
items.doc: Returns the distance from the origin, in kilometers.
items.doc_zh: 返回到原点的距离，单位为千米。

items.name: speed
items.doc: Returns the speed, in kilometers per second.
items.doc_zh: 返回速率，单位为千米每秒。

items.name: hermite_position
items.signature: pub fn hermite_position(p0: Vec3, v0: Vec3, p1: Vec3, v1: Vec3, dt: f64, s: f64) -> Vec3 {
items.doc:
Evaluates the Hermite cubic for one component.

`p0` and `p1` are the endpoint values, `v0` and `v1` the endpoint
derivatives with respect to time, `dt` the interval length, and `s` the
fraction along the interval in `[0, 1]`.

The four terms are the standard cubic Hermite basis: the first and third
carry the endpoints, the second and fourth the slopes. The derivative
terms are scaled by `dt` because the slopes are per unit time while `s`
is per unit interval.
items.doc_zh:
对一个分量求 Hermite 三次式的值。

`p0` 与 `p1` 为端点值，`v0` 与 `v1` 为端点处对时间的导数，`dt` 为区间长度，
`s` 为区间内位置比例，位于 `[0, 1]`。

四项即标准三次 Hermite 基：第一、三项承载端点值，第二、四项承载斜率。导数项
乘以 `dt`，因为斜率以单位时间计而 `s` 以单位区间计。

items.name: hermite_velocity
items.signature: pub fn hermite_velocity(p0: Vec3, v0: Vec3, p1: Vec3, v1: Vec3, dt: f64, s: f64) -> Vec3 {
items.doc:
Evaluates the derivative of the Hermite cubic for one component.

This is the velocity that goes with [`hermite_position`]. It is the exact
derivative of that cubic, so the reconstructed state is internally
consistent: a caller that differentiates the position gets this velocity.
items.doc_zh:
对一个分量求 Hermite 三次式的导数。

这是与 [`hermite_position`] 配对的速度，且是该三次式的精确导数，因此重建
的状态内部自洽：调用方对位置求导会得到这个速度。

items.name: hermite_state
items.signature: pub fn hermite_state(p0: Vec3, v0: Vec3, p1: Vec3, v1: Vec3, dt: f64, s: f64) -> (Vec3, Vec3) {
items.doc: Evaluates both the Hermite position and velocity.
items.doc_zh: 同时求 Hermite 位置与速度。

items.name: Ephemeris
items.doc:
A table of sampled states that answers queries by interpolation.

The table holds at least two samples in strictly increasing time order.
A query at a sample time returns that sample exactly; a query between two
samples returns the Hermite cubic through the four endpoint values. A
query outside the covered interval is refused rather than extrapolated,
because the interpolation has no information there and an extrapolated
orbit can diverge quickly.
items.doc_zh:
以插值回答查询的采样状态表。

该表至少含两个样本，时间严格递增。在样本时刻查询会精确返回该样本；两个样本
之间的查询返回穿过四个端点值的 Hermite 三次式。落在覆盖区间之外的查询会被
拒绝而非外推，因为插值在那里没有信息，而外推的轨道可能迅速发散。

items.name: from_samples
items.signature: pub fn from_samples(samples: Vec<Sample>) -> Result<Self, EphemerisError> {
items.doc:
Builds a table from samples in increasing time order.

Returns an error when there are fewer than two samples, when a sample
is not finite, or when the times do not strictly increase.
items.doc_zh:
由时间递增的样本构建该表。

当样本少于两个、某个样本非有限，或时间未严格递增时返回错误。

items.name: samples
items.doc: Returns the samples in time order.
items.doc_zh: 返回按时间排列的样本。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of samples.
items.doc_zh: 返回样本数。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the table is empty.

A table built through [`Ephemeris::from_samples`] is never empty, so
this is always `false` for one that exists; it is provided so that
generic code that accepts a slice can use the usual pair of methods.
items.doc_zh:
当该表为空时返回 `true`。

经 [`Ephemeris::from_samples`] 构建的表不会为空，故已存在的表恒返回
`false`；提供它是为了让接受切片的泛型代码可以配上惯常的一对方法。

items.name: start_time
items.doc: Returns the first sample time, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回首个样本时刻，单位为秒。

items.name: end_time
items.doc: Returns the last sample time, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回末个样本时刻，单位为秒。

items.name: duration
items.doc: Returns the time the table covers, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回该表覆盖的时间，单位为秒。

items.name: covers
items.signature: pub fn covers(&self, seconds: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when a time falls within the covered interval.

The interval is closed, so its endpoints are covered.
items.doc_zh:
当某时刻落在覆盖区间内时返回 `true`。

该区间是闭的，故其端点也被覆盖。

items.name: uniform_step
items.doc:
Returns the nominal step, when the samples are evenly spaced.

Returns `None` when the spacing varies, which a caller checks before
indexing samples by arithmetic.
items.doc_zh:
当样本等间隔时返回标称步长。

间隔不一致时返回 `None`；调用方应先检查这一点，再按算术方式索引样本。

items.name: is_uniform
items.doc: Returns `true` when the samples are evenly spaced.
items.doc_zh: 当样本等间隔时返回 `true`。

items.name: state_at
items.signature: pub fn state_at(&self, seconds: f64) -> Option<Sample> {
items.doc:
Returns the state at a time, interpolating between samples.

A time equal to a sample time returns that sample. Returns `None`
when the time is outside the covered interval.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的状态，在样本之间插值。

时刻与某样本相同时返回该样本。落在覆盖区间之外时返回 `None`。

items.name: clamped_state_at
items.signature: pub fn clamped_state_at(&self, seconds: f64) -> Option<Sample> {
items.doc:
Returns the state at a time, or the nearest endpoint when the time is
outside the covered interval.

This is for a caller that must produce a value for any time and is
content to hold the last known state rather than fail.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时刻的状态；时刻落在覆盖区间之外时返回最近的端点。

适用于必须对任意时刻给出取值、且宁可保持最近已知状态而不愿失败的调用方。

items.name: nearest_sample
items.signature: pub fn nearest_sample(&self, seconds: f64) -> Option<Sample> {
items.doc: Returns the sample nearest to a time, without interpolating.
items.doc_zh: 返回距某时刻最近的样本，不作插值。

items.name: times
items.doc: Returns the times of every sample, in order.
items.doc_zh: 返回各样本时刻，按顺序排列。

items.name: all_samples
items.signature: pub fn all_samples<F>(&self, predicate: F) -> bool where F: Fn(&Sample) -> bool, {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every state satisfies a predicate.

This is a convenience for a caller that wants to check a property of
the whole table, such as every radius being above the surface, once.
items.doc_zh:
当每个状态都满足给定谓词时返回 `true`。

这是给需要一次性检查整表性质的调用方的便利方法，例如检查所有半径都在
表面之上。

items.name: EphemerisErrorKind
items.doc: The category of an ephemeris error.
items.doc_zh: 星历错误的类别。

items.name: EphemerisError
items.doc: A failure while building or querying an ephemeris.
items.doc_zh: 构建或查询星历时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the value that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: Sampler
items.doc:
A uniform time grid that a state function is evaluated on.

A sampler describes when to sample and how finely. The grid is defined by
a start time, an end time, and a step, and the number of samples follows
from them: the samples are placed at the start and at every step up to
the end, with the end itself included whether or not it falls on the
grid. Including the end matters, because a caller that asks for coverage
up to a time expects the table to reach it.
items.doc_zh:
状态函数求值的均匀时间网格。

采样器说明何时采样以及采样多密。网格由起始时刻、结束时刻与步长定义，样本数
随之而定：样本置于起点及此后每隔一步处，并始终包含结束时刻，无论它是否落在
网格上。包含结束时刻很重要，因为要求覆盖到某时刻的调用方期望表格确实延伸到
那里。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(start_seconds: f64, end_seconds: f64, step_seconds: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a sampler over an interval with a step.
items.doc_zh: 按给定步长在某区间上创建采样器。

items.name: sample_count
items.doc:
Returns the number of samples the grid produces.

This is the number of whole steps that fit in the interval plus one
for the start and one for the end when the end is off the grid.
Returns `None` when the sampler is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回该网格产生的样本数。

它等于区间内容纳的整步数，加上起点那一个；当结束时刻不在网格上时再加
结束那一个。采样器不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: times
items.doc:
Returns the times of the grid, in order.

Returns `None` when the sampler is not usable. The last time is the
end when the end does not fall on the grid, and the last grid point
otherwise.
items.doc_zh:
返回网格上的各时刻，按顺序排列。

采样器不可用时返回 `None`。结束时刻不落在网格上时最后一项为结束时刻，
否则为最后一个网格点。

items.name: sample
items.signature: pub fn sample<F>(&self, mut state_at: F) -> Result<Ephemeris, EphemerisError> where F: FnMut(f64) -> Sample, {
items.doc:
Fills an ephemeris by evaluating a state function on the grid.

The function maps a time in seconds to a position and velocity. In
this workspace it is normally a closure over
`apsis_sgp4::Satellite::propagate_at`, but any function works, so
the sampler can be tested against an analytic orbit.

Returns an error when the sampler is not usable or when the function
produces a state that is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
在网格上求值状态函数以填充星历。

该函数把以秒计的时刻映射为位置与速度。在本工作区它通常是
`apsis_sgp4::Satellite::propagate_at` 上的闭包，但任何函数都可以，因此
采样器也可针对解析轨道测试。

采样器不可用或函数产生非有限状态时返回错误。

items.name: sample_positions
items.signature: pub fn sample_positions<F>(&self, mut position_at: F) -> Result<Ephemeris, EphemerisError> where F: FnMut(f64) -> Vec3, {
items.doc:
Fills an ephemeris from a function that returns only a position.

The velocity is reconstructed from neighbouring positions by a
central difference. This is for a position-only source, such as a
tabulated file; where a velocity is available it should be used, so
prefer [`Sampler::sample`].
items.doc_zh:
用只返回位置的函数填充星历。

速度由相邻位置用中心差分重建。这适用于只有位置的数据源，例如制表文件；
若可得速度应予使用，故优先选用 [`Sampler::sample`]。

crates.name: apsis-maneuver
crates.summary:
Impulsive and finite orbital maneuver models.

A maneuver changes an orbit by applying thrust. The two models here are
the two ends of the spectrum.

An impulsive maneuver, [`Impulse`], applies a velocity change
instantaneously, so the position is unchanged and only the velocity
jumps. This is the model for a chemical burn, whose duration is short
compared with the orbital period, and it is the model every textbook
delta-v budget is written in. It is exact in the limit of zero burn time
and the source of the closed form results for transfers between two
orbits.

A finite maneuver, [`FiniteBurn`], applies a constant acceleration over a
duration, so the position drifts during the burn and the achieved
velocity change is less than the thrust would give in free space when
the thrust has to fight gravity. It is the model for an electric
thruster, whose burn may last a large fraction of an orbit, and for any
burn where the short duration approximation is not good enough.

The two agree in the limit: a finite burn of acceleration `a` over a
duration `t` delivers the impulse `a t`, so a [`FiniteBurn`] with a
vanishing duration converges on the matching [`Impulse`]. The tests check
that limit, which is what ties the two models together.

The impulsive model also provides the classic two impulse transfer
between two coplanar circular orbits, [`hohmann_transfer`], which is the
reference every low thrust result is compared against. It gives the two
burns and the total delta-v for a transfer between two circular orbits of
given radii, together with the transfer time, the half period of the
transfer ellipse.

Conventions match the rest of the orbit layer: lengths are in kilometers,
velocities in kilometers per second, and angles in radians.

```
use apsis_maneuver::{Impulse, hohmann_transfer};
use apsis_kepler::GravityParameter;
use apsis_math::Vec3;

// An impulsive burn straight along the velocity.
let impulse = Impulse::new(Vec3::new(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)).expect("the change is usable");
assert!((impulse.magnitude() - 1.0).abs() < 1e-12);

// The two burns that raise a circular orbit from 7000 to 8000 km.
let transfer = hohmann_transfer(7_000.0, 8_000.0, GravityParameter::WGS84)
    .expect("the radii are usable");
assert!(transfer.first_burn > 0.0);
assert!(transfer.total_delta_v() > 0.0);
```
crates.summary_zh:
脉冲式与有限式轨道机动模型。

机动通过施加推力改变轨道。此处的两个模型是谱系的两端。

脉冲机动 [`Impulse`] 瞬时施加速度变化，故位置不变、只有速度跃变。这是
化学推进点火所用的模型，其持续时间相对轨道周期很短，也是每本教科书
delta-v 预算所写的模型。它在点火时间为零的极限下精确，也是两轨道之间
转移各闭式结果的来源。

有限机动 [`FiniteBurn`] 在一段时长上施加恒定加速度，故位置在点火期间
漂移，且当推力须对抗引力时，所达到的速度变化小于推力在自由空间中会给出
的。这是电推进器所用的模型，其点火可能持续轨道的很大一部分，也适用于
任何短时近似不够好的点火。

二者在极限下一致：加速度为 `a`、时长为 `t` 的有限点火给出冲量 `a t`，
故时长趋于零的 [`FiniteBurn`] 收敛到相应的 [`Impulse`]。测试检查该极限，
正是它把两个模型联系起来。

脉冲模型还提供两个共面圆轨道之间经典的双脉冲转移
[`hohmann_transfer`]，它是每个低推力结果所比较的参照。它给出给定半径的
两个圆轨道之间转移的两次点火与总 delta-v，以及转移时间，即转移椭圆的
半个周期。

约定与 orbit 层其余部分一致：长度以千米计，速度以千米每秒计，角度以
弧度计。

items.name: FiniteBurn
items.doc:
A maneuver that applies a constant acceleration for a duration.

A finite burn is the model for a thruster that is on for long enough that
its duration cannot be ignored: an electric thruster, whose burn may last
a large fraction of an orbit, or any burn where the spacecraft moves
appreciably while thrusting.

The acceleration is held constant in an inertial frame chosen by the
caller. That is the simplification this model makes: a real thruster
fires along a body axis that rotates as the spacecraft turns to hold a
direction, and modelling that requires the attitude history, which is not
part of this crate.
items.doc_zh:
在一段时间内施加恒定加速度的机动。

有限推力点火适用于推力器工作时间足够长、其时长无法忽略的情形：电推力器的
点火可能持续轨道相当大一部分，任何推力期间航天器有明显位移的点火亦属此类。

加速度在调用方选定的惯性系中保持恒定。这是本模型所作的简化：真实推力器
沿随航天器转动以保持方向的本体轴喷焰，建模这一点需要姿态历史，而它不属
于本 crate 的范围。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(acceleration: Vec3, duration: f64) -> Result<Self, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Creates a burn from an acceleration and a duration.

Returns an error when a value is not finite, when the duration is not
positive, or when the acceleration is zero.
items.doc_zh:
由加速度与时长创建一次点火。

当某个值非有限、时长不为正或加速度为零时返回错误。

items.name: along
items.signature: pub fn along(direction: Vec3, acceleration: f64, duration: f64) -> Result<Self, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Creates a burn of a given acceleration magnitude along a direction.

The direction is normalized, so the acceleration magnitude is fixed
whatever the length of the direction vector.
items.doc_zh:
沿给定方向创建指定大小加速度的点火。

方向被归一化，故无论方向矢量多长，加速度大小都固定不变。

items.name: acceleration
items.doc: Returns the acceleration vector, in kilometers per second squared.
items.doc_zh: 返回加速度矢量，单位为千米每二次方秒。

items.name: acceleration_magnitude
items.doc:
Returns the magnitude of the acceleration, in kilometers per second
squared.
items.doc_zh: 返回加速度大小，单位为千米每二次方秒。

items.name: duration
items.doc: Returns the duration, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回时长，单位为秒。

items.name: nominal_delta_v
items.doc:
Returns the velocity change the acceleration would give in free space,
in kilometers per second.

This is the acceleration times the duration, the delta-v the burn
would deliver without gravity acting during it. Under gravity the
achieved change is close to this for a short burn and differs from it
for a long one, which is the difference the finite model exists to
capture.
items.doc_zh:
返回该加速度在自由空间中会造成的速度变化，单位为千米每秒。

它是加速度乘以时长，即点火在不受引力作用时会提供的 delta-v。在引力
作用下，短点火的实际变化与之接近，长点火则不同，这正是有限推力模型
得以存在的意义。

items.name: equivalent_impulse
items.doc:
Returns the impulse equivalent to the nominal change.

This is the impulsive burn the finite one approximates as its
duration shrinks, and it is what [`FiniteBurn::apply`] returns in the
limit of a constant gravity field.
items.doc_zh:
返回与标称变化等效的冲量。

它是有限点火在时长趋零时所逼近的脉冲点火，也是 [`FiniteBurn::apply`]
在恒定引力场极限下给出的量。

items.name: apply
items.signature: pub fn apply( self, state: State, parameter: GravityParameter, steps: usize, ) -> Result<BurnOutcome, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Applies the burn to a state under two-body gravity.

The position and velocity are integrated forward over the duration
with the constant acceleration added to gravity. The exact solution
of constant acceleration plus point mass gravity has no closed form,
so the integration is a fixed step fourth order Runge-Kutta, which is
accurate for the short arcs a burn occupies.

The achieved velocity change is measured against a coast of the same
duration, not against the initial velocity. That distinction matters:
gravity changes the velocity during the burn even with no thrust, so
the difference between the final and the initial velocity includes
the natural rotation of the velocity vector. Comparing against the
coast isolates the contribution of the thrust, which is what the
burn bought; it also makes the result converge on the nominal change
as the duration shrinks, which the difference from the initial
velocity would not.

Returns the state at the end of the burn together with the achieved
velocity change.
items.doc_zh:
在二体引力下把该点火作用于一个状态。

位置与速度在时长内积分前进，积分时把恒定加速度叠加到引力上。恒定加速度
加质点引力的精确解没有闭式，故用定步长四阶 Runge-Kutta 积分，对点火所占
的短弧段是精确的。

实际达到的速度变化以同时长的滑行作为比较基准，而非以初始速度。区分这
一点很重要：即使无推力，引力在点火期间也会改变速度，故末速度与初速度
之差含速度矢量的自然转动。与滑行比较才能隔离出推力的贡献，即该次点火
实际买到的东西；这也使结果在时长趋零时收敛到标称变化，而与初速度
作差则不然。

返回点火结束时的状态及实际达到的速度变化。

items.name: apply_to_elements
items.signature: pub fn apply_to_elements( self, elements: KeplerianElements, parameter: GravityParameter, steps: usize, ) -> Result<BurnOutcome, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Applies the burn to a set of Keplerian elements.

The elements are converted to a state, the burn is applied to it, and
the result is converted back. Returns an error when the elements are
not valid, when the integration fails, or when the resulting state is
no longer an elliptical orbit, which happens when the burn is large
enough to escape.
items.doc_zh:
把该点火作用于一组开普勒根数。

先把根数转为状态，对状态施加点火，再转回根数。当根数无效、积分失败，或
结果状态不再是椭圆轨道时返回错误；后者在点火足够大以致逃逸时发生。

items.name: BurnOutcome
items.doc:
What a finite burn produced.

The outcome keeps the final state, the change the burn achieved, and the
change the acceleration would have given in free space, so a caller can
see how much gravity cost or added during the burn.
items.doc_zh:
一次有限推力点火的产物。

结果保留末状态、点火实际达到的变化，以及该加速度在自由空间中会造成的
变化，使调用方可以看出点火期间引力造成或增加了多少。

items.name: achieved_magnitude
items.doc: Returns the magnitude of the achieved velocity change.
items.doc_zh: 返回实际达到的速度变化的大小。

items.name: gravity_loss
items.doc:
Returns the difference between the achieved and nominal change, in
kilometers per second.

A negative value means gravity turned the velocity against the thrust
during the burn, so the burn bought less than its free space delta-v.
items.doc_zh:
返回实际变化与标称变化之差，单位为千米每秒。

负值表示点火期间引力把速度转向了推力的反方向，使该次点火的收获小于其
自由空间 delta-v。

items.name: elements
items.signature: pub fn elements(&self, parameter: GravityParameter) -> Option<KeplerianElements> {
items.doc:
Returns the elements at the end of the burn.

Returns `None` when the final state is not an elliptical orbit, which
happens when the burn is large enough to escape.
items.doc_zh:
返回点火结束时的根数。

当末状态不是椭圆轨道时返回 `None`；这在点火足够大以致逃逸时发生。

items.name: ManeuverErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a maneuver error.
items.doc_zh: 机动错误的类别。

items.name: ManeuverError
items.doc: A failure while building or applying a maneuver.
items.doc_zh: 构建或应用机动时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the value that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: HohmannTransfer
items.doc:
A two impulse transfer between two coplanar circular orbits.

The transfer is the classic Hohmann maneuver: a burn onto an ellipse
whose perigee touches the lower orbit and whose apogee touches the upper
one, a coast for half the ellipse's period, and a second burn onto the
destination circle. It is the cheapest two impulse transfer between two
coplanar circular orbits in the impulsive model, which is why it is the
reference every other transfer is measured against.

The burns are signed along the direction of motion: a positive value
raises the orbit and a negative one lowers it, so the same type covers a
climb and a descent. The total is the sum of the magnitudes, which is the
quantity a propellant budget uses.
items.doc_zh:
两个共面圆轨道之间的双脉冲转移。

该转移即经典的 Hohmann 机动：一次点火进入椭圆，其近地点相切于较低轨道、
远地点相切于较高轨道，沿该椭圆滑行半个周期，再一次点火进入目标圆轨道。它
是脉冲模型中两个共面圆轨道之间最省的双脉冲转移，因此成为衡量其他转移的
基准。

两次点火沿运动方向带符号：正值抬升轨道，负值降低轨道，故同一类型同时
表达上升与下降。总和取两者模之和，即推进剂预算所用的量。

items.name: total_delta_v
items.doc:
Returns the total velocity change, in kilometers per second.

This is the sum of the magnitudes of the two burns, which is what the
transfer costs whatever its direction.
items.doc_zh:
返回总速度变化，单位为千米每秒。

它是两次点火大小之和，即无论方向如何该转移所需的代价。

items.name: is_raising
items.doc: Returns `true` when the transfer raises the orbit.
items.doc_zh: 当该转移抬升轨道时返回 `true`。

items.name: first_burn_magnitude
items.doc: Returns the velocity change of the first burn, unsigned.
items.doc_zh: 返回第一次点火的速度变化，不带符号。

items.name: second_burn_magnitude
items.doc: Returns the velocity change of the second burn, unsigned.
items.doc_zh: 返回第二次点火的速度变化，不带符号。

items.name: mean_radius
items.doc:
Returns the mean radius the transfer is symmetric about, in
kilometers.

This is the semi-major axis of the ellipse, which is the arithmetic
mean of the two orbit radii.
items.doc_zh:
返回该转移所对称的平均半径，单位为千米。

它即该椭圆的半长轴，为两个轨道半径的算术平均。

items.name: hohmann_transfer
items.signature: pub fn hohmann_transfer( from_radius: f64, to_radius: f64, parameter: GravityParameter, ) -> Result<HohmannTransfer, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Returns the two impulse transfer between two circular orbits.

The radii are in kilometers and must be finite and positive. The two may
be given in either order: a larger second radius is a climb and a smaller
one a descent.

Returns an error when a radius is not usable or when the two are equal,
because a transfer between an orbit and itself is not a maneuver and is
almost always a mistake in a plan.

The burns follow from the vis-viva equation. At the first radius the
circular speed is `sqrt(mu / r1)` and the speed on the transfer ellipse
is `sqrt(mu (2 / r1 - 1 / a))`, where `a` is the semi-major axis of the
ellipse, so the first burn is the difference. The second burn is the
difference between the circular speed at the destination and the speed on
the ellipse there, taken the other way round because the ellipse arrives
slower than the circle it must join. The coast time is half the period of
the ellipse.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个圆轨道之间的双脉冲转移。

半径单位为千米，须有限且为正。二者可按任意次序给出：第二个半径较大者为
上升，较小者为下降。

当某半径不可用或二者相等时返回错误，因为轨道到其自身的转移不是机动，且
几乎总是计划中的笔误。

两次点火由活力公式导出。在第一个半径处圆轨道速度为 `sqrt(mu / r1)`，而
转移椭圆上的速度为 `sqrt(mu (2 / r1 - 1 / a))`，其中 `a` 为椭圆半长轴，
第一次点火即二者之差。第二次点火是目标处圆轨道速度与椭圆上速度之差，取
相反方向，因为椭圆到达时比它必须汇入的圆轨道更慢。滑行时间为该椭圆
周期的一半。

items.name: Impulse
items.doc:
An instantaneous change in velocity.

An impulse is a velocity change applied in zero time, so it changes the
velocity of a state but not its position. That is the model for a burn
short compared with the orbital period, and it is how a delta-v budget is
written.

The change is stored as a vector in the same frame as the state it will
be applied to, so the caller is responsible for expressing it in that
frame. The magnitude is the delta-v, the quantity a propellant budget is
measured in.
items.doc_zh:
瞬时速度变化。

冲量是在零时间内施加的速度变化，故只改变状态的速度而不改变其位置。这是相对
轨道周期很短的点火的模型，也是编写 delta-v 预算所用的模型。

该变化以矢量形式存储在与待施加状态相同的坐标系中，因此调用方负责把它表达
在该系中。其模即 delta-v，推进剂预算以此计量。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(delta_v: Vec3) -> Result<Self, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Creates an impulse from a velocity change vector, in kilometers per
second.

Returns an error when a component is not finite or when the vector is
zero, because a zero change is not a maneuver and is almost always a
mistake in a plan.
items.doc_zh:
由速度变化矢量创建冲量，单位为千米每秒。

当某个分量非有限或矢量为零时返回错误，因为零变化不是机动，且几乎总是
计划中的笔误。

items.name: along
items.signature: pub fn along(direction: Vec3, magnitude: f64) -> Result<Self, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Creates an impulse of a given magnitude along a direction.

The direction is normalized, so the magnitude is the delta-v whatever
the length of the direction vector. Returns an error when the
magnitude is not positive and finite or when the direction is zero or
not finite.
items.doc_zh:
沿给定方向创建指定大小的冲量。

方向被归一化，故无论方向矢量多长，其大小即 delta-v。当大小非正或非有限，
或方向为零或非有限时返回错误。

items.name: delta_v
items.doc: Returns the velocity change vector, in kilometers per second.
items.doc_zh: 返回速度变化矢量，单位为千米每秒。

items.name: magnitude
items.doc:
Returns the magnitude of the change, in kilometers per second.

This is the delta-v the burn costs.
items.doc_zh:
返回该变化的大小，单位为千米每秒。

这就是该次点火所需的 delta-v。

items.name: scaled
items.signature: pub fn scaled(self, factor: f64) -> Result<Self, ManeuverError> {
items.doc:
Returns a copy of the change scaled by a factor.

A factor of zero produces a zero impulse, which [`Impulse::new`]
rejects, so this returns an error for it rather than a value that
cannot be built.
items.doc_zh:
返回该变化按某因子缩放后的副本。

因子为零会得到零冲量，而 [`Impulse::new`] 拒绝这种情况，故本函数对该
因子返回错误，而不是给出一个无法构造的值。

items.name: reversed
items.doc: Returns a copy of the change reversed, which undoes the burn.
items.doc_zh: 返回取反后的变化副本，即撤销该次点火。

items.name: apply_to_velocity
items.signature: pub fn apply_to_velocity(self, velocity: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
items.doc: Applies the impulse to a velocity, returning the new velocity.
items.doc_zh: 把该冲量作用于一个速度，返回新的速度。

crates.name: apsis-orbit
crates.summary_zh:
整合 orbit 层的轨道状态门面。

本 crate 是 orbit 层的单一入口。它重导出根数解析、解析传播器与二体模型，
并加入一个把它们联系起来的类型。

[`Orbit`] 保存为传播准备好的卫星，连同其初始化所用的引力模型，并提供该层
所支持的两种轨道描述之间的换算：

- 由 SGP4 传播的平根数，这是两行根数集所针对的模型，也是复现已编目卫星
  已发布位置的唯一方式。
- 瞬时开普勒根数，它描述某一瞬时的密切二体轨道，对检视与规划机动有用。

两种描述不可互换。用二体模型传播平根数，或用 SGP4 传播密切根数，会给出
不同且错误的答案；此处的换算明确说明它们朝哪个方向进行。

另有两项操作建立在传播之上并在此公开，因为它们需要同一引力参数以保持
一致：

- [`Orbit::sample_ephemeris`] 在时间网格上记录轨迹，使其可经插值而非
  传播查询，这正是覆盖或可见性搜索所需的。
- [`Orbit::apply_burn`] 对密切状态施加有限机动并返回所得根数，这正是
  机动规划所产生的。

items.name: Orbit
items.doc:
A satellite orbit, held as mean elements ready for propagation.

The type pairs a prepared SGP4 satellite with the gravity model it was
initialised against, because the osculating element conversion needs the
same gravitational parameter to be consistent with the propagation.
items.doc_zh:
以平均根数形式持有、随时可传播的卫星轨道。

该类型把准备好的 SGP4 卫星与其初始化时所用的重力模型配对，因为密切根数
换算需要同一个引力参数才能与传播保持一致。

items.name: from_element
items.signature: pub fn from_element(element: &TwoLineElement, model: GravityModel) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc: Prepares an orbit from a parsed element set and a gravity model.
items.doc_zh:
由已解析的根数集与重力模型准备轨道。

The gravity model must match the one the element set was fitted
against, which for a catalogued satellite means
[`GravityModel::WGS72`]. Returns `None` when the elements are not
propagatable.

由已解析的根数集与重力模型准备轨道。

重力模型须与该根数集拟合时所用者一致；对编目卫星即 [`GravityModel::WGS72`]。
当根数不可传播时返回 `None`。

items.name: try_from_element
items.signature: pub fn try_from_element( element: &TwoLineElement, model: GravityModel, ) -> Result<Self, PropagationError> {
items.doc: Prepares an orbit from a parsed element set and a gravity model.
items.doc_zh:
由已解析的根数集与重力模型准备轨道。

Returns an error describing which element is not propagatable.

由已解析的根数集与重力模型准备轨道。

返回一个说明哪个根数不可传播的错误。

items.name: from_elements
items.signature: pub fn from_elements( elements: &Elements, model: GravityModel, ) -> Result<Self, PropagationError> {
items.doc: Prepares an orbit from mean elements already in model units.
items.doc_zh: 由已按模型单位表示的平均根数准备轨道。

items.name: satellite
items.doc: Returns the underlying propagator.
items.doc_zh: 返回底层的传播器。

items.name: gravity_parameter
items.doc:
Returns the gravitational parameter paired with the gravity model.

The value is the one used for the osculating element conversion, so
that the conversion is consistent with the propagation.
items.doc_zh:
返回与该重力模型配对的引力参数。

该值即密切根数换算所用者，从而使换算与传播保持一致。

items.name: epoch_mjd
items.doc:
Returns the epoch of the elements as a Modified Julian Date on the
UTC scale.

The epoch is the value written in the element set, which is the
origin the propagator measures time from.
items.doc_zh:
返回根数历元，为 UTC 标度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

该历元即根数集中写下的值，也是传播器度量的时间原点。

items.name: is_deep_space
items.doc: Returns `true` when the propagator uses the deep space branch.
items.doc_zh: 当传播器使用深空分支时返回 `true`。

items.name: propagate_minutes
items.signature: pub fn propagate_minutes(&self, minutes: f64) -> Result<State, PropagationError> {
items.doc:
Returns the state at a number of minutes from the element epoch.

Position is in kilometers and velocity in kilometers per second, in
the True Equator Mean Equinox frame.
items.doc_zh:
返回距根数历元若干分钟处的状态。

位置单位为千米，速度单位为千米每秒，位于真赤道平春分点系。

items.name: propagate_at
items.signature: pub fn propagate_at(&self, utc_mjd: f64) -> Result<State, PropagationError> {
items.doc: Returns the state at a Modified Julian Date on the UTC scale.
items.doc_zh: 返回 UTC 标度上某修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）处的状态。

items.name: osculating_elements
items.signature: pub fn osculating_elements(&self, minutes: f64) -> Result<KeplerianElements, PropagationError> {
items.doc:
Returns the osculating Keplerian elements at a number of minutes from
the element epoch.

The osculating elements describe the two-body orbit that matches the
position and velocity at that instant. They are not the mean elements
of the element set, and they change along the orbit because SGP4
includes perturbations that the two-body model does not.

Returns an error when the state cannot be propagated, or when the
instantaneous orbit is not elliptical, which can happen for a state
the propagation has pushed onto an escape trajectory.
items.doc_zh:
返回距根数历元若干分钟处的密切开普勒根数。

密切根数描述与该瞬时位置和速度相匹配的二体轨道。它不是根数集的平均根数，
且沿轨道变化，因为 SGP4 含有二体模型所没有的摄动。

当状态无法传播，或瞬时轨道非椭圆时返回错误；后者可发生于传播把状态推上
逃逸轨迹的情形。

items.name: radius_at
items.signature: pub fn radius_at(&self, minutes: f64) -> Result<f64, PropagationError> {
items.doc:
Returns the magnitude of the state vector.

This is a convenience for the common case of wanting only the
distance from the center of the Earth.
items.doc_zh:
返回状态矢量的模。

这为只需到地心距离的常见情形提供便利。

items.name: position_at
items.signature: pub fn position_at(&self, minutes: f64) -> Result<Vec3, PropagationError> {
items.doc: Returns the position at a number of minutes from the element epoch.
items.doc_zh: 返回距根数历元若干分钟处的位置。

items.name: sample_ephemeris
items.signature: pub fn sample_ephemeris( &self, start_minutes: f64, end_minutes: f64, step_minutes: f64, ) -> Result<apsis_ephemeris::Ephemeris, EphemerisSamplingError> {
items.doc:
Samples the orbit into an ephemeris over a range of minutes.

The propagation is the expensive part of a track, so a table built
once and queried many times is worth the memory. The sample times are
minutes from the element epoch, matching the rest of this type, while
the returned ephemeris keeps seconds, matching `apsis-ephemeris`.

The table is built with position and velocity from the propagator,
so the Hermite interpolation has exact endpoint slopes and the error
between samples is tiny; there is no need to use the position only
route except for a source that has no velocity.

Returns an error when the grid is not usable or when a sample cannot
be propagated, which happens when the elements have decayed or the
range leaves the region where the model is defined.
items.doc_zh:
把该轨道在若干分钟的区间上采样为星历。

传播是生成轨迹中开销最大的部分，故一次建表、多次查询值得占用内存。采样
时刻以距根数历元的分钟计，与本类型其余部分一致；返回的星历则用秒，与
`apsis-ephemeris` 一致。

该表用传播器给出的位置与速度建立，故 Hermite 插值具有精确的端点斜率，
样本间误差极小；除数据源没有速度外，无需使用仅位置的路径。

当网格不可用或某样本无法传播时返回错误；后者发生于根数已衰减，或区间
超出模型定义范围的情形。

items.name: apply_burn
items.signature: pub fn apply_burn( &self, minutes: f64, burn: apsis_maneuver::FiniteBurn, steps: usize, ) -> Result<KeplerianElements, ManeuverApplicationError> {
items.doc:
Applies a finite burn and returns the resulting osculating elements.

The burn is applied to the oscillating state at the given time, so the
manoeuvre is described relative to the orbit the satellite is
actually on rather than the mean elements. The resulting elements are
the osculating elements of the post burn state, which is what a
following propagation needs. Because the underlying propagator is
built for one element set, this is a planning result rather than a
new propagator; a caller that wants to propagate the new orbit starts
a fresh `Orbit` from the returned elements.
items.doc_zh:
施加有限推力点火并返回所得的密切根数。

点火施加于给定时刻的密切状态，故该机动是相对卫星实际所在轨道而非平均
根数描述的。所得根数是点火后状态的密切根数，正是后续传播所需的。由于
底层传播器是为一个根数集构建的，这给出的是规划结果而非新的传播器；
需要传播新轨道的调用方应据此创建新的 `Orbit`。

持续时间可由 30 天星历采样路径支撑。

items.name: EphemerisSamplingError
items.doc: A failure while sampling an orbit into an ephemeris.
items.doc_zh: 把轨道采样为星历时发生的失败。

items.name: ManeuverApplicationError
items.doc: A failure while applying a burn to an orbit.
items.doc_zh: 把点火作用于轨道时发生的失败。

crates.name: apsis-constellation
crates.summary:
Constellation definition and instantiation.

A constellation is a set of satellites described by a small number of
parameters rather than as a list of individual orbits. This crate models
two forms of construction that together cover the constellations in
operational use:

- A **Walker constellation**, in which satellites are spread evenly over
  a set of orbital planes that share an inclination and a semi-major
  axis, with a fixed phase relationship between adjacent planes.
- A **custom constellation**, where each shell is described separately so
  that a design that does not follow the Walker pattern can still be
  instantiated.
crates.summary_zh:
- **Walker 星座**：卫星均匀分布在若干轨道面上，各面共用同一倾角与同一半长轴，
  相邻轨道面之间有固定的相位关系。
- **自定义星座**：每个壳层单独描述，使不遵循 Walker 构型的设计同样可以
  实例化。

Both forms produce a list of [`KeplerianElements`] at a reference time,
which the orbit layer can propagate. The constellations in use for
satellite internet are Walker patterns at several altitudes, so the
Walker constructor is the one most callers need.

两种形式都在参考时刻产出一组 [`KeplerianElements`]，可由 orbit 层传播。
当前用于卫星互联网的星座是在若干高度上的 Walker 构型，因此多数调用方需要的
是 Walker 构造函数。

The Walker notation is written `i: t/p/f`, where `i` is the inclination
in degrees, `t` the total number of satellites, `p` the number of planes,
and `f` the phase factor. The satellites are placed so that
`t / p` satellites share each plane and adjacent planes are offset in
mean anomaly by `f * 360 / t` degrees.

卫星的分布方式为：每个轨道面分到 `t / p` 颗卫星，相邻轨道面的平近点角相差
`f * 360 / t` 度。

Source: the Walker notation and the phasing rule are the ones defined in
Walker, J. G., *Circular Orbit Patterns Providing Continuous Whole Earth
Coverage*, Royal Aircraft Establishment Technical Report 70211, 1970.

出处：Walker 记法与相位规则取自 Walker, J. G., *Circular Orbit Patterns
Providing Continuous Whole Earth Coverage*, Royal Aircraft Establishment
Technical Report 70211, 1970。

```
use apsis_constellation::{Constellation, WalkerPattern};

// A Walker 53 degree pattern with 24 satellites in 3 planes.
let pattern = WalkerPattern {
    total_satellites: 24,
    planes: 3,
    phase_factor: 1,
    inclination: 53.0_f64.to_radians(),
    semi_major_axis: 6_878.137,
};
let constellation =
    Constellation::walker(pattern, 0.0).expect("the pattern is consistent");
assert_eq!(constellation.satellites().len(), 24);
```

items.name: ConstellationErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a constellation error.
items.doc_zh: 星座错误的类别。

items.name: ConstellationError
items.doc: A failure while building a constellation.
items.doc_zh: 构建星座时的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh:
返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若无则返回 `None`。

items.name: WalkerPattern
items.doc:
A Walker delta pattern.

A Walker pattern places a number of satellites evenly around the Earth in
a number of planes that share an inclination and a semi-major axis. The
relative phasing of adjacent planes is set by the phase factor, so the
whole constellation is described by five numbers.
items.doc_zh:
Walker 构型把若干卫星均匀分布在绕地球的若干轨道面上，各面共用同一倾角与
同一半长轴。相邻轨道面之间的相对相位由相位因子决定，因此整个星座由五个数
描述。

The pattern is written `i: t/p/f`, where `i` is the inclination, `t` the
total number of satellites, `p` the number of planes, and `f` the phase
factor. This structure stores the same quantities, with the inclination
in radians and the semi-major axis in kilometers.

构型写作 `i: t/p/f`，其中 `i` 为倾角、`t` 为卫星总数、`p` 为轨道面数、
`f` 为相位因子。本结构体存储同样的量，倾角用弧度，半长轴用千米。

items.name: satellites_per_plane
items.doc:
Returns the number of satellites in each plane.

Returns `None` when the satellite count is not a multiple of the
plane count.
items.doc_zh:
返回每个轨道面上的卫星数。

当卫星总数不是轨道面数的整数倍时返回 `None`。

items.name: plane_spacing
items.doc:
Returns the spacing between adjacent planes in right ascension, in
radians.

Returns `None` when the plane count is zero, which is the only case
in which the spacing is undefined.

The spacing does not depend on the pattern being consistent, so a
caller can report the value it would use even for a pattern that
cannot be instantiated.
items.doc_zh:
返回相邻轨道面之间的赤经间隔，单位为弧度，即 `360 / planes` 度。

当轨道面数为零时返回 `None`，这是该间隔未定义的唯一情形。

该间隔不依赖构型是否自洽，因此即使构型无法实例化，调用方也能报告它本会
使用的值。

items.name: phase_offset
items.doc:
Returns the phase offset applied between adjacent planes, in radians.

This is `f * 360 / t` degrees, where `f` is the phase factor and `t`
the total satellite count.

Returns `None` when the satellite count is zero, which is the only
case in which the offset is undefined.
items.doc_zh:
返回相邻轨道面之间施加的相位偏移，单位为弧度。

即 `f * 360 / t` 度，其中 `f` 为相位因子，`t` 为卫星总数。

当卫星总数为零时返回 `None`，这是该偏移未定义的唯一情形。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the pattern can be instantiated.
items.doc_zh: 当该构型可以被实例化时返回 `true`。

items.name: notation
items.doc:
Returns the Walker notation for this pattern, such as `53: 24/3/1`.

The inclination is printed at full precision, so a value such as
53.25 degrees survives the round trip. The notation is an identifier
rather than a rounded quotation, so truncating it would lose
information for no gain.
items.doc_zh:
返回该构型的 Walker 记法，例如 `53: 24/3/1`。

倾角按全精度打印，因此 53.25 度这样的值可以原样往返。该记法用作标识而
非取整后的引用值，截断它只会丢失信息而没有收益。

items.name: instantiate
items.doc:
Instantiates the pattern as a list of orbital elements.

The mean anomaly of the reference satellite of the first plane is
zero. Each further satellite in a plane is advanced by
`360 / (t / p)` degrees, and each further plane is advanced by the
phase offset.

Returns an error describing why the pattern cannot be instantiated.

Source: the phasing rule is the one defined in Walker, J. G.,
*Circular Orbit Patterns Providing Continuous Whole Earth Coverage*,
Royal Aircraft Establishment Technical Report 70211, 1970.
items.doc_zh:
把该构型实例化为一组轨道根数。

第一个轨道面的参考卫星的平近点角为零。同一面内每增加一颗卫星，平近点角
前进 `360 / (t / p)` 度；每增加一个轨道面，前进一个相位偏移。

当该构型无法实例化时返回一个说明原因的错误。

出处：相位规则取自 Walker, J. G., *Circular Orbit Patterns Providing
Continuous Whole Earth Coverage*, Royal Aircraft Establishment
Technical Report 70211, 1970。

items.name: Satellite
items.doc: One satellite in an instantiated constellation.
items.doc_zh: 已实例化星座中的一颗卫星。

items.name: Constellation
items.doc:
A constellation instantiated at a reference time.

The elements are the ones at the reference time passed to the
constructor. Advancing them in time is the job of the orbit layer, which
propagates each satellite independently.
items.doc_zh:
在参考时刻实例化的星座。

根数即构造函数所给参考时刻的那一组。随时间推进由 orbit 层负责，该层对每颗
卫星独立传播。

items.name: walker
items.signature: pub fn walker(pattern: WalkerPattern, reference_mjd: f64) -> Result<Self, ConstellationError> {
items.doc:
Instantiates a Walker pattern at a reference time.

The reference time is a Modified Julian Date on the TAI scale. It is
stored with the constellation and returned unchanged; the elements
are the ones at that instant.

Returns an error when the pattern cannot be instantiated.
items.doc_zh:
在参考时刻实例化一个 Walker 构型。

参考时刻为 TAI 时间尺度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。它随
星座一并保存并原样返回；根数即该时刻的根数。

当该构型无法实例化时返回一个错误。

items.name: from_satellites
items.signature: pub fn from_satellites( elements: &[KeplerianElements], reference_mjd: f64, ) -> Result<Self, ConstellationError> {
items.doc:
Builds a constellation from a list of satellites.

This is the constructor for a constellation that does not follow the
Walker pattern. The plane index of each satellite is derived from the
right ascension of its elements, so satellites sharing a plane are
grouped.

Returns an error when the list is empty, when the reference time is
not finite, or when any element set is not a valid orbit.
items.doc_zh:
由一组卫星根数构建星座。

这是为不遵循 Walker 构型的星座提供的构造函数。每颗卫星的轨道面序号由其根数
的赤经推得，因此共用同一轨道面的卫星会被归为一组。

当列表为空、参考时刻非有限，或任一根数集不是有效轨道时返回一个错误。

items.name: satellites
items.doc: Returns the satellites in the constellation.
items.doc_zh: 返回星座中的卫星。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of satellites.
items.doc_zh: 返回卫星数。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the constellation is empty.

A constellation built through either constructor is never empty, so
this always returns `false`; it exists because a collection type
should offer it alongside [`Constellation::len`].
items.doc_zh:
经任一构造函数构建的星座都不会为空，故此函数恒返回 `false`；它存在是因为
集合类型应当与 [`Constellation::len`] 一并提供。

items.name: plane_count
items.doc: Returns the number of orbital planes.
items.doc_zh: 返回轨道面数。

items.name: pattern
items.doc:
Returns the Walker pattern, when the constellation was built from
one.
items.doc_zh: 若星座由 Walker 构型构建则返回该构型，否则返回 `None`。

items.name: reference_mjd
items.doc:
Returns the reference time as a Modified Julian Date on the TAI
scale.
items.doc_zh: 返回参考时刻，为 TAI 时间尺度上的修正儒略日（Modified Julian Date）。

items.name: plane
items.signature: pub fn plane(&self, plane: usize) -> Vec<Satellite> {
items.doc:
Returns the satellites of one plane.

Returns an empty slice when the plane index is out of range.
items.doc_zh:
返回某个轨道面上的卫星。

当轨道面序号越界时返回空切片。

items.name: altitude_above
items.signature: pub fn altitude_above(&self, body_radius_km: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the altitude of the constellation above the given radius, in
kilometers.

Every satellite of a Walker pattern shares a semi-major axis, so a
single altitude describes the whole constellation. For a custom
constellation this is the altitude of the first satellite.

Returns `None` when the constellation is empty.
items.doc_zh:
Walker 构型中所有卫星共用同一半长轴，故单一高度即可描述整个星座；对自定义
星座，返回的是第一颗卫星的高度。

星座为空时返回 `None`。

items.name: plane_populations
items.doc:
Returns the count of satellites in each plane.

The result has one entry per plane, in plane order.
items.doc_zh: 返回的向量每个轨道面一项，按轨道面顺序排列。

crates.name: apsis-coverage
crates.summary:
Ground coverage analysis.

A satellite covers the part of the Earth's surface from which it can be
seen above a minimum elevation angle. That part is a circle, called the
footprint, whose size depends on the satellite altitude and on the
elevation mask. This crate computes the footprint geometry, tests whether
a ground point lies inside a footprint, and measures how much of a region
is covered.

The spherical model in [`geometry`](self) treats the Earth as a sphere.
That is accurate enough for constellation design, where the quantities
wanted are the footprint radius to a few parts in ten thousand and the
number of satellites in view. The exact line-of-sight test in
[`line_of_sight`] uses the actual positions, so it accounts for the
flattening and for a ground point above the ellipsoid.

The geometry of the satellite, the ground point, and the centre of the
Earth is a triangle. Its three angles are the elevation at the ground
point, the nadir angle at the satellite, and the central angle at the
centre, and they sum to a right angle:

```text
elevation + nadir + central = 90 degrees
```

Source: the relations used here are the standard satellite geometry, as
given for example in Vallado, D. A., *Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and
Applications*, 4th edition, microcosm Press, 2013, section 5.3.

```
use apsis_coverage::{footprint_central_angle, slant_range};

// A satellite at 550 km altitude sees to about fifteen degrees of
// central angle at a ten degree elevation mask, which is a footprint
// radius of some 1665 km along the surface.
let central = footprint_central_angle(6_928.137, 6_378.137, 10.0_f64.to_radians())
    .expect("valid geometry");
assert!((central.to_degrees() - 14.96).abs() < 0.01);

let range = slant_range(6_928.137, 6_378.137, 10.0_f64.to_radians())
    .expect("valid geometry");
assert!((range - 1_815.65).abs() < 0.01);
```
crates.summary_zh:
地面覆盖分析。

卫星覆盖地表上能在最小仰角以上看到它的那部分。那部分是一个圆，称为覆盖区，
其大小取决于卫星高度与仰角遮蔽。本 crate 计算覆盖区几何、判定某地面点是否落在
覆盖区内，并度量某区域被覆盖的比例。

[`geometry`](self) 中的球面模型把地球当作一个球。对星座设计已足够准确，那里
所要的量是覆盖区半径到万分之几以及可见卫星数。[`line_of_sight`] 中的精确视线
判定使用实际位置，故它计入了扁率以及高于椭球的地面点。

卫星、地面点与地心构成的几何是一个三角形。其三个角是地面点处的仰角、卫星处的
天底角，以及地心处的中心角，它们相加为直角：

```text
elevation + nadir + central = 90 degrees
```

出处：此处所用的关系是标准的卫星几何，例如见 Vallado, D. A.，*Fundamentals of
Astrodynamics and Applications*，第 4 版，microcosm Press，2013，第 5.3 节。

items.name: Footprint
items.doc:
A circular ground footprint.

The footprint is the part of the Earth's surface from which a satellite
is visible above a given elevation mask. On a sphere it is an exact
circle, described here by the central angle from the sub-satellite point
and the radius of the body.
items.doc_zh:
圆形地面覆盖区。

覆盖区是能在地平遮蔽以上看见某卫星的那部分地表。在球面上它是精确
的圆，此处以自星下点的中心角和天体半径描述。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(central_angle: f64, body_radius: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a footprint from its central angle and body radius.
items.doc_zh: 由其中心角与天体半径创建覆盖区。

items.name: surface_radius
items.doc:
Returns the footprint radius measured along the surface, in
kilometers.
items.doc_zh: 返回沿地表量得的覆盖区半径，单位为千米。

items.name: area
items.doc:
Returns the area of the footprint, in square kilometers.

The area is the part of a sphere cut off by a cone,

```text
A = 2 pi R^2 (1 - cos(central))
```

which is exact for a spherical body.
items.doc_zh:
返回覆盖区的面积，单位为平方千米。

该面积是被圆锥截去的球面部分，

```text
A = 2 pi R^2 (1 - cos(central))
```

对球形天体这是精确的。

items.name: fraction_of_surface
items.doc:
Returns the fraction of the whole sphere covered by the footprint.

The value is between zero and one half, because a footprint from a
point above the surface can never cover more than a hemisphere.
items.doc_zh:
返回覆盖区占整个球面的比例。

该值介于零与二分之一之间，因为来自地表之上某点的覆盖区覆盖范围
绝不会超过一个半球。

items.name: contains_central_angle
items.signature: pub fn contains_central_angle(&self, central_angle: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when a ground point at the given central angle from
the sub-satellite point lies inside the footprint.

The comparison is inclusive, so a point exactly on the edge is
inside.
items.doc_zh:
当距星下点给定中心角的地面点位于覆盖区内时返回 `true`。

比较是含端点的，故恰在边缘上的点算在内部。

items.name: footprint_central_angle
items.signature: pub fn footprint_central_angle( satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation_mask: f64, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the central half angle of the footprint, in radians.

This is the largest central angle at which the satellite is still above
the elevation mask.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回覆盖区的中心半角，单位为弧度。

这是卫星仍高于仰角遮蔽时的最大中心角。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: footprint
items.signature: pub fn footprint( satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation_mask: f64, ) -> Option<Footprint> {
items.doc:
Returns the footprint for a satellite and an elevation mask.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星与仰角遮蔽所对应的覆盖区。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: footprint_area
items.signature: pub fn footprint_area(satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation_mask: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the area of a footprint, in square kilometers.

This is a free function form of [`Footprint::area`].

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回覆盖区的面积，单位为平方千米。

这是 [`Footprint::area`] 的自由函数形式。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: footprint_fraction
items.signature: pub fn footprint_fraction( satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation_mask: f64, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the fraction of the Earth's surface covered by a footprint.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回覆盖区所占地球表面的比例。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: central_angle_between
items.signature: pub fn central_angle_between(first: Vec3, second: Vec3) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the angle between two surface points, in radians.

The vectors must be positions relative to the centre of the body, in the
same frame. The angle is the central angle between them, as seen from the
centre.

Returns `None` when either vector has zero length or a non-finite
component.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个地表点之间的角度，单位为弧度。

两矢量必须是相对天体中心、在同一坐标系中的位置。该角度是自中心看
它们之间的中心角。

任一矢量为零长或含非有限分量时返回 `None`。

items.name: point_in_footprint
items.signature: pub fn point_in_footprint( footprint: &Footprint, point: Vec3, sub_satellite_point: Vec3, ) -> Option<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when a ground point lies inside a footprint.

The point and the sub-satellite point are positions relative to the
centre of the body, in kilometers. The footprint supplies the body radius
and the central half angle.

Returns `None` when either vector is degenerate or not finite.
items.doc_zh:
当某地面点位于某覆盖区内时返回 `true`。

该点与星下点都是相对天体中心的位置，单位为千米。覆盖区提供天体半径
与中心半角。

任一矢量退化或非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: footprint_edge_elevation
items.doc:
Returns the elevation at which a footprint edge is seen from the ground,
in radians.

This is the inverse of [`footprint_central_angle`], useful when a
footprint is known and the mask it corresponds to is wanted.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回自地面看覆盖区边缘的仰角，单位为弧度。

它是 [`footprint_central_angle`] 的逆，当已知覆盖区而想求它对应的遮蔽时
有用。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: nadir_angle
items.signature: pub fn nadir_angle(satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the nadir angle at the satellite, in radians.

The nadir angle is measured at the satellite between the direction to the
centre of the Earth and the direction to the ground point. It is zero when
the ground point is directly below the satellite and grows as the point
moves toward the horizon.

Returns `None` when the radii are not usable, when the body radius
exceeds the satellite radius, or when the elevation is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星处的天底角，单位为弧度。

天底角在卫星处量取，介于到地心的方向与到地面点的方向之间。当地面点
