恰在卫星正下方时它为零，并随该点移向地平而增大。

半径不可用、天体半径超过卫星半径，或仰角非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: earth_central_angle
items.signature: pub fn earth_central_angle(satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the earth central angle between the sub-satellite point and the
ground point, in radians.

The central angle is the angle at the centre of the Earth between the two
radial directions. It is the distance along the surface, divided by the
body radius.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回星下点与地面点之间的地心中心角，单位为弧度。

中心角是地心处两个径向方向之间的角。它是沿地表的距离除以天体半径。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: slant_range
items.signature: pub fn slant_range(satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, elevation: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the slant range between the satellite and the ground point, in
kilometers.

The range is the straight line distance, not the distance along the
surface. It is the quantity a link budget needs, because it sets the free
space path loss.

The relation is the law of cosines applied to the triangle formed by the
satellite, the ground point, and the centre of the Earth,

```text
range^2 = satellite_radius^2 + body_radius^2
          - 2 satellite_radius body_radius cos(central)
```

The law of cosines is used rather than the equivalent form
`Rs sin(central) / cos(elevation)` because the latter is singular at the
zenith, where the elevation is a right angle and its cosine is zero,
even though the range there is simply the altitude.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星与地面点之间的斜距，单位为千米。

该距离是直线距离，而非沿地表的距离。它是链路预算所需的量，因为它决定自由
空间路径损耗。

该关系是余弦定理施加于卫星、地面点与地心构成的三角形：

```text
range^2 = satellite_radius^2 + body_radius^2
          - 2 satellite_radius body_radius cos(central)
```

此处用余弦定理而非等价形式 `Rs sin(central) / cos(elevation)`，因为后者在
天顶处奇异，那里仰角是直角、其余弦为零，尽管那里的距离恰是高度。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: elevation_from_central_angle
items.signature: pub fn elevation_from_central_angle( satellite_radius: f64, body_radius: f64, central_angle: f64, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the elevation angle for a central angle, in radians.

This inverts [`earth_central_angle`]. It is used when the position of a
ground point relative to the sub-satellite point is known and the
elevation at that point is wanted.

The relation is

```text
tan(elevation) = (cos(central) - body_radius / satellite_radius)
                 / sin(central)
```

Returns `None` when the radii are not usable or when the central angle is
not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回某中心角对应的仰角，单位为弧度。

它反解 [`earth_central_angle`]。当已知地面点相对星下点的位置而要求
该点处仰角时使用它。

关系为

```text
tan(elevation) = (cos(central) - body_radius / satellite_radius)
                 / sin(central)
```

半径不可用或中心角非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: GroundPoint
items.doc: A ground station, given as a geodetic position on an ellipsoid.
items.doc_zh: 一个地面站，以椭球上的大地位置给出。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(position: Geodetic, elevation_mask: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a ground point on the WGS 84 ellipsoid with a given mask.
items.doc_zh: 在 WGS 84 椭球上以给定遮蔽创建地面点。

items.name: ecef
items.doc:
Returns the position of the station in the Earth-fixed Cartesian
frame, in kilometers.

The geodetic conversion yields meters, so the result is divided by a
thousand to match the frame the orbit layer uses.
items.doc_zh:
返回该站在地固直角坐标系中的位置，单位为千米。

大地转换得到的是米，故结果除以一千，以与 orbit 层所用的坐标系
一致。

items.name: radius
items.doc:
Returns the distance from the centre of the Earth, in kilometers.

This is the local radius of the ellipsoid at the station's latitude
plus its height, so it includes the effect of the flattening.
items.doc_zh:
返回距地心的距离，单位为千米。

这是该站纬度处椭球的当地半径加上其高度，故包含了扁率的影响。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the station and its mask describe a usable
sensor.
items.doc_zh: 当该站及其遮蔽描述一个可用传感器时返回 `true`。

items.name: Sensor
items.doc:
A sensor at a ground point, with a pointing direction.

The direction is a unit vector in the Earth-fixed frame. It is optional,
because a station that can point anywhere with sufficient gain is
modelled by its elevation mask alone; the direction matters only when the
station has a fixed beam.
items.doc_zh:
位于地面点、具有指向方向的传感器。

方向是地固系中的单位矢量。它是可选的，因为能以足够增益指向任何
方向的站仅以其仰角遮蔽建模即可；只有当站具有固定波束时方向才要紧。

items.name: omnidirectional
items.signature: pub const fn omnidirectional(ground: GroundPoint) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a station that can point anywhere above its mask.
items.doc_zh: 创建能在其遮蔽之上指向任何方向的站。

items.name: directional
items.signature: pub const fn directional(ground: GroundPoint, pointing: Vec3) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a station with a fixed pointing direction.

The direction is normalized when it is used, so the caller may pass
an unnormalized vector.
items.doc_zh:
创建具有固定指向方向的站。

该方向在使用时被归一化，故调用方可以传入未归一化的矢量。

items.name: SubSatellitePoint
items.doc: The point on the Earth's surface directly below a satellite.
items.doc_zh: 卫星正下方的地表点。

items.name: sub_satellite_point
items.signature: pub fn sub_satellite_point( position_ecef_km: Vec3, ellipsoid: Ellipsoid, ) -> Option<SubSatellitePoint> {
items.doc:
Returns the sub-satellite point for a position in the Earth-fixed frame.

The satellite position is in kilometers. The sub-satellite point is the
intersection of the line from the centre of the Earth through the
satellite with the ellipsoid, which is the geodetic position of the
satellite with its height set to zero at the same latitude and longitude.

This is the geocentric projection, not the point at which the ellipsoid
normal through the satellite meets the surface. The difference is at most
about twenty kilometers for a low Earth satellite, and the geocentric
form is the one the footprint geometry uses.

Returns `None` when the position is not finite or lies on the polar axis,
where no longitude is defined.
items.doc_zh:
返回地固系中某位置的星下点。

卫星位置单位为千米。星下点是从地心过卫星的直线与椭球的交点，即把
卫星高度置零而纬经度不变所得的大地位置。

这是地心投影，而非过卫星的椭球法线与地表相交的点。对低轨卫星两者
相差至多约二十千米，而覆盖区几何用的是地心形式。

位置非有限，或位于未定义经度的极轴上时返回 `None`。

items.name: elevation_angle
items.signature: pub fn elevation_angle(satellite_ecef_km: Vec3, ground: &GroundPoint) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the elevation of a satellite as seen from a station, in radians.

The satellite position is in the Earth-fixed frame, in kilometers. The
elevation is measured from the local horizon, which is the plane
perpendicular to the ellipsoid normal at the station.

A positive value means the satellite is above the horizon, a value of a
right angle means it is at the zenith, and a negative value means it is
below the horizon.

Returns `None` when either position is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回自某站看某卫星的仰角，单位为弧度。

卫星位置在地固系中，单位为千米。仰角自当地地平量起，后者是垂直于该
站处椭球法线的平面。

正值表示卫星在地平之上，直角值表示在天顶，负值表示在地平之下。

任一位置不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: local_up
items.doc:
Returns the unit vector along the ellipsoid normal at a station.

This is the local vertical, the direction a plumb line points. For a
geodetic position it follows from the latitude and longitude, because the
normal of a biaxial ellipsoid lies in the meridian plane and makes the
geodetic latitude with the equatorial plane.
items.doc_zh:
返回沿某站处椭球法线的单位矢量。

这是当地垂线，即铅垂线所指的方向。对大地位置而言，它由纬度与经度
得出，因为双轴椭球的法线位于子午面内，并与赤道面夹大地纬度。

items.name: line_of_sight
items.signature: pub fn line_of_sight(satellite_ecef_km: Vec3, ground: &GroundPoint) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the elevation of a satellite as seen from a station, in radians.

This is the same as [`elevation_angle`], named for symmetry with the
other visibility functions.

Returns `None` when either position is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回自某站看某卫星的仰角，单位为弧度。

这与 [`elevation_angle`] 相同，其命名是为与其余可见性函数对称。

任一位置不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: visible_from
items.signature: pub fn visible_from(satellite_ecef_km: Vec3, sensor: &Sensor) -> Option<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when a satellite is visible from a sensor.

The satellite is visible when its elevation at the station is at least
the sensor's mask, and, for a directional sensor, when the direction to
the satellite is within a right angle of the pointing direction, so that
the satellite is in the forward hemisphere of the beam.

Returns `None` when the satellite position or the sensor is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
当从某传感器可见某卫星时返回 `true`。

当卫星在该站处的仰角不低于该传感器的遮蔽，且（对定向传感器）到卫星
的方向与指向方向的夹角在一个直角以内，即卫星处于波束的前半球时，
卫星可见。

卫星位置或传感器不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: visible_from_geodetic
items.signature: pub fn visible_from_geodetic( satellite_ecef_km: Vec3, position: Geodetic, elevation_mask: f64, ) -> Option<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns the elevation of a satellite as seen from a geodetic station.

This is a convenience for a station given directly as a geodetic
position, without building a [`GroundPoint`].

Returns `None` when the satellite position or the station is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回自某大地站看某卫星的仰角。

这是为直接把站作为大地位置给出、而不构建 [`GroundPoint`] 的便利
函数。

卫星位置或该站不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: central_angle_to_station
items.signature: pub fn central_angle_to_station( satellite_ecef_km: Vec3, ground: &GroundPoint, elevation: f64, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the central angle between a satellite and a ground station, in
radians.

This uses the spherical relation between the two radii and the elevation,
so it is consistent with the footprint geometry. The satellite position
is used only for its radius.

Returns `None` when the geometry is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星与地面站之间的中心角，单位为弧度。

它使用两个半径与仰角之间的球面关系，故与覆盖区几何一致。卫星位置只用于其
半径。

几何不可用时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-access
crates.summary_zh:
地面站可见性窗口。

当卫星升到地面站仰角遮蔽之上时，它在那段时间内可从该站访问。每个这样的区间
是一次过境，或称可见性窗口，而一段时间上的窗口序列即可见性调度。本 crate 从
传播后的轨道找出这些窗口，并报告其开始、结束、时长以及峰值处的几何。

窗口通过对仰角以固定步长采样、并对仰角穿过遮蔽的每个穿越加以细化来找到。采样
步长设定所能找到的最短过境，而细化给出独立于步长的穿越时刻精度。

仰角由地固系中的卫星位置求值，故调用方提供从轨道坐标系来的变换。在本工作区中
那是 `apsis-coord` 中的换算，配以来自 `apsis-frames` 的地球自转角。

items.name: find_all
items.signature: pub fn find_all( finder: &AccessFinder, tracks: &[Vec<OrbitSample>], ) -> Vec<Result<PassSummary, AccessError>> {
items.doc:
Searches access for many tracks, in order.

The sequential form, provided for comparison and for small sets where
starting a thread would cost more than the search.
items.doc_zh:
按次序为许多轨迹搜索可见性。

顺序形式，供比较以及线程启动代价高于搜索本身的小规模情形使用。

items.name: find_all_parallel
items.signature: pub fn find_all_parallel( finder: &AccessFinder, tracks: &[Vec<OrbitSample>], ) -> Vec<Result<PassSummary, AccessError>> {
items.doc:
Searches access for many tracks, across several threads.

The result matches [`find_all`] element for element and in the same order.
A track that cannot be searched yields its error in the same position the
sequential form would put it, so one bad track does not hide the rest.
items.doc_zh:
跨多个线程为许多轨迹搜索可见性。

结果与 [`find_all`] 逐元素、逐次序相同。无法搜索的轨迹在顺序形式会
放置它的同一位置给出其错误，故一条坏轨迹不会掩盖其余。

items.name: AccessErrorKind
items.doc: The category of an access error.
items.doc_zh: 接入错误的类别。

items.name: AccessError
items.doc: A failure while finding access windows.
items.doc_zh: 查找可见性窗口时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: OrbitSample
items.doc:
One sample of a satellite track, as the finder consumes it.

The position is in the Earth-fixed frame, in kilometers, and the time is
in seconds from the caller's origin. The caller supplies a sequence of
these, which decouples the finder from the propagation and the frame
transformation.
items.doc_zh:
卫星轨迹的一个样本，按其被查找器消费的形式。

位置在地固系中，单位为千米；时间以距调用方原点的秒数表示。调用方
提供这样的一串样本，使查找器与传播及坐标系变换解耦。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(seconds: f64, position_ecef_km: Vec3) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a sample from a time and a position.
items.doc_zh: 由时间与位置创建样本。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the sample is usable.
items.doc_zh: 当该样本可用时返回 `true`。

items.name: AccessFinder
items.doc:
Finds access windows for one station.

The finder holds the station and the numerical settings of the search.
The settings are separated from the search so that the same finder can be
applied to many satellites.
items.doc_zh:
为一个地面站查找可见性窗口。

查找器保存地面站与搜索的数值设置。设置与搜索分开，使同一个查找器可
应用于许多卫星。

items.name: elevation_of
items.doc:
Returns the elevation of a sample, in radians.

Returns `None` when the sample or the station is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回某样本的仰角，单位为弧度。

样本或地面站不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: find
items.signature: pub fn find(&self, samples: &[OrbitSample]) -> Result<PassSummary, AccessError> {
items.doc:
Finds the access windows in an ordered sequence of samples.

The samples must be ordered by time and cover the interval of
interest. The finder assumes the elevation is continuous between
samples, so the step must be short enough that the satellite does not
rise and set within one step. A low Earth satellite is above a
ten degree mask for several minutes, so a step of a minute or less
satisfies that.

The crossing times are found by interpolating the satellite position
linearly between the two samples that straddle the crossing. The
chord between two samples departs from the true arc by an amount of
the second order in the step, so a ten second step gives a crossing
accurate to about a tenth of a second and a one second step to about
a millisecond. Use [`AccessFinder::find_with`] when the propagator is
available and the crossing is wanted to the full tolerance.

A pass that is already in progress at the first sample is reported
with its rise at the first sample time, and one still in progress at
the last sample is reported with its set at the last sample time.
That convention means the pass is clipped to the interval searched
rather than extrapolated beyond it.

Returns an error when the settings are not usable, when the sample
sequence has fewer than two entries, when a sample is not usable, or
when the sequence is not in increasing time order. The order is
checked rather than assumed, because the interpolation between two
samples binary searches the sequence and a binary search over an
unordered list returns a wrong index without failing.
items.doc_zh:
在有序的样本序列中查找可见性窗口。

各样本必须按时间排序并覆盖所关注的区间。查找器假定仰角在样本
之间连续，故步长必须短到卫星不会在一个步长内升起又降落。低轨
卫星在十度遮蔽以上持续数分钟，故一分钟或更短的步长即满足。

穿越时刻通过在跨越该穿越的两个样本之间线性插值卫星位置求得。
两样本之间的弦与真实弧的偏差为步长的二阶量，故十秒步长给出的
穿越精度约为十分之一秒，一秒步长约为毫秒。当传播器可用且希望
穿越达到完整容差时，用 [`AccessFinder::find_with`]。

在第一个样本处已进行中的过境，其升起时刻报告为第一个样本时间；
在最后一个样本处仍在进行中的过境，其降落时刻报告为最后一个
样本时间。该约定意味着过境被裁剪到所搜索的区间，而不外推超出
它。

设置不可用、样本序列少于两项、某样本不可用，或序列未按时间
递增排列时返回错误。次序是被检查而非假定的，因为两样本之间的
插值会对序列做二分查找，而对无序列表的二分查找会返回错误的下标
而不报错。

items.name: find_with
items.signature: pub fn find_with<F>( &self, start_seconds: f64, end_seconds: f64, mut propagator: F, ) -> Result<PassSummary, AccessError> where F: FnMut(f64) -> Option<Vec3>, {
items.doc:
Finds the access windows over an interval, calling a propagator for
each sample.

The propagator receives a time in seconds from the origin of the
search and returns the satellite position in the Earth-fixed frame.
This adapts the finder to any orbit source without this crate
depending on one.

Returns an error when the settings are not usable, when the interval
is not ordered, or when the propagator fails at a sample.
items.doc_zh:
在某个区间上查找可见性窗口，对每个样本调用一次传播器。

传播器接收以距搜索原点的秒数表示的时间，返回地固系中的卫星
位置。这使查找器可适配任何轨道来源，而本 crate 不依赖于其一。

设置不可用、区间次序不对，或传播器在某样本处失败时返回错误。

items.name: Pass
items.doc:
One continuous interval during which a satellite is above a station's
elevation mask.

Times are seconds from an origin chosen by the caller, so the same
structure serves a search over a scenario clock and one over elapsed
time.
items.doc_zh:
卫星高于某地面站仰角遮蔽的一个连续区间。

时间是以距调用方所选原点的秒数表示，故同一结构既服务于按场景时钟的
搜索，也服务于按流逝时间的搜索。

items.name: duration
items.doc: Returns the duration of the pass, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回该过境的时长，单位为秒。

items.name: rise_to_peak
items.doc: Returns the time from the rise to the peak, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回从升起到峰值的时间，单位为秒。

items.name: contains
items.signature: pub fn contains(&self, seconds: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns the elevation at a time within the pass, when the caller can
supply it.

The pass stores only the peak, so this helper reports the stored
values at the three defining times and defers to the caller's
elevation function otherwise.
items.doc_zh:
返回过境内某时刻的仰角，当调用方能提供它时。

过境只保存峰值，故该辅助函数在三个界定时刻报告所存的值，其余
情形交由调用方的仰角函数。

items.name: maximum_elevation
items.doc:
Returns the maximum elevation of the pass, in radians.

This is the same as the peak elevation, named for readability at a
call site that compares passes.
items.doc_zh:
返回该过境的最大仰角，单位为弧度。

这与峰值仰角相同，其命名是为在比较过境的调用处更具可读性。

items.name: PassSummary
items.doc: A summary of the access windows over an interval.
items.doc_zh: 某区间上可见性窗口的汇总。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(passes: Vec<Pass>, interval_seconds: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a summary from a list of passes and the interval length.
items.doc_zh: 由过境列表与区间长度创建汇总。

items.name: count
items.doc: Returns the number of passes.
items.doc_zh: 返回过境的数量。

items.name: total_access_seconds
items.doc:
Returns the total access time, in seconds.

The passes are disjoint, so the durations add.
items.doc_zh:
返回总可见时间，单位为秒。

各过境互不相交，故时长相加。

items.name: access_fraction
items.doc:
Returns the fraction of the interval during which the satellite was
accessible.

Returns `None` when the interval length is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回卫星可见所占该区间的比例。

区间长度非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: mean_duration_seconds
items.doc:
Returns the mean pass duration, in seconds.

Returns `None` when there are no passes.
items.doc_zh:
返回过境的平均时长，单位为秒。

没有过境时返回 `None`。

items.name: longest
items.doc: Returns the longest pass, if there is one.
items.doc_zh: 返回最长的过境（若存在）。

items.name: highest
items.doc: Returns the highest pass, if there is one.
items.doc_zh: 返回仰角最高的过境（若存在）。

items.name: gap_seconds
items.signature: pub fn gap_seconds(&self, first: usize, second: usize) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the gap between two consecutive passes, in seconds.

Returns `None` when either index is out of range or the two indices
are not consecutive and increasing.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个相邻过境之间的间隙，单位为秒。

任一下标越界，或两个下标不相邻且递增时返回 `None`。

items.name: longest_gap_seconds
items.doc:
Returns the largest gap between consecutive passes, in seconds.

This is the longest time a station waits between contacts.
Returns `None` when there are fewer than two passes.
items.doc_zh:
返回相邻过境之间的最大间隙，单位为秒。

这是一个地面站在两次通信之间等待的最长时间。过境少于两个时返回
`None`。

crates.name: apsis-topology
crates.summary_zh:
时变网络拓扑。

卫星网络不是单一的图。可用链路的集合随卫星移动而改变，故该网络是按时间索引的
一个图序列，而本 crate 提供该序列的数据结构。

模型有意简单。一个 [`Topology`] 是节点集合固定、边集合可有可无的图，节点是卫星
或地面站。一个 [`TopologySeries`] 是递增时刻上一串拓扑，连同各自适用的区间。

该序列是阶跃函数：一个拓扑从其自身时间起保持到下一项的时间。这是时变图的标准
离散时间模型，也是对该序列路由所期望的。

边除存在与否外还携带代价，使路由算法有可最小化之物。该代价是一个普通数，故
调用方可以放一个时延、一个跳数，或任何别的东西，只要路由算法与代价在含义上
一致。

items.name: TopologyErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a topology error.
items.doc_zh: 拓扑错误的类别。

items.name: TopologyError
items.doc: A failure while building or querying a topology.
items.doc_zh: 构建或查询拓扑时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: Edge
items.doc: One link in a topology.
items.doc_zh: 拓扑中的一条链路。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(from: usize, to: usize, cost: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an edge.
items.doc_zh: 创建一条边。

items.name: reversed
items.doc:
Returns the same edge with its endpoints exchanged.

A link between two satellites carries traffic both ways, so most
topologies add both directions.
items.doc_zh:
返回端点互换后的同一条边。

两颗卫星之间的链路双向承载业务，故多数拓扑会添加两个方向。

items.name: Topology
items.doc:
A graph of nodes and links at one instant.

The node count is fixed at construction and nodes are identified by their
index. Edges are directed: adding an edge from one node to another does
not add the reverse, so a caller that wants a bidirectional link adds
both directions. This is deliberate, because an inter-satellite link may
have different capacity in each direction and a ground link is often
asymmetric.
items.doc_zh:
某一瞬时的节点与链路图。

节点数在构造时固定，节点以其下标标识。边是有向的：从一节点向另一
节点添加边不会添加反向边，故需要双向链路的调用方要添加两个方向。
这是有意的，因为星间链路每个方向的容量可能不同，而地面链路往往
不对称。

items.name: new
items.doc:
Creates an empty topology with the given number of nodes.

This is not a `const fn` because it sizes the adjacency index, which
allocates.
items.doc_zh:
以给定节点数创建空拓扑。

它不是 `const fn`，因为它要为邻接索引确定大小，而这会分配。

items.name: node_count
items.doc: Returns the number of nodes.
items.doc_zh: 返回节点的数量。

items.name: edge_count
items.doc: Returns the number of edges.
items.doc_zh: 返回边的数量。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc: Returns `true` when there are no edges.
items.doc_zh: 当没有边时返回 `true`。

items.name: edges
items.doc: Returns the edges.
items.doc_zh: 返回各条边。

items.name: add_edge
items.signature: pub fn add_edge(&mut self, from: usize, to: usize, cost: f64) -> Result<(), TopologyError> {
items.doc:
Adds a directed edge.

Returns an error when either node index is out of range, when the
cost is not finite and positive, or when the edge already exists.
Rejecting a duplicate rather than replacing it keeps a topology free
of silent contradictions about the cost of a link.
items.doc_zh:
添加一条有向边。

任一端点下标越界、代价非有限且为正，或该边已存在时返回错误。拒绝
重复边而非替换它，使拓扑不会对某条链路的代价产生无声的矛盾。

items.name: add_bidirectional_edge
items.signature: pub fn add_bidirectional_edge( &mut self, first: usize, second: usize, cost: f64, ) -> Result<(), TopologyError> {
items.doc:
Adds an edge in both directions with the same cost.

If the second direction fails after the first succeeds, the first is
rolled back, so the topology is left unchanged when the call reports
an error.
items.doc_zh:
以相同代价在两个方向添加边。

若第一个方向成功后第二个方向失败，则回滚第一个，故调用报告错误
时拓扑保持不变。

items.name: has_edge
items.signature: pub fn has_edge(&self, from: usize, to: usize) -> bool {
items.doc: Returns `true` when an edge exists from one node to another.
items.doc_zh: 当存在从一节点到另一节点的边时返回 `true`。

items.name: cost
items.signature: pub fn cost(&self, from: usize, to: usize) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the cost of the edge between two nodes.

Returns `None` when there is no such edge.
items.doc_zh:
返回两节点之间边的代价。

不存在该边时返回 `None`。

items.name: remove_edge
items.signature: pub fn remove_edge(&mut self, from: usize, to: usize) -> Result<(), TopologyError> {
items.doc:
Removes the edge between two nodes.

Returns an error when there is no such edge.
items.doc_zh:
移除两节点之间的边。

不存在该边时返回错误。

items.name: neighbours
items.signature: pub fn neighbours(&self, node: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
items.doc:
Returns the indices of the nodes reachable from a node in one hop.

The result is in the order the edges were added, so it is
deterministic for a given construction sequence.
items.doc_zh:
返回自某节点一跳可达的节点下标。

结果按边被添加的次序排列，故对给定的构建序列是确定的。

items.name: out_degree
items.signature: pub fn out_degree(&self, node: usize) -> usize {
items.doc: Returns the number of edges leaving a node.
items.doc_zh: 返回离开某节点的边数。

items.name: in_degree
items.signature: pub fn in_degree(&self, node: usize) -> usize {
items.doc: Returns the number of edges arriving at a node.
items.doc_zh: 返回到达某节点的边数。

items.name: adjacency
items.doc:
Returns the adjacency of every node.

The result has one entry per node, in node order, each listing the
neighbours of that node.
items.doc_zh:
返回每个节点的邻接。

结果每个节点一项，按节点次序排列，各自列出该节点的邻居。

items.name: connected_components
items.doc:
Returns the number of connected components, treating the edges as
undirected.

This answers how many separate networks the topology forms, which is
the first thing to check about a constellation snapshot: a
constellation that has split into pieces can still carry traffic
within each piece but not between them.
items.doc_zh:
把边视为无向时返回连通分量的数量。

它回答该拓扑构成多少个独立网络，这是检查星座快照时要看的第一件
事：已裂成数块的星座仍可在各块内承载业务，但块与块之间不行。

items.name: is_connected
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every node can reach every other node, treating
the edges as undirected.
items.doc_zh: 把边视为无向时，当每个节点都能到达其余每个节点，返回 `true`。

items.name: total_cost
items.doc:
Returns the total cost of every edge.

This is a crude measure of the network's extent, useful for comparing
snapshots rather than for routing.
items.doc_zh:
返回所有边的代价之和。

这是对网络规模的一个粗略度量，用于比较快照而非用于路由。

items.name: TopologySample
items.doc: One topology and the time from which it applies.
items.doc_zh: 一个拓扑及其开始适用的时间。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(seconds: f64, topology: Topology) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a sample.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个样本。

items.name: TopologySeries
items.doc:
A sequence of topologies over time.

The sequence is a step function. The entry at index `i` applies from its
own time until the time of the entry at index `i + 1`, and the last entry
applies for all later times. Querying a time before the first entry
returns the first topology, so the series behaves as if it extends
backwards as well as forwards.

The times must be strictly increasing. Two entries at the same time would
make the topology at that instant ambiguous.
items.doc_zh:
拓扑随时间变化的序列。

该序列是阶跃函数。下标 `i` 处的项自其自身时间起适用，直到下标
`i + 1` 处项的时间；最后一项适用于其后所有时间。查询首项之前的时间
返回第一个拓扑，故该序列的行为像是向前向后都延伸。

各时间必须严格递增。同一时间的两项会使该瞬时的拓扑含糊。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(samples: Vec<TopologySample>) -> Result<Self, TopologyError> {
items.doc:
Creates a series from a list of samples.

Returns an error when the list is empty, when a time is not finite,
or when the times are not strictly increasing.
items.doc_zh:
由样本列表创建序列。

列表为空、某时间非有限，或各时间非严格递增时返回错误。

items.name: from_parts
items.signature: pub fn from_parts(times: Vec<f64>, topologies: Vec<Topology>) -> Result<Self, TopologyError> {
items.doc:
Creates a series from times and topologies as separate lists.

The two lists must have the same length.

Returns an error when the lists differ in length or when the series
itself is not valid.
items.doc_zh:
由分别给出的时间列表与拓扑列表创建序列。

两个列表必须长度相同。

列表长度不同或序列自身无效时返回错误。

items.name: samples
items.doc: Returns the samples.
items.doc_zh: 返回各样本。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of samples.
items.doc_zh: 返回样本的数量。

items.name: start_seconds
items.doc: Returns the first time in the series.
items.doc_zh: 返回序列中的第一个时间。

items.name: end_seconds
items.doc: Returns the last time in the series.
items.doc_zh: 返回序列中的最后一个时间。

items.name: index_at
items.signature: pub fn index_at(&self, seconds: f64) -> Option<usize> {
items.doc:
Returns the index of the sample that applies at a time.

The index is the last entry whose time is at or before the query, so
a time before the series returns zero and a time after it returns the
last index.

Returns `None` when the time is not finite or the series is empty.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时间处适用的样本下标。

该下标是时间不晚于查询的最后一个项，故序列之前的时间返回零，
序列之后的时间返回最后的下标。

时间非有限或序列为空时返回 `None`。

items.name: topology_at
items.signature: pub fn topology_at(&self, seconds: f64) -> Option<&Topology> {
items.doc:
Returns the topology in force at a time.

Returns `None` when the time is not finite or the series is empty.
items.doc_zh:
返回某时间处生效的拓扑。

时间非有限或序列为空时返回 `None`。

items.name: interval_of
items.signature: pub fn interval_of(&self, index: usize) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
items.doc:
Returns the interval over which the sample at an index applies.

The upper bound is the time of the next sample, or positive infinity
for the last entry.

Returns `None` when the index is out of range.
items.doc_zh:
返回某下标处样本适用的区间。

上界是下一样本的时间，对最后一项为正无穷。

下标越界时返回 `None`。

items.name: change_count
items.doc:
Returns the number of times the topology changes.

This is the number of samples less one, since each change introduces
a new entry. It measures how dynamic the network is: a series with
many changes needs routing that accounts for them.
items.doc_zh:
返回拓扑变化的次数。

它是样本数减一，因为每次变化引入一个新项。它衡量网络的动态
程度：变化多的序列需要能考虑到这些变化的路由。

items.name: mean_interval_seconds
items.doc:
Returns the mean interval between changes, in seconds.

The last entry has unbounded duration, so it is excluded from the
mean and the result covers the changes that have a measured interval.

Returns `None` when there is only one sample.
items.doc_zh:
返回变化之间的平均间隔，单位为秒。

最后一项的持续时间无界，故它被排除在均值之外，结果涵盖有可测
间隔的那些变化。

只有一个样本时返回 `None`。

items.name: edge_changes
items.doc:
Returns the number of edge changes across the series.

Each topology is compared with the one before it, counting the edges
that appear and the edges that disappear. A topology that differs by
one link contributes two, since one link changed.

Returns zero for a series of one sample.
items.doc_zh:
返回整个序列中边变化的次数。

每个拓扑与其前一个比较，统计出现与消失的边。相差一条链路的拓扑
贡献二，因为有一条链路发生了变化。

单样本序列返回零。

items.name: node_count
items.doc:
Returns the number of nodes in the series.

Every entry is expected to describe the same set of nodes, so the
value is taken from the first entry. A caller that changes the node
count between entries is comparing two different networks and should
build two series instead.
items.doc_zh:
返回序列中的节点数。

每个项都应描述同一组节点，故该值取自第一项。在各项之间改变节点
数的调用方是在比较两个不同的网络，应改为构建两个序列。

crates.name: apsis-isl
crates.summary_zh:
星间链路几何与可见性。

当两颗卫星之间的直线不穿过地球时，它们可以形成一条链路。本 crate 判定该条件、
给出链路预算所需的几何，并报告距离以及每颗卫星必须指向的角度。

遮挡判据是两点之间的线段是否有点位于天体内部。对球形天体而言这是一个垂距判定，
它精确且廉价，故此处采用它。

光链路还加一个条件：太阳不得位于任一终端的视场内，因为背景会淹没信号。那是一个
单独的判定，作为 [`sun_blocks_link`] 提供，它接收太阳方向。

长度以千米计，角度以弧度计。各位置所在的坐标系中地球是给定半径的球，对链路
几何而言它与 orbit 层所产生的是同一坐标系。

items.name: visibility_matrix
items.signature: pub fn visibility_matrix(positions: &[Vec3], body_radius: f64) -> Vec<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns the visibility of every ordered pair of positions, in order.

The result is row major: the entry at `row * positions.len() + column` is
the visibility from `positions[row]` to `positions[column]`. A satellite is
always visible to itself, which is the caller's cue to skip the diagonal.

A pair whose test is undefined, because a position is not finite or the
body radius is not positive, yields `false`.
items.doc_zh:
按顺序返回各位置有序对的可见性。

结果按行主序：位于 `row * positions.len() + column` 的元素是
`positions[row]` 对 `positions[column]` 的可见性。卫星对自身总可见，
这提示调用方跳过对角线。

测试未定义的点对（位置非有限或天体半径非正）给出 `false`。

items.name: visibility_matrix_parallel
items.signature: pub fn visibility_matrix_parallel(positions: &[Vec3], body_radius: f64) -> Vec<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns the visibility of every ordered pair of positions, across several
threads.

The result matches [`visibility_matrix`] element for element and in the
same order. The pairs are independent, so splitting the flat index space
across threads needs no coordination and produces the same matrix however
the work is divided.

The gain from threading is modest here and shrinks as the matrix shrinks.
A single visibility test is a few nanoseconds, so the cost of starting the
threads is only repaid by a large matrix: on a sixteen core machine a few
hundred satellites already gain, while a few dozen lose. The sequential
form is the better choice for a small shell, and this one exists for the
large ones where the quadratic sweep dominates.
items.doc_zh:
跨多个线程返回各位置有序对的可见性。

结果与 [`visibility_matrix`] 逐元素、逐次序相同。各对相互独立，故把扁平的
下标空间跨线程划分无需协调，且无论工作如何划分都产生相同的矩阵。

此处的线程收益不大，并随矩阵变小而缩小。单次可见性判定只有几纳秒，故启动
线程的代价只有大矩阵才回收：在十六核机器上，几百颗卫星已有收益，而几十颗则
亏损。顺序形式是小壳层的更好选择，而这个存在是为了二次扫描占主导的大壳层。

items.name: closest_approach_to_centre
items.signature: pub fn closest_approach_to_centre(first: Vec3, second: Vec3) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the closest distance from the origin to the line segment between
two points.

This is the perpendicular distance when the closest point lies between
the two ends, and the distance to the nearer end otherwise. For an
inter-satellite link the first case is the one that matters, because the
blocking body lies between the terminals.

Returns `None` when either point is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回原点到两点连线的最短距离。

最近点落在两端之间时它是垂距，否则是到较近一端的距离。对星间链路
而言前一种情形是要紧的，因为遮挡天体位于两端之间。

任一点非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: mutual_visibility
items.signature: pub fn mutual_visibility(first: Vec3, second: Vec3, body_radius: f64) -> Option<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the two satellites can see each other past the body.

The test is whether the line segment between the two positions stays
outside a sphere of the given radius. A link that grazes the surface
exactly is treated as clear, because the limit is the geometric horizon.

Returns `None` when either position is not finite or the body radius is
not positive.
items.doc_zh:
当两颗卫星能越过该天体互相可见时返回 `true`。

判据是两位置之间的线段是否保持在给定半径的球体之外。恰好擦过表面
的链路被视为通畅，因为该极限即几何地平线。

任一位置非有限或天体半径非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: link_geometry
items.signature: pub fn link_geometry(first: Vec3, second: Vec3, body_radius: f64) -> Option<LinkGeometry> {
items.doc:
Returns the full geometry of a link between two satellites.

The directions are unit vectors from each satellite toward the other. The
closest approach to the centre is included so that the caller can judge
how much margin the link has.

Returns `None` when either position is not finite, when the two coincide,
or when the body radius is not usable. A cell that reports its own
position for both ends has no link, so that case is rejected rather than
returned with a zero range.
items.doc_zh:
返回两颗卫星之间链路的完整几何。

各方向是自每颗卫星指向对方的单位矢量。其中含对中心的最接近距离，使
调用方能判断该链路有多少余量。

任一位置非有限、两者重合或天体半径不可用时返回 `None`。两端回报
自身位置的单元没有链路，故该情形被拒绝而非以零距离返回。

items.name: sun_blocks_link
items.signature: pub fn sun_blocks_link( link: &LinkGeometry, sun_direction: Vec3, field_of_view: f64, ) -> Option<bool> {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the Sun is within the field of view of an optical
link.

The test is the angle between the link direction and the direction to the
Sun. If that angle is within the field of view at either terminal, the
Sun is in the beam and the link cannot be used.

The field of view is given as a half angle in radians, which is the
acceptance cone of the telescope. A typical optical terminal has a half
angle of a few microradians.

The direction to the Sun is a unit vector in the same frame as the
positions. This crate does not compute it, because that needs an
ephemeris of the Sun, which the orbit layer does not currently provide; a
caller with such an ephemeris supplies the direction.

Returns `None` when the directions or the field of view are not usable.
items.doc_zh:
当太阳位于某光链路的视场内时返回 `true`。

判据是链路方向与太阳方向之间的夹角。若该夹角落在任一终端的视场内，则太阳进入
波束，该链路不可用。

视场以半角（弧度）给出，即望远镜的接受锥角。典型光终端的半角为若干微弧度。

太阳方向是与位置同系的单位矢量。本 crate 不计算它，因为这需要太阳星历，而
orbit 层当前不提供；拥有该星历的调用方自行提供该方向。

方向或视场不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: LinkGeometry
items.doc:
The geometry of a link between two satellites.

The range is the straight line distance, which a link budget uses for the
free space path loss. The two pointing vectors are the directions each
terminal must aim, expressed in the frame the positions were given in.
items.doc_zh:
两颗卫星之间链路的几何。

距离是直线距离，链路预算以之计算自由空间路径损耗。两个指向矢量是各
终端须瞄准的方向，表达在位置所给的坐标系中。

items.name: surface_clearance
items.signature: pub fn surface_clearance(&self, body_radius: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the grazing margin of the link, in kilometers.

This is how far the line between the two satellites clears the
surface, measured at the closest point. A negative value means the
link is blocked.
items.doc_zh:
返回该链路的擦地余量，单位为千米。

它是两点连线在最接近处越过地表的量度。负值表示该链路被遮挡。

items.name: is_clear
items.signature: pub fn is_clear(&self, body_radius: f64) -> bool {
items.doc: Returns `true` when the link clears the body.
items.doc_zh: 当该链路越过天体时返回 `true`。

items.name: LinkState
items.doc:
The state of a link at one instant.

A link is either carrying traffic or not. The reasons a link can be
unavailable are kept separate, because routing across a constellation has
to distinguish a link that is geometrically blocked from one that is
merely not established yet.
items.doc_zh:
某一瞬时链路的状态。

链路或承载业务或否。链路不可用的各种原因分开保留，因为在星座上路由
须区分被几何遮挡的链路与尚未建立的链路。

items.name: is_usable
items.doc: Returns `true` when the link may carry traffic.
items.doc_zh: 当该链路可承载业务时返回 `true`。

items.name: name
items.doc: Returns a short name for the state.
items.doc_zh: 返回该状态的简称。

crates.name: apsis-routing
crates.summary:
Routing over time-varying satellite topologies.

The topology of a satellite network changes as the satellites move, so a
route is only valid over an interval. This crate computes least cost
routes through a [`Topology`] and reports the
route together with the time it remains valid.

Two forms of routing are provided:

- [`shortest_path`] finds the least cost route through the topology in
  force at one instant.
- [`route_over_series`] finds a route that is valid for a whole interval,
  by taking the intersection of the topologies across that interval.

The second form is the one a store and forward network needs. A route
through a topology that changes halfway along it may not exist in the new
topology, so a route is only useful if its every link survives the
interval it is planned for.

The algorithm is Dijkstra's, with a binary heap. Costs must be positive,
which the topology layer enforces, so the algorithm is exact: the first
time a node is removed from the heap its distance is final.

Source: Dijkstra, E. W., *A note on two problems in connexion with
graphs*, Numerische Mathematik 1, 1959, and the binary heap formulation
as given in Cormen et al., *Introduction to Algorithms*, 3rd edition,
MIT Press, 2009, chapter 24.

```
use apsis_routing::shortest_path;
use apsis_topology::Topology;

// A three node line: 0 - 1 - 2, with the direct link 0 - 2 absent.
let mut topology = Topology::new(3);
topology.add_edge(0, 1, 1.0).expect("the nodes exist");
topology.add_edge(1, 2, 1.0).expect("the nodes exist");

let route = shortest_path(&topology, 0, 2).expect("a route exists");
assert_eq!(route.nodes, vec![0, 1, 2]);
assert!((route.cost - 2.0).abs() < 1e-12);
```
crates.summary_zh:
时变卫星拓扑上的路由。

卫星网络的拓扑随卫星移动而改变，故一条路由只在一个区间上有效。本 crate 计算
穿过 [`Topology`] 的最小代价路由，并把该路由连同其保持有效的时间一起报告。

提供两种路由形式：

- [`shortest_path`] 找出在某一瞬时生效的拓扑中的最小代价路由。
- [`route_over_series`] 找出对整个区间都有效的路由，方法是取该区间内各拓扑的
  交集。

第二种形式是存储转发网络所需者。穿过一条中途改变的拓扑的路由，在新拓扑中可能
不存在，故一条路由只有在其每条链路都存活于它所规划的那个区间时才有用。

该算法是 Dijkstra 的，配以二叉堆。代价必须为正，这由拓扑层强制，故该算法精确：
某节点首次从堆中取出时其距离即为最终。

出处：Dijkstra, E. W.，*A note on two problems in connexion with graphs*，
Numerische Mathematik 1，1959，以及二叉堆的表述，见 Cormen 等，
*Introduction to Algorithms*，第 3 版，MIT Press，2009，第 24 章。

items.name: route_over_series
items.signature: pub fn route_over_series( series: &TopologySeries, source: usize, destination: usize, start_seconds: f64, end_seconds: f64, ) -> Result<RouteLeg, RoutingError> {
items.doc:
Returns the shortest route valid across an interval of a topology series.

The route is computed over the links that are present throughout the
interval, so it remains valid for the whole of it. The interval is taken
from the start of the sample in force at `start_seconds` to the start of
the sample in force at `end_seconds`, and the links of every sample in
that span are intersected.

The returned leg records the interval the route is valid for, which is
bounded by the next topology change after `end_seconds`.

Returns an error when either node is out of range or the same, when the
interval is not ordered, or when no route survives the whole interval.

Source: the store and forward routing model over a time-varying graph is
the one described in Fraire, J. A. et al., *Routing in Delay-Tolerant
Networks Comprising Heterogeneous Populations of Deterministic Link
Dynamics*, IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing, 2020.
items.doc_zh:
返回在拓扑序列某区间上有效的最短路由。

该路由在贯穿整个区间都存在的链路上计算，故它在整个区间上保持有效。
该区间取自 `start_seconds` 处生效样本的起点，到 `end_seconds` 处生效
样本的起点，并对该跨度内每个样本的链路求交。

所返回的路段记录该路由有效的区间，它以 `end_seconds` 之后的下一处
拓扑变化为界。

任一节点越界或两者相同、区间次序不对，或没有路由能存活整个区间时
返回错误。

出处：时变图上的存储转发路由模型见 Fraire, J. A. 等，*Routing in
Delay-Tolerant Networks Comprising Heterogeneous Populations of
Deterministic Link Dynamics*，IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing，
2020。

crates.name: apsis-handover
crates.summary:
Handover decision logic for mobile terminals.

A terminal that can be served by more than one satellite must choose one,
and it must change its choice when the current server becomes unsuitable.
This crate makes that decision. It does not compute access windows, which
belong to the access layer; it takes a list of candidate satellites with
their quality and decides whether to hand over.

Two effects oppose each other and both must be in the policy:

- **Handing over too late** loses the link. If the current server drops
  below the terminal's minimum, the link fails before the switch happens.
- **Handing over too often** wastes capacity and time. Each handover costs
  signalling and interrupts the data flow, so a terminal that switches on
  every small fluctuation performs poorly even though each individual
  choice looked better.

The policy therefore has three parts: a threshold at which the current
server is considered unusable, a margin by which a candidate must beat
the current server before it is worth switching to, and a minimum time
between handovers. The margin is what suppresses oscillation, and it is
the hysteresis of the decision.

Source: the threshold, margin, and dwell time structure is the one used
for handover in cellular and satellite networks, as described for example
in ITU-R Recommendation M.1184 on the technical and operational
characteristics of mobile satellite systems, and in the general treatment
of handover hysteresis in mobile radio.

```
use apsis_handover::{Candidate, HandoverPolicy, HandoverDecision, decide};

let policy = HandoverPolicy {
    minimum_quality: 0.2,
    handover_margin: 0.1,
    minimum_dwell_seconds: 5.0,
};

// The current server is fine and the alternative is only slightly
// better, so nothing happens.
let candidates = [
    Candidate::new(1, 0.8, 100.0),
    Candidate::new(2, 0.85, 90.0),
];
let decision = decide(&policy, Some(1), &candidates).expect("valid input");
assert_eq!(decision, HandoverDecision::Stay);
```
crates.summary_zh:
移动终端的切换决策逻辑。

能被不止一颗卫星服务的终端必须选择其一，并在当前服务星变得不合适时改变其
选择。本 crate 作出该决策。它不计算可见性窗口，那属于可见性层；它接收一份带有
各自质量的候选卫星列表，并决定是否切换。

有两种效果相互对抗，二者都必须纳入策略：

- **切换太迟**会掉链。若当前服务星跌到终端的最低值以下，链路在切换发生之前即
  失效。
- **切换太频繁**浪费容量与时间。每次切换都要付出信令代价并中断数据流，故在每个
  小起伏上都切换的终端表现很差，即便每个单独的选择看起来更好。

故该策略有三部分：当前服务星被视为不可用的阈值、候选在值得切换之前必须超出
当前服务星的余量，以及两次切换之间的最短时间。该余量正是抑制振荡者，也是该
决策的滞回。

出处：阈值、余量与驻留时间的结构即蜂窝网与卫星网中切换所用者，例如见 ITU-R
建议书 M.1184 关于移动卫星系统技术特性的内容，以及移动无线电中切换滞回的一般
论述。

items.doc_zh: 当该候选可用时返回 `true`。

items.doc: What the terminal should do at one instant.
items.doc_zh: 终端在某一瞬时应做的动作。

items.name: is_change
items.doc: Returns `true` when the decision changes the serving satellite.
items.doc_zh: 当该决策改变服务卫星时返回 `true`。

items.doc:
Returns the satellite the terminal serves after the decision.

Returns `None` for [`HandoverDecision::Drop`] and for
[`HandoverDecision::Stay`] with no current server.
items.doc_zh:
返回决策之后终端所服务的卫星。

对 [`HandoverDecision::Drop`] 以及没有当前服务星的
[`HandoverDecision::Stay`] 返回 `None`。

items.name: name
items.doc: Returns a short name for the decision.
items.doc_zh: 返回该决策的简称。

items.name: decide
items.signature: pub fn decide( policy: &HandoverPolicy, current: Option<usize>, candidates: &[Candidate], ) -> Result<HandoverDecision, HandoverError> {
items.doc:
Returns the decision implied by the policy, without a dwell time.

This is the form to use when the terminal makes an independent decision
at each instant and the caller tracks the history itself. Use
[`decide_with_history`] when the dwell time must be enforced.

The rules, in the order they are applied:

1. With no current server, acquire the best candidate, or drop when none
   meets the minimum quality.
2. When the current server is not among the candidates, it has become
   unavailable, so switch to the best candidate or drop when none meets
   the minimum quality.
3. When the current server is below the minimum quality, abandon it for
   the best candidate, or drop when none meets the minimum quality.
4. Otherwise stay, unless a candidate exceeds the current server's
   quality by more than the margin.

Returns an error when the candidates or the policy are not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回策略在不设驻留时间时所蕴含的决策。

这是终端在每一瞬时独立决策、而调用方自行跟踪历史时所用的形式。当必须强制
驻留时间时，用 [`decide_with_history`]。

各条规则，按其施加次序：

1. 没有当前服务星时，获取最优候选；若没有一个满足最低质量，则放弃。
2. 当前服务星不在候选中时，它已不可用，故切换到最优候选；若没有一个满足
   最低质量，则放弃。
3. 当前服务星低于最低质量时，放弃它而取最优候选；若没有一个满足最低质量，
   则放弃。
4. 否则保持，除非某候选超出当前服务星的质量多于余量。

候选或策略不可用时返回错误。

items.name: decide_with_history
items.signature: pub fn decide_with_history( policy: &HandoverPolicy, current: Option<usize>, last_handover_seconds: Option<f64>, candidates: &[Candidate], seconds: f64, ) -> Result<HandoverDecision, HandoverError> {
items.doc:
Returns the decision implied by the policy, enforcing the dwell time.

This adds one rule to those of [`decide`]. When the time since the last
handover is less than the dwell time, a handover that would otherwise
happen for a quality gain is refused and the terminal stays. A handover
that is forced, because the current server has become unavailable or has
fallen below the minimum quality, is allowed regardless: refusing it
would drop the link, which is worse than the churn the dwell time
prevents.

Returns an error when the candidates or the policy are not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回策略在强制驻留时间时所蕴含的决策。

它在 [`decide`] 的各条规则之上再加一条。当距上次切换的时间少于驻留时间时，
本会因质量增益而发生的切换被拒绝，终端保持。被强制的切换——因为当前服务星
已不可用或已跌至最低质量以下——无论如何都允许：拒绝它会掉链，这比驻留时间
所要防止的频繁切换更糟。

候选或策略不可用时返回错误。

items.doc_zh: 返回当前正在服务的卫星（若有）。

items.name: last_handover_seconds
items.doc: Returns the time of the last handover, if there has been one.
items.doc_zh: 返回最后一次切换的时间（若曾发生）。

items.name: history
items.doc: Returns the handover history, in time order.
items.doc_zh: 按时间次序返回切换历史。

items.name: handover_count
items.doc: Returns the number of handovers that have occurred.
items.doc_zh: 返回已发生的切换次数。

items.name: step
items.signature: pub fn step( &mut self, seconds: f64, candidates: &[Candidate], ) -> Result<crate::decision::HandoverDecision, HandoverError> {
items.doc:
Applies the policy to a set of candidates at a time.

The tracker updates its state according to the decision and returns
that decision, so a caller can both react to it and rely on the
tracker having recorded it.

Returns an error when the candidates or the policy are not usable.
items.doc_zh:
在某一时刻把策略施加于一组候选。

跟踪器按该决策更新其状态并返回该决策，使调用方既能对它作出反应，也能
依赖跟踪器已记录它。

候选或策略不可用时返回错误。

items.name: mean_interval_seconds
items.doc:
Returns the mean time between handovers, in seconds.

Returns `None` when fewer than two handovers have occurred, because a
single interval is not a mean.
items.doc_zh:
返回两次切换之间的平均时间，单位为秒。

发生的切换少于两次时返回 `None`，因为单个间隔算不上均值。

items.name: handover_rate_per_second
items.doc:
Returns the number of handovers per unit time over the history.

The rate is measured across the whole history, from the first
handover to the last. Returns `None` when there are fewer than two
handovers or when they all occur at the same instant.
items.doc_zh:
返回整个历史上单位时间的切换次数。

速率跨越整个历史度量，从首次切换到末次。切换少于两次或它们都
发生在同一瞬时时返回 `None`。

items.name: total_quality_gain
items.doc:
Returns the total quality gained by handing over.

The value is the sum over the history, which can be negative when a
handover was forced by a falling quality rather than chosen for a
gain.
items.doc_zh:
返回切换所获得的质量总和。

该值是对整个历史求和，当切换是被下降的质量所迫而非为增益所选择
时可为负。

crates.name: apsis-mesh
crates.summary_zh:
网格连通性抽象。

卫星网格是一组经链路互相到达的终端，其中一些是卫星链路、一些是地面链路。本
crate 提供网格应用在拓扑之上所需的抽象：哪些终端能到达哪些其他终端、有多少条
独立路径可以做到，以及哪些链路是关键。

本 crate 回答的三个问题：

- **可达性**：自某给定终端可达的终端集合。
- **冗余度**：连接两个终端的独立路径条数，即可独立失效的链路数。依 Menger 定理，
  它是该图的边连通度。
- **关键性**：移除后会切开网格的那些链路，即网络运营者必须保护的链路。

冗余度计算对卫星网格所呈现的小图是精确的。它使用 Menger 定理的边版本，从一
系列单位容量的最大流问题计算连通度。

出处：Menger 定理，以及把边连通度归约为最大流，见 Cormen 等，
*Introduction to Algorithms*，第 3 版，MIT Press，2009，第 26 章。

items.name: reachable_from
items.signature: pub fn reachable_from(topology: &Topology, source: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
items.doc:
Returns the set of nodes reachable from a node, following edges in their
direction.

The start node is included, since a node reaches itself by a path of no
hops. The result is in node order.

Returns an empty vector when the node is out of range.
items.doc_zh:
沿边的方向返回自某节点可达的节点集合。

起点节点被包含在内，因为节点经零跳路径可达自身。结果按节点次序
排列。

节点越界时返回空向量。

items.name: edge_connectivity
items.signature: pub fn edge_connectivity(topology: &Topology, source: usize, destination: usize) -> Option<usize> {
items.doc:
Returns the number of independent paths between two nodes.

Two paths are independent when they share no edge. By Menger's theorem
that number is the minimum number of edges whose removal disconnects the
two nodes, so it is the number of link failures the connection survives.

The value is computed as a maximum flow of unit capacity between the two
nodes, using the Edmonds-Karp variant of the Ford-Fulkerson method, which
augments along a shortest path at each step. For the small graphs of a
satellite mesh this is fast, and it is exact.

Returns `Some(0)` when no path exists, and `None` when either node is out
of range or the two nodes are the same, for which the question is not
defined.
items.doc_zh:
返回两节点之间相互独立的路径条数。

两条路径在不含公共边时相互独立。依 Menger 定理，该条数即使这两节点
断连所需移除的最少边数，故即该连接可承受的链路失效次数。

该值以两节点之间单位容量的最大流计算，采用 Ford-Fulkerson 方法的
Edmonds-Karp 变体，每步沿最短增广。对卫星网这样的小图它既快又
精确。

不存在路径时返回 `Some(0)`；任一节点越界或两节点相同（此时该问题
无定义）时返回 `None`。

items.name: strongly_connected_components
items.doc:
Returns the number of strongly connected components.

A component is strongly connected when every node in it can reach every
other following the edges in their direction. This is the count of
separate networks that can route internally, which for a satellite mesh
with directed inter-satellite links is the right measure of how many
pieces it has.

The algorithm is Kosaraju's: a depth first search records the order in
which nodes finish, and a second search over the reversed edges, taking
the nodes in reverse finishing order, emits the components.

Source: Kosaraju's algorithm as described in Cormen et al.,
*Introduction to Algorithms*, 3rd edition, MIT Press, 2009, chapter 22.
items.doc_zh:
返回强连通分量的数量。

一个分量内每个节点都能沿边的方向到达其余每个节点时，它即强连通。
该计数是各自内部可路由的独立网络数，对含定向星间链路的卫星网而
言，它正是衡量该网由几部分构成的恰当度量。

算法为 Kosaraju：一次深度优先搜索记录各节点的完成次序，再在反向
边上按完成次序的逆序做第二次搜索，输出各分量。

出处：Kosaraju 算法，见 Cormen 等，*Introduction to Algorithms*，
第 3 版，MIT Press，2009，第 22 章。

items.name: CriticalLink
items.doc: A link whose removal would change the connectivity of the mesh.
items.doc_zh: 一条移除后会改变网格连通性的链路。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(from: usize, to: usize, cost: f64, components_without: usize) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a critical link record.
items.doc_zh: 创建关键链路记录。

items.name: MeshSummary
items.doc: A summary of the connectivity of a mesh.
items.doc_zh: 网格连通性的摘要。

items.name: Mesh
items.doc:
A mesh of terminals joined by links.

The mesh wraps a topology and adds the connectivity measures a mesh
application needs. It does not own a schedule or a traffic model; those
belong to the caller.
items.doc_zh:
由链路连接的终端构成的网格。

网格封装一个拓扑并加入网格应用所需的连通性度量。它不拥有调度或业务
模型；那些属于调用方。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(topology: Topology) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a mesh over a topology.
items.doc_zh: 在某拓扑之上创建网格。

items.name: topology
items.doc: Returns the underlying topology.
items.doc_zh: 返回底层拓扑。

items.name: node_count
items.doc: Returns the number of terminals.
items.doc_zh: 返回终端的数量。

items.name: edge_count
items.doc: Returns the number of links.
items.doc_zh: 返回链路的数量。

items.name: is_connected
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every terminal reaches every other, treating the
links as undirected.
items.doc_zh: 把链路视为无向时，当每个终端都能到达其余每个终端，返回 `true`。

items.name: reachable_from
items.signature: pub fn reachable_from(&self, source: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
items.doc: Returns the terminals reachable from a terminal.
items.doc_zh: 返回自某终端可达的各终端。

items.name: edge_connectivity
items.signature: pub fn edge_connectivity(&self, source: usize, destination: usize) -> Option<usize> {
items.doc:
Returns the number of independent paths between two terminals.

Returns `None` when either terminal is out of range or the two are
the same.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个终端之间独立路径的条数。

任一终端越界或两者相同时返回 `None`。

items.name: minimum_connectivity
items.doc:
Returns the smallest number of independent paths between any two
distinct terminals.

Returns `None` when there are fewer than two terminals.
items.doc_zh:
返回任意两个不同终端之间独立路径条数的最小值。

终端少于两个时返回 `None`。

items.name: critical_links
items.doc:
Returns the links whose removal would increase the number of
connected components, treating each link as undirected.

These are the bridges of the undirected graph underlying the mesh. A
link is reported once, even when it is present in both directions,
because a failure takes out the whole link rather than one direction
of it.

Each candidate is found by removing the link in both directions and
comparing the component count, which is exact but costs one traversal
per link. For the size of graph a satellite mesh presents that is
acceptable, and it is easier to verify than a linear time bridge
finding algorithm.

Links that are not bridges are omitted, so an empty result means
every link lies on a cycle and the mesh survives any single link
failure without splitting.
items.doc_zh:
返回移除后会增加连通分量数的那些链路，把每条链路视为无向。

它们是网格底层无向图的桥。一条链路只报告一次，即便它有双向，
因为一次失效是整条链路失效而非其中一个方向。

每个候选通过在两方向移除该链路并比较分量数来发现，这精确但每条
链路要花一次遍历。对卫星网所呈现的图规模而言这是可接受的，且比
线性时间的桥查找算法更易验证。

非桥的链路被省略，故空结果意味着每条链路都在某个环上，网格在
任何单条链路失效下都不会裂开。

items.name: survives_single_link_failure
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the mesh survives the failure of any single link
without splitting.

This is the condition for the mesh to have a single link failure
tolerance, which is the minimum redundancy a network carrying traffic
without interruption should have.
items.doc_zh:
当网格在任何单条链路失效下都不裂开时返回 `true`。

这是网格具备单链路失效容错的条件，而这是不中断地承载业务的网络
应有的最低冗余。

items.name: strongly_connected_components
items.doc:
Returns the number of strongly connected components.

For a mesh of directed links this counts the pieces that can route
internally. A value above one means some terminals cannot be reached
from some others.
items.doc_zh:
返回强连通分量的数量。

对有向链路的网格而言，它统计可各自内部路由的块数。大于一的值
意味着有些终端无法从另一些到达。

items.name: summarise
items.doc: Returns a summary of the mesh connectivity.
items.doc_zh: 返回网格连通性的摘要。

crates.name: apsis-rf
crates.summary:
Core radio frequency primitives.

This crate holds the quantities that the rest of the radio frequency
layer is written in: power, gain, and the decibel scale that both are
usually quoted on, together with the two relations that every link
calculation starts from, the wavelength of a frequency and the free
space path loss.

Units are SI throughout. Power is in watts, frequency in hertz, distance
in meters, and temperature in kelvin. Decibel values are power ratios,
computed as ten times the base ten logarithm of the ratio.

Two conventions are worth stating because they are easy to mix up:

- A decibel is a ratio between two powers. A gain expressed in `dBi` is a
  ratio to an isotropic radiator and one in `dBd` is a ratio to a half
  wave dipole, which is 2.15 dB more directive than an isotropic
  radiator. [`Gain`] carries the ratio and both named forms.
- The free space path loss increases with frequency as well as with
  distance, because both the effective aperture of a fixed gain antenna
  and the solid angle it subtends shrink as the wavelength shortens.

```
use apsis_rf::{Power, wavelength};

// A noise power of -204 dBW is about 4e-21 W.
let noise = Power::from_dbw(-204.0).expect("the reading is finite");
assert!(noise.watts() > 0.0);

// A one meter wavelength corresponds to a frequency of 299.792 MHz.
let lambda = wavelength(299_792_458.0).expect("the frequency is positive");
assert!((lambda - 1.0).abs() < 1e-12);
```
crates.summary_zh:
核心射频原语。

本 crate 保存射频层其余部分据以书写的各量：功率、增益，以及二者通常所
用的分贝尺度，连同每次链路计算所起的两条关系——某频率的波长与自由空间
路径损耗。

全程使用 SI 单位。功率以瓦特计，频率以赫兹计，距离以米计，温度以开尔文
计。分贝值是功率比，按该比的十进对数的十倍计算。

有两条约定值得写出，因为它们容易混淆：

- 分贝是两个功率之比。以 `dBi` 表示的增益是相对各向同性辐射体的比值，
  以 `dBd` 表示的则是相对半波振子的比值，后者比各向同性辐射体更具方向性
  2.15 dB。[`Gain`] 携带该比值以及两种具名形式。
- 自由空间路径损耗既随频率也随距离增大，因为固定增益天线的有效孔径与其
  所张立体角都随波长变短而缩小。

items.name: Decibel
items.doc:
A ratio expressed in decibels.

A decibel is ten times the base ten logarithm of a power ratio, so a
value of zero is unity gain or loss, a value of three is very close to a
doubling, and a value of minus three is very close to a halving.

The type stores the decibel value rather than the ratio, because a chain
of gains and losses is then a sum, which is both faster and less prone to
overflow than a product of ratios.
items.doc_zh:
以分贝表示的比值。

分贝是功率比的十进对数的十倍，故值为零是单位增益或损耗，值为三非常接近加倍，
值为负三非常接近减半。

该类型存储分贝值而非比值，因为一串增益与损耗于是成为求和，这比比值之积既更快
也更不易溢出。

items.name: UNITY
items.doc: The value for a ratio of one, which is zero decibels.
items.doc_zh: 比值为一时的取值，即零分贝。

items.name: DOUBLING
items.doc: The value for a ratio of two, which is about 3.0103 decibels.
items.doc_zh: 比值为二时的取值，约为 3.0103 分贝。

items.name: from_db
items.signature: pub const fn from_db(decibels: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a value from a decibel reading.
items.doc_zh: 由分贝读数创建一个取值。

items.name: from_ratio
items.doc:
Creates a value from a power ratio.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive and finite, because the
logarithm is not defined there.
items.doc_zh:
由功率比创建一个取值。

比值非正且非有限时返回 `None`，因为那里没有定义对数。

items.name: from_amplitude_ratio
items.doc: Creates a value from an amplitude ratio.
items.doc_zh:
由幅度比创建一个取值。

An amplitude, unlike a power, scales the decibel value by twenty
rather than ten, because power is proportional to amplitude squared.
Use this for a voltage or field ratio.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive and finite.

比值非正或非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: db
items.doc: Returns the reading in decibels.
items.doc_zh: 返回该分贝读数。

items.name: ratio
items.doc: Returns the power ratio this reading represents.
items.doc_zh: 返回该读数所表示的功率比。

items.name: amplitude_ratio
items.doc: Returns the amplitude ratio this reading represents.
items.doc_zh: 返回该读数所表示的幅度比。

items.name: plus
items.signature: pub const fn plus(self, other: Self) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns the sum of two readings.

Adding decibel values multiplies the ratios they represent, which is
how a cascade of gains and losses is combined.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个读数之和。

分贝值相加即其所表示的比值相乘，这正是级联增益与损耗的合成
方式。

items.name: minus
items.signature: pub const fn minus(self, other: Self) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns the difference of two readings.

Subtracting decibel values divides the ratios they represent, which
is how a loss is removed from a gain.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个读数之差。

分贝值相减即其所表示的比值相除，这正是从增益中去掉损耗的方式。

items.name: negated
items.doc: Returns this reading negated, which inverts the ratio.
items.doc_zh: 返回该读数的相反数，即比值的倒数。

items.name: is_finite
items.doc: Returns `true` when the reading is finite.
items.doc_zh: 当该读数有限时返回 `true`。

items.name: wavelength
items.doc:
Returns the wavelength of a frequency in vacuum, in meters.

The relation is `lambda = c / f`, with `c` exact by the definition of the
metre.

Returns `None` when the frequency is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回某频率在真空中的波长，单位为米。

关系为 `lambda = c / f`，其中 `c` 依米的定义是精确的。

频率非正且非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: free_space_path_loss
items.signature: pub fn free_space_path_loss(distance: f64, frequency: f64) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the free space path loss between two isotropic antennas, as a
ratio in decibels.

The ratio is positive, so it represents a loss: the received power is the
transmitted power divided by this ratio. The relation is

```text
L = (4 pi d / lambda)^2
```

which is the spreading loss of a spherical wave over a distance `d`
combined with the effective aperture of an isotropic receive antenna.

The loss grows with frequency at a fixed distance, because the effective
aperture of the receive antenna falls as the square of the wavelength.

The distance must be positive. A zero distance is not a case this
expression covers: the ratio would be zero, which is infinite attenuation
in decibels, and the underlying far field assumption does not hold.

Returns `None` when the distance is not positive, or when either argument
is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个各向同性天线之间的自由空间路径损耗，以分贝比值表示。

该比值为正，故表示一种损耗：接收功率是发射功率除以该比值。关系为

```text
L = (4 pi d / lambda)^2
```

它是球面波在距离 `d` 上的扩散损耗与各向同性接收天线有效孔径的
结合。

固定距离下损耗随频率增大，因为接收天线的有效孔径按波长的平方下降。

距离必须为正。零距离不是本式所涵盖的情形：比值会为零，即以分贝计的
无穷衰减，且其背后的远场假定不成立。

距离非正，或任一参数非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: free_space_received_ratio
items.signature: pub fn free_space_received_ratio( distance: f64, frequency: f64, transmitter: Gain, receiver: Gain, ) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the received power ratio between two antennas in free space.

The received power is the transmitted power multiplied by the two antenna
gains and divided by the free space path loss, which in decibels is the
sum

```text
P_r / P_t = G_t G_r / L
```

The result is the ratio in decibels, so a positive value means the
receive antenna collects more than was transmitted, which happens when
the two gains exceed the spreading loss.

Returns `None` when the distance or frequency is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回自由空间两个天线之间的接收功率比。

接收功率是发射功率乘以两个天线增益、再除以自由空间路径损耗，以分贝
表示即

```text
P_r / P_t = G_t G_r / L
```

结果是分贝比值，故正值意味着接收天线收集到的多于所发射的，这在两个
增益超过扩散损耗时发生。

距离或频率不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: DIPOLE_OVER_ISOTROPIC_DB
items.doc:
The gain of a half wave dipole relative to an isotropic radiator, in
decibels.

The exact directivity of an ideal half wave dipole is 1.6409, which is
2.1509 dB. Engineering practice rounds this to 2.15 dB, and that rounded
value is what the `dBd` and `dBi` conventions are defined against. This
crate uses the conventional value so that a conversion between the two
named forms is exact, and it derives the linear ratio from it.
items.doc_zh:
半波振子相对各向同性辐射体的增益，单位为分贝。

理想半波振子的精确方向性为 1.6409，即 2.1509 dB。工程实践将其取整为
2.15 dB，`dBd` 与 `dBi` 两种约定即以该取整值定义。本 crate 采用
该约定值，使两种具名形式之间的换算精确，并由其导出线性比值。

items.name: HALF_WAVE_DIPOLE_RATIO
items.doc:
The linear gain ratio of a half wave dipole, `10^(2.15 / 10)`.

This is about 1.64059, within 0.02 percent of the exact directivity of an
ideal dipole, which is 1.6409.
items.doc_zh:
半波振子的线性增益比值，`10^(2.15 / 10)`。

该值约为 1.64059，与理想振子 1.6409 的精确方向性相差在 0.02% 以内。

items.name: Gain
items.doc:
An antenna gain expressed as a ratio to an isotropic radiator.

The type stores the linear ratio. The two named decibel forms are offered
as conversions, because the choice is a matter of convention rather than
of the gain itself:

- `dBi` is the ratio to an isotropic radiator, which radiates equally in
  every direction.
- `dBd` is the ratio to a half wave dipole, which is
  [`DIPOLE_OVER_ISOTROPIC_DB`] decibels above an isotropic radiator.
items.doc_zh:
以相对各向同性辐射体的比值表示的天线增益。

该类型以线性比值存储。两种具名分贝形式以换算形式提供，因为这一
选择关乎约定而非增益本身：

- `dBi` 是相对各向同性辐射体的比值，后者向各方向均匀辐射。
- `dBd` 是相对半波振子的比值，后者比各向同性辐射体高
  [`DIPOLE_OVER_ISOTROPIC_DB`] 分贝。

items.name: ISOTROPIC
items.doc: Unit gain, as an isotropic radiator has.
items.doc_zh: 单位增益，如各向同性辐射体所有。

items.name: HALF_WAVE_DIPOLE
items.doc: The gain of a half wave dipole, about 1.6406.
items.doc_zh: 半波振子的增益，约为 1.6406。

items.name: from_ratio
items.signature: pub const fn from_ratio(ratio: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a gain from a linear ratio.
items.doc_zh: 由线性比值创建增益。

items.name: from_dbi
items.doc:
Creates a gain from a value in decibels relative to an isotropic
radiator.

A gain ratio is never negative, so any finite reading is accepted.
items.doc_zh:
由相对各向同性辐射体的分贝值创建增益。

增益比值不会为负，故任何有限读数都被接受。

items.name: from_dbd
items.doc:
Creates a gain from a value in decibels relative to a half wave
dipole.

Returns `None` when the reading is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
由相对半波振子的分贝值创建增益。

该读数非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: ratio
items.doc: Returns the linear ratio to an isotropic radiator.
items.doc_zh: 返回相对各向同性辐射体的线性比值。

items.name: dbi
items.doc:
Returns this gain in decibels relative to an isotropic radiator.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回该增益，相对各向同性辐射体以分贝计。

比值非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: dbd
items.doc:
Returns this gain in decibels relative to a half wave dipole.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回该增益，相对半波振子以分贝计。

比值非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: as_decibel
items.doc:
Returns this gain as a ratio in decibels.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回该增益，以分贝比表示。

比值非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: effective_aperture
items.signature: pub fn effective_aperture(self, wavelength: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the effective aperture of an antenna with this gain at the
given wavelength, in square meters.

The relation is `A = G lambda^2 / (4 pi)`. It follows from the
requirement that an antenna in a thermal bath receive as much power
as it radiates.

Returns `None` when the wavelength is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回具有该增益的天线在给定波长处的有效孔径，单位为平方米。

关系为 `A = G lambda^2 / (4 pi)`。它由热浴中的天线接收功率须等于
其辐射功率这一要求得出。

波长非正且非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: from_effective_aperture
items.signature: pub fn from_effective_aperture(aperture: f64, wavelength: f64) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain of an antenna with this effective aperture at the
given wavelength.

This is the inverse of [`Gain::effective_aperture`].

Returns `None` when the wavelength is not positive and finite, or
when the aperture is negative.
items.doc_zh:
返回具有该有效孔径的天线在给定波长处的增益。

它是 [`Gain::effective_aperture`] 的逆。

波长非正且非有限，或孔径为负时返回 `None`。

items.name: DBW_REFERENCE
items.doc:
The reference power of the decibel watt, one watt.

A power quoted in dBW is a ratio to this value.
items.doc_zh:
分贝瓦的参考功率，即一瓦。

以 dBW 表示的功率是相对该值的比值。

items.name: DBM_REFERENCE
items.doc:
The reference power of the decibel milliwatt, one milliwatt.

A power quoted in dBm is a ratio to this value, so a value in dBm is
thirty decibels above the same value in dBW.
items.doc_zh:
分贝毫瓦的参考功率，即一毫瓦。

以 dBm 表示的功率是相对该值的比值，故同一数值以 dBm 表示比以 dBW
表示高三十分贝。

items.name: Power
items.doc:
A power level in watts.

The type stores watts, which is the unit the decibel references are
defined against, and offers conversion to and from the two decibel forms
used in link budgets.
items.doc_zh:
以瓦特表示的功率电平。

该类型以瓦特存储，这是分贝参考所依据的单位，并提供与链路预算中常用
的两种分贝形式之间的换算。

items.name: WATT
items.doc: The reference power of zero dBW, one watt.
items.doc_zh: 零 dBW 的参考功率，即一瓦。

items.name: MILLIWATT
items.doc: The reference power of zero dBm, one milliwatt.
items.doc_zh: 零 dBm 的参考功率，即一毫瓦。

items.name: from_watts
items.signature: pub const fn from_watts(watts: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a power level from a value in watts.

A power may be zero, which represents no power, but not negative.
items.doc_zh:
以瓦特值创建功率电平。

功率可以为零，表示没有功率，但不可为负。

items.name: from_milliwatts
items.signature: pub const fn from_milliwatts(milliwatts: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a power level from a value in milliwatts.
items.doc_zh: 以毫瓦值创建功率电平。

items.name: from_dbw
items.doc:
Creates a power level from a value in decibel watts.

A zero or negative reading cannot be expressed as a finite power, so
no validation is needed.
items.doc_zh:
以分贝瓦值创建功率电平。

零或负的读数无法表示为有限功率，故无需校验。

items.name: from_dbm
items.doc:
Creates a power level from a value in decibel milliwatts.

Returns `None` when the reading is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
以分贝毫瓦值创建功率电平。

该读数非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: watts
items.doc: Returns this power in watts.
items.doc_zh: 返回该功率的瓦特值。

items.name: milliwatts
items.doc: Returns this power in milliwatts.
items.doc_zh: 返回该功率的毫瓦值。

items.name: dbw
items.doc:
Returns this power in decibel watts.

Returns `None` when the power is not positive, because the logarithm
is not defined there.
items.doc_zh:
返回该功率的分贝瓦值。

功率非正时返回 `None`，因为对数在那里没有定义。

items.name: dbm
items.doc:
Returns this power in decibel milliwatts.

Returns `None` when the power is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回该功率的分贝毫瓦值。

功率非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: ratio_in_decibels
items.signature: pub fn ratio_in_decibels(self, rhs: Self) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the ratio of `self` to `rhs`, in decibels.

This is the form used in a link budget to express a loss or a gain
between two power levels.

Returns `None` when either power is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回 `self` 与 `rhs` 之比，以分贝计。

这是链路预算中用来表达两个功率电平之间损耗或增益的形式。

两个功率之一非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: scaled
items.signature: pub fn scaled(self, ratio: Decibel) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Returns this power scaled by a ratio in decibels.

Returns `None` when the resulting power is not finite, which happens
for a very large gain.
items.doc_zh:
返回该功率按某个分贝比值缩放后的值。

结果功率非有限时返回 `None`；增益极大时即如此。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the power is finite and not negative.
items.doc_zh: 当该功率有限且非负时返回 `true`。

crates.name: apsis-antenna
crates.summary:
Antenna radiation patterns and gain models.

An antenna does not radiate equally in every direction. This crate models
how the gain varies with angle for the two shapes that appear in almost
every satellite link: a parabolic reflector, whose beam is a narrow
pencil, and an idealised element with a broad pattern.

Three beam width conventions are used in practice and they are not
interchangeable:

- The half power beam width is the angle between the two directions where
  the gain has fallen to half its peak, which is three decibels down.
- The null to null beam width is the angle between the first two zeros on
  either side of the main lobe. It is roughly twice the half power width
  for a uniformly illuminated aperture.
- The first sidelobe level is the peak gain outside the main lobe. For a
  uniformly illuminated circular aperture it is about minus 17.6 dB.

Every function here takes or returns angles in radians and gains as
[`apsis_rf::Gain`], so a result can be fed straight into a link budget.

Sources:

- Parabolic aperture gain: `G = eta (pi D / lambda)^2`, where `eta` is
  the aperture efficiency, typically between 0.55 and 0.70 for a
  well adjusted dish.
- Half power beam width of a circular aperture: `theta = k lambda / D`
  with `k` about 1.02 for uniform illumination and close to 1.2 for
  typical illumination tapers.
- The co-polar reference pattern of a simple Earth station antenna, which
  falls as the square of the off-axis angle down to a sidelobe floor. This
  is the form used by ITU-R Recommendation S.465 to bound interference
  from one satellite system into another.

```
use apsis_antenna::ParabolicAperture;

// A three meter dish at twelve gigahertz has a peak gain near 50 dBi.
let dish = ParabolicAperture {
    diameter: 3.0,
    efficiency: 0.65,
};
let peak = dish.peak_gain(0.025).expect("valid wavelength");
assert!(peak.dbi().expect("positive") > 45.0);
assert!(peak.dbi().expect("positive") < 50.0);
```
crates.summary_zh:
天线辐射方向图与增益模型。

天线并非向各个方向均匀辐射。本 crate 为几乎每条卫星链路都会出现的两种
形状建模增益随角度的变化：抛物面反射体，其波束是窄笔形；以及具有宽方向图
的理想化单元。

实践中有三种波束宽度约定，它们不可互换：

- 半功率波束宽度是增益降到峰值一半（即低三分贝）的两个方向之间的角。
- 零点到零点波束宽度是主瓣两侧头两个零点之间的角。对均匀照射孔径，它约
  为半功率宽度的两倍。
- 第一旁瓣电平是主瓣之外的峰值增益。对均匀照射的圆孔径，它约为负
  17.6 dB。

此处的每个函数都以弧度接收或返回角度，以 [`apsis_rf::Gain`] 接收或返回
增益，故结果可直接送入链路预算。

出处：

- 抛物面孔径增益：`G = eta (pi D / lambda)^2`，其中 `eta` 是孔径效率，
  对调准良好的天线通常在 0.55 与 0.70 之间。
- 圆孔径的半功率波束宽度：`theta = k lambda / D`，均匀照射时 `k` 约为
  1.02，典型照射锥削时接近 1.2。
- 简单地球站天线的同极化参考方向图，其随偏轴角的平方下降到旁瓣底限。
  这是 ITU-R 建议书 S.465 为限定从一个卫星系统到另一个的干扰所用的
  形式。

items.name: ParabolicAperture
items.doc:
A parabolic reflector described by its diameter and aperture efficiency.

The aperture efficiency collects every loss between the power delivered
to the feed and the power that leaves the aperture as a uniform plane
wave: illumination taper, spillover, blockage by the feed and its
supports, and surface error. A well adjusted dish reaches 0.65 to 0.70,
and a small or simply built one is nearer 0.55.
items.doc_zh:
由其直径与孔径效率描述的抛物面反射体。

孔径效率汇集了从送到馈源的功率到以均匀平面波离开孔径的功率之间的
每一项损耗：照射锥削、溢出、馈源及其支撑的遮挡，以及表面误差。调准
良好的天线达到 0.65 至 0.70，小而简易的接近 0.55。

items.name: area
items.doc: Returns the physical area of the aperture, in square meters.
items.doc_zh: 返回孔径的物理面积，单位为平方米。

items.name: effective_area
items.doc:
Returns the effective area, in square meters.

This is the physical area scaled by the aperture efficiency. It is
the area that, if it collected uniformly, would deliver the observed
power.
items.doc_zh:
返回有效面积，单位为平方米。

这是物理面积按孔径效率缩放后的值。它是这样一块面积：若均匀收集，
将给出所观测到的功率。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the aperture describes a usable dish.
items.doc_zh: 当该孔径描述一个可用天线时返回 `true`。

items.name: peak_gain
items.signature: pub fn peak_gain(self, wavelength: f64) -> Option<Gain> {
items.doc:
Returns the peak gain on boresight at the given wavelength.

The relation is

```text
G = eta (pi D / lambda)^2
```

which follows from the effective area through
[`Gain::from_effective_aperture`]. Returns `None` for an invalid
aperture or wavelength.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定波长处视轴上的峰值增益。

关系为

```text
G = eta (pi D / lambda)^2
```

它由有效面积经 [`Gain::from_effective_aperture`] 得出。孔径或波长
无效时返回 `None`。

items.name: uniform_beam_width
items.signature: pub fn uniform_beam_width(self, wavelength: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the half power beam width at the given wavelength, in
radians.

This uses the uniform illumination relation, which is the narrowest
a dish of this diameter can be. A real dish with an illumination
taper is wider; use [`ParabolicAperture::half_power_beam_width`] to
include the taper.

Returns `None` for an invalid aperture or wavelength.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定波长处的半功率波束宽度，单位为弧度。

这里用的是均匀照射关系，即该直径天线所能达到的最窄。带照射锥削
的实际天线更宽；要计入锥削请用
[`ParabolicAperture::half_power_beam_width`]。

孔径或波长无效时返回 `None`。

items.name: half_power_beam_width
items.signature: pub fn half_power_beam_width(self, wavelength: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the half power beam width at the given wavelength, in
radians, allowing for an illumination taper.

A tapered illumination reduces the sidelobes at the cost of a wider
main lobe. The factor `k` in `theta = k lambda / D` rises from about
1.02 for uniform illumination to about 1.2 for the taper that
minimises sidelobes. A value of 1.15 is representative of a
well designed dish.

Returns `None` for an invalid aperture or wavelength.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定波长处的半功率波束宽度（弧度），并计入照射锥削。

锥削照射以加宽主瓣为代价降低旁瓣。`theta = k lambda / D` 中的因子
`k` 从均匀照射的约 1.02 升到最小化旁瓣的锥削的约 1.2。1.15 是
设计良好的天线的代表值。

孔径或波长无效时返回 `None`。

items.name: beam_width
items.signature: pub fn beam_width(diameter: f64, wavelength: f64, k: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the half power beam width of a circular aperture, in radians.

The relation is `theta = k lambda / D`, where `k` depends on how the
aperture is illuminated. Uniform illumination gives the narrowest beam,
with `k` about 1.02, and the taper that suppresses sidelobes gives the
widest, with `k` about 1.2.

The result is the full width between the two three decibel points, not
the half width. It is a small angle approximation, so the caller should
confirm that the resulting width is small compared to a radian.

Returns `None` when the diameter or wavelength is not positive, or when
`k` is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回圆孔径的半功率波束宽度，单位为弧度。

关系为 `theta = k lambda / D`，其中 `k` 取决于孔径如何被照射。均匀
照射给出最窄波束，`k` 约为 1.02；抑制旁瓣的锥削给出最宽的，`k` 约为
1.2。

结果是两个三分贝点之间的全宽，而非半宽。它是小角近似，故调用方应
确认所得宽度相对一弧度很小。

直径或波长非正，或 `k` 非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: floor_angle
items.signature: pub fn floor_angle(beam_width: f64, floor_db: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the angle at which the squared angle law of
[`off_axis_attenuation`](crate::off_axis_attenuation) reaches the
sidelobe floor.

Beyond this angle the model holds the gain at the floor rather than
letting it fall without bound. The angle follows from setting the
attenuation `12 (theta / theta_0)^2` equal to the floor, which gives
`theta = theta_0 sqrt(floor / 12)`.

Returns `None` when the beam width or floor is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回 [`off_axis_attenuation`](crate::off_axis_attenuation) 的角平方律
到达旁瓣底限的角度。

超过该角度后，模型把增益保持在底限，而非任其无界下降。该角度由令
衰减 `12 (theta / theta_0)^2` 等于底限得出，即
`theta = theta_0 sqrt(floor / 12)`。

波束宽度或底限非正且非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: off_axis_attenuation
items.signature: pub fn off_axis_attenuation( peak: Gain, beam_width: f64, off_axis_angle: f64, floor_db: f64, ) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain of an antenna at an angle from boresight, given a peak
gain and a half power beam width.

This is the squared angle model that several interference assessments
use, expressed in terms of the half power beam width so that any antenna
can be described by the two numbers a link budget has to hand. In
decibels,

```text
G(theta) = G_peak - min(12 (theta / theta_0)^2, G_floor)
```

where `theta_0` is the half power beam width and `G_floor` is the
sidelobe level to fall to, in decibels below the peak. The squared angle
law comes from the first term of the Airy pattern of a uniformly
illuminated aperture, which is a good approximation down to the first
sidelobe.

The coefficient twelve is chosen so that the attenuation reaches three
decibels at `theta_0 / 2`, which is the definition of the half power beam
width. A pattern taken from a recommendation should be used in place of
this one where the recommendation applies: see
[`reference_pattern_gain`](crate::reference_pattern_gain) for the ITU-R
S.465 pattern, which differs from this model in the main lobe and also in
the shape of its sidelobe region.

Returns `None` when the peak gain has no decibel form, or when the beam
width or floor is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定峰值增益与半功率波束宽度时，天线在偏离视轴某角度处的增益。

这是若干干扰评估所用的角平方模型，以半功率波束宽度表达，使任何天线
都能由链路预算手头的两个数描述。以分贝计，

```text
G(theta) = G_peak - min(12 (theta / theta_0)^2, G_floor)
```

其中 `theta_0` 是半功率波束宽度，`G_floor` 是所要降到的旁瓣电平，
相对峰值以分贝计。角平方律来自均匀照射孔径 Airy 图案的首项，直到
第一旁瓣都是良好近似。

系数十二的选取使衰减在 `theta_0 / 2` 处达到三分贝，这正是半功率
波束宽度的定义。在建议书适用之处，应改用取自建议书的图案：ITU-R
S.465 图案见 [`reference_pattern_gain`](crate::reference_pattern_gain)，
它在主瓣上以及旁瓣区的形状上都与本模型不同。

峰值增益没有分贝形式，或波束宽度、底限非正且非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: mask_gain
items.signature: pub fn mask_gain(diameter_over_wavelength: f64, off_axis_angle: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain that an antenna is required not to exceed at an angle
from boresight, in decibels relative to an isotropic radiator.

This is the reference pattern of the Radio Regulations Appendix 8, used
to check whether an Earth station meets the off-axis emission limits that
protect neighbouring satellites. The pattern is piecewise:

```text
for  D/lambda >= 100:
  G = 29 - 25 log10(theta)            for 1   <= theta < 36 degrees
  G = -10                             for 36  <= theta <= 180 degrees
for  D/lambda <  100:
  G = 32 - 25 log10(theta)            for 1   <= theta < 48 degrees
  G = -10                             for 48  <= theta <= 180 degrees
  G = 32 - 25 log10(48)               for theta < 1 degree
```

The angle is in radians and the diameter to wavelength ratio decides
which branch applies, because a small antenna has a broader main lobe
and therefore a wider range over which the pattern must be controlled.

This function returns the limit, that is the largest gain permitted. An
antenna is compliant when its actual off-axis gain is at or below it.

Returns `None` when the angle is negative, when the ratio is not
positive, or when the angle is not finite.

Source: ITU, *Radio Regulations*, Appendix 8, which reproduces the
reference pattern of ITU-R Recommendation S.465.
items.doc_zh:
返回天线在偏离视轴某角度处不得超出的增益，相对各向同性辐射体以分贝
计。

这是《无线电规则》附录 8 的参考方向图，用于检查地球站是否满足保护
