邻近卫星的偏轴发射限值。该方向图是分段的：

```text
for  D/lambda >= 100:
  G = 29 - 25 log10(theta)            for 1   <= theta < 36 degrees
  G = -10                             for 36  <= theta <= 180 degrees
for  D/lambda <  100:
  G = 32 - 25 log10(theta)            for 1   <= theta < 48 degrees
  G = -10                             for 48  <= theta <= 180 degrees
  G = 32 - 25 log10(48)               for theta < 1 degree
```

角度以弧度计，口径与波长之比决定适用哪一支，因为小天线主瓣更宽，
故须受控的角度范围也更大。

本函数返回限值，即允许的最大增益。当实际偏轴增益不高于它时天线即
合规。

角度为负、比值为非正，或角度非有限时返回 `None`。

出处：ITU，*Radio Regulations*，附录 8，其中再现了 ITU-R 建议书
S.465 的参考方向图。

items.name: Pattern
items.doc:
The shape of an antenna pattern.

A pattern is either described by its geometry, in which case the peak
gain and beam width are derived from the aperture, or given directly as
measured or published values. The enum lets a link budget accept either.
items.doc_zh:
天线方向图的形状。

方向图或由其几何描述（此时峰值增益与波束宽度由孔径导出），或作为
实测或已发表的值直接给出。该枚举使链路预算能接受二者。

items.name: beam_width
items.signature: pub fn beam_width(self, wavelength: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the half power beam width of this pattern at the given
wavelength, in radians.
items.doc_zh: 返回本方向图在给定波长处的半功率波束宽度，单位为弧度。

items.name: ElementPattern
items.doc:
A gain pattern constructed from a peak gain and a half power beam width.

This is the form a link budget needs: the two numbers that describe the
beam, plus the model that gives the gain at any angle from boresight.
items.doc_zh:
由峰值增益与半功率波束宽度构造的增益方向图。

这是链路预算所需的形式：描述波束的两个数，加上给出偏离视轴任意角度
处增益的模型。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(peak: Gain, beam_width: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a pattern from a peak gain and a half power beam width.

The sidelobe floor is set to the value of the Radio Regulations
reference pattern, 32 decibels below the peak, which is a common
worst case for a small Earth station.
items.doc_zh:
由峰值增益与半功率波束宽度创建方向图。

旁瓣底限被设为《无线电规则》参考方向图的值，即相对峰值低
32 分贝，这是小型地球站常见的坏情形。

items.name: from_parabolic
items.signature: pub fn from_parabolic(aperture: ParabolicAperture, wavelength: f64) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Creates a pattern from a parabolic aperture at a wavelength.

Returns `None` when the aperture or wavelength is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
由某波长处的抛物面孔径创建方向图。

孔径或波长不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: with_floor
items.signature: pub const fn with_floor(mut self, floor_db: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns this pattern with a different sidelobe floor.
items.doc_zh: 返回本方向图的一个具有不同旁瓣底限的副本。

items.name: gain_at
items.signature: pub fn gain_at(self, off_axis_angle: f64) -> Option<Gain> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain at an angle from boresight.

Returns `None` when the pattern is not usable or the angle is not
finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回偏离视轴某角度处的增益。

方向图不可用或角度非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: PEAK_GAIN_OFFSET_DB
items.doc:
The peak gain offset of the reference pattern, in decibels.

The recommendation gives the peak gain as `20 log10(D / lambda) + 7.7`,
which corresponds to an aperture efficiency near 0.6. It is slightly
below what a well adjusted dish reaches, because the reference pattern
represents a typical rather than an optimal antenna.
items.doc_zh:
参考方向图的峰值增益偏移，单位为分贝。

建议书把峰值增益给出为 `20 log10(D / lambda) + 7.7`，对应约 0.6 的
孔径效率。它略低于调准良好的天线所达到者，因为参考方向图代表的是
典型天线而非最优天线。

items.name: reference_peak_gain
items.doc:
Returns the peak gain of the reference pattern, in decibels relative to an
isotropic radiator.

The expression is `20 log10(D / lambda) + 7.7`.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回参考方向图的峰值增益，相对各向同性辐射体以分贝计。

表达式为 `20 log10(D / lambda) + 7.7`。

比值非正或非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: main_lobe_break_angle
items.doc:
Returns the angle at which the main lobe meets the sidelobe region, in
degrees.

The two expressions intersect at this angle, and there is no closed form,
so the value is found by bisection. The main lobe falls as the square of
the angle while the sidelobe region falls as its logarithm, so the
difference has a single zero in the interval searched, which makes
bisection reliable.

The result lies between zero and the floor angle of the sidelobe region.
items.doc_zh:
返回主瓣与旁瓣区相接的角度，单位为度。

两个表达式在该角度处相交，且没有闭式解，故该值以二分法求得。主瓣按
角度的平方下降，而旁瓣区按其对数下降，故二者之差在所搜索区间内只有
一个零点，这使二分法可靠。

结果落在零与旁瓣区底限角之间。

items.name: reference_pattern_gain
items.signature: pub fn reference_pattern_gain(diameter_over_wavelength: f64, off_axis_angle: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain of the S.465 reference pattern at an off-axis angle.

The angle is in radians. The three regions are

```text
G = G_max - 2.5e-3 (D/lambda phi_deg)^2   for 0 <= phi < phi_break
G = head - 25 log10(phi_deg)              for phi_break <= phi < phi_floor
G = -10                                   for phi_floor <= phi <= 180
```

where `phi_break` is the angle returned by [`main_lobe_break_angle`], the
head is 29 for a large aperture and 32 for a small one, and the floor
angle is 36 or 48 degrees accordingly.

The falling sidelobe expression does not reach exactly minus ten decibels
at the floor angle, so the pattern has a step of a few hundredths of a
decibel there. This is a property of the recommendation, which defines
the regions separately, and it is reproduced here rather than smoothed
over.

Returns `None` when the ratio or the angle is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回 S.465 参考方向图在偏轴某角度处的增益。

角度以弧度计。三个区是

```text
G = G_max - 2.5e-3 (D/lambda phi_deg)^2   for 0 <= phi < phi_break
G = head - 25 log10(phi_deg)              for phi_break <= phi < phi_floor
G = -10                                   for phi_floor <= phi <= 180
```

其中 `phi_break` 是 [`main_lobe_break_angle`] 返回的角度，head 对大
孔径为 29、对小孔径为 32，底限角相应地是 36 或 48 度。

下降的旁瓣表达式在底限角处并不精确达到负十分贝，故方向图在那里有
几百分之一分贝的台阶。这是建议书的性质，它把各区分开定义；此处照实
再现而非加以平滑。

比值或角度不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: reference_pattern_decibel
items.signature: pub fn reference_pattern_decibel( diameter_over_wavelength: f64, off_axis_angle: f64, ) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain of the S.465 reference pattern as a decibel value.

Returns `None` when the ratio or the angle is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回 S.465 参考方向图的增益，以分贝值表示。

比值或角度不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: diameter_over_wavelength_from_peak_gain
items.doc:
Returns the diameter to wavelength ratio of an antenna with a given peak
gain.

This inverts the peak gain expression, which is useful when a station is
specified by its gain rather than its size.

Returns `None` when the gain is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回某峰值增益天线的口径与波长之比。

它反解峰值增益表达式，当某站以其增益而非尺寸规定时有用。

增益非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: reference_beam_width
items.doc:
Returns the half power beam width of the reference pattern main lobe, in
radians.

The main lobe falls to three decibels at
`phi = sqrt(3 / 2.5e-3) / (D / lambda)` degrees from boresight, so the
full width between the two three decibel points is twice that value.

Returns `None` when the ratio is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回参考方向图主瓣的半功率波束宽度，单位为弧度。

主瓣在距视轴 `phi = sqrt(3 / 2.5e-3) / (D / lambda)` 度处降到三分贝，故
两个三分贝点之间的全宽是该值的两倍。

比值非正或非有限时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-doppler
crates.summary_zh:
多普勒频移计算。

卫星与地面站相对运动，故到达接收机的频率不同于离开发射机的频率。本 crate
由相对速度计算该频移。

存在两种效应，它们是分开的。经典频移与距离变化率除以光速成正比，它是
多普勒跟踪器所补偿的。两个时钟之间的相对论时间膨胀是二阶改正，对轨道
速度而言小得多，它被分开提供，使调用方在应用需要时可以计入它。

此处所用的符号约定是：正的距离变化率（即两终端正在远离）产生负频移，
因而接收频率更低。这与日常观察——远离的声源听起来更低——一致。

items.name: range_rate_from_velocity
items.signature: pub fn range_rate_from_velocity(relative_position: Vec3, relative_velocity: Vec3) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the range rate between two terminals, in meters per second.

The range rate is the component of the relative velocity along the line
between the terminals. A positive value means the separation is
increasing.

The first argument is the position of the remote terminal relative to the
local one, so that its magnitude is the separation. The second is the
velocity of the remote terminal relative to the local one. Both are in
SI units.

Returns `None` when the separation is zero, because no line of sight is
defined there, or when either argument is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回两终端之间的距离变化率，单位为米每秒。

距离变化率是相对速度沿两终端连线的分量。正值表示间距在增大。

第一个参数是远端终端相对本地终端的位置，故其模即间距。第二个是远端
终端相对本地终端的速度。两者均为 SI 单位。

间距为零时返回 `None`，因为那里没有定义视线；或任一参数非有限时
返回 `None`。

items.name: classical_shift
items.signature: pub fn classical_shift(carrier_frequency: f64, range_rate: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the classical Doppler shift of a frequency for a range rate, in
hertz.

The relation is

```text
delta f = -f_0 (v_r / c)
```

where `v_r` is the range rate, positive when receding. The shift is
negative for a receding terminal, so the received frequency is lower than
the transmitted one.

The magnitude of the shift is small compared to the carrier: a range rate
of 7 km/s at 12 GHz gives about 280 kHz, which is two parts in a hundred
thousand. The caller must therefore treat the frequency as a double, and
the shifted frequency is returned separately rather than by adding a
small shift to a large number.

Returns `None` when the frequency is not positive and finite, or when the
range rate is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回某频率对应某距离变化率的经典多普勒频移，单位为赫兹。

关系为

```text
delta f = -f_0 (v_r / c)
```

其中 `v_r` 是距离变化率，远离时为正。远离的终端其频移为负，故接收
频率低于发射频率。

该频移的幅度相对载波很小：12 GHz 下 7 km/s 的距离变化率约给出
280 kHz，即十万分之二。故调用方必须把频率当作双精度处理，且移位后的
频率是单独返回，而非把一个小频移加到一个大数上。

频率非正且非有限，或距离变化率非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: relativistic_doppler_factor
items.doc:
Returns the relativistic Doppler factor for a range rate.

The factor is `sqrt((1 - beta) / (1 + beta))` with `beta = v_r / c`.
Multiplying the transmitted frequency by it gives the received frequency
to all orders in `beta`, so it is not a small correction to the classical
shift but the quantity the classical shift approximates.

Its expansion is `1 - beta + beta^2 / 2 - ...`. The first two terms are
the classical result, which is `1 - beta` to within a factor that is
itself second order, and the remaining terms are the difference between
the two treatments. For a satellite at orbital velocity, `beta` is about
`2.3e-5` and the second order term is about `2.7e-10` of the carrier, so
the two agree to a few parts in ten to the tenth.

Returns `None` when the range rate is not finite, or when its magnitude
reaches the speed of light, where the expression has no real value.
items.doc_zh:
返回某距离变化率的相对论多普勒因子。

该因子为 `sqrt((1 - beta) / (1 + beta))`，其中 `beta = v_r / c`。把
发射频率乘以它便给出对 `beta` 各阶都正确的接收频率，故它不是对经典
频移的小修正，而是经典频移所近似的量。

其展开为 `1 - beta + beta^2 / 2 - ...`。前两项是经典结果，它在本身为
二阶的因子之内即 `1 - beta`；其余项是两种处理之差。对轨道速度的
卫星，`beta` 约为 `2.3e-5`，二阶项约为载波的 `2.7e-10`，故两者相符
到十的十次方分之几。

距离变化率非有限，或其幅度达到光速（此时该式无实值）时返回 `None`。

items.name: DopplerShift
items.doc:
A Doppler shift applied to a carrier.

The type carries the carrier frequency and the range rate, so the
transmitted and received frequencies and the shift itself are all
available without ambiguity about which sign convention was used.
items.doc_zh:
施加于载波的多普勒频移。

该类型带有载波频率与距离变化率，故发射频率、接收频率以及频移本身都
可得，而不必对所用符号约定存疑。

items.name: from_range_rate
items.signature: pub fn from_range_rate(carrier_frequency: f64, range_rate: f64) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Creates a shift from a carrier frequency and a range rate.

Returns `None` when the frequency is not positive and finite, or when
the range rate is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
由载波频率与距离变化率创建频移。

频率非正且非有限，或距离变化率非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: carrier_frequency
items.doc: Returns the transmitted frequency, in hertz.
items.doc_zh: 返回发射频率，单位为赫兹。

items.name: range_rate
items.doc: Returns the range rate, in meters per second, positive when receding.
items.doc_zh: 返回距离变化率，单位为米每秒，远离时为正。

items.name: shift
items.doc:
Returns the shift, in hertz.

The value is negative when the terminals are receding.
items.doc_zh:
返回频移，单位为赫兹。

两终端远离时该值为负。

items.name: shifted_frequency
items.doc: Returns the received frequency, in hertz.
items.doc_zh: 返回接收频率，单位为赫兹。

items.name: shift_including_relativity
items.doc:
Returns the shift including the relativistic clock correction, in
hertz.

The received frequency is the carrier multiplied by the relativistic
factor, so the shift is `f_0 (factor - 1)`.

This is not the classical shift plus a small correction: the factor
already contains the first order term, and its expansion is
`1 - beta + beta^2 / 2 - ...`, whose leading term is exactly the
classical shift. The classical value is the first order
approximation to this one, and the two differ only by the second and
higher order terms, of order `beta^2`, which for a satellite is a few
parts in ten to the tenth of the carrier.

The factor is evaluated first and the carrier multiplied afterwards,
because the difference from one is tiny and would lose precision if
the shift were added to the carrier before the correction.

Returns `None` when the range rate reaches the speed of light.
items.doc_zh:
返回含相对论钟改正的频移，单位为赫兹。

接收频率是载波乘以相对论因子，故频移为 `f_0 (factor - 1)`。

这不是经典频移加一个小修正：该因子已含一阶项，其展开为
`1 - beta + beta^2 / 2 - ...`，其首项恰是经典频移。经典值是对它的
一阶近似，两者只差二阶及更高阶项，量级为 `beta^2`，对卫星而言是
载波的十的十次方分之几。

先求因子、后乘载波，因为它与一之差极小，若在改正之前把频移加到
载波上会损失精度。

距离变化率达到光速时返回 `None`。

items.name: shift_in_ppm
items.doc:
Returns the shift in parts per million of the carrier.

This is a convenient way to compare the shift of links on different
carriers.
items.doc_zh:
返回频移，以载波的百万分率计。

这是比较位于不同载波上的链路频移的便利方式。

items.name: shift_rate
items.signature: pub fn shift_rate(self, range_acceleration: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the rate of change of the shift, in hertz per second.

This is what a Doppler tracker must follow, and it follows from the
range acceleration.

Returns `None` when the acceleration is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回频移的变化率，单位为赫兹每秒。

这是多普勒跟踪器必须跟随的量，它由距离加速度得出。

加速度非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: is_receding
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the shift is a redshift, meaning the terminals
are receding and the received frequency is lower.
items.doc_zh: 当该频移是红移（即两终端远离、接收频率更低）时返回 `true`。

items.name: angle_from_range_rate
items.signature: pub fn angle_from_range_rate(velocity: Vec3, range_rate: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the angle between the line of sight and the velocity, in radians.

This is the complement of the usual elevation angle within the plane
containing both, and it is useful when the range rate is known and the
velocity from the orbit is known: the angle follows from the ratio of the
two.

The result lies in `[0, pi]`.

Returns `None` when the velocity has zero length or either argument is
not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回视线与速度之间的夹角，单位为弧度。

它是二者所在平面内通常仰角的余角，当已知距离变化率且已知来自轨道的
速度时有用：该角由二者之比得出。

结果落在 `[0, pi]` 内。

速度为零长或任一参数非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: maximum_shift
items.signature: pub fn maximum_shift(carrier_frequency: f64, speed: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the largest possible shift magnitude for a carrier and a speed,
in hertz.

This is the shift when the motion is entirely along the line of sight,
which is the width of the acquisition range a receiver must cover. It is
half the total span between the approach and the recession extremes.

The result is returned as a positive magnitude. Returns `None` when the
carrier or speed is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回某载波与某速度下可能的最大频移幅度，单位为赫兹。

这是运动完全沿视线时的频移，即接收机必须覆盖的捕获范围宽度。它是在
接近与远离两个极端之间的总跨度的一半。

结果以正幅度返回。载波或速度非正且非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: acquisition_span
items.signature: pub fn acquisition_span(carrier_frequency: f64, speed: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the total span of frequencies a receiver must accept to cover
every range rate up to the given speed.

Approach and recession give shifts of opposite sign, so the span is twice
the maximum shift.

Returns `None` when the carrier or speed is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回接收机为覆盖直到给定速度的每个距离变化率所必须接受的总频率跨度。

接近与远离给出符号相反的频移，故该跨度是最大频移的两倍。

载波或速度不可用时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-atmosphere
crates.summary_zh:
大气衰减与折射模型。

穿过大气的卫星信号被两种机制削弱，它们被分开处理，因为其行为随频率、
仰角与天气而异。

气体吸收来自氧与水汽的吸收谱线。氧在 50 与 70 GHz 之间有一组密集谱线，
并在 118.75 GHz 处有一条孤立线；水汽在 22.235 GHz 处有一条强线，在
183.31 GHz 处有一条强得多的线。衰减即对上述各线的逐线求和，这使它在
约 10 GHz 以下可忽略，而在各吸收带中很严重。

降雨衰减由降水中的散射与吸收造成。它在约 4 GHz 以下可忽略，随降雨率的
幂次增大，并强烈依赖仰角与极化。

二者都经相同的路径几何依赖仰角：低仰角的信号穿过更多大气。

出处：

- 气体比衰减与等效高度：ITU-R 建议书 P.676-12，*Attenuation by
  atmospheric gases*。
- 降雨比衰减系数：ITU-R 建议书 P.838-3，*Specific attenuation model for
  rain for use in prediction methods*。
- 降雨路径与仰角依赖：ITU-R 建议书 P.618-13，*Propagation data and
  prediction methods required for the design of Earth-space
  telecommunication systems*。

items.name: Atmosphere
items.doc:
The atmospheric state that the gaseous attenuation depends on.

The pressure is the dry air pressure, as the recommendation specifies. The
water vapour density is separate because the partial pressure of water
vapour is derived from it.
items.doc_zh:
气体衰减所依赖的大气状态。

气压是干空气气压，如建议书所规定。水汽密度单列，因为水汽分压由它
导出。

items.name: REFERENCE
items.doc:
The ITU-R reference atmosphere at mean sea level.

The values are the ones the recommendation uses for its reference
curves: a dry air pressure of 1013.25 hPa, a water vapour density of
7.5 g/m^3, and a temperature of 288.15 K.
items.doc_zh:
平均海平面处的 ITU-R 参考大气。

各值即该建议书用于其参考曲线者：干空气气压 1013.25 hPa，水汽
密度 7.5 g/m^3，温度 288.15 K。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(pressure_hpa: f64, water_vapour_density: f64, temperature_k: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an atmosphere from its three parameters.
items.doc_zh: 由其三个参数创建大气。

items.name: water_vapour_partial_pressure
items.doc:
Returns the partial pressure of water vapour, in hectopascals.

The relation is `e = rho T / 216.7`, which follows from the ideal gas
law with the molar masses of water and dry air.
items.doc_zh:
返回水汽分压，以百帕计。

关系为 `e = rho T / 216.7`，它由理想气体定律连同水与干空气的摩尔
质量得出。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the state describes a physical atmosphere.
items.doc_zh: 当该状态描述一个物理大气时返回 `true`。

items.name: specific_attenuation_dry_air
items.signature: pub fn specific_attenuation_dry_air(frequency_ghz: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the specific attenuation of dry air, in decibels per kilometer.

This is the oxygen contribution, computed by the line-by-line sum of
equation 1 of ITU-R P.676-12, plus the non-resonant Debye term that
accounts for the far wings of all the lines together.

The frequency is in gigahertz.

Returns `None` when the frequency or atmosphere is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回干空气的比衰减，单位为分贝每千米。

这是氧的贡献，由 ITU-R P.676-12 式 1 的逐线求和计算，加上计入所有谱线远翼
合在一起的非共振 Debye 项。

频率单位为吉赫。

频率或大气不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: specific_attenuation_water_vapour
items.signature: pub fn specific_attenuation_water_vapour( frequency_ghz: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the specific attenuation of water vapour, in decibels per
kilometer.

This is the water vapour contribution, computed by the line-by-line sum of
equation 1 of ITU-R P.676-12.

The frequency is in gigahertz.

Returns `None` when the frequency or atmosphere is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回水汽的比衰减，单位为分贝每千米。

这是水汽的贡献，由 ITU-R P.676-12 式 1 的逐线求和计算。

频率单位为吉赫。

频率或大气不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: specific_attenuation
items.signature: pub fn specific_attenuation(frequency_ghz: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the total specific attenuation of the atmosphere, in decibels per
kilometer.

This is the sum of the dry air and water vapour contributions.

Returns `None` when the frequency or atmosphere is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回大气的总比衰减，单位为分贝每千米。

这是干空气与水汽贡献之和。

频率或大气不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: EquivalentHeights
items.doc: The equivalent height of dry air and of water vapour, in kilometers.
items.doc_zh: 干空气与水汽的等效高度，单位为千米。

items.name: equivalent_heights
items.signature: pub fn equivalent_heights(frequency_ghz: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere) -> Option<EquivalentHeights> {
items.doc:
Returns the equivalent heights of dry air and water vapour.

The heights are the lengths that, multiplied by the surface specific
attenuation, give the zenith attenuation. The dry air height is limited
to a pressure dependent bound below 70 GHz, where the oxygen complex is
narrow enough that the height would otherwise be overestimated.

The frequency is in gigahertz.
items.doc_zh:
频率单位为吉赫。

Returns `None` when the frequency or atmosphere is not usable.

返回干空气与水汽的等效高度。

各高度是这样的长度：乘以地表比衰减即给出天顶衰减。干空气高度在 70 GHz
以下被限制到一个依赖气压的界，那里氧复合体足够窄，否则该高度会被高估。

频率单位为吉赫。

频率或大气不可用时返回 `None`。

出处：ITU-R 建议书 P.676-12，式 30 至式 38。

items.name: zenith_attenuation
items.signature: pub fn zenith_attenuation(frequency_ghz: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the zenith attenuation of the atmosphere, in decibels.

This is the specific attenuation at the surface multiplied by the
equivalent height, summed over the two constituents.

The frequency is in gigahertz.
items.doc_zh:
频率单位为吉赫。

Returns `None` when the frequency or atmosphere is not usable.

返回大气的天顶衰减，单位为分贝。

这是地表比衰减乘以等效高度，并对两个成分求和。

频率单位为吉赫。

频率或大气不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: slant_path_attenuation
items.signature: pub fn slant_path_attenuation( frequency_ghz: f64, elevation: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the attenuation along a slant path at an elevation angle, in
decibels.

The zenith attenuation is divided by the sine of the elevation. The
plane parallel approximation this uses is the one the recommendation
applies for the approximate method; it is accurate above about five
degrees of elevation.

The elevation is in radians.

Returns `None` when the frequency or atmosphere is not usable, or when
the elevation is at or below the horizon.
items.doc_zh:
返回某仰角下沿斜路径的衰减，单位为分贝。

天顶衰减除以仰角的正弦。其使用的平面平行近似即建议书用于近似方法
者；在约五度仰角以上是准确的。

仰角以弧度计。

频率或大气不可用，或仰角在地平及其以下时返回 `None`。

items.name: slant_path_attenuation_exact
items.signature: pub fn slant_path_attenuation_exact( frequency_ghz: f64, elevation: f64, atmosphere: Atmosphere, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the attenuation along a slant path by the exact method of
Recommendation P.676.

The exact method divides the atmosphere into a stack of layers whose
thickness grows exponentially with height, evaluates the specific
attenuation in each, and sums the contribution of each layer weighted by
the ray path length through it. Because the ray is refracted, the path
length is found by ray tracing with Snell's law applied to the ratio of
the refractive indices of adjacent layers, which the approximate method
ignores.

This is the form to use at low elevation, where the plane parallel
approximation that [`slant_path_attenuation`] uses is inaccurate. It is
far more expensive, so the approximate form remains available for the
high elevation case where it is adequate.

The frequency is in gigahertz, the elevation in radians, and the surface
atmosphere supplies the pressure, the water vapour density, and the
temperature at ground level. The surface water vapour density scales the
exponential vapour profile, so the atmosphere defines the whole stack.

Returns `None` when the frequency, elevation, or atmosphere is not
usable.

Source: ITU-R Recommendation P.676-12, equations 13 through 19, with the
layered atmosphere of ITU-R Recommendation P.835-6.
items.doc_zh:
以建议书 P.676 的精确方法返回沿斜路径的衰减。

精确方法把大气分成厚度随高度指数增长的一叠层，计算每层的比衰减，
并按射线穿过该层的路径长度对每层的贡献加权求和。由于射线发生折射，
路径长度以射线追踪求得，其中对相邻层折射率之比施加 Snell 定律，而
近似方法忽略这一点。

这是低仰角下宜用的形式，此时 [`slant_path_attenuation`] 所用的平面
平行近似不准确。它的代价高得多，故近似形式仍可供其足够胜任的高仰角
情形使用。

频率以吉赫兹计，仰角以弧度计，地表大气提供地面处的气压、水汽密度与
温度。地表水汽密度缩放指数水汽廓线，故该大气界定了整叠层。

频率、仰角或大气不可用时返回 `None`。

出处：ITU-R 建议书 P.676-12，式 13 至式 19，分层大气取自 ITU-R
建议书 P.835-6。

items.name: elevation_from_zenith
items.doc:
Returns the elevation angle for a zenith angle.

The elevation is measured from the horizon and the zenith angle from the
vertical, so the two add to a right angle.
items.doc_zh:
返回某天顶角对应的仰角。

仰角自地平量起，天顶角自垂线量起，故两者相加为直角。

items.name: zenith_to_elevation
items.doc: Returns the zenith angle for an elevation angle.
items.doc_zh: 返回某仰角对应的天顶角。

items.name: air_mass
items.doc:
Returns the air mass along a slant path at the given elevation angle.

The air mass is the ratio of the path length through a flat atmosphere to
the vertical path length. For a plane parallel atmosphere it is the
cosecant of the elevation,

```text
m = 1 / sin(elevation)
```

so the value is one at the zenith and grows without bound at the horizon.
The plane parallel assumption fails below about ten degrees elevation,
where the curvature of the Earth shortens the path compared with this
expression and the true air mass is smaller.

The value is not clamped at low elevation. A caller that needs a finite
bound near the horizon should impose one; this function reports the plane
parallel geometry it models.

Returns infinity at or below the horizon, where no direct path exists.
items.doc_zh:
返回给定仰角下沿斜路径的大气质量。

大气质量是穿过平坦大气的路径长度与垂直路径长度之比。对平面平行
大气它是仰角的余割，

```text
m = 1 / sin(elevation)
```

故在天顶处为一，在地平处无界增长。平面平行假定在约十度仰角以下
失效，那里地球曲率使路径比该式更短，真实大气质量更小。

该值在低仰角处不被截断。需要在地平附近取有限上界的调用方应自行
施加；本函数报告它所建模的平面平行几何。

在地平及其以下不存在直接路径，返回无穷。

items.name: geopotential_height
items.doc:
Returns the geopotential height for a geometric height, in kilometers.

The relation is

```text
h_p = R H / (R + H)
```

with `R` the fixed Earth radius of the standard atmosphere and `H` the
geometric height. The geopotential height is always the smaller of the
two.
items.doc_zh:
返回某几何高度对应的势高，单位为千米。

关系为

```text
h_p = R H / (R + H)
```

其中 `R` 是标准大气固定的地球半径，`H` 是几何高度。势高总是两者中较
小者。

items.name: standard_temperature
items.doc:
Returns the temperature of the reference atmosphere, in kelvin.

The profile is piecewise linear in geopotential height up to 84.852 km
and is then defined by two further segments that extend to 100 km. Above
100 km the recommendation does not define a global profile and this
function returns the value at 100 km.

The geometric height is in kilometers.
items.doc_zh:
返回参考大气的温度，单位为开尔文。

该廓线在势高度 84.852 km 以下分段线性，其后由延伸至 100 km 的两段定义。
100 km 以上该建议书不定义全球廓线，本函数返回 100 km 处的值。

几何高度单位为千米。

items.name: standard_pressure
items.doc:
Returns the pressure of the reference atmosphere, in hectopascals.

The profile is piecewise, continuous at the segment boundaries, and
follows from the hydrostatic relation applied to each temperature
segment.

The geometric height is in kilometers.
items.doc_zh:
返回参考大气的气压，单位为百帕。

该廓线是分段的，在各分段边界处连续，由静力关系施加于每个温度分段得出。

几何高度单位为千米。

items.name: standard_water_vapour_density
items.signature: pub fn standard_water_vapour_density(geometric_height_km: f64, surface_density: f64) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the water vapour density of the reference atmosphere, in grams
per cubic meter.

The profile is exponential with a scale height of two kilometers, scaled
so that the density at the surface is the value given.

The geometric height is in kilometers.
items.doc_zh:
返回参考大气的水汽密度，单位为克每立方米。

该廓线是指数式的，标高两千米，并缩放使地表的密度为所给值。

几何高度单位为千米。

items.name: radio_refractive_index
items.signature: pub fn radio_refractive_index( dry_pressure_hpa: f64, vapour_pressure_hpa: f64, temperature_k: f64, ) -> f64 {
items.doc:
Returns the radio refractive index of moist air, dimensionless.

The relation is

```text
N = 77.6 P_d / T + 72 e / T + 3.75e5 e / T^2
n = 1 + N 1e-6
```

with `P_d` the dry air pressure and `e` the water vapour partial
pressure, both in hectopascals, and `T` the temperature in kelvin. The
first two terms are the non-dispersive refractivity and the third is the
dipole term that gives water vapour its strong effect.

Source: ITU-R Recommendation P.453, which gives this expression for the
refractive index of moist air.
items.doc_zh:
返回湿空气的无线电折射率，无量纲。

关系为

```text
N = 77.6 P_d / T + 72 e / T + 3.75e5 e / T^2
n = 1 + N 1e-6
```

其中 `P_d` 是干空气气压，`e` 是水汽分压，两者均以百帕计；`T` 是
温度，以开尔文计。前两项是非色散折射率，第三项是使水汽产生强烈效应
的偶极项。

出处：ITU-R 建议书 P.453，它给出湿空气折射率的这一表达式。

items.name: RAIN_HEIGHT_OFFSET_KM
items.doc:
The offset added to the isotherm height to obtain the rain height, in
kilometers.

The recommendation states that the rain height is the isotherm height
plus 0.36 km, which represents the depth of the melting layer below the
isotherm.
items.doc_zh:
加到等温线高度上以获得雨顶高度的偏移，单位为千米。

建议书指出雨顶高度是等温线高度加 0.36 km，它代表等温线以下融化层的
深度。

items.name: zero_isotherm_height
items.signature: pub fn zero_isotherm_height(latitude: f64, longitude: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the height of the zero degree isotherm at a location, in
kilometers above mean sea level.

The latitude is in degrees, positive north, and the longitude in degrees,
positive east. The value is interpolated bilinearly from the tabulated
grid, and longitudes are reduced into `[0, 360)` first so that any
convention is accepted.

Returns `None` when either coordinate is not finite, or when the latitude
is outside the range of the grid.

Source: ITU-R Recommendation P.839-4, equation 1 and the tabulated
isotherm height.
items.doc_zh:
返回某位置零度等温线的高度，以平均海平面以上千米计。

纬度以度计、北正；经度以度计、东正。该值由列表网格双线性插值得到，
经度先归约到 `[0, 360)`，故任何约定都被接受。

任一坐标非有限，或纬度超出网格范围时返回 `None`。

出处：ITU-R 建议书 P.839-4，式 1 及所列等温线高度。

items.name: rain_height
items.signature: pub fn rain_height(latitude: f64, longitude: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the rain height at a location, in kilometers above mean sea level.

This is the zero degree isotherm height plus
[`RAIN_HEIGHT_OFFSET_KM`], as the recommendation defines it.

Returns `None` when the coordinates are not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回某位置的雨顶高度，以平均海平面以上千米计。

它是零度等温线高度加 [`RAIN_HEIGHT_OFFSET_KM`]，如建议书所定义。

坐标不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: grid_step_degrees
items.doc: Returns the grid resolution of the tabulated isotherm height, in degrees.
items.doc_zh: 返回列表等温线高度的网格分辨率，单位为度。

items.name: DEFAULT_RAIN_HEIGHT_KM
items.doc:
A mid latitude rain height, in kilometers above sea level.

Recommendation P.618 takes the rain height from the zero degree isotherm
height of Recommendation P.839, which is tabulated as a function of
latitude and longitude. Prefer [`rain_attenuation_at`], which looks the
value up, over [`rain_attenuation`] with this constant.
items.doc_zh:
中纬度雨顶高度，以海拔千米计。

建议书 P.618 从建议书 P.839 的零度等温线高度取雨顶高度，后者按纬度
与经度列表给出。相较用本常量调用 [`rain_attenuation`]，更宜用会查表
的 [`rain_attenuation_at`]。

items.name: RainAttenuation
items.doc: A rain attenuation result at a given elevation.
items.doc_zh: 给定仰角下的降雨衰减结果。

items.name: attenuation
items.doc: Returns the total attenuation.
items.doc_zh: 返回总衰减。

items.name: rain_coefficients
items.signature: pub fn rain_coefficients(frequency: f64, polarisation: f64, elevation: f64) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
items.doc:
Returns the P.838-3 coefficients of the specific attenuation power law.

The polarisation is an angle in radians between the electric field and
the horizontal, so zero is horizontal and a right angle is vertical. The
elevation is in radians.

The result is a pair of the coefficient `k` and the exponent `alpha` of
the relation `gamma = k R^alpha`, with the rain rate in millimeters per
hour and the result in decibels per kilometer.

Returns `None` when the frequency, polarisation, or elevation is not
usable. The recommendation is stated for frequencies from 1 GHz to
1000 GHz.

Source: ITU-R Recommendation P.838-3, equations 2 and 3.
items.doc_zh:
返回比衰减幂律的 P.838-3 系数。

极化是电场与水平方向之间以弧度计的角度，故零为水平、直角为垂直。
仰角以弧度计。

结果是关系 `gamma = k R^alpha` 中系数 `k` 与指数 `alpha` 的一对值，
其中降雨率以毫米每小时计，结果以分贝每千米计。

频率、极化或仰角不可用时返回 `None`。该建议书针对 1 GHz 至 1000 GHz
的频率陈述。

出处：ITU-R 建议书 P.838-3，式 2 与式 3。

items.name: specific_rain_attenuation
items.signature: pub fn specific_rain_attenuation( rain_rate: f64, frequency: f64, polarisation: f64, elevation: f64, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the specific attenuation in rain, in decibels per kilometer.

The rain rate is in millimeters per hour.

Returns `None` when the rain rate is negative, or when the coefficients
are not available.
items.doc_zh:
返回雨中的比衰减，单位为分贝每千米。

降雨率以毫米每小时计。

降雨率为负，或系数不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: rain_attenuation
items.signature: pub fn rain_attenuation( rain_rate: f64, frequency: f64, polarisation: f64, elevation: f64, station_height_km: f64, rain_height_km: f64, latitude: f64, ) -> Option<RainAttenuation> {
items.doc:
Returns the total rain attenuation along a slant path.

The rain rate is the value exceeded for the percentage of time of
interest, in millimeters per hour. The station height above sea level and
the rain layer height are in kilometers; pass [`DEFAULT_RAIN_HEIGHT_KM`]
for the latter when no local value is available.

The method is the one of Recommendation P.618. The slant path length
follows from the rain height, the station height, and the elevation, with
a correction for the curvature of the Earth. Two reduction factors then
account for the non-uniformity of the rain: a horizontal factor that
depends on the specific attenuation, the frequency, and the horizontal
projection of the path, and a vertical factor that depends on the
latitude through the angle at which the path crosses the rain layer.

Returns `None` when the rain rate, frequency, or elevation is not usable,
when the station is above the rain layer, or when the elevation is at or
below the horizon.

Source: ITU-R Recommendation P.618-13, equations 1 through 10.
items.doc_zh:
返回沿斜路径的总降雨衰减。

降雨率是在所关注时间百分比上被超过的值，以毫米每小时计。站的海拔
高度与雨层高度以千米计；没有本地值时，后者传
[`DEFAULT_RAIN_HEIGHT_KM`]。

方法即建议书 P.618 所述。斜路径长度由雨顶高度、站高与仰角得出，
并作地球曲率修正。随后两个缩减因子计入降雨的不均匀性：一个水平
因子，取决于比衰减、频率以及路径的水平投影；一个垂直因子，通过
路径穿越雨层的角度取决于纬度。

降雨率、频率或仰角不可用，站高于雨层，或仰角在地平及其以下时返回
`None`。

出处：ITU-R 建议书 P.618-13，式 1 至式 10。

items.name: polarisation_tilt
items.doc:
Returns the angle in radians for a polarisation described by a tilt from
horizontal.

This is a convenience for the two cases that are quoted by name.
items.doc_zh:
返回以相对水平倾角描述的极化所对应的弧度角。

这是为两种常被具名引用的情形提供的便利。

items.name: rain_attenuation_at
items.signature: pub fn rain_attenuation_at( rain_rate: f64, frequency: f64, polarisation: f64, elevation: f64, station_height_km: f64, latitude: f64, longitude: f64, ) -> Option<RainAttenuation> {
items.doc:
Returns the total rain attenuation along a slant path, taking the rain
height from the Recommendation P.839 model.

This is the same calculation as [`rain_attenuation`], with the rain layer
height looked up from the tabulated zero degree isotherm height at the
given latitude and longitude rather than supplied by the caller. It is
the form to use unless a locally measured isotherm height is available.

The station height must be given; pass zero for a station at sea level.

Returns `None` when the coordinates are not usable, or when any of the
other arguments is rejected by [`rain_attenuation`].

Source: the rain height is from ITU-R Recommendation P.839-4 and the path
method from ITU-R Recommendation P.618-13.
items.doc_zh:
返回沿斜路径的总降雨衰减，雨顶高度取自建议书 P.839 模型。

这与 [`rain_attenuation`] 是同一计算，只是雨层高度由给定纬经度处列表
给出的零度等温线高度查得，而非由调用方提供。除非有本地实测的等温线
高度，否则宜用此形式。

站高必须给出；海拔为零的站传零。

坐标不可用，或其他任何参数被 [`rain_attenuation`] 拒绝时返回 `None`。

出处：雨顶高度来自 ITU-R 建议书 P.839-4，路径方法来自 ITU-R 建议书
P.618-13。

crates.name: apsis-noise
crates.summary:
Noise temperature and noise figure models.

Noise enters a receiver from three places: the source, the antenna and
its feed, and the receiver itself. They are combined by adding noise
temperatures rather than powers, because a temperature is a power
referred to a fixed bandwidth through the Boltzmann relation, and a
cascade of stages at different gains does not simply add powers.

The central relations are:

- Thermal noise power in a bandwidth, `P = k T B`, with `k` the Boltzmann
  constant.
- Noise figure as a temperature, `T = T_0 (F - 1)`, with `T_0` the
  reference temperature of 290 K.
- The Friis cascade, which weights each stage's noise by the gain that
  precedes it.

Sources:

- The reference temperature of 290 K and the noise figure definition are
  from the IEEE standard definition of noise figure, IEEE Std 161.
- The cascade is the Friis formula for noise, as given in any receiver
  design text.

```
use apsis_noise::{NoiseTemperature, thermal_noise_power};

// A 36 MHz bandwidth at 290 K carries about -128 dBW of thermal noise.
let temperature = NoiseTemperature::from_kelvin(290.0);
let power = thermal_noise_power(temperature, 36.0e6).expect("valid arguments");
assert!((power.dbw().expect("positive") + 128.0).abs() < 1.0);
```
crates.summary_zh:
噪声温度与噪声系数模型。

噪声从三处进入接收机：源、天线及其馈源，以及接收机自身。它们通过相加噪声
温度而非功率来合并，因为温度是经玻尔兹曼关系折算到固定带宽的功率，而不同
增益各级的级联并不能简单地把功率相加。

核心关系是：

- 某带宽内的热噪声功率 `P = k T B`，其中 `k` 是玻尔兹曼常量。
- 噪声系数作为温度 `T = T_0 (F - 1)`，其中 `T_0` 是 290 K 的参考温度。
- Friis 级联，它按本级之前的增益对每级的噪声加权。

出处：

- 290 K 的参考温度与噪声系数定义来自 IEEE 噪声系数标准定义，IEEE Std
  161。
- 级联即噪声的 Friis 公式，见任何接收机设计教材。

items.name: Stage
items.doc:
One stage of a receiver chain.

A stage is described by the noise it adds, referred to its own input, and
the gain it applies. The noise may be given as a temperature or as a
noise figure; both are converted to a temperature before the cascade is
evaluated, because temperatures add across the chain while decibel
figures do not.
items.doc_zh:
接收链的一级。

一级由其折算到自身输入所加的噪声与其所施加的增益描述。噪声可以温度或
噪声系数给出；两者都在评估级联之前换算为温度，因为温度在链中相加而
分贝系数不然。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(temperature: NoiseTemperature, gain: Gain) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a stage from a noise temperature and a gain.
items.doc_zh: 由噪声温度与增益创建一级。

items.name: from_noise_figure
items.signature: pub fn from_noise_figure(noise_figure_db: f64, gain_dbi: f64) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Creates a stage from a noise figure in decibels and a gain in
decibels.

Returns `None` when either value is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
由以分贝表示的噪声系数与以分贝表示的增益创建一级。

任一值非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: ideal
items.signature: pub const fn ideal(gain: Gain) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a noiseless stage with the given gain.

An ideal amplifier adds no noise, so it contributes nothing to the
cascade except its gain.
items.doc_zh:
以给定增益创建无噪声的一级。

理想放大器不加噪声，故除其增益外它对级联别无贡献。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the stage is usable.
items.doc_zh: 当该级可用时返回 `true`。

items.name: cascade_temperature
items.doc:
Returns the noise temperature of a cascade of stages, referred to the
input of the first stage.

The Friis formula weights each stage's contribution by the gain that
precedes it:

```text
T = T_1 + T_2 / G_1 + T_3 / (G_1 G_2) + ...
```

The consequence is that the first stage dominates: a noisy second stage
matters much less when the first stage has gain. The total temperature is
that of the chain, so it can be compared directly with the available
gain to find the noise figure of the chain.

Returns `None` when any stage is not usable, which includes a gain ratio
that is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回各级级联的噪声温度，折算到第一级的输入。

Friis 公式按本级之前的增益对每级的贡献加权：

```text
T = T_1 + T_2 / G_1 + T_3 / (G_1 G_2) + ...
```

其结果是第一级占主导：当第一级有增益时，噪声大的第二级影响小得多。
总温度即整链的温度，故可直接与可用增益比较以求得整链的噪声系数。

任一级不可用（包括增益比非正）时返回 `None`。

items.name: noise_figure_to_temperature
items.doc:
Returns the noise temperature that corresponds to a noise figure in
decibels, using the standard reference temperature.

This is a free function form of
[`NoiseTemperature::from_noise_figure_db`](crate::NoiseTemperature::from_noise_figure_db).

Returns `None` when the figure is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
使用标准参考温度，返回与某分贝噪声系数对应的噪声温度。

这是
[`NoiseTemperature::from_noise_figure_db`](crate::NoiseTemperature::from_noise_figure_db)
的自由函数形式。

该系数非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: cascade_noise_figure_db
items.doc:
Returns the noise figure of a cascade, in decibels.

The cascade is evaluated as a temperature and then converted to a figure
using the standard reference temperature. This is the form in which a
receiver chain is usually specified.

Returns `None` when any stage is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回级联的噪声系数，以分贝计。

级联先按温度求值，再用标准参考温度换算为系数。这是接收链通常规定的
形式。

任一级不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: reference_temperature
items.doc: Returns the reference temperature used by the noise figure definition.
items.doc_zh: 返回噪声系数定义所用的参考温度。

items.name: REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE_K
items.doc:
The reference temperature used to define the noise figure, in kelvin.

The value is 290 K, which is the standard reference temperature of the
IEEE definition of noise figure. It is a convention rather than a
physical temperature, and the choice affects the noise figure quoted for
a given noise temperature.
items.doc_zh:
用于定义噪声系数的参考温度，单位为开尔文。

该值为 290 K，即 IEEE 噪声系数定义的标准参考温度。它是约定而非物理
温度，这一选择会影响给定噪声温度所对应的噪声系数。

items.name: NoiseTemperature
items.doc:
A noise temperature in kelvin.

A noise temperature is the temperature of a resistor that would deliver
the same noise power in the same bandwidth. It is a convenient way to
express any noise source, including one that is not thermal in origin,
because temperatures add across a cascade while powers do not.
items.doc_zh:
以开尔文表示的噪声温度。

噪声温度是在同一带宽内会给出相同噪声功率的电阻的温度。它是表达任何
噪声源（包括非热起源者）的便利方式，因为温度在级联中相加而功率
不然。

items.name: REFERENCE
items.doc: The standard reference temperature of 290 K.
items.doc_zh: 290 K 的标准参考温度。

items.name: from_kelvin
items.signature: pub const fn from_kelvin(kelvin: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a noise temperature from a value in kelvin.
items.doc_zh: 由以开尔文表示的值创建噪声温度。

items.name: from_noise_figure_db
items.doc:
Creates a noise temperature from a noise figure in decibels.

The relation is `T = T_0 (F - 1)` with `F` the linear noise factor,
so a noise figure of zero decibels gives a temperature of zero.

Returns `None` when the figure is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
由以分贝表示的噪声系数创建噪声温度。

关系为 `T = T_0 (F - 1)`，其中 `F` 是线性噪声因子，故零分贝的
噪声系数给出零温度。

该系数非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: from_noise_factor
items.doc:
Creates a noise temperature from a linear noise factor.

Returns `None` when the factor is not finite or is below one, which
would describe a stage that removes noise.
items.doc_zh:
由线性噪声因子创建噪声温度。

该因子非有限或小于一时返回 `None`，那将描述一个去除噪声的级。

items.name: kelvin
items.doc: Returns this temperature in kelvin.
items.doc_zh: 返回该温度的开尔文值。

items.name: noise_factor
items.doc:
Returns this temperature as a linear noise factor.

The factor is `T / T_0 + 1`, which is one for zero noise.
items.doc_zh:
返回该温度的线性噪声因子。

该因子为 `T / T_0 + 1`，零噪声时为一。

items.name: noise_figure_db
items.doc:
Returns this temperature as a noise figure in decibels.

Returns `None` when the temperature is not finite or is negative,
which would give a factor below one.
items.doc_zh:
返回该温度的噪声系数，以分贝计。

温度非有限或为负（会给出小于一的因子）时返回 `None`。

items.name: plus
items.signature: pub const fn plus(self, other: Self) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns the sum of two temperatures.

Noise temperatures of independent sources add, which is the reason
the quantity is useful.
items.doc_zh:
返回两个温度之和。

独立源的噪声温度相加，这正是该量有用的原因。

items.name: scaled
items.signature: pub const fn scaled(self, factor: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns this temperature scaled by a gain ratio.

A source followed by a gain contributes its temperature divided by
that gain when referred to the input, so the scaling for a
contribution referred to the input is the reciprocal.
items.doc_zh:
返回该温度按某增益比缩放后的值。

某源之后接一增益时，折算到输入其贡献为该温度除以该增益，故折算到
输入的贡献其缩放取倒数。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the temperature is finite and not negative.
items.doc_zh: 当该温度有限且非负时返回 `true`。

items.name: thermal_noise_power
items.signature: pub fn thermal_noise_power(temperature: NoiseTemperature, bandwidth: f64) -> Option<Power> {
items.doc:
Returns the thermal noise power in a bandwidth at a noise temperature.

The relation is `P = k T B`, with `k` the Boltzmann constant. This is the
power that a matched resistor at the given temperature would deliver to a
load over the stated bandwidth.

The bandwidth must be positive. Returns `None` for an invalid
temperature or bandwidth.
items.doc_zh:
返回某噪声温度下某带宽内的热噪声功率。

关系为 `P = k T B`，其中 `k` 是玻尔兹曼常量。这是给定温度下的匹配
电阻在所给带宽内向负载输送的功率。

带宽必须为正。温度或带宽无效时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-interference
crates.summary_zh:
干扰与载干比计算。

有用信号很少独自到达。本 crate 把有用载波与一个或多个干扰载波以及噪声
合并，并报告决定该有用链路是否可用的各比值。

此处计算的数字是：

- 载干比，对一个或若干干扰源。
- 载波与噪声加干扰之比，这是接收机实际所见，因为它无法把二者分开。
- 某干扰源的等效噪声温度，它使干扰贡献可以像噪声一样折算进链路预算。

来自共享同一频率的第二颗卫星的干扰，由自地面站看两颗卫星之间的角描述。
接收天线在该方向上有旁瓣响应，而干扰源功率与有用功率之比由两个增益与
两个路径损耗得出。本 crate 把两个增益作为输入，故它与 `apsis-antenna`
中的方向图模型可组合。

出处：载干比与载波噪声加干扰比的定义，以及把干扰表达为等效噪声温度的
做法，都是卫星链路设计中的标准内容，例如见于 ITU-R Handbook on Satellite
Communications。

items.name: Interferer
items.doc:
One interfering carrier seen at the receiver input.

The power is the interfering power that reaches the receiver, already
including the transmit power, the transmit gain, the path loss, the
receive antenna gain in the direction of the interferer, and any
propagation loss. This crate combines the powers; it does not compute the
geometry.
items.doc_zh:
在接收机输入端看到的一个干扰载波。

功率是到达接收机的干扰功率，其中已含发射功率、发射增益、路径损耗、
干扰源方向上的接收天线增益，以及任何传播损耗。本 crate 只合并功率；
它不计算几何。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(power: Power) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an interferer from a power at the receiver input.
items.doc_zh: 由接收机输入端的功率创建干扰源。

items.name: InterferenceSummary
items.doc: The combined result of a wanted carrier and its interference.
items.doc_zh: 有用载波与其干扰合并所得的结果。

items.name: interference_to_carrier
items.doc:
Returns the interference to carrier ratio.

This is the reciprocal of the carrier to interference ratio and is
the form some specifications use.
items.doc_zh:
返回干扰与载波之比。

它是载干比的倒数，是某些规范所用的形式。

items.name: total_interference
items.doc:
Returns the total interfering power from a set of interferers.

Interfering powers add, because they are independent signals and their
power is what matters, not their amplitudes. Two equal interferers
therefore give twice the power of one, which is three decibels and not
six.

Returns `None` when any interferer has an invalid power.
items.doc_zh:
返回一组干扰源的总干扰功率。

各干扰功率相加，因为它们是独立信号，要紧的是其功率而非幅度。故两个
相等的干扰源给出单个的两倍功率，即三分贝而非六分贝。

任一干扰源的功率无效时返回 `None`。

items.name: carrier_to_interference
items.signature: pub fn carrier_to_interference(carrier: Power, interferers: &[Interferer]) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the carrier to interference ratio for a carrier and a set of
interferers.

The ratio is the wanted carrier power divided by the sum of the
interfering powers. A large ratio means the interferers are weak.

Returns `None` when the carrier is not positive, when any interferer is
invalid, or when the total interference is zero, which would give an
infinite ratio.
items.doc_zh:
返回某载波与一组干扰源的载干比。

该比是有用载波功率除以各干扰功率之和。比大意味着干扰源弱。

载波非正、任一干扰源无效，或总干扰为零（会给出无穷的比）时返回
`None`。

items.name: carrier_to_interference_single
items.signature: pub fn carrier_to_interference_single(carrier: Power, interferer: Interferer) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the carrier to interference ratio for a single interferer.

This is a convenience for the common case of one dominant interferer.

Returns `None` when either power is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回单个干扰源下的载干比。

这是为一个占主导的干扰源这一常见情形提供的便利。

两个功率之一非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: combine
items.signature: pub fn combine(first: Decibel, second: Decibel) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Combines a ratio with another ratio of the same kind.

When two independent impairments act together, their effects add as
reciprocal ratios, which in decibels means

```text
1 / R = 1 / R_1 + 1 / R_2
```

The result is always below the smaller of the two, so adding a second
impairment can only lower the combined ratio. This is how a carrier to
noise ratio and a carrier to interference ratio are combined into a
carrier to noise plus interference ratio.

Returns `None` when either value is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
把一个比与另一个同类之比合并。

当两种独立损伤共同作用时，它们的效果按倒数之比相加，以分贝表示即

```text
1 / R = 1 / R_1 + 1 / R_2
```

结果总低于两者中较小者，故加入第二种损伤只会降低合并之比。载噪比与
载干比正是这样合并为载波与噪声加干扰之比的。

任一值非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: carrier_to_noise_plus_interference
items.signature: pub fn carrier_to_noise_plus_interference( carrier_to_noise: Decibel, carrier_to_interference: Decibel, ) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the carrier to noise plus interference ratio.

This combines a carrier to noise ratio and a carrier to interference
ratio through [`combine`]. It is the ratio a receiver actually
experiences, because it cannot separate thermal noise from a competing
carrier.

Returns `None` when either ratio is not finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回载波与噪声加干扰之比。

它通过 [`combine`] 把载噪比与载干比合并。这是接收机实际经历的比，因为
它无法把热噪声与竞争载波分开。

任一比非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: interference_to_noise_ratio
items.signature: pub fn interference_to_noise_ratio(interference: Power, noise: Power) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the interference to noise ratio.

This compares the interfering power with the thermal noise power in the
receiver. A value well below zero decibels means the interference is
negligible against the noise and can be ignored; a value near or above
zero means it must be accounted for.

Returns `None` when either power is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回干扰与噪声之比。

它把干扰功率与接收机中的热噪声功率相比较。远低于零分贝的值意味着干扰相对
噪声可忽略、可以不计；接近或高于零的值意味着必须计入它。

两个功率之一非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: equivalent_noise_temperature
items.signature: pub fn equivalent_noise_temperature(interference: Power, bandwidth: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the noise temperature equivalent to an interfering power.

An interferer that a receiver treats as noise can be folded into the link
budget as an increase in system noise temperature. In temperature the
relation is

```text
T = P / (k B)
```

with `P` the interfering power, `k` the Boltzmann constant, and `B` the
receiver noise bandwidth. The temperature is the value that, added to the
system temperature, would raise the noise by the same amount as the
interferer.

Returns `None` when the power is not positive or the bandwidth is not
positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
返回与某干扰功率等效的噪声温度。

接收机当作噪声处理的干扰源可以折算为系统噪声温度的增量计入链路
预算。在温度上关系为

```text
T = P / (k B)
```

其中 `P` 是干扰功率，`k` 是玻尔兹曼常量，`B` 是接收机噪声带宽。该
温度即加到系统温度上会使噪声上升与干扰源相同量的值。

功率非正，或带宽非正且非有限时返回 `None`。

items.name: summarise
items.signature: pub fn summarise( carrier: Power, interferers: &[Interferer], noise: Option<Power>, ) -> Option<InterferenceSummary> {
items.doc:
Returns a summary of a carrier with its interference.

When a noise power is given, the carrier to noise plus interference ratio
is computed as well. Pass `None` for the noise power when only the
interference is of interest.

Returns `None` when the carrier is not positive, when any interferer is
invalid, or when the total interference is zero.
items.doc_zh:
返回某载波及其干扰的摘要。

当给出噪声功率时，载波与噪声加干扰之比也一并算出。当只关注干扰时，
噪声功率传 `None`。

载波非正、任一干扰源无效，或总干扰为零时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-link
crates.summary:
Link budget computation.

A link budget adds up every gain and loss between a transmitter and a
receiver and compares the resulting carrier power with the noise that
competes with it. This crate computes that sum and the figures derived
from it: the carrier to noise ratio, the energy per bit to noise density
ratio, and the link margin.

The order of operations matters, so the chain is stated explicitly:

1. The transmitter power is reduced by the transmit losses and increased
   by the transmit antenna gain, giving the equivalent isotropically
   radiated power.
2. That is divided by the free space path loss and increased by the
   receive antenna gain, giving the carrier power at the receiver input.
3. The system noise temperature is converted to a noise density by
   multiplying by the Boltzmann constant.
4. The carrier to noise density ratio is the carrier power divided by
   that density, and the carrier to noise ratio divides it further by the
   receiver bandwidth.

Sources:

- The link equation in this form is the one used throughout satellite
  communications practice, as described for example in the ITU-R
  Handbook on Satellite Communications.
- The Boltzmann constant and the speed of light come from the SI
  definitions, as re-exported by `apsis-rf`.

```
use apsis_link::{LinkBudget, LinkGeometry};
use apsis_rf::{Gain, Power};

let budget = LinkBudget {
    transmit_power: Power::from_dbw(10.0).expect("finite"),
    transmit_gain: Gain::from_dbi(30.0).expect("finite"),
    transmit_loss: apsis_rf::Decibel::from_db(1.0),
    receive_gain: Gain::from_dbi(35.0).expect("finite"),
    receive_loss: apsis_rf::Decibel::from_db(0.5),
    system_temperature: apsis_noise::NoiseTemperature::from_kelvin(150.0),
    bandwidth: 36.0e6,
    geometry: LinkGeometry {
        distance: 38_000_000.0,
        frequency: 12.0e9,
    },
};

// The carrier to noise density ratio is available directly. For this
// budget it is about 74.7 dB, which is typical of a Ku band downlink.
let ratio = budget.carrier_to_noise_density().expect("valid budget");
assert!(ratio.db() > 70.0);
assert!(ratio.db() < 80.0);
```
crates.summary_zh:
链路预算计算。

链路预算把发射机与接收机之间的每项增益与损耗相加，并把所得载波功率与同
它竞争的噪声比较。本 crate 计算该和以及由它导出的各数字：载噪比、每比特
能量与噪声密度之比，以及链路余量。

运算次序要紧，故该链被明确写出：

1. 发射机功率减去发射损耗、加上发射天线增益，给出等效全向辐射功率。
2. 它除以自由空间路径损耗、加上接收天线增益，给出接收机输入端的载波
   功率。
3. 系统噪声温度乘以玻尔兹曼常量，换算为噪声密度。
4. 载噪密度比是载波功率除以该密度，载噪比则进一步除以接收机带宽。

出处：

- 此形式的链路方程是卫星通信实践中通篇所用的，例如见 ITU-R Handbook on
  Satellite Communications。
- 玻尔兹曼常量与光速来自 SI 定义，由 `apsis-rf` 重导出。

items.name: LinkGeometry
items.doc:
The geometric part of a link: how far apart the terminals are and at what
frequency they operate.
items.doc_zh: 链路的几何部分：两端相距多远，以及在什么频率上工作。

items.name: path_loss
items.doc:
Returns the free space path loss for this geometry.

Returns `None` when the distance or frequency is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回该几何的自由空间路径损耗。

距离或频率不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the geometry is usable.
items.doc_zh: 当该几何可用时返回 `true`。

items.name: LinkBudget
items.doc:
A complete link budget for one direction of a radio link.

The losses are given as positive decibel values that are subtracted,
which is the convention in link budgets: a three decibel loss is entered
as three decibels, not as minus three.
items.doc_zh:
无线电链路一个方向的完整链路预算。

各损耗以被减去的正分贝值给出，这是链路预算中的约定：三分贝的损耗记
为三，而非负三。

items.name: eirp
items.doc:
Returns the equivalent isotropically radiated power, in watts.

This is the transmit power reduced by the transmit losses and
increased by the transmit antenna gain. It is the power that an
isotropic radiator would have to radiate to produce the same flux
density in the direction of the receiver.

Returns `None` when any input is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回等效全向辐射功率，单位为瓦特。

这是发射功率减去发射损耗、加上发射天线增益。它是一个各向同性辐射体为
在接收机方向上产生相同通量密度所必须辐射的功率。

任一输入不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: received_power
items.doc:
Returns the carrier power at the receiver input, in watts.

Returns `None` when any input is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回接收机输入端的载波功率，单位为瓦特。

任一输入不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: noise_density
items.doc:
Returns the noise power density at the receiver input, in watts per
hertz.

This is `k T`, the noise temperature converted to a power per unit
bandwidth. It does not depend on the receiver bandwidth, which is
what makes the carrier to noise density ratio a property of the link
rather than of the receiver.

Returns `None` when the system temperature is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回接收机输入端的噪声功率密度，单位为瓦特每赫兹。

这是 `k T`，即把噪声温度换算为单位带宽的功率。它不依赖于接收机
带宽，这正是载噪密度比成为链路属性而非接收机属性的原因。

系统温度不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: carrier_to_noise_density
items.doc:
Returns the carrier to noise density ratio.

This is the carrier power divided by the noise power in one hertz.
It is the form used to compare a link against the energy per bit
requirement of a modulation, because the data rate is accounted for
separately.

Returns `None` when any input is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回载噪密度比。

这是载波功率除以一赫兹内的噪声功率。它是把链路与某调制的每比特能量要求
相比较所用的形式，因为数据速率被分开计入。

任一输入不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: carrier_to_noise
items.doc:
Returns the carrier to noise ratio in the receiver bandwidth.

This is the carrier to noise density ratio reduced by the bandwidth.
Unlike the density ratio it depends on the receiver, which is why the
same link can show different carrier to noise ratios in receivers of
different bandwidth.

Returns `None` when any input is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回接收机带宽内的载噪比。

这是载噪密度比减去带宽的贡献。与密度比不同，它依赖于接收机，这正是同一
链路在不同带宽的接收机中可显示不同载噪比的原因。

任一输入不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: energy_per_bit_over_noise
items.signature: pub fn energy_per_bit_over_noise(&self, data_rate: f64) -> Option<Decibel> {
items.doc:
Returns the energy per bit to noise density ratio for a data rate.

This is the carrier to noise density ratio reduced by the data rate,
because energy per bit is carrier power divided by bit rate.

Returns `None` when the data rate is not positive, or when the
carrier to noise density ratio is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回某数据速率下每比特能量与噪声密度之比。

它是载噪密度比减去数据速率，因为每比特能量是载波功率除以比特
速率。

数据速率非正，或载噪密度比不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: with_added_noise
items.signature: pub fn with_added_noise(&self, added: NoiseTemperature) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Returns the rise in system noise caused by the receive antenna
viewing a noise source of the given temperature.

The antenna noise is added to the system temperature in power, which
in temperature is a sum. This is the form used to account for the
Earth, the Sun, or a rain cell in the beam.

Returns `None` when the added temperature is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回接收天线看到给定温度的噪声源所引起的系统噪声上升。

天线噪声按功率加到系统温度上，在温度上即求和。这是用于计入波束中
的地球、太阳或雨胞的形式。

所加温度不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: carrier_wavelength
items.doc:
Returns the wavelength of the carrier, in meters.

Returns `None` when the frequency is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回载波的波长，单位为米。

频率不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when every input describes a usable link.
items.doc_zh: 当每个输入都描述一条可用链路时返回 `true`。

items.name: LinkMargin
items.doc: The result of comparing a link against a requirement.
items.doc_zh: 把链路与某项要求比较所得的结果。

items.name: margin
items.doc:
Returns the margin, in decibels.

A positive margin means the link closes with room to spare; a
negative margin means it does not.
items.doc_zh:
返回余量，单位为分贝。

正余量意味着链路闭合并有余，负余量意味着不能闭合。

items.name: closes
items.doc: Returns `true` when the margin is not negative.
items.doc_zh: 当余量非负时返回 `true`。

items.name: link_margin
items.signature: pub fn link_margin(achieved: Decibel, required: Decibel) -> LinkMargin {
items.doc:
Returns the margin between an achieved ratio and a required one.

This is the comparison that decides whether a link closes.
items.doc_zh:
返回所达到的比与所要求的比之间的余量。

这一比较决定链路是否闭合。

items.name: carrier_to_noise_density
items.doc:
Returns the carrier to noise density ratio for a budget.

This is a free function form of
[`LinkBudget::carrier_to_noise_density`].

Returns `None` when the budget is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回某预算的载噪密度比。

这是 [`LinkBudget::carrier_to_noise_density`] 的自由函数形式。

预算不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: gain_to_temperature
items.signature: pub fn gain_to_temperature(gain: Gain, temperature: NoiseTemperature) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the gain to system temperature ratio of a receive chain, in
reciprocal kelvin.

This figure of merit is written `G / T` and is the standard way to
compare receive stations. It combines the receive antenna gain with the
system noise temperature, so a station with a bigger dish and a quieter
receiver scores higher.

Expressed in decibels, `G / T` is the receive gain in dBi minus ten times
the logarithm of the temperature, which is the form usually quoted.

Returns `None` when the gain or temperature is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
返回接收链路的增益与系统温度之比，单位为每开尔文。

该品质因数写作 `G / T`，是比较接收站的标准方式。它把接收天线增益与
系统噪声温度结合起来，故天线更大、接收机更安静的站得分更高。

以分贝表示时，`G / T` 是接收增益（以 dBi 计）减去温度的十倍对数，
这是通常引用的形式。

增益或温度不可用时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-resource
crates.summary:
Resource modeling for satellite operations.

A resource is anything a task can occupy: a satellite, a ground station, a
transmitter, an onboard recorder. This crate models the two things a
scheduler needs to know about one: when it is available, and how much of
it a task consumes.

Availability is expressed as a set of disjoint intervals on a single time
axis, called windows. A resource is usable at an instant when that instant
falls inside one of its windows. The windows may come from anywhere: the
access analysis in `apsis-access` produces them for a ground station, and
an operator enters maintenance periods by hand.

Capacity is a positive number whose meaning is the caller's. A satellite
that can run one observation at a time has a capacity of one; a recorder
has a capacity in megabits; a power bus has one in watts. Two tasks
conflict only when their demands together exceed the capacity, which lets
the same type express exclusive and shared resources.

Times are in seconds from an origin chosen by the caller, so the same
model serves a scenario clock, an elapsed time, and a Julian date offset.

```
use apsis_resource::{Resource, ResourceId, Window};

// A station available from 100 to 200 seconds.
let mut resource = Resource::new(ResourceId::new(0), 1.0);
resource.add_window(Window::new(100.0, 200.0)).expect("the window is usable");

assert!(resource.is_available_at(150.0));
assert!(!resource.is_available_at(250.0));
assert!(resource.is_available_over(120.0, 80.0));
assert!(!resource.is_available_over(150.0, 100.0));
```
crates.summary_zh:
卫星运行的资源建模。

资源是任务可以占用的任何东西：一颗卫星、一座地面站、一台发射机、一台星载
记录器。本 crate 为调度器需要了解的关于它的两件事建模：它何时可用，以及一个
任务消耗它多少。

可用性表达为单一时间轴上互不相交的区间集合，称为窗口。在某瞬时有窗口包含该
瞬时，资源即可用。这些窗口可来自任何地方：`apsis-access` 中的可见性分析为
地面站产生它们，操作员则手工录入维护时段。

容量是一个正数，其含义由调用方定义。一次只能运行一项观测的卫星容量为一；记录
器的容量以兆比特计；功率母线的以瓦特计。两个任务只有在它们的需求合起来超过
容量时才冲突，这使同一个类型既能表达独占资源也能表达共享资源。

时间以距调用方所选原点的秒数计，故同一模型可服务于场景时钟、流逝时间与儒略日
偏移。

items.name: ResourceErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a resource error.
items.doc_zh: 资源错误的类别。

items.name: ResourceError
items.doc: A failure while building or querying a resource.
items.doc_zh: 构建或查询资源时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: ResourceId
items.doc:
An identifier for a resource.

The identifier is an index chosen by the caller. It is deliberately opaque
to this crate so that a caller can use whatever numbering its own model
provides.
items.doc_zh:
资源的标识符。

标识符是由调用方选定的下标。它对本 crate 刻意保持不透明，以便调用方
使用其自身模型所提供的任何编号方式。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(index: usize) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an identifier.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个标识符。

items.name: index
items.doc: Returns the index.
items.doc_zh: 返回该下标。

items.name: Resource
items.doc:
A resource with availability windows and a capacity.

The capacity is a positive number whose unit the caller chooses. A task
that occupies more than the capacity of a resource cannot be scheduled on
it at all; two tasks conflict when their demands together exceed the
capacity at some instant.
items.doc_zh:
带有可用窗口与容量的资源。

容量是由调用方选定单位的正数。占用量超过某资源容量的任务根本无法在其上
调度；当两个任务的需求之和在某瞬超出容量时，二者冲突。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(id: ResourceId, capacity: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a resource with no availability and the given capacity.

A resource with no windows is never available, so a caller adds
windows before using it. That is the safe default: a resource whose
availability was forgotten is unavailable rather than always
available.
items.doc_zh:
创建无可用性、容量给定的资源。

没有窗口的资源永不可用，故调用方须先添加窗口再使用。这是安全的
默认值：忘记设置可用性的资源是不可用，而非始终可用。

items.name: capacity
items.doc: Returns the capacity.
items.doc_zh: 返回该容量。

items.name: set_capacity
items.signature: pub fn set_capacity(&mut self, capacity: f64) -> Result<(), ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Sets the capacity.

Returns an error when the capacity is not positive and finite.
items.doc_zh:
设置容量。

当容量非正或非有限时返回错误。

items.name: has_valid_capacity
items.doc: Returns `true` when the capacity is usable.
items.doc_zh: 当该容量可用时返回 `true`。

items.name: windows
items.doc: Returns the availability windows, merged and in time order.
items.doc_zh: 返回可用窗口，已合并且按时间有序。

items.name: window_count
items.doc: Returns the number of availability windows.
items.doc_zh: 返回可用窗口的数量。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc: Returns `true` when the resource has no availability at all.
items.doc_zh: 当该资源完全没有可用性时返回 `true`。

items.name: set_windows
items.signature: pub fn set_windows(&mut self, windows: &[Window]) -> Result<(), ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Replaces the availability with a list of windows.

The windows are merged, so the stored form is canonical whatever order
the caller supplies them in.

Returns an error when a window is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
用一组窗口替换可用性。

窗口会被合并，故无论调用方以何种顺序给出，存储形式都是规范的。

当某个窗口不可用时返回错误。

items.name: add_window
items.signature: pub fn add_window(&mut self, window: Window) -> Result<(), ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Adds one availability window.

The window is merged into the existing set.

Returns an error when the window is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
添加一个可用窗口。

该窗口被合并进已有集合。

当该窗口不可用时返回错误。

items.name: remove_window
items.signature: pub fn remove_window(&mut self, removed: Window) -> Result<(), ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Removes an availability window.

The window is subtracted from the existing set, which may split a
stored window in two.

Returns an error when the window is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
移除一个可用窗口。

该窗口从已有集合中被减去，可能把某个已存窗口一分为二。

当该窗口不可用时返回错误。

items.name: is_available_at
items.signature: pub fn is_available_at(&self, time: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the resource is available at an instant.

An instantaneous query is a query of zero duration, which is satisfied
when the instant is inside a window. At the end of a window the
resource is not available, because the window is half-open.
items.doc_zh:
当该资源在某瞬可用时返回 `true`。

瞬时查询即零时长查询，当该瞬落在某个窗口内即得到满足。在窗口
终点处该资源不可用，因为窗口是半开的。

items.name: is_available_over
items.signature: pub fn is_available_over(&self, start: f64, duration: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the resource is available for a whole interval.

A resource can satisfy a request of zero duration whenever it is
available at the requested instant, so a zero duration is checked as
an instant.
items.doc_zh:
当该资源在整段区间上可用时返回 `true`。

只要资源在所请求瞬时可用，即可满足零时长请求，故零时长按瞬时检查。

items.name: availability_within
items.signature: pub fn availability_within(&self, query: Interval) -> Vec<Window> {
items.doc:
Returns the availability that falls inside an interval.

The result is the intersection of the stored windows with the query,
which is what a scheduler needs to know when it asks what part of its
planning horizon a resource is usable for.
items.doc_zh:
返回落在某区间内的可用性。

结果是已存窗口与该查询的交集，这正是调度器在询问资源的规划时域中
哪一段可用时所需的信息。

items.name: total_availability
items.doc:
Returns the total availability, in seconds.

The windows are disjoint, so the durations add.
items.doc_zh:
返回总可用时长，单位为秒。

各窗口互不相交，故时长可直接相加。

items.name: earliest_fit
items.signature: pub fn earliest_fit(&self, duration: f64) -> Option<Window> {
items.doc:
Returns the first window that can hold a request.

This is the earliest time at which the resource can satisfy a request
of the given duration, which is what a greedy scheduler asks. Returns
`None` when no window is long enough.
items.doc_zh:
返回第一个能容纳某请求的窗口。

这是该资源能满足给定时长请求的最早时刻，即贪心调度器所询问的量。
没有足够长的窗口时返回 `None`。

items.name: earliest_fit_after
items.signature: pub fn earliest_fit_after(&self, not_before: f64, duration: f64) -> Option<Window> {
items.doc:
Returns the first window that can hold a request starting no earlier
than a given time.

Returns `None` when no window is both late enough and long enough.
items.doc_zh:
返回第一个能容纳请求的窗口，且该请求的起点不早于给定时刻。

没有既够晚又够长的窗口时返回 `None`。

items.name: busy_until
items.signature: pub fn busy_until(&self, time: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the time at which the resource stops being available.

Returns `None` when the resource is not available at the given
instant, and infinity when the window that contains it is unbounded.
items.doc_zh:
返回该资源不再可用的时刻。

该资源在所给瞬时不可用时返回 `None`；包含该瞬的窗口无界时返回无穷。

items.name: ResourceSet
items.doc:
A collection of resources, indexed by identifier.

The set keeps the resources in the order they were added and provides the
lookups a scheduler needs: by identifier, and by the resource that has a
window covering an instant.
items.doc_zh:
以标识符为索引的资源集合。

该集合按添加顺序保存资源，并提供调度器所需的查找：按标识符，以及按
某个瞬时上有窗口覆盖的资源。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an empty set.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个空集合。

items.name: from_resources
items.signature: pub fn from_resources(resources: Vec<Resource>) -> Result<Self, ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Creates a set from a list of resources.

Returns an error when two resources share an identifier, because a
lookup would then be ambiguous.
items.doc_zh:
由一组资源创建集合。

两个资源标识符相同时返回错误，因为查找将有歧义。

items.name: insert
items.signature: pub fn insert(&mut self, resource: Resource) -> Result<(), ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Inserts a resource.

Returns an error when the identifier is already present.
items.doc_zh:
插入一个资源。

该标识符已存在时返回错误。

items.name: get
items.signature: pub fn get(&self, id: ResourceId) -> Option<&Resource> {
items.doc: Returns the resource with the given identifier.
items.doc_zh: 返回具有所给标识符的资源。

items.name: get_mut
items.signature: pub fn get_mut(&mut self, id: ResourceId) -> Option<&mut Resource> {
items.doc: Returns the resource with the given identifier for modification.
items.doc_zh: 返回具有所给标识符的资源以供修改。

items.name: remove
items.signature: pub fn remove(&mut self, id: ResourceId) -> Result<Resource, ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Removes a resource.

Returns an error when no resource has the identifier.
items.doc_zh:
移除一个资源。

没有资源具有该标识符时返回错误。

items.name: resources
items.doc: Returns the resources in the order they were added.
items.doc_zh: 返回按添加顺序排列的资源。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of resources.
items.doc_zh: 返回资源数量。

items.name: available_at
items.signature: pub fn available_at(&self, time: f64) -> Vec<ResourceId> {
items.doc:
Returns the identifiers of the resources available at an instant.

The result is in the order the resources were added.
items.doc_zh:
返回在某瞬可用的资源标识符。

结果按资源添加顺序排列。

items.name: available_over
items.signature: pub fn available_over(&self, start: f64, duration: f64) -> Vec<ResourceId> {
items.doc:
Returns the identifiers of the resources available for a whole
interval.
items.doc_zh: 返回在整段区间上可用的资源标识符。

items.name: Interval
items.doc:
A half-open interval of time, `[start, end)`.

The half-open convention is the one that makes intervals tile without
overlap or gap: an interval that ends where another begins shares only the
instant at the boundary, which belongs to the second. Two intervals are
therefore disjoint when the end of the first is at or before the start of
the second.
items.doc_zh:
半开时间区间 `[start, end)`。

采用半开约定正是为了使区间既不重叠也无空隙地铺满：一个在某处结束、
另一处从此开始的区间只在边界那一瞬相交，而该瞬归后者。故当第一个区
间的终点不晚于第二个区间的起点时，二者不相交。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(start: f64, end: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an interval.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个区间。

items.name: duration
items.doc:
Returns the duration of the interval, in seconds.

The value is zero for an empty interval and positive otherwise.
items.doc_zh:
返回该区间的时长，单位为秒。

对空区间该值为零，其余情形为正。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the interval is finite and ordered.
items.doc_zh: 当该区间有限且次序正确时返回 `true`。

items.name: contains
items.signature: pub fn contains(&self, time: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when an instant lies inside the interval.

The start is included and the end is excluded, so a boundary instant
belongs to the interval that begins there.
items.doc_zh:
当某时刻落在该区间内时返回 `true`。

含起点不含终点，故边界时刻归由此处开始的区间。

items.name: contains_interval
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the interval fully contains another.

An empty interval is contained by any interval that contains its
instant, so a zero length query inside the range is satisfied.
items.doc_zh:
当该区间完全包含另一区间时返回 `true`。

空区间被任何包含其瞬时的区间所包含，故范围内的零长度查询得到满足。

items.name: overlaps
items.doc:
Returns `true` when two intervals share any time.

Two intervals that meet at a point do not overlap, because the point
belongs to only one of them under the half-open convention.
items.doc_zh:
当两个区间共享任一时刻时返回 `true`。

在一点相接的两个区间不重叠，因为在半开约定下该点只属于其中之一。

items.name: intersection
items.doc:
Returns the intersection of two intervals, or `None` when they do not
overlap.
items.doc_zh: 返回两个区间的交集；二者不重叠时返回 `None`。

items.name: hull
items.doc: Returns the shortest interval containing both.
items.doc_zh: 返回包含二者的最短区间。

items.name: is_adjacent_to
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the two intervals touch or overlap, so that they
can be merged without leaving a gap.
items.doc_zh: 当两个区间相接或重叠时返回 `true`，此时合并它们不会留下空隙。

items.name: Window
items.doc:
An availability window of a resource.

This is an [`Interval`] under a name that reads better where the caller is
describing when a resource can be used rather than doing interval algebra.
items.doc_zh:
资源的可用窗口。

它就是一个 [`Interval`]，只是当调用方描述资源何时可用、而非进行区间运算
时，这个名字读起来更贴切。

items.name: from_interval
items.signature: pub const fn from_interval(interval: Interval) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a window from an interval.
items.doc_zh: 由区间创建窗口。

items.name: start
items.doc: Returns the start of the window, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回窗口起点，单位为秒。

items.name: end
items.doc: Returns the end of the window, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回窗口终点，单位为秒。

items.name: validate
items.doc: Validates the window, returning the reason when it is not usable.
items.doc_zh: 校验该窗口；不可用时返回原因。

items.name: merge_windows
items.doc:
Merges a list of windows into a list of disjoint windows in time order.

Windows that overlap or touch are combined, and empty windows are dropped.
The result is the canonical form of a set of availability windows: sorted,
disjoint, and non-empty, so that two sets can be compared directly.

Returns an error when a window is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
把一组窗口合并为按时间排序的互不相交窗口。

重叠或相接的窗口被合并，空窗口被丢弃。结果是一组可用窗口的规范形式：
有序、互不相交且无空项，故两组可直接比较。

当某个窗口不可用时返回错误。

items.name: subtract_window
items.signature: pub fn subtract_window(windows: &[Window], removed: Window) -> Result<Vec<Window>, ResourceError> {
items.doc:
Removes a window from each of a list of windows.

The result is the same set of availability with the removed window taken
out. Windows that are entirely inside the removed one disappear, and one
that contains it is split in two.

Returns an error when any input window is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
从一组窗口中逐个减去某个窗口。

结果是同一组可用性去掉该窗口之后的情形。完全落在被减窗口内部的窗口
消失，包含它的窗口被一分为二。

当任一输入窗口不可用时返回错误。

crates.name: apsis-task
crates.summary:
Task modeling for satellite operations.

A task is a unit of work that a scheduler places on a set of resources. It
carries everything a scheduler needs to decide whether and where to run
it: how long it takes, when it may run, which resources it needs and in
what amount, and what it is worth.

A task requires all of its resources at the same time, for its whole
duration. That is the model an observation has: the satellite and the
ground station must both be available while the data is taken. A task that
needs resources in sequence is expressed as two tasks joined by a
precedence constraint in a [`PrecedenceGraph`], which says that one task
must finish before the other starts.

Tasks are immutable once built. The state a scheduler assigns to one is
kept separately, in the schedule, so that the same task can be considered
for several placements without being modified.

```
use apsis_resource::ResourceId;
use apsis_task::{Requirement, Task, TaskId};

// An observation of sixty seconds that needs a satellite and a station.
let task = Task::new(TaskId::new(0), 60.0)
    .with_window(100.0, 1_000.0)
    .with_priority(5.0)
    .try_require(ResourceId::new(0), 1.0)
    .expect("the satellite is not yet required")
    .try_require(ResourceId::new(1), 1.0)
    .expect("the station is not yet required");

assert_eq!(task.duration, 60.0);
assert_eq!(task.requirements.len(), 2);
assert!(task.is_valid());
```
crates.summary_zh:
卫星运行的任务建模。

任务是调度器放置到一组资源上的工作单元。它携带调度器决定是否运行它、在哪里
运行它所需的一切：耗时多久、何时可以运行、需要哪些资源及多少量，以及它值多少。

一个任务在其整个时长内同时需要它的全部资源。这是观测所具有的模型：取数期间
卫星与地面站必须都可用。需要按序使用资源的任务，表达为两个由
[`PrecedenceGraph`] 中先后约束连接的任务，该约束说一个任务必须在另一个开始
之前完成。

任务一旦构建便不可变。调度器赋给它的状态分开保存在调度中，使同一个任务可以
被考虑用于多处放置而不被修改。

items.name: TaskErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a task error.
items.doc_zh: 任务错误的类别。

items.name: TaskError
items.doc: A failure while building or querying a task.
items.doc_zh: 构建或查询任务时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: PrecedenceGraph
items.doc:
A directed acyclic graph of precedence constraints.

An edge from one task to another means the first must finish before the
second starts. The order of the tasks themselves is the caller's: the
graph only records which pairs are related.
items.doc_zh:
优先约束构成的有向无环图。

从一个任务指向另一个任务的边表示前者必须先于后者完成。任务本身的次序
由调用方决定：该图只记录哪些任务对之间存在关系。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an empty graph.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个空图。

items.name: edge_count
items.doc: Returns the number of edges.
items.doc_zh: 返回边的数量。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc: Returns `true` when there are no edges.
items.doc_zh: 当没有边时返回 `true`。

items.name: has_constraint
items.signature: pub fn has_constraint(&self, before: TaskId, after: TaskId) -> bool {
items.doc: Returns `true` when the constraint from `before` to `after` exists.
items.doc_zh: 当存在从 `before` 到 `after` 的约束时返回 `true`。

items.name: add
items.signature: pub fn add(&mut self, before: TaskId, after: TaskId) -> Result<(), TaskError> {
items.doc:
Adds a constraint that `before` must finish before `after` starts.

Returns an error when the two identifiers are the same, because a task
cannot precede itself, or when the constraint would close a cycle.

Adding a constraint that already exists is accepted and has no effect,
so a caller may assemble a graph from overlapping sources without
having to deduplicate.
items.doc_zh:
添加一条约束：`before` 必须在 `after` 开始之前完成。

两个标识符相同时返回错误，因为任务不能先于自身；该约束会闭成环时
亦返回错误。

添加已存在的约束被接受且不起作用，故调用方可以从多个有重叠的数据源
汇集一个图，无须先去重。

items.name: is_reachable
items.signature: pub fn is_reachable(&self, from: TaskId, to: TaskId) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when `to` is reachable from `from` following the
constraints.
items.doc_zh: 当沿约束可自 `from` 到达 `to` 时返回 `true`。

items.name: predecessors_of
items.signature: pub fn predecessors_of(&self, task: TaskId) -> Vec<TaskId> {
items.doc:
Returns the tasks that must finish before a task starts.

The result is in the order the constraints were added. It is the
direct predecessors only, not the transitive closure.
items.doc_zh:
返回必须在某任务开始前完成的任务。

结果按约束添加顺序排列。它只含直接前驱，不含传递闭包。

items.name: successors_of
items.signature: pub fn successors_of(&self, task: TaskId) -> Vec<TaskId> {
items.doc:
Returns the tasks that must wait for a task to finish.

The result is in the order the constraints were added. It is the
direct successors only, not the transitive closure.
items.doc_zh:
返回必须等待某任务完成的任务。

结果按约束添加顺序排列。它只含直接后继，不含传递闭包。

items.name: roots
items.doc: Returns the tasks with no predecessor.
items.doc_zh: 返回没有前驱的任务。

items.name: leaves
items.doc: Returns the tasks with no successor.
items.doc_zh: 返回没有后继的任务。

items.name: topological_order
items.signature: pub fn topological_order(&self, tasks: &[TaskId]) -> Result<Vec<TaskId>, TaskError> {
items.doc:
Returns a topological order of the given tasks.

The order respects every constraint: a task appears after all of its
predecessors. Ties are broken by the position of the task in the
supplied list, so that a caller can impose its own preference among
tasks that are otherwise unordered. That is what lets a planner place
the more valuable tasks first within the freedom the constraints
allow.

Tasks in the list that have no constraints still appear.
