Returns an error when the graph contains a cycle among the given
tasks. The graph rejects cycles as they are added, so this can only
happen when a caller builds the graph from one task set and orders
another, or when the tasks are not all in the graph.
items.doc_zh:
返回所给任务的拓扑序。

该次序满足每一条约束：任务出现在其所有前驱之后。平局按该任务在所给
列表中的位置打破，使调用方可在本来无序的任务间表达自己的偏好。这
正是让规划器在约束允许的自由度内先放置更有价值的任务。

列表中无任何约束的任务同样出现。

当图在所给任务之间含环时返回错误。该图在添加时就拒绝成环，故这只
可能发生在调用方以一组任务建图却对另一组排序，或任务未全在图中时。

items.name: task_count
items.doc: Returns the number of tasks in the graph.
items.doc_zh: 返回图中的任务数。

items.name: TaskId
items.doc: An identifier for a task.
items.doc_zh: 任务的标识符。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(index: usize) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an identifier.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个标识符。

items.name: index
items.doc: Returns the index.
items.doc_zh: 返回该下标。

items.name: Requirement
items.doc:
A demand that a task makes on one resource.

The demand is the amount of the resource's capacity the task consumes
while it runs. A demand that exceeds the resource's capacity makes the
task impossible to schedule there, which a scheduler discovers by
comparing the two.
items.doc_zh:
任务对某个资源的需求。

需求是任务运行期间消耗的资源容量大小。超出资源容量的需求使该任务无法在
此处调度，调度器通过比较二者即可发现。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(resource: ResourceId, demand: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a requirement.
items.doc_zh: 创建一条需求。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the demand is positive and finite.
items.doc_zh: 当该需求为正且有限时返回 `true`。

items.name: Task
items.doc:
A unit of work to be scheduled.

A task is immutable after construction. The builder methods take `self` by
value and return a new task, so a caller can share a base task and derive
variants from it without the variants interfering.
items.doc_zh:
待调度的一份工作。

任务在构造后不可变。各构建方法按值接收 `self` 并返回新任务，故调用方
可以共享一个基础任务并由它派生出若干变体，而变体之间互不干扰。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(id: TaskId, duration: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a task with the given duration and no requirements.

The task may start at any finite time, because it has no window. It
has a priority of zero and is not mandatory.
items.doc_zh:
以给定时长、无资源需求创建任务。

该任务没有窗口，故可在任意有限时刻开始。其优先级为零，且非强制。

items.name: with_window
items.signature: pub fn with_window(mut self, start: f64, end: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns a copy of this task with a time window.

The window is the interval in which the whole task must fit, so the
task may start no earlier than the window start and must end no later
than the window end.
items.doc_zh:
返回带时间窗口的本任务副本。

该窗口是整个任务必须容纳其中的区间，故任务起点不早于窗口起点、终点
不晚于窗口终点。

items.name: with_priority
items.signature: pub fn with_priority(mut self, priority: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this task with a priority.
items.doc_zh: 返回带给定优先级的本任务副本。

items.name: with_mandatory
items.signature: pub fn with_mandatory(mut self, mandatory: bool) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this task marked mandatory or not.
items.doc_zh: 返回标记为强制或非强制的本任务副本。

items.name: require
items.signature: pub fn require(mut self, resource: ResourceId, demand: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Returns a copy of this task with an additional resource requirement.

Adding the same resource twice is allowed at this point, because a
builder chain cannot report an error. [`Task::validate`] rejects it,
and [`Task::try_require`] reports it immediately.
items.doc_zh:
返回附加一条资源需求的本任务副本。

此处允许重复加入同一资源，因为构建者链无法报告错误。
[`Task::validate`] 会拒绝它，[`Task::try_require`] 则立即报告。

items.name: try_require
items.signature: pub fn try_require(mut self, resource: ResourceId, demand: f64) -> Result<Self, TaskError> {
items.doc:
Returns a copy of this task with an additional resource requirement,
reporting a duplicate or an invalid demand immediately.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加一条资源需求的本任务副本，并立即报告重复或无效需求。

items.name: demand_for
items.signature: pub fn demand_for(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the demand the task makes on a resource.

Returns `None` when the task does not require the resource.
items.doc_zh:
返回该任务对某资源的需求。

该任务不要求该资源时返回 `None`。

items.name: requires
items.signature: pub fn requires(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> bool {
items.doc: Returns `true` when the task requires a resource.
items.doc_zh: 当该任务要求某资源时返回 `true`。

items.name: requirement_count
items.doc: Returns the number of resources the task requires.
items.doc_zh: 返回该任务要求的资源数量。

items.name: resources
items.doc: Returns the identifiers of the required resources.
items.doc_zh: 返回所要求资源的标识符。

items.name: window_length
items.doc:
Returns the length of the window in which the task must fit, in
seconds.

Returns infinity when the task has no restriction at either end, and
zero or a negative value when the window cannot hold the task at all.
items.doc_zh:
返回该任务必须容纳其中的窗口长度，单位为秒。

任务两端均无限制时返回无穷；窗口完全容不下该任务时返回零或负值。

items.name: window_is_too_short
items.doc: Returns `true` when the window cannot hold the task.
items.doc_zh: 当窗口容不下该任务时返回 `true`。

items.name: earliest_possible_end
items.doc:
Returns the earliest time the task could end, given its window.

Returns infinity when the task has no upper bound, and negative
infinity when it has no lower bound.
items.doc_zh:
返回在其窗口下该任务可能结束的最早时刻。

任务无上界时返回无穷，无下界时返回负无穷。

items.name: fits_window
items.doc: Returns `true` when the task fits its window.
items.doc_zh: 当该任务能容纳于其窗口时返回 `true`。

items.name: has_duplicate_requirements
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the task uses any resource more than once, or
demands a non-positive amount.
items.doc_zh: 当该任务重复使用某资源，或需求非正时返回 `true`。

items.name: validate
items.doc:
Validates the task, returning the reason when it is not usable.

A task is usable when its duration is finite and positive, its window
is finite at the ends it states and holds the duration, every demand
is positive and finite and names a distinct resource, and the weights
are finite.
items.doc_zh:
校验该任务；不可用时返回原因。

任务可用当且仅当：时长有限且为正；窗口在其给出的两端有限并容得下该
时长；每条需求为正且有限并指向互不相同的资源；各权值有限。

items.name: weighted_value
items.doc:
Returns the value of the task, which is its priority weighted by its
duration.

This is the quantity a scheduler maximises when it is asked to make
the most of the available time: a long task of high priority is worth
more than a short one of the same priority.
items.doc_zh:
返回该任务的价值，即其优先级与时长的乘积。

当调度器被要求充分利用可用时间时，最大化的正是该量：同等优先级下
时长较长的任务价值更高。

items.name: TaskState
items.doc:
The state a scheduler has assigned to a task.

The state is kept apart from the task so that the same task can be
considered for several placements without being modified. A task that has
been placed records when and where, so that a schedule can be examined
without a second lookup.
items.doc_zh:
调度器为某任务指定的状态。

状态与任务分开保存，故同一任务可被考虑多次放置而不被修改。已放置的
任务记录了何时何地，从而无需二次查找即可检查一份计划。

items.name: is_scheduled
items.doc: Returns `true` when the task has been placed.
items.doc_zh: 当该任务已被放置时返回 `true`。

items.name: start
items.doc: Returns the start time of the placement, if there is one.
items.doc_zh: 返回放置的起始时刻，若有。

items.name: end
items.signature: pub fn end(&self, duration: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc: Returns the end time of the placement, if there is one.
items.doc_zh: 返回放置的结束时刻，若有。

items.name: name
items.doc: Returns a short name for the state.
items.doc_zh: 返回该状态的简称。

items.name: TaskSet
items.doc: A collection of tasks, indexed by identifier.
items.doc_zh: 以标识符为索引的任务集合。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an empty set.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个空集合。

items.name: from_tasks
items.signature: pub fn from_tasks(tasks: Vec<Task>) -> Result<Self, TaskError> {
items.doc:
Creates a set from a list of tasks.

Returns an error when two tasks share an identifier or when any task
is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
由一组任务创建集合。

两个任务标识符相同或任一任务不可用时返回错误。

items.name: insert
items.signature: pub fn insert(&mut self, task: Task) -> Result<(), TaskError> {
items.doc:
Inserts a task.

Returns an error when the identifier is already present or when the
task is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
插入一个任务。

该标识符已存在或该任务不可用时返回错误。

items.name: get
items.signature: pub fn get(&self, id: TaskId) -> Option<&Task> {
items.doc: Returns the task with the given identifier.
items.doc_zh: 返回具有所给标识符的任务。

items.name: remove
items.signature: pub fn remove(&mut self, id: TaskId) -> Result<Task, TaskError> {
items.doc:
Removes a task.

Returns an error when no task has the identifier.
items.doc_zh:
移除一个任务。

没有任务具有该标识符时返回错误。

items.name: tasks
items.doc: Returns the tasks in the order they were added.
items.doc_zh: 返回按添加顺序排列的任务。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of tasks.
items.doc_zh: 返回任务数量。

items.name: total_duration
items.doc:
Returns the total duration of every task, in seconds.

This is the load the tasks would place on the schedule if each used
one unit of resource for its whole duration.
items.doc_zh:
返回所有任务的总时长，单位为秒。

这是各任务在整个时长内各占一个单位资源时，会施加到计划上的负载。

items.name: total_weighted_value
items.doc: Returns the total weighted value of every task.
items.doc_zh: 返回所有任务的总加权价值。

items.name: tasks_requiring
items.signature: pub fn tasks_requiring(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Vec<TaskId> {
items.doc: Returns the identifiers of the tasks that require a resource.
items.doc_zh: 返回要求某资源的任务标识符。

items.name: mandatory
items.doc: Returns the identifiers of the mandatory tasks.
items.doc_zh: 返回强制任务的标识符。

items.name: task_order
items.doc:
Returns a task ordering suitable for a greedy scheduler.

The order is by decreasing weighted value, which is an efficient
heuristic: placing the tasks that contribute most first leaves the least
valuable ones to fill the gaps. Ties are broken by the earlier deadline
and then by the identifier, so that the order is deterministic for a given
set.

This is not guaranteed to find the best possible schedule. Scheduling
with resource constraints is intractable in general, so a heuristic is the
practical choice and the caller may supply its own order instead.
items.doc_zh:
返回适合贪心调度器的任务次序。

该次序按加权价值递减排列，这是一个有效启发式：先放置贡献最大的任务，
把价值最小的留给填补空隙。平局先按更早的截止时刻、再按标识符打破，故
对给定集合次序是确定的。

它不保证找到最优计划。带资源约束的调度在一般情况下不可解，故启发式
是现实的选择，调用方亦可自行提供次序。

crates.name: apsis-scheduler
crates.summary_zh:
卫星任务规划的调度算法。

调度器接收任务列表与资源集合，产生一个调度。本 crate 提供一个贪心调度器以及
构建其他调度器所需的构件。

带资源约束的调度一般是难解的：判定是否每个任务都放得下是一个装箱问题，它是
NP 难的。卫星规划问题规模小，有数百个任务而非数百万个，但对例行的规划周期而言，
精确搜索仍不切实际。故此处的调度器是贪心启发式。

该算法把任务排序，并把每个放到其全部资源同时空闲的最早时间。任务按加权价值递减
的次序考虑，这是一个好的启发式：最有价值的工作先被放置，最不有价值的填充剩余
空隙。强制任务不论其价值都先放置，因为一个必须运行的任务比任何可以运行的任务
都值更多。

结果不保证最优，且本 crate 报告它无法放置的内容而非无声丢弃，使操作员能看到该
计划的代价。

items.name: resources_have_capacity
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every resource of a task has the capacity to hold its
demand.

A task that demands more of a resource than the resource has can never be
scheduled on it, so this is checked before the search for a time. Returns
`false` when a required resource does not exist.
items.doc_zh:
当任务的每个资源都有容量容纳其需求时返回 `true`。

需求超过某资源容量的任务永远无法在其上调度，故在搜索时刻之前先检查
此点。所需资源不存在时返回 `false`。

items.name: demand_at
items.signature: pub fn demand_at( schedule: &Schedule, tasks: &[Task], resources: &ResourceSet, time: f64, ) -> Vec<(ResourceId, f64)> {
items.doc:
Returns the total demand placed on each resource at an instant, given a
schedule and the tasks it contains.

The result is in the order the resources appear in the set. A resource
that is not in the set is omitted.
items.doc_zh:
给定一份计划及其任务集合，返回某瞬时各资源上的总需求。

结果按资源在集合中的次序排列。不在集合中的资源被省略。

items.name: resources_free_at
items.signature: pub fn resources_free_at( schedule: &Schedule, tasks: &[Task], resources: &ResourceSet, time: f64, ) -> Vec<ResourceId> {
items.doc:
Returns the identifiers of the resources that are free at an instant.

A resource is free when its availability windows cover the instant and
the demand already placed on it leaves room for one more unit. This is
the query a watermark scheduler makes when it looks for a satellite with
spare capacity.
items.doc_zh:
返回在某瞬空闲的资源标识符。

资源空闲当且仅当其可用窗口覆盖该瞬，且其上已放置的需求还留有一个单
位的余量。这正是水位调度器寻找有余量卫星时所作的查询。

items.name: feasible_at
items.signature: pub fn feasible_at( task: &Task, tasks: &[Task], schedule: &Schedule, resources: &ResourceSet, start: f64, ) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when a task placed at a time is feasible.

The check is that every required resource is available for the whole
duration and that the demand already placed on it, plus the new demand,
stays within the capacity at every instant of the placement.
items.doc_zh:
当某任务在某时刻的放置可行时返回 `true`。

检查内容为：每个所需资源在整个时长上可用，且其上已放置的需求加上
新需求，在放置的每个瞬时都不超过容量。

items.name: infeasible_tasks
items.doc:
Returns the identifiers of the tasks that a set of resources cannot
accommodate at all.

A task is infeasible when it demands more of a resource than the resource
has, when a resource it requires does not exist, or when its window is
shorter than its duration. These cannot be repaired by rescheduling and
are worth reporting separately from the tasks that were merely left out.
items.doc_zh:
返回某组资源完全无法容纳的任务标识符。

任务不可行的情形有：需求超过某资源容量；所需资源不存在；窗口短于其
时长。这些无法通过重排修复，值得与那些只是被排除的任务分开报告。

items.name: ImprovementSettings
items.doc: The settings of the improvement pass.
items.doc_zh: 改进轮的设置。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(max_attempts_per_task: usize) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates settings with the given bound.
items.doc_zh: 以给定界创建设置。

items.name: disabled
items.doc: Returns settings that do not run the pass.
items.doc_zh: 返回不运行该轮的设置。

items.name: ImprovementOutcome
items.doc: What the improvement pass changed.
items.doc_zh: 改进轮所作的改变。

items.name: placed_count
items.doc: Returns the number of tasks the pass placed.
items.doc_zh: 返回该轮所放置的任务数。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc: Returns `true` when the pass changed nothing.
items.doc_zh: 当该轮未作任何改变时返回 `true`。

items.name: improve
items.signature: pub fn improve( tasks: &[Task], resources: &ResourceSet, deferred: &[TaskId], schedule: &mut Schedule, states: &mut [TaskState], settings: ImprovementSettings, ) -> ImprovementOutcome {
items.doc:
Tries to place deferred tasks by relocating the placements that block them.

`deferred` are the tasks the greedy pass could not place, in the order to
consider them. `states` holds the state of every task indexed by
identifier and is updated in place, so the caller sees the final
assignment. The schedule is modified in place.

Returns a record of what the pass placed and moved.
items.doc_zh:
通过搬迁阻塞它们的放置，尝试安排被推迟的任务。

`deferred` 是贪心轮无法放置的任务，按考虑顺序排列。`states` 按标识符
索引保存每个任务的状态并就地更新，故调用方看到的是最终指派。该计划
亦被就地修改。

返回记录该轮所放置与所移动内容的报告。

items.name: PlanOutcome
items.doc:
What happened to one task during planning.

The outcome pairs a task with the state the planner assigned, which is the
information an operator needs to see. It is separate from the schedule
because a task that was not placed has no placement but still has an
outcome worth reporting.
items.doc_zh:
规划过程中某个任务的结果。

它把任务与规划器所指定的状态配对，这是操作者需要看到的信息。它与
计划分开，因为未放置的任务虽无放置，却仍有一份值得报告的结果。

items.name: is_scheduled
items.doc: Returns `true` when the task was placed.
items.doc_zh: 当该任务已被放置时返回 `true`。

items.name: is_infeasible
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the task could not be placed for a structural
reason, rather than being left out for want of time.
items.doc_zh: 当该任务因结构性原因无法放置、而非因时间不足被排除时返回 `true`。

items.name: SchedulingResult
items.doc: The result of planning.
items.doc_zh: 规划的结果。

items.name: outcome_of
items.signature: pub fn outcome_of(&self, task: TaskId) -> Option<&PlanOutcome> {
items.doc: Returns the outcome of a task.
items.doc_zh: 返回某任务的结果。

items.name: scheduled
items.doc: Returns the identifiers of the tasks that were placed.
items.doc_zh: 返回已放置任务的标识符。

items.name: deferred
items.doc: Returns the identifiers of the tasks that were left out.
items.doc_zh: 返回被排除任务的标识符。

items.name: infeasible
items.doc: Returns the identifiers of the tasks that cannot be placed at all.
items.doc_zh: 返回完全无法放置的任务的标识符。

items.name: is_complete
items.doc: Returns `true` when every offered task was placed.
items.doc_zh: 当所有提交任务均被放置时返回 `true`。

items.name: honours_mandatory
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every mandatory task was placed.

A plan that leaves a mandatory task unplaced is not usable, however
much optional work it found room for.
items.doc_zh:
当所有强制任务均被放置时返回 `true`。

留下强制任务未放置的计划不可用，无论它为多少可选工作腾出了
空间。

items.name: honours_precedence
items.doc:
Returns `true` when every precedence constraint is satisfied.

A constraint is satisfied when the second task starts at or after the
end of the first. A constraint whose tasks are not both placed is
trivially satisfied, because nothing has been promised about them.
items.doc_zh:
当所有优先约束都得到满足时返回 `true`。

约束被满足，指第二个任务的起点不早于第一个的终点。两个任务未
同时放置的约束平凡地满足，因为对它们未作任何承诺。

items.name: Planner
items.doc:
A greedy planner.

The planner holds the settings of the search. The settings are separated
from the schedule so that the same planner can be applied to many task
sets with the same policy.
items.doc_zh:
贪心规划器。

该规划器持有搜索的设置。设置与计划分开，故同一个规划器可按同一策略
应用于许多任务集。

items.name: new
items.doc:
Creates a planner with the default settings.

The defaults are the ones [`Planner::default`] uses: mandatory tasks
first and the improvement pass enabled with four attempts per task.
items.doc_zh:
以默认设置创建规划器。

默认值即 [`Planner::default`] 所用者：先放置强制任务，改进轮
启用且每任务尝试四次。

items.name: with_mandatory_first
items.signature: pub const fn with_mandatory_first(mut self, mandatory_first: bool) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this planner with the mandatory placement rule set.
items.doc_zh: 返回设置了强制放置规则的规划器副本。

items.name: with_improvement
items.signature: pub const fn with_improvement(mut self, improvement: ImprovementSettings) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this planner with the improvement pass configured.
items.doc_zh: 返回配置了改进轮的规划器副本。

items.name: order
items.doc:
Returns the order in which the planner considers the tasks.

Without a precedence graph the order is mandatory tasks first, when
the planner is configured that way, and then decreasing weighted
value with ties broken by deadline and identifier.

With a precedence graph the order is a topological order of the
graph, using the value order to break ties. That places a task as
early as its constraints allow and the most valuable one first among
the tasks that are free.
items.doc_zh:
返回规划器考虑任务的顺序。

无优先关系图时，顺序是先强制任务（若规划器如此配置），再按加权
价值递减，平局按截止时刻与标识符打破。

有优先关系图时，顺序是该图的拓扑序，并以价值次序打破平局。这
使任务在其约束允许的最早时刻被放置，而在自由的任务中优先放置
价值最高者。

items.name: order_with_precedence
items.signature: pub fn order_with_precedence( &self, tasks: &[Task], precedence: Option<&PrecedenceGraph>, ) -> Vec<TaskId> {
items.doc:
Returns the order in which the planner considers the tasks, honouring
a precedence graph.

A graph whose constraints contain a cycle produces the value order
unchanged, because the constraints then have no satisfiable
interpretation. The caller should validate the graph before
planning; the order is a fallback so that planning still produces
something rather than failing outright.
items.doc_zh:
返回规划器考虑任务的顺序，并遵从给定的优先关系图。

约束含环的图会原样产生价值次序，因为这些约束此时没有可满足的
解释。调用方应在规划前校验该图；此处的次序是一个回退，使规划
仍能产出结果而非直接失败。

items.name: schedule
items.signature: pub fn schedule(&self, tasks: &[Task], resources: &ResourceSet) -> SchedulingResult {
items.doc:
Plans a set of tasks on a set of resources.

Every task is considered once, in the order the planner chooses. A
task is placed at the earliest time at which all of its resources are
free together. A task that cannot be placed is reported as deferred,
or as infeasible when no placement could ever exist.

The schedule that is returned is feasible by construction, because
each placement is checked against the capacity before it is made. The
caller may confirm that with `apsis-conflict`.
items.doc_zh:
在一组资源上规划一组任务。

每个任务按规划器所选的顺序被考虑一次，被放置在其全部资源恰好同时
空闲的最早时刻。无法放置的任务被报告为被推迟；不存在任何可行
放置的则报告为不可行。

返回的计划按构造即可行，因为每处放置在做下之前都对照容量校验
过。调用方可用 `apsis-conflict` 复核。

items.name: schedule_with_precedence
items.signature: pub fn schedule_with_precedence( &self, tasks: &[Task], resources: &ResourceSet, precedence: &PrecedenceGraph, ) -> SchedulingResult {
items.doc:
Plans a set of tasks, honouring a precedence graph.

A task is placed only after every task that must precede it has been
placed, so the search for its start begins no earlier than the latest
end among its predecessors. A predecessor that could not be placed
makes the successor deferred as well, because the constraint cannot be
met.

The improvement pass is not applied to a plan with precedence
constraints, because relocating a placement could break a constraint
that the pass does not consider. A caller that needs both should
improve the plan and then verify it with
[`SchedulingResult::honours_precedence`].
items.doc_zh:
遵从优先关系图规划一组任务。

任务仅在其所有前驱均已放置之后才被放置，故其起点搜索不早于
前驱中最晚的结束时刻。无法放置的前驱会使其后继同样被推迟，
因为该约束无法满足。

改进轮不作用于带优先约束的计划，因为移动某处放置可能破坏该轮
并不考虑的约束。两者皆需的调用方应先改进计划，再用
[`SchedulingResult::honours_precedence`] 复核。

items.name: earliest_feasible_start
items.signature: pub fn earliest_feasible_start( task: &Task, tasks: &[Task], schedule: &Schedule, resources: &ResourceSet, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the earliest time at which a task can be placed.

The earliest feasible start is always one of a small set of candidate
times: the start of the task's window, the start of an availability
window of one of its resources, or the end of a placement already on one
of those resources. Feasibility cannot change at any other instant,
because the demand on every resource is constant between those events and
the availability is constant between them too.

Returns `None` when the task cannot be placed anywhere in its window.
items.doc_zh:
返回某任务可被放置的最早时刻。

最早可行起点总是某个小候选集合之一：任务窗口的起点、其某资源可用窗口
的起点，或其某资源上已有放置的结束时刻。可行性在其他任何瞬时都不会
改变，因为各资源的需求在这些事件之间恒定，可用性亦然。

该任务在其窗口内无处可放时返回 `None`。

crates.name: apsis-conflict
crates.summary_zh:
资源与时间冲突检测。

一份调度可能以若干方式出错，本 crate 找出它们。它报告冲突而非拒绝它们，使从
文件加载的计划能被完整检查，并一次列出每个问题，而不是每次尝试报一个。

检测五类冲突：

- **容量**：两处放置在同一瞬时需要的某资源超过该资源所有。
- **窗口**：一处放置在任务可开始之前开始，或在它必须结束之后结束。
- **需求**：一处放置的任务未知，或其时长与调度不符。
- **可用性**：一处放置落在它所需某资源的可用性窗口之外，故该资源实际上不在场。
- **先后**：一个必须跟随另一任务的任务在其结束之前开始。

容量冲突与可用性冲突之别在实践中要紧：前者说明计划超额承诺，后者说明计划在资源
被关闭或不可见之时索求它，二者是不同的修复。

items.name: ConflictKind
items.doc: The kind of problem a conflict describes.
items.doc_zh: 冲突所描述的问题类别。

items.name: Conflict
items.doc:
One problem found in a schedule.

The conflict names the tasks involved and, where it applies, the resource
and the instant at which the problem occurs. That is enough for an
operator to locate the placement without re-deriving the analysis.
items.doc_zh:
计划中发现的单个问题。

冲突指明所涉任务，并在适用时指明资源及问题发生的时刻。这足以让操作
者定位放置，而无须重新推导分析。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(kind: ConflictKind, task: TaskId, at: f64, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a conflict.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个冲突。

items.name: with_other
items.signature: pub fn with_other(mut self, other: TaskId) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this conflict involving another task.
items.doc_zh: 返回涉及另一任务的本冲突副本。

items.name: with_resource
items.signature: pub fn with_resource(mut self, resource: ResourceId) -> Self {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this conflict involving a resource.
items.doc_zh: 返回涉及某资源的本冲突副本。

items.name: is_movable
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the conflict concerns a placement that should be
moved rather than one that should be dropped.

A capacity or availability conflict can often be repaired by moving
the placement, while a requirement conflict means the placement does
not belong in the schedule at all.
items.doc_zh:
当该冲突涉及一处应当移动而非丢弃的放置时返回 `true`。

容量或可用性冲突常可通过移动放置来修复，而需求冲突意味着该
放置本就不应出现在计划中。

items.name: ConflictReport
items.doc:
The conflicts found in a schedule.

The report is ordered by time and then by kind, so that reading it
follows the plan. The counts by kind are provided because a planner
usually wants to know how many of each problem there are before deciding
what to do.
items.doc_zh:
计划中发现的所有冲突。

报告按时间、再按类别排序，故阅读它即是在阅读该计划。各类计数一并
提供，因为规划器通常希望先知道每类问题各有若干，再决定对策。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(mut conflicts: Vec<Conflict>, offered_tasks: usize, placed_tasks: usize) -> Self {
items.doc:
Creates a report from a list of conflicts and the task counts.

The conflicts are sorted by time, then by kind, then by task, so that
the order does not depend on the order they were found.
items.doc_zh:
由一组冲突与任务计数创建报告。

冲突按时间、类别、任务依次排序，故其次序不取决于发现它们的
顺序。

items.name: conflicts
items.doc: Returns the conflicts, in time order.
items.doc_zh: 返回各冲突，按时间排序。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of conflicts.
items.doc_zh: 返回冲突数量。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc:
Returns `true` when there are no conflicts.

This is the conventional spelling of [`ConflictReport::is_clear`], and
the two always agree.
items.doc_zh:
当没有冲突时返回 `true`。

这是 [`ConflictReport::is_clear`] 的惯用拼写，二者始终一致。

items.name: is_clear
items.doc:
Returns `true` when there are no conflicts.

A clear report means the schedule is feasible with respect to every
check this crate performs, not that it is optimal.
items.doc_zh:
当没有冲突时返回 `true`。

报告无冲突意味着该计划就本 crate 执行的每项检查而言是可行的，
并不意味着它最优。

items.name: has_conflicts
items.doc: Returns `true` when there is at least one conflict.
items.doc_zh: 当至少存在一个冲突时返回 `true`。

items.name: count_of
items.signature: pub fn count_of(&self, kind: ConflictKind) -> usize {
items.doc: Returns the number of conflicts of one kind.
items.doc_zh: 返回某一类别的冲突数量。

items.name: of_kind
items.signature: pub fn of_kind(&self, kind: ConflictKind) -> Vec<&Conflict> {
items.doc: Returns the conflicts of one kind, in time order.
items.doc_zh: 返回某一类别的冲突，按时间排序。

items.name: conflicting_tasks
items.doc:
Returns the tasks involved in at least one conflict.

A task appears once even when it has several conflicts, which is what
a repair pass wants: the set of tasks to reconsider.
items.doc_zh:
返回至少卷入一个冲突的任务。

同一任务即使有多个冲突也只出现一次，这正是一个修复轮所需：待重新
考虑的任务集合。

items.name: offered_tasks
items.doc: Returns the number of tasks that were offered to the schedule.
items.doc_zh: 返回提交给该计划的任务数量。

items.name: placed_tasks
items.doc: Returns the number of tasks that were placed.
items.doc_zh: 返回已被放置的任务数量。

items.name: summary
items.doc: Returns a one line summary of the report.
items.doc_zh: 返回该报告的单行摘要。

items.name: Precedence
items.doc: A precedence constraint: one task must finish before another starts.
items.doc_zh: 一条优先约束：一个任务必须先于另一个开始而完成。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(before: TaskId, after: TaskId) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a precedence constraint.
items.doc_zh: 创建一条优先约束。

items.name: placements_of
items.signature: pub fn placements_of(schedule: &Schedule, task: TaskId) -> Option<&apsis_schedule::Placement> {
items.doc: Returns the placements of a task, which is at most one.
items.doc_zh: 返回某任务的放置，至多一处。

items.name: detect
items.signature: pub fn detect(schedule: &Schedule, tasks: &[Task], resources: &ResourceSet) -> ConflictReport {
items.doc:
Returns every conflict in a schedule.

The checks are performed in full: the report contains every problem found,
not just the first. That is deliberate, because a planner that is handed a
plan usually wants to know how bad it is before deciding whether to repair
or rebuild.

The checks are:

- every placement's task exists in the list, and the durations agree;
- every placement falls inside its task's window;
- no resource exceeds its capacity at any instant;
- every placement falls inside the availability windows of each resource
  it requires.

The resource sweep examines the boundaries of the placements, because the
total demand on a resource is constant between them, so the check is exact
and takes time proportional to the number of placements rather than to the
length of the plan.
items.doc_zh:
返回计划中的所有冲突。

检查是完整执行的：报告包含所有发现的问题，而非只有首个。这是有意
的，因为拿到一份计划的规划器通常希望先知道它有多糟，再决定修复还是
重建。

检查项为：

- 每处放置的任务都在列表中，且时长一致；
- 每处放置都落在其任务窗口内；
- 任何瞬时没有资源超出其容量；
- 每处放置都落在其所要求的每个资源的可用窗口内。

资源扫掠检查各放置的边界，因为资源上的总需求在相邻边界之间恒定，
故该检查是精确的，耗时正比于放置数而非计划长度。

items.name: detect_precedence
items.doc:
Returns the precedence conflicts among a set of constraints.

A precedence conflict occurs when the task that must come second starts
before the one that must come first has finished. A constraint whose
tasks are not both placed is not a conflict, because nothing has been
promised about them.

The constraints are checked as given, so they must be acyclic. A cycle is
a contradiction in the caller's own model and is not detected here.
items.doc_zh:
返回一组约束中的优先冲突。

当本应居次的任务在应居首者完成之前开始，即为优先冲突。若某约束的两
个任务未被同时放置，则不构成冲突，因为对它们未作任何承诺。

约束按给定形式检查，故必须无环。环是调用方自身模型中的矛盾，此处
不予检测。

crates.name: apsis-schedule
crates.summary_zh:
调度的表示与评估。

调度是调度器所产生的答案：对每个任务，它何时运行以及在哪些资源上运行。本
crate 保存该答案并评估它。它不决定放置，那是 `apsis-scheduler` 的事；把二者
分开，使一个调度可以从文件读取、由调度器产生，或手工书写，并以相同方式评估。

一处放置记录任务、其开始时间，以及它所持有的资源。放置时各资源会针对任务的需求
检查，故调度无法描述一个运行在它并未请求的资源上的任务。

评估报告操作员对已完成计划所问的：放置了多少任务、每种资源在其最繁忙时被用去
多少，以及可用时间实际花去多少。这些数字正是规划器在候选调度之间比较的。

items.name: ScheduleErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a schedule error.
items.doc_zh: 计划错误的类别。

items.name: ScheduleError
items.doc: A failure while building or evaluating a schedule.
items.doc_zh: 构建或评估计划时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: Placement
items.doc: One task placed on the schedule.
items.doc_zh: 计划上放置的一个任务。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub const fn new(task: TaskId, start: f64, duration: f64) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates a placement.
items.doc_zh: 创建一次放置。

items.name: end
items.doc: Returns the end time of the placement, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回放置的结束时刻，单位为秒。

items.name: covers
items.signature: pub fn covers(&self, time: f64) -> bool {
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the placement covers an instant.

The interval is half-open, so a placement covers its start and not its
end. That convention lets two back to back placements share a boundary
without overlapping.
items.doc_zh:
当该放置覆盖某瞬时返回 `true`。

区间是半开的，故放置含其起点而不含其终点。该约定使两个首尾相接的
放置可共享边界而不重叠。

items.name: overlaps
items.doc: Returns `true` when the placement overlaps another.
items.doc_zh: 当该放置与另一个放置重叠时返回 `true`。

items.name: is_valid
items.doc: Returns `true` when the placement is usable.
items.doc_zh: 当该放置可用时返回 `true`。

items.name: ResourceUsage
items.doc: How much of one resource a schedule uses.
items.doc_zh: 一份计划对某个资源的使用情况。

items.name: utilisation
items.signature: pub fn utilisation(&self, interval_seconds: f64) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the utilisation of the resource over an interval.

The value is the busy time divided by the length of the interval. It
is a time utilisation, not a capacity utilisation: a resource that is
only half occupied by demand still counts as busy.

Returns `None` when the interval is not positive.
items.doc_zh:
返回该资源在某区间上的利用率。

其值为忙碌时长除以区间长度。这是时间利用率而非容量利用率：仅被
需求占据一半的资源同样算作忙碌。

区间非正时返回 `None`。

items.name: Evaluation
items.doc: The evaluation of a whole schedule.
items.doc_zh: 整份计划的评估结果。

items.name: makespan
items.doc:
Returns the length of the planning horizon the schedule covers, in
seconds.

This is the time from the earliest start to the latest end, which is
the makespan of the plan.
items.doc_zh:
返回该计划覆盖的规划时域长度，单位为秒。

它是从最早开始到最晚结束的时间，即该计划的 makespan。

items.name: fill_rate
items.doc:
Returns the fraction of the offered tasks that were placed.

Returns `None` when no tasks were offered.
items.doc_zh:
返回所提交任务中被放置的比例。

没有提交任务时返回 `None`。

items.name: is_complete
items.doc: Returns `true` when every offered task was placed.
items.doc_zh: 当所有提交任务均被放置时返回 `true`。

items.name: usage_of
items.signature: pub fn usage_of(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Option<&ResourceUsage> {
items.doc: Returns the usage of one resource.
items.doc_zh: 返回某个资源的使用情况。

items.name: Schedule
items.doc:
A set of task placements.

The schedule stores placements in the order they were made and keeps an
index from task to placement, so that a lookup by task is direct. A task
may be placed at most once: placing it again is an error rather than a
silent overwrite, because a schedule that contains two placements for one
task is not a schedule.
items.doc_zh:
一组任务放置。

该计划按放置发生的顺序保存各项，并维护从任务到放置的索引，故按任务查找
是直接的。一个任务至多放置一次：重复放置是错误而非静默覆盖，因为含有
同一任务两处放置的集合已不是一份计划。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an empty schedule.
items.doc_zh: 创建一份空计划。

items.name: placements
items.doc: Returns the placements in the order they were made.
items.doc_zh: 返回按放置顺序排列的各项。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of placements.
items.doc_zh: 返回放置的数量。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc: Returns `true` when there are no placements.
items.doc_zh: 当没有放置时返回 `true`。

items.name: is_placed
items.signature: pub fn is_placed(&self, task: TaskId) -> bool {
items.doc: Returns `true` when a task has been placed.
items.doc_zh: 当某任务已被放置时返回 `true`。

items.name: placement_of
items.signature: pub fn placement_of(&self, task: TaskId) -> Option<&Placement> {
items.doc: Returns the placement of a task.
items.doc_zh: 返回某任务的放置。

items.name: place
items.signature: pub fn place( &mut self, task: &apsis_task::Task, start: f64, ) -> Result<&Placement, ScheduleError> {
items.doc:
Places a task at a time.

The placement is checked against the task's window. The resources of
the task are recorded with the placement through the task itself, so
this method does not need them; the capacity check is performed by
[`Schedule::validate_capacity`], which needs the resources.

Returns an error when the task is already placed, when the start time
is not finite, or when the placement falls outside the task's window.
items.doc_zh:
把某任务放置在某时刻。

放置会对照该任务的窗口校验。任务的资源通过任务本身随放置一同记录，
故本方法无需它们；容量检查由需要资源的
[`Schedule::validate_capacity`] 完成。

该任务已被放置、起始时刻非有限，或放置落在任务窗口之外时返回错误。

items.name: unplace
items.signature: pub fn unplace(&mut self, task: TaskId) -> Result<Placement, ScheduleError> {
items.doc:
Removes the placement of a task.

Returns an error when the task is not placed.
items.doc_zh:
移除某任务的放置。

该任务未被放置时返回错误。

items.name: placements_on
items.signature: pub fn placements_on( &self, resource: ResourceId, tasks: &[apsis_task::Task], ) -> Vec<Placement> {
items.doc: Returns the placements that use a resource, in time order.
items.doc_zh: 返回使用某资源的放置，按时间排序。

items.name: has_overlapping_placements
items.doc:
Returns `true` when two placements of different tasks overlap.

This checks the schedule against itself, ignoring the resources. Two
tasks on disjoint resources may legitimately overlap, so a caller that
wants to know whether a resource is overbooked should use
[`Schedule::validate_capacity`] instead.
items.doc_zh:
当两个不同任务的放置重叠时返回 `true`。

这是计划与自身的比较，忽略资源。位于不相交资源上的两个任务本就可
以合法重叠，故欲知某资源是否超订的调用方应改用
[`Schedule::validate_capacity`]。

items.name: scheduled_seconds
items.doc: Returns the total placed duration, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回已放置的总时长，单位为秒。

items.name: earliest_start
items.doc:
Returns the earliest start of any placement.

Returns `None` when the schedule is empty.
items.doc_zh:
返回所有放置中最早的开始时刻。

计划为空时返回 `None`。

items.name: latest_end
items.doc:
Returns the latest end of any placement.

Returns `None` when the schedule is empty.
items.doc_zh:
返回所有放置中最晚的结束时刻。

计划为空时返回 `None`。

items.name: validate_capacity
items.signature: pub fn validate_capacity( &self, tasks: &[apsis_task::Task], resources: &apsis_resource::ResourceSet, ) -> Result<(), ScheduleError> {
items.doc:
Validates a schedule against a set of resources.

The check has two parts. First every placement must agree with the
requirements of its task, which catches a schedule built with a
different task list. Then, for each resource, the total demand placed
at any instant must not exceed the capacity.

The second check walks the placement boundaries of each resource in
time order, which is exact because the total demand is constant
between boundaries.

Returns an error describing the first violation.
items.doc_zh:
对照一组资源校验该计划。

检查分两部分。其一，每处放置须与其任务的需求一致，这可捕获用另
一份任务列表建成的计划。其二，对每个资源，任意瞬时的总需求不得超
过容量。

第二部分按时间序遍历各资源的放置边界，由于相邻边界之间总需求恒定，
该遍历是精确的。

返回描述首个违规的错误。

items.name: evaluate
items.signature: pub fn evaluate( &self, tasks: &[apsis_task::Task], resources: &apsis_resource::ResourceSet, ) -> Evaluation {
items.doc:
Evaluates the schedule against a task list and a resource set.

The evaluation reports the counts, the makespan, and the usage of each
resource. The peak demand of a resource is found by the same event
sweep that the capacity check uses, so the two agree.
items.doc_zh:
对照任务列表与资源集合评估该计划。

评估给出各项计数、makespan 以及每个资源的使用情况。资源的峰值
需求由与容量检查相同的事件扫掠求得，故二者一致。

items.name: in_time_order
items.doc:
Returns the schedule sorted by start time, leaving the original alone.

A schedule is stored in the order it was built, which is the order a
scheduler considered the tasks. A caller that wants to read the plan
in time order uses this.
items.doc_zh:
返回按开始时刻排序的计划副本，原计划不变。

计划按其构建顺序存储，即调度器考虑任务的顺序。欲按时间阅读该计
划的调用方使用本方法。

items.name: resource_busy_until
items.signature: pub fn resource_busy_until( &self, resource: ResourceId, tasks: &[apsis_task::Task], time: f64, ) -> Option<f64> {
items.doc:
Returns the time at which a resource becomes free if it is busy at a
given instant.

Returns `None` when the resource is idle there. This is what a
sequential scheduler asks when it looks for the next gap.
items.doc_zh:
若某资源在给定瞬时忙碌，返回其变为空闲的时刻。

该资源在彼处空闲时返回 `None`。顺序调度器寻找下一个空隙时正是
询问这一点。

crates.name: apsis-sim-engine
crates.summary_zh:
离散事件仿真引擎。

引擎通过从一个事件跳到下一个来推进时钟。它保存事件队列、当前仿真时刻，以及调用方
判断一次运行所需的统计。一个事件意味着什么由调用方定义：它提供一个接收该事件并可
再调度更多事件的处理器，而引擎只负责排序各次调用。

引擎保持仿真确定。同一瞬时的事件按它们被调度的次序投递，这是事件队列所保证的，故
相同输入的一次运行产生相同输出。这正是使结果可复现、与另一实现的交叉核对有意义的
原因。

引擎因四种原因之一停止，报告为一个 [`StopReason`]：队列排空、仿真达到其时限、
调用方请求它停止，或达到事件上限。后两者存在，是为了让永远调度事件的模型无法无界
运行。

items.name: Engine
items.doc:
A discrete-event simulation engine.

The engine owns the event queue and the clock. A run repeatedly takes the
earliest event and passes it to a handler, which may schedule more
events. The engine stops when the queue empties or when one of the limits
is reached.
items.doc_zh:
离散事件仿真引擎。

引擎拥有事件队列与时钟。一次运行反复取出最早的事件并交给处理器，
处理器可再调度更多事件。队列排空或达到某个限制时引擎停止。

items.name: new
items.doc:
Creates an engine with the clock at zero and no limits.

An engine with no limits runs until the queue empties, which is the
right default for a model that terminates. A model that schedules
without bound needs a limit, which is set with
[`Engine::with_time_limit`] or [`Engine::with_event_limit`].
items.doc_zh:
创建时钟为零且无限制的引擎。

无限制的引擎一直运行到队列排空，这是会终止的模型的恰当缺省。
无界地调度事件的模型需要限制，可用 [`Engine::with_time_limit`]
或 [`Engine::with_event_limit`] 设置。

items.name: with_time_limit
items.signature: pub const fn with_time_limit(mut self, limit: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Sets the latest simulation time the engine will process.

An event scheduled beyond the limit is left in the queue rather than
executed, so the caller can examine what remained. A limit that is
negative or not finite disables the limit.
items.doc_zh:
设置引擎将处理的最晚仿真时刻。

调度到超出该限制的事件被留在队列中而不执行，使调用方能检查
剩余了哪些。限制为负或非有限时该限制被禁用。

items.name: with_event_limit
items.signature: pub const fn with_event_limit(mut self, limit: u64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Sets the greatest number of events the engine will execute.

A limit of zero disables the rule, because a run that executes no
events is never useful.
items.doc_zh:
设置引擎将执行的事件数上限。

限制为零时该规则被禁用，因为不执行任何事件的运行从无用处。

items.name: now
items.doc: Returns the current simulation time, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回当前仿真时刻，单位为秒。

items.name: set_now
items.signature: pub fn set_now(&mut self, time: f64) {
items.doc:
Sets the current simulation time.

This is used to start a run at an offset, for example at a scenario
epoch rather than at zero. It does not reschedule pending events, so a
caller that moves the clock forward past a pending event will execute
that event late. The engine has no way to detect the mistake, so the
caller is responsible for keeping the clock consistent with the
queue.
items.doc_zh:
设置当前仿真时刻。

用于从某个偏移开始运行，例如从场景历元而非从零开始。它不重排
待处理事件，故把时钟前移越过某待处理事件的调用方会迟执行该
事件。引擎无法检测这一错误，故保持时钟与队列一致是调用方的
责任。

items.name: executed
items.doc: Returns the number of events executed so far.
items.doc_zh: 返回迄今已执行的事件数。

items.name: pending
items.doc: Returns the number of pending events.
items.doc_zh: 返回待处理事件的数量。

items.name: is_idle
items.doc: Returns `true` when no events are pending.
items.doc_zh: 当没有待处理事件时返回 `true`。

items.name: next_time
items.doc: Returns the time of the next pending event, if there is one.
items.doc_zh: 返回下一待处理事件的时间（若存在）。

items.name: state
items.doc: Returns what the engine currently holds.
items.doc_zh: 返回引擎当前所持有的状态。

items.name: schedule
items.signature: pub fn schedule(&mut self, time: f64, payload: T) -> Option<EventId> {
items.doc:
Schedules an event at a time.

Returns the identifier of the new event, or `None` when the time is
not usable.
items.doc_zh:
在某个时刻调度一个事件。

返回新事件的标识符；该时刻不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: schedule_after
items.signature: pub fn schedule_after(&mut self, delay: f64, payload: T) -> Option<EventId> {
items.doc:
Schedules an event at a delay from the current simulation time.

Returns the identifier of the new event, or `None` when the delay is
not usable.
items.doc_zh:
在当前仿真时刻之后某个延时处调度一个事件。

返回新事件的标识符；该延时不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: request_stop
items.doc:
Asks the engine to stop after the current event.

The handler calls this when its own model says the run is over, for
example when a stopping condition that the queue cannot express is
met. The pending events are left in the queue.
items.doc_zh:
请求引擎在当前事件之后停止。

当处理器自身的模型表明运行已结束时调用它，例如当某个队列无法
表达的停止条件被满足时。待处理事件被留在队列中。

items.name: clear_stop
items.doc: Clears the stop request, so that a subsequent run continues.
items.doc_zh: 清除停止请求，使后续运行得以继续。

items.name: clear
items.doc: Removes every pending event and returns how many were discarded.
items.doc_zh: 移除所有待处理事件并返回被丢弃的数量。

items.name: queue
items.doc:
Returns the queue, for a caller that needs to inspect or manipulate it
directly.
items.doc_zh: 返回事件队列，供需要直接查看或操作它的调用方使用。

items.name: queue_mut
items.signature: pub const fn queue_mut(&mut self) -> &mut EventQueue<T> {
items.doc: Returns the queue for modification.
items.doc_zh: 返回事件队列以供修改。

items.name: run
items.signature: pub fn run<F>(&mut self, mut handler: F) -> EngineOutcome where F: FnMut(&mut Engine<T>, Event<T>), {
items.doc:
Runs the engine until it stops.

Each iteration takes the earliest event, advances the clock to its
time, and passes it to the handler. The handler may schedule further
events, including at the same instant, which are delivered after the
events already scheduled for that instant.

Returns the outcome of the run. The clock is left at the time of the
last event executed, not at a limit, so a caller that records the
clock sees the last instant the model actually reached.
items.doc_zh:
运行引擎直到其停止。

每次迭代取出最早的事件，把时钟推进到其时刻，并交给处理器。处理器
可再调度更多事件，包括在同一瞬时的，它们在该瞬时已调度的事件
之后投递。

返回该运行的结果。时钟留在最后执行事件的时间，而非某个限制处，
故记录时钟的调用方看到的是模型实际到达的最后瞬时。

items.name: StopReason
items.doc:
Why a run stopped.

The reason is reported rather than inferred from the event count, because
the same count can arise from an empty queue or from a limit, and a
caller that records the outcome of a run needs to distinguish them.
items.doc_zh:
一次运行停止的原因。

该原因是被报告的，而不是由事件计数推断的，因为同样的计数可能来自
空队列或某个限制，而记录运行结果的调用方需要区分二者。

items.name: is_natural
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the run ended because the model had no more work
to do rather than because a limit intervened.
items.doc_zh: 当运行因模型已无工作而结束、而非因某个限制介入时返回 `true`。

items.name: name
items.doc: Returns a short name for the reason.
items.doc_zh: 返回该原因的简称。

items.name: EngineOutcome
items.doc:
What a run produced.

The outcome records the counts and the clock, so a caller can record the
result of a run without reaching back into the engine.
items.doc_zh:
一次运行所产生的结果。

结果记录各项计数与时钟，使调用方无需回访引擎即可记录一次运行的结果。

items.name: duration
items.doc: Returns the time the run covered, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回该运行所覆盖的时长，单位为秒。

items.name: event_rate
items.doc:
Returns the mean number of events per second of simulation time.

This measures how busy the model is rather than how long the run took
on the wall clock. Returns `None` when the run covered no time.
items.doc_zh:
返回每仿真秒的平均事件数。

它衡量模型的繁忙程度，而非该运行在挂钟上耗时多久。运行未覆盖
任何时间时返回 `None`。

items.name: is_natural
items.doc:
Returns `true` when the run finished because the model had no more
work rather than because a limit stopped it.
items.doc_zh: 当运行因模型已无工作而结束、而非因某个限制而停止时返回 `true`。

items.name: EngineState
items.doc: What the engine currently holds.
items.doc_zh: 引擎当前所持有的状态。

items.name: is_idle
items.doc: Returns `true` when no events are pending.
items.doc_zh: 当没有待处理事件时返回 `true`。

crates.name: apsis-scenario
crates.summary:
Scenario definition and loading.

A scenario is a simulation's initial conditions: the resources a plan may
use, the tasks it must place, the precedence constraints between those
tasks, and the limits the run should respect. It is the input a run is
built from, and keeping it in one place means a run can be reproduced from
a single description rather than reconstructed from scattered arguments.

The crate offers two ways to build one. The builder methods are what Rust
code uses, and they check each addition as it is made. The text format is
what a stored scenario uses, and [`Scenario::parse`] reads it back. The
two agree: a scenario written with [`Scenario::to_text`] parses to an equal
scenario, so a scenario can be stored, edited, and reloaded without drift.

The text format is line oriented and carries no third party dependency. A
blank line and a line whose first non-space character is `#` are ignored.
Every other line is a keyword followed by its arguments:

```text
scenario leo downlink
epoch 0
time_limit 3600
event_limit 1000000

resource 0 capacity 1
window 0 0 600
window 0 1200 1800

task 0 duration 60
task_window 0 100 1000
task_priority 0 5
task_mandatory 0 true
require 0 0 1

precedence 0 1
```

`epoch` is the time the simulation clock starts at, in seconds.
`time_limit` and `event_limit` are the two run limits; either may be
omitted, which leaves that limit unset.

```
use apsis_scenario::Scenario;

let text = "\
scenario demo
resource 0 capacity 1
window 0 0 600
task 0 duration 60
require 0 0 1
";

let scenario = Scenario::parse(text).expect("the text is well formed");
assert_eq!(scenario.name(), "demo");
assert_eq!(scenario.resources().len(), 1);
assert_eq!(scenario.tasks().len(), 1);
assert_eq!(scenario.validate(), Ok(()));
```
crates.summary_zh:
场景的定义与加载。

场景是一次仿真的初始条件：计划可用的资源、必须放置的任务、这些任务之间的先后
约束，以及运行应遵守的限制。它是一次运行所据以构建的输入，把它保存在一处意味着
一次运行可以从单一描述复现，而不必从散落的参数重建。

本 crate 提供两种构建方式。构建器方法是 Rust 代码所用的，它们在每次添加时就检查。
文本格式是存储的场景所用的，[`Scenario::parse`] 把它读回。二者一致：用
[`Scenario::to_text`] 写出的场景解析回相等的场景，故场景可以被存储、编辑并重新
加载而不漂移。

文本格式是面向行的，且不携带第三方依赖。空行与第一个非空格字符为 `#` 的行被忽略。
其余每一行是一个关键字后接其参数：

```text
scenario leo downlink
epoch 0
time_limit 3600
event_limit 1000000

resource 0 capacity 1
window 0 0 600
window 0 1200 1800

task 0 duration 60
task_window 0 100 1000
task_priority 0 5
task_mandatory 0 true
require 0 0 1

precedence 0 1
```

`epoch` 是仿真时钟的起始时刻，单位为秒。`time_limit` 与 `event_limit` 是两个运行
限制；任一个都可省略，那会使该限制不被设置。

items.name: ScenarioErrorKind
items.doc: The category of a scenario error.
items.doc_zh: 场景错误的类别。

items.name: ScenarioError
items.doc: A failure while building, loading, or validating a scenario.
items.doc_zh: 构建、加载或校验场景时发生的失败。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an error with the given category.
items.doc_zh: 用给定类别创建一个错误。

items.name: with_detail
items.signature: pub fn with_detail(mut self, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches a description of the values that caused the failure.
items.doc_zh: 附加对该失败所涉数值的说明。

items.name: with_line
items.signature: pub fn with_line(mut self, line: usize) -> Self {
items.doc: Attaches the one based line number a load failure came from.
items.doc_zh: 附加加载失败所来自的、以 1 为基的行号。

items.name: kind
items.doc: Returns the category of this failure.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败的类别。

items.name: detail
items.doc: Returns the detail text attached to this error, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回附加在该错误上的说明文本，若有。

items.name: line
items.doc: Returns the line number this failure came from, if any.
items.doc_zh: 返回该失败所来自的行号（若有）。

items.name: Scenario
items.doc:
A simulation's initial conditions.

A scenario holds the resources a plan may use, the tasks it must place,
and the constraints between them, together with the limits a run should
respect. It is built either with the builder methods or by parsing text,
and both routes apply the same checks, so a scenario that parses is one
that would have been accepted by the builders.
items.doc_zh:
一次仿真的初始条件。

场景保存计划可用的资源、必须放置的任务、它们之间的约束，以及一次
运行应遵守的限制。它既可用构建器方法构建，也可由文本解析，两条
路径施加相同的检查，故能解析的场景即是构建器会接受的场景。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(name: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
items.doc: Creates an empty scenario with an epoch at zero.
items.doc_zh: 创建历元为零的空场景。

items.name: name
items.doc: Returns the name of the scenario.
items.doc_zh: 返回该场景的名称。

items.name: epoch
items.doc: Returns the time the simulation clock starts at, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回仿真时钟的起始时刻，单位为秒。

items.name: time_limit
items.doc: Returns the latest time the run will process, if one is set.
items.doc_zh: 返回该运行将处理的最晚时刻（若已设置）。

items.name: event_limit
items.doc:
Returns the greatest number of events the run will execute, if one is
set.
items.doc_zh: 返回该运行将执行的事件数上限（若已设置）。

items.name: resources
items.doc: Returns the resources in the order they were added.
items.doc_zh: 按添加次序返回各资源。

items.name: resources_mut
items.doc:
Returns the resources for modification.

A caller that changes a resource is responsible for keeping the
scenario consistent; [`Scenario::validate`] checks it afterwards.
items.doc_zh:
返回各资源以供修改。

修改资源的调用方负责保持场景一致；[`Scenario::validate`] 随后
检查它。

items.name: parse
items.doc:
Reads a scenario from its text form.

The format is described on the crate documentation. A scenario written
with [`Scenario::to_text`] parses back to an equal scenario.
items.doc_zh:
由其文本形式读取场景。

该格式在 crate 文档中描述。用 [`Scenario::to_text`] 写出的场景
解析回相等的场景。

items.name: tasks
items.doc: Returns the tasks in the order they were added.
items.doc_zh: 按添加次序返回各任务。

items.name: precedence
items.doc: Returns the precedence constraints.
items.doc_zh: 返回先后约束。

items.name: with_epoch
items.signature: pub fn with_epoch(mut self, epoch: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Sets the time the simulation clock starts at.

Returns the scenario unchanged in value but not in type; the caller
uses the returned value. The epoch must be finite and non-negative.
items.doc_zh:
设置仿真时钟的起始时刻。

返回的场景值不变而类型改变；调用方使用返回的值。历元必须有限
且非负。

items.name: with_time_limit
items.signature: pub const fn with_time_limit(mut self, limit: f64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Sets the latest time the run will process.

A negative or non-finite limit clears the limit rather than storing
it, matching the engine, which ignores a limit it cannot use.
items.doc_zh:
设置该运行将处理的最晚时刻。

负或非有限的限制清除该限制而非存储它，与引擎一致，后者忽略
它无法使用的限制。

items.name: with_event_limit
items.signature: pub const fn with_event_limit(mut self, limit: u64) -> Self {
items.doc:
Sets the greatest number of events the run will execute.

A limit of zero clears the limit rather than storing it, matching the
engine, which treats zero as no limit.
items.doc_zh:
设置该运行将执行的事件数上限。

限制为零清除该限制而非存储它，与引擎一致，后者把零视为无限制。

items.name: set_epoch
items.signature: pub fn set_epoch(&mut self, epoch: f64) -> Result<(), ScenarioError> {
items.doc: Sets the epoch, reporting a value the clock cannot use.
items.doc_zh: 设置历元，并报告时钟无法使用的值。

items.name: set_time_limit
items.signature: pub fn set_time_limit(&mut self, limit: f64) -> Result<(), ScenarioError> {
items.doc: Sets the time limit, reporting a value a run cannot use.
items.doc_zh: 设置时限，并报告运行无法使用的值。

items.name: add_resource
items.signature: pub fn add_resource(&mut self, resource: Resource) -> Result<(), ScenarioError> {
items.doc:
Adds a resource, reporting one whose identifier is already used.

The resource itself is also checked, so a scenario cannot hold a
resource that a scheduler would refuse.
items.doc_zh:
添加一个资源，并报告标识符已被使用的那种情况。

资源自身也受检查，故场景无法保存调度器会拒绝的资源。

items.name: add_task
items.signature: pub fn add_task(&mut self, task: Task) -> Result<(), ScenarioError> {
items.doc:
Adds a task, reporting one whose identifier is already used.

The task's requirements must name resources the scenario holds, and
the task itself must be usable.
items.doc_zh:
添加一个任务，并报告标识符已被使用的那种情况。

任务的需求必须指名场景所持有的资源，且任务自身必须可用。

items.name: add_precedence
items.signature: pub fn add_precedence(&mut self, before: TaskId, after: TaskId) -> Result<(), ScenarioError> {
items.doc: Adds a precedence constraint, reporting a cycle or a missing task.
items.doc_zh: 添加一条先后约束，并报告成环或缺失任务的情况。

items.name: resource_set
items.doc: Returns the resources as a set, for a scheduler.
items.doc_zh: 返回资源集合，供调度器使用。

items.name: validate
items.doc:
Checks the whole scenario at once.

A scenario built with the builder methods is already checked as it is
built; this is for one that was assembled field by field or read from
text, and it reports the first problem found.
items.doc_zh:
一次性检查整个场景。

用构建器方法构建的场景在构建时已被检查；本方法用于逐字段拼装或
从文本读取的场景，它报告所发现的第一个问题。

items.name: summary
items.doc: Returns a summary of what the scenario holds.
items.doc_zh: 返回场景所持有内容的摘要。

items.name: to_text
items.doc:
Renders the scenario in the text form [`Scenario::parse`] reads.

The output parses to an equal scenario, which is what lets a scenario
be stored and reloaded without drift.
items.doc_zh:
以 [`Scenario::parse`] 所读取的文本形式呈现场景。

输出解析回相等的场景，这正是场景可被存储并重新加载而不漂移的
原因。

items.name: ScenarioSummary
items.doc: What a scenario holds, as counts and totals.
items.doc_zh: 场景所持有的内容，以计数与总计表示。

crates.name: apsis-event
crates.summary_zh:
仿真事件类型与事件队列。

离散事件仿真通过从一个事件跳到下一个来推进，而不是逐步走过每个瞬时。本 crate
提供使之成为可能的队列：一个按时间排序的优先队列，并在落在同一瞬时的各事件之间
有明确定义的次序。

该并列打破规则比它初看更重要。为同一瞬时调度的两个事件必须以可重复的次序投递，
否则仿真每次运行都会产生不同结果，与另一实现的交叉核对也不可能。故每个事件携带
一个在调度时赋予的序号，时间相等的事件按该序号排序，故该次序即它们被调度的次序。
这是每个离散事件仿真器所用的约定。

时间以距仿真起点的秒数计，故队列对日历与时标一无所知。

items.name: EventId
items.doc:
An identifier for a scheduled event.

The identifier combines the time at which the event is due with the order
in which it was scheduled. Two events that fall at the same instant are
therefore distinguishable, which is what makes the delivery order
repeatable.
items.doc_zh:
已调度事件的标识符。

该标识符把事件到期的时刻与其被调度的次序结合起来。因此落在同一
瞬时的两个事件可区分，这正是投递次序可重复的原因。

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new(time: f64, sequence: u64) -> Option<Self> {
items.doc:
Creates an identifier from a time and a sequence number.

The time must be finite and non-negative. A caller that has a time
outside that range cannot use this type, which is deliberate: a
simulation clock that goes backwards or becomes infinite has no
meaningful order.
items.doc_zh:
由时刻与序号创建标识符。

该时刻必须有限且非负。时刻超出该范围的调用方无法使用本类型，
这是有意为之：倒退或趋于无限的仿真时钟没有有意义的次序。

items.name: time
items.doc: Returns the scheduled time, in seconds.
items.doc_zh: 返回调度时刻，单位为秒。

items.name: sequence
items.doc: Returns the order in which the event was scheduled.
items.doc_zh: 返回该事件被调度的次序。

items.name: Event
items.doc:
One scheduled event.

The payload is the caller's: it names what should happen. The queue does
not interpret it, so the same queue serves any model.
items.doc_zh:
一个已调度的事件。

载荷属于调用方：它指明应发生什么。队列不解释它，故同一队列可服务
任何模型。

items.name: is_due
items.signature: pub fn is_due(&self, now: f64) -> bool {
items.doc: Returns `true` when the event is due at or before a time.
items.doc_zh: 当该事件在某时刻或之前到期时返回 `true`。

items.name: with_payload
items.signature: pub fn with_payload<U>(self, payload: U) -> Event<U> {
items.doc: Returns a copy of this event with a different payload.
items.doc_zh: 返回本事件的一个具有不同载荷的副本。

items.name: reschedule
items.signature: pub fn reschedule(&self, time: f64, sequence: u64) -> Option<Event<T>> where T: Clone, {
items.doc:
Returns a copy of this event scheduled at a different time.

Returns `None` when the new time is not usable, which leaves the
original event available for the caller to keep using.
items.doc_zh:
返回本事件的一个调度在不同时刻的副本。

新时刻不可用时返回 `None`，此时原事件仍可供调用方继续使用。

items.name: QueueState
items.doc:
What the queue currently holds.

The state is exposed so that a simulation loop can decide whether to
advance the clock or to stop without popping an event first.
items.doc_zh:
队列当前所持有的状态。

该状态被公开，使仿真循环无需先弹出一个事件即可决定是推进时钟还是
停止。

items.name: is_idle
items.doc: Returns `true` when no events are pending.
items.doc_zh: 当没有待处理事件时返回 `true`。

items.name: EventQueue
items.doc:
A priority queue of events ordered by time and then by schedule order.

The queue assigns the sequence numbers, so a caller cannot accidentally
create two events with the same identifier. Sequence numbers start at
zero and increase by one with every event scheduled, including events
scheduled from inside the handling of another event.
items.doc_zh:
按时间、再按调度次序排序的事件优先队列。

序号由队列分配，故调用方无法意外创建两个具有相同标识符的事件。
序号从零开始，每个被调度的事件（包括在另一事件处理过程中调度的
事件）都使之加一。

items.name: new
items.doc: Creates an empty queue.
items.doc_zh: 创建一个空队列。

items.name: len
items.doc: Returns the number of pending events.
items.doc_zh: 返回待处理事件的数量。

items.name: is_empty
items.doc: Returns `true` when no events are pending.
items.doc_zh: 当没有待处理事件时返回 `true`。

items.name: delivered
items.doc: Returns the number of events delivered so far.
items.doc_zh: 返回迄今已投递的事件数。

items.name: state
items.doc: Returns what the queue currently holds.
items.doc_zh: 返回队列当前所持有的状态。

items.name: next_time
items.doc:
Returns the time of the earliest pending event.

Returns `None` when the queue is empty.
items.doc_zh:
返回最早待处理事件的时间。

队列为空时返回 `None`。

items.name: schedule
items.signature: pub fn schedule(&mut self, time: f64, payload: T) -> Option<EventId> {
items.doc:
Schedules an event at a time.

The sequence number is assigned by the queue, so the delivery order
among events at the same instant is the order they were scheduled.

Returns the identifier of the new event, or `None` when the time is
not usable: a simulation clock runs forward from zero, so a negative
or non-finite time is refused rather than stored.
items.doc_zh:
在某个时刻调度一个事件。

序号由队列分配，故同一瞬时各事件之间的投递次序即它们被调度的
次序。

返回新事件的标识符；时刻不可用时返回 `None`：仿真时钟从零向前
运行，故负或非有限的时刻被拒绝而非存储。

items.name: schedule_after
items.signature: pub fn schedule_after(&mut self, now: f64, delay: f64, payload: T) -> Option<EventId> {
items.doc:
Schedules an event at a time relative to a base instant.

This is the form a handler uses when it schedules a follow-up: the
delay is relative to the current simulation time.

Returns `None` when the resulting time is not usable.
items.doc_zh:
在相对于某基准瞬时的时刻调度一个事件。

这是处理器调度后续事件时所用的形式：延时相对于当前仿真时刻。

所得时刻不可用时返回 `None`。

items.name: pop
items.doc:
Removes and returns the earliest event.

Returns `None` when the queue is empty. The payload is taken from the
queue, so the slot is left empty; scheduling a later event reuses the
slot.
items.doc_zh:
取出并返回最早的事件。

队列为空时返回 `None`。载荷被取离队列，故该槽位被留空；调度
后续事件会复用该槽位。

items.name: peek
items.doc:
Returns a reference to the payload of the earliest event without
removing it.
items.doc_zh: 返回最早事件载荷的引用而不移除它。

items.name: clear
items.doc:
Removes every pending event and returns how many were discarded.

The delivered count is left alone, because it records history rather
than queue contents.
items.doc_zh:
移除所有待处理事件并返回被丢弃的数量。

已投递计数保持不变，因为它记录的是历史而非队列内容。

items.name: drain
items.doc:
Returns every pending event in delivery order, leaving the queue
empty.

The order is the order the events would have been delivered in, which
is what a caller wants when it records the remaining schedule at the
end of a run.
items.doc_zh:
按投递次序返回所有待处理事件，并使队列为空。

该次序即各事件本会被投递的次序，这正是调用方在运行结束时记录
剩余调度所需的。

crates.name: apsis-output
crates.summary:
Simulation output recording.

A simulation produces more output than a caller can act on at once: event
times, the values a model computes as it runs, and the warnings it raises.
This crate collects those into one trace, so that a run can be examined
after it finishes rather than only as it happens.

A record has a time, a kind, a label, and a value. The time is the
simulation instant the record was made at, which is what makes a trace
orderable and joinable against the event log. The kind separates the three
things a caller usually wants to tell apart: an observation the model made,
a state change it decided on, and a warning it wants to surface. The label
names what the value is about, and the value is a single number, which
covers the great majority of what a simulation records without imposing a
schema the caller has to design.

The trace keeps the records in the order they were made, not in time order.
That distinction matters: a handler may record a value for an event it is
handling after recording one for a follow-up it just scheduled, and the
order the model reasoned in is worth keeping. A caller that wants time
order asks for it with [`Trace::in_time_order`].

```
use apsis_output::{Recorder, RecordKind};

let mut recorder = Recorder::new();
recorder.observe(10.0, "altitude", 550.0);
recorder.note(10.0, "eclipse", 1.0);

assert_eq!(recorder.len(), 2);
assert!(recorder.trace().is_stable());
assert_eq!(recorder.trace().value_of("altitude"), Some(550.0));
let _ = RecordKind::Warning;
```
crates.summary_zh:
仿真输出记录。

一次仿真产生的输出多到调用方无法一次全部处理：事件时刻、模型运行时计算的值，以及
它提出的警告。本 crate 把这些收集进一条轨迹，使一次运行可以在结束后被检视，而不
只在发生时。

一条记录有一个时刻、一个类别、一个标签与一个值。时刻是作出该记录时的仿真瞬时，
这正是使轨迹可排序、可与事件日志连接的原因。类别区分了调用方通常想分辨的三件事：
模型作出的观测、它决定的变更，以及它想揭示的警告。标签指明该值所关于的内容，而
值是一个单数，这覆盖了一次仿真所记录的绝大多数内容，而不强加调用方必须设计的
模式。

轨迹保持记录在它们被作出的次序，而非时间次序。该区别要紧：处理器可能先为它刚
调度的后续事件记录了一个值，再为它正在处理的事件记录一个值，而模型推理所用的
次序值得保留。想要时间次序的调用方用 [`Trace::in_time_order`] 索取。

crates.name: apsis-sim
crates.summary_zh:
整合仿真层的仿真门面。

本 crate 是仿真层的单一入口。它把四部分联系起来：[`Scenario`] 描述初始条件，
ops 层为其作计划，引擎运行所得时间线，[`Recorder`] 收集该运行所产生的。

调用方所遵循的序列很短：

1. [`Simulation::prepare`] 检查场景并为其作计划，产生一个调度。
2. [`Simulation::start`] 把该调度转为由开始与结束事件构成的时间线，并交回一个
   [`Session`]。
3. [`Session::run`] 驱动引擎，在每个事件处调用一个处理器，并返回一个
   [`RunReport`]，其中含有引擎结果与轨迹。

该计划是贪心启发式，在 `apsis-scheduler` 中有述，故一次运行可能留下未放置的任务。
门面报告这一点而非隐藏它：[`Simulation::plan`] 公开完整规划结果，而
[`Simulation::has_full_plan`] 直接回答那个常见的问题。

时间线是调度而非物理模型。任务开始时触发一个开始事件，结束时触发一个结束事件，
这正是调用方随时间记录状态所需的；处理器提供该运行所需的任何物理或簿记。

items.name: Activity
items.doc:
One thing that happens in the timeline.

The timeline is derived from a schedule: a placed task contributes a start
and an end, and the handler is called at each. The two are separate events
rather than one interval so that the engine orders them with everything
else on the clock, which is what lets two tasks overlap correctly.
items.doc_zh:
时间线上发生的一件事。

时间线由一个调度导出：一处被放置的任务贡献一个开始与一个结束，
处理器在每个处被调用。二者是分开的事件而非一个区间，使引擎把它们
与时钟上其余一切一起排序，这正是让两个任务正确重叠的原因。

items.doc_zh: 创建一个开始活动。

items.doc: Creates an end activity.

再调度更多事件；引擎把它们与时间线一起按时间次序投递。

items.name: record
items.signature: pub fn record( &mut self, time: f64, kind: RecordKind, label: impl Into<String>, value: f64, ) -> bool {
items.doc: Records a value of a given kind without running anything.
items.doc_zh: 记录给定类别的一个值而不运行任何东西。

items.name: Simulation
items.doc:
A scenario prepared for a run.

A simulation holds the scenario, the plan that was made from it, and the
timeline that plan implies. Preparing is separate from running so that a
caller can inspect the plan, and reject it, before a run commits to it.
items.doc_zh:
为一次运行准备好的场景。

仿真保存场景、由其作出的计划，以及该计划所蕴含的时间线。准备与运行
分开，使调用方可以在运行承诺之前检查该计划并拒绝它。

items.name: prepare
items.signature: pub fn prepare(scenario: Scenario) -> Result<Self, SimulationError> {
items.doc:
Checks a scenario and plans it.

The scenario is validated, the tasks are planned against the
resources, and the resulting schedule is turned into a timeline of
start and end events. The plan is greedy, so a scenario may be
prepared successfully and still leave tasks unplaced; that is reported
by [`Simulation::has_full_plan`] rather than being an error.
items.doc_zh:
检查场景并为其作计划。

场景被校验，任务针对资源被规划，所得调度被转为由开始与结束事件
构成的时间线。该计划是贪心的，故场景可能被成功准备却仍留下未
放置的任务；这由 [`Simulation::has_full_plan`] 报告，而不是当作
错误。

items.name: from_plan
items.signature: pub fn from_plan( scenario: Scenario, result: SchedulingResult, ) -> Result<Self, SimulationError> {
items.doc:
Builds a simulation from an already planned result.

This is for a caller that has planned with its own settings and wants
the rest of the facade: the timeline and the run loop. The result must
belong to the scenario, which is checked.
items.doc_zh:
由已规划好的结果构建仿真。

这适用于已用自己的设置完成规划、只想要外观其余部分的调用方：时间
线与运行循环。该结果必须属于该场景，这一点会被检查。

items.doc_zh: 返回场景。

items.name: timeline
items.doc:
Returns the timeline as time and activity pairs, in time order.

Each placed task contributes a start and an end. Ties are ordered so
that an end precedes a start at the same instant, which lets two back
to back tasks share a boundary without the reader seeing them overlap.
items.doc_zh:
按时间次序返回时间与活动对的列表。

每处被放置的任务贡献一个开始与一个结束。并列情形按结束先于开始
排序，使两个前后相接的任务可共享一个边界而读者不会看到它们
重叠。

items.name: activity_count

items.doc_zh: 当每条先后约束都被满足时返回 `true`。

items.doc_zh: 返回因时间不足而未被放置的任务。

items.name: start
items.doc:
Starts a run.

The returned session owns its own engine and recorder, so several
sessions may run from one prepared simulation without interfering. The
clock starts at the scenario epoch and the run limits come from the
scenario.
items.doc_zh:
开始一次运行。

返回的会话拥有自己的引擎与记录器，故多个会话可从同一个已准备
仿真运行而互不干扰。时钟从场景历元开始，运行限制来自场景。
